tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so//

phag gru'i gsung ltar bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len rdo rje ye shes kyi zhu chos// 202) dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin/ bde ba dang legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ spyir ngas chos thos pa dang bsam pa ni ma byas/ shes rab che lo/ chos mkhas lo/ gang dang yang mi 'dra lo bya ba la sogs pa'i lo 'dod pa'i bsam pa yang ma mchis/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung 'di tsug gis bya ba rdog po re re la lo zla ba mang po 'gor bas/ rang la nyams su myong ba bag tsam skyes pa de yi ger bri ba dang*/ tshig tu brjod pa shin tu 'phangs kyang*/ khyed dge 'dun rnams kyis nga la yon tan nam cig yod du ston nas/ shin tu thag ring po nas sdug bsngal dang dka' las la ma bltas nas 'ongs pa dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad ci yod nga'i phyogs su btang ba dang*/ mi chos dang lha chos gang la yang ma bltas par nga rang 'ba' zhig la bsam pa shin tu mang bar 'dug pa dang*/ nga rang yang sa mtha'i ldom bu bar song*/ sus kyang bshes mi dang phan 'dogs mi ni med/ byes sa'i mthar shi na yang 'bu sbrang shi ba dang ni 'dra/ yon tan rin po che 'dod pa'i gdung ba drag po ni yod/ bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la 'gag dang nya ga myong ba'i thog nas dris na yang*/ 'di 'di tsug 'dod bya ba 'dod lugs mang po bshad pa ma gtogs pa/ 'di tsug byas nas 'di tsug 'ong bya ba gsung ba yang dka' bar 'dug bar chad dang gnod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gis ni gtses/ mdze nad drag po man chad nad dang sdug bsngal mang po yang nyams su blangs/ gcig pur gnyis su med par dka' ba yang nyams su blangs pas/ rang gis skyid sdug mang po nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas snying rje drag po skyes nas/

rang gis nyams su myong ba ci yod tshad yi ger btab pa 'di rnams kyis nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can phyogs dang ris med pa thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob kyang ci ma rung ste/ thob par yang shog cig sgom chen rnams kyis kyang 'di nga'i bla ma yin/ rdzun yang mi bzlo/ zhe 'dod kyang med snyam nas/ nyams su len par yang shog cig nyams su blangs pas skyon dang yon tan ngo shes nas/ skyon mtha' dag ni dag yon tan thams cad ni mtha' dag rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog cig spyir rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs shing*/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nam mkha' lta bur gyur nas/ rang skyid dang gzhan skyid thams cad 'byung bar 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas/ dus da lta phan chad du tshig don gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ tshong 'dus kyi 'o mar ma song*/ tshig dang tha snyad kyis ma bslad pa nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'o na de gang yin snyam na/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyang 'ching ba/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs kyang 'ching ba zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ thabs dang shes rab rkang gnyis gshog pa brkyang*// gar 'dod sar phyin bde ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ thabs dang shes rab ya ma bral bar nyams su blang bar bya'o// de yang spyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang thabs dang shes rab ya bral na gang yin mi 'grub par dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ da res rang nyid nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas nas/

theg pa chen po'i thabs dang shes rab rnam pa gnyis nyams su len lugs cung zad cig brjod par bya yi/ de la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar bzhed de/ de yang mdor bsdu na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa la thabs dang shes rab ces zer ba yin/ thabs kun rdzob 'dus byas kyi chos/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang byed pa thams cad yin/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor gnas pa yin/ de la mi mthun phyogs gegs dang bar chad kyi dbang du byas pas/ spyir kun rdzob tsam/ sgos khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mtha' dag bskyed par byed pa'i gzhi/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po rnam pa gsum mam/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug pa rnam bzhis rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i las de stong nyid bsgoms pas/ myur du rnam par smin par 'gyur bas/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal shig dmag dang*/ na tsha'i rigs mi 'dra ba mang po dang*/ gsod pa dang*/ sgom chen bzang po su bas kyang btsun pa de la bu smad can du 'gyur ba dang*/ sgom yod kyang smyo ba dang*/ shes pa 'khrul pa la sogs pa mang po 'byung ste/ dpon 'jong ber shi ka na shes pa 'khrul nas shi ba la/ bla ma rin po che la kho la sgom med dam zhus pas/ sgom lta yod de kho bo mi mang po skyong bas bya byed shin tu mang la/ re 'khrul snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa zhig byung bas cis kyang de ltar mi 'gyur kha med pa yin gsung ba dang*// 'dir mang smras pas ci zhig bya// gnas brtan chen po mo'u 'gal bu// rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mchog yin yang*// phyi rol mu stegs byed kyis bsad// dgra bcom rang sangs rgyas rnams la// 'di 'dra dpag tu med pa zhig

/bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// ston pa bdag nyid chen pos gsungs// su zhig 'di la the tshom za/ des na sbyin pa ma btang na ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi rdzogs pas bar du chod/ tshul khrims ma bsrung na ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi rdzogs pas bar du chod/ bzod pa ma bsgom na ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi rdzogs pas bar du chod/ brtson 'grus ma brtsam na ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi rdzogs pas bar du chod/ bsam gtan ma bsgom na ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi rdzogs pas bar du chod/ de rnams ma rdzogs na rdzogs pa'i byang chub ji ltar yang thob ste shin tu yang mi thob kyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna dang*/ 'chal ba dang*/ khong khro ba dang*/ le lo dang sems rnam par g.yeng bas nying sha nying gis za zhing*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis smod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa skyon dang bar du gcod par 'gyur bas/ thabs pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lngas rang gi rgyud gong du sbyangs nas byang chub kyi sems dang dbyer med pa'i 'bras bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyis myur du smin par byas nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung 'jug tu bsags nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shes bya'i sgrib pa bcom ste/ rang don shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de thabs kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu/ yon tan gzugs sku gnyis kyi gzhi rten byed pa ma yin nam snyam du bsam par bya'o// de ltar bsams nas dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las gang byas shing bsags pa de da lta nyid du rang la smin cing 'byung bar stong nyid kyis byed pas/ dang po kho nar byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa brtan par byas nas/ brtan pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don par byed pa ni 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems/

byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs te/ de yang dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum yin la/ dang po dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gis bsdus shing lus pa med pa la bslab par bya ba dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims spyir rang gi dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byed tshad rang nyid thed la btang nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du dam bcas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas mgo dang rkang lag lus longs spyod thams cad kyis smin pa dang grol bar byed pa ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi sdom pa dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu las sdom pa'i tshul khrims su bzhag bslab btus nas nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las bstan pa rnams gtsor gsungs/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa yan chad/ sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams su gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes gsungs pas/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa man chad la dam bcar 'jug par 'dug ste/ de ltar de ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims so// de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa 'dis rgyud shin tu smin cing 'byongs par gyur nas/ gzod stong pa nyid kyi don bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed// ces pa'i don gong du smon 'jug gnyis la bsam pa brtan por ma gyur pas/

stong nyid theg pa chen po yin lo ba'i tshig gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ tshul khrims la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang stong nyid kyi 'bras bu smin rgyu med thog tu/ mi dge ba'i 'bras bu mi 'dod pa sna tshogs smin nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis smad pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang*/ tshe thung ba dang nad mang ba 'ong bar 'dug de la yang sgom chen gsar pa song ba dang*/ bla ma la mos gus chung bas gong ma'i rjes su ma 'brangs par/ sdig pa phyag rgya chen pos sbyong snyam nas/ sngon 'gro med par cig car btab pas en tsam nyams su myong ba skyes pa dang dus mnyam du stag ro g.yag ror song nas shi ba la sogs pa nyes pa sna tshogs byung ste/ de yang don gyis byas pas rdo rje'i ri 'khor yug dang bcas pa bong bu ri bong gi thog tu bzhag pas shi ba ma gtogs pa lam med pa dang 'dra ba yin 'dug 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa des ni/ tshe snga ma phan chad la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las tshan po che byas pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ nad dang gdon tshan po ches zin pa rnams dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ sdig po che rnams la ni/ nyes pa thams cad sor chud par byed pa'i thabs rten 'brel du ming btags pa mang po dang*/ tshogs gsog pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis rgyud smin par byas nas/ gzod phyag rgya chen po ston par mdzad kyi/ de'i gong du bsgom la ngang thung ba rnams la yang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po de thog tu 'jog par mi mdzad kyi/ thun 'jog dang a ro ma dang dmigs pa'i bye brag mang po la phyag rgya chen por ming btags kyin ston pa dang*/ yang kho bos khyed la rmi lam du bstan pa de yin mod gsung zhing*/

tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong thabs kyi sgo nas mdzad cing*/ sgrib pa byang ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma thon nas gzod phyag rgya chen po ston par mdzad pas/ da ni nged bla ma rin po che'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// 'di de khyed rang mkhas 'dod kyis// lung dang rigs pa bsgrigs pa las// nyams su myong ba med snyam na// 'di ltar smras pa 'di dag kun// rang nyid nyams su myong ba yin// spun gnyis po yi lo rgyus dang*// gzhan yang dpag tu med pa yod// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// dge dang mi dge'i bsam pa yis// sa bon grung po gang yin pa// mtho dman zhing la btab pa de// sgom pa'i dus kyis smin pa yin// de ltar min na rtogs tshod kyis// yon tan gong du mi 'phel te// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan 'gyur// gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*// sog ma med dang yar lung pa'i// dpe la sogs pa dpag med gsungs// des na rang skyid 'dod pa rnams// byang chub sems kyi sa bon gyis// kha zad gre ba ral ral du// rtag tu khyed la smras pa yin// bsod nams tshogs bsags bstan pa yis// 'bras bu stong pa nyid kyis dbyung*// de ltar bsod nams tshogs de shin tu gal che bar yang nas yang du bsnan nas gal che bar bshad na/ yul gang la rten gyi gang zag gang gis/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar gsog pa ni/ yul dkon mchog rin po che rnam gsum/ rten gyi gang zag sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa/ tshul lam thabs yul gsum dang ma 'gal bar gsog ste/ de yang dang por gzhi cher so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni dge 'dun la brten cing dge 'dun gzhi che bas/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba mtha' dag dge 'dun gyis 'grub par bstan pas/ nyes pa dang ltung ba bshags pa'i yul dge 'dun gzhi che ba dang*/ tshogs gsog pa'i yul rgan pa la bkur bsti dang*/ rim gro bya ba dpag tu med pa gsung shing*/

bcas pa dge 'dun gtso bor gyur pa yin pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni chos gtso bor gyur pa yin te/ lus ngag yid gsum stong pa nyid dang snying rje 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang zhing stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bsam pa tshad mar gyur pa las/ lus ngag gi bya ba mtho dman mang po zhig tshad mar ni mi byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa dang*/ yang*/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces so// gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ni sangs rgyas gtso bor gyur pa ste/ sku rnam pa gsum las sprul pa'i sku bskyed pa'i rim pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan ma can gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ chos kyi sku mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rgyu'i dus na sems can thams cad sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa bla ma dam pa'i dbang gis ngo sprad/ lam du bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi tshul gyis nyams su blangs/ 'bras bu sku gsum gyi ngo bor sangs rgyas/ gsang sngags pa ci byed kyang yi dam lha yi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar byed pa yin pas so// de yang sdom pa gsum ldan du shugs kyis 'ong bas/ sems 'dul ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan par lung rnams su dam bcas nas/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la yang 'du shes gtso bo dang*/ stong nyid snying rje 'ba' zhig gis bsam par gyur na so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba med pa dang*/ de 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi skur nges na 'og ma gang dang yang 'gal lam/ 'gal na ni lung dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ba mang ngo*// de gsum gyi byed pa po'am bdag po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa'i zhing*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad skyed par byed pa'i gzhi/ 'khor ba dang ngan song dang nyes pa thams cad las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer chen por 'gro ba'i ded dpon/

dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi ngo bo bla ma yin pas/ skad cig kyang bral ba'i thabs med par/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang*/ gsang sngags mtha' dag nas bshad pas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bla ma dam pa la brten par nges pa kho na yin no// de ltar theg pa chen po mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa thabs shes rab rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du nyams su blang ba/ rang nyid nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas ji ltar nyams su blang ba bstan nas/ da ni gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa nyams su blang ba'i man ngag ston te/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ gsang sngags pha rol phyin pa la// brten nas byang chub bsgrub bo zhes// bla ma sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ snying po lta bu'i rgyud dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rgyud nas kyang*/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes pa nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes dgyes pa'i rdo rje bslab// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ dang po sa gzhi dang 'dra bar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pas rgyud 'byongs par gyur pa'i rten gyi gang zag dbang po rab tu gyur pa des/ gzod gsang sngags kyi theg pa bslab par bya yi/ de ltar ma byas shing dus deng sang nged rang gi ltar nyon mongs pas nyen pa'i snyad gsang sngags la btags shing*/ snam bu bor tshong rang nyid rdo rje dmyal bar rang gis bskyur ba 'di/ rang nyid la rang nyid snying yang mi rje'am/ kye rnal 'byor pa rnams nga'i bla mas ni 'di ltar gsungs te/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas ni nyon mongs pa rags rim spong la/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pas ni nyon mongs pa phra ba'i phra ba spong pas/ sngags dang mtshan nyid gnyis char yang spang bya nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa spong ba yang gcig

thob bya sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ldan pa de thob par yang gcig mos gus dang brtson 'grus rab tu gyur na/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas par yang 'dra gsung bas/ nged rang rnams bla ma rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ sdom pa gsum ldan du bya ste/ de yang rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i ming gis sdom pa gsum ldan du mi bya la/ snying nas sdom pa gsum dang ldan par byas la/ da gzod gsang sngags bsgrub par bya'o// de la spyir gsang sngags/ sgos rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi brjod bya nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa yin/ khyad par 'dod chags lam du byed pa yin/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang mi mthun/ 'di phan tshun dngos 'gal yin snyam na yang*/ de nyon mongs pa gsum dang khyad par du 'dod chags 'khor ba dang*/ ngan song gi rgyu 'phel ba lam du byed zer ba min/ dag par byed pa la lam du byed pa zer ba yin/ de ltar yang brtag pa gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag /srid pas srid pa 'dag par byed// ces pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa phra ba'i phra ba gsang sngags kyis 'dag par gzhung dang*/ man ngag thams cad nas gsungs/ 'o na slob dpon rgyal po in dra bo dhi nyon mongs pa ma spangs par rnam par grol ba dang*/ dpal birwa pa dang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi phal cher la las kyi phyag rgya yod pa de/ des grol ba ma yin na/ bar der las kyi phyag rgya 'chang ba la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ kye rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams/ de dag sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin/ gdul bya 'dul ba la de ltar dgos pa bstan pa yin bya ba de ltar nged kyi blo la shin tu yang mi shong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa/ nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i 'bras bu/ phyag rgya ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas pang nas 'khyud cing*/ 'chi kha dang bar do med par 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du khrid pa ma yin nam/

de ltar ma yin na ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams dang*/ 'dag byed ces pa dang*/ chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa rnams dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// rang gi nyams su myong bas kyang gtum mo bsgoms pa'i bde nyams tsam la yang chags shing bdag gir byas na/ gsang sngags sam gtum mo'i yon tan 'byung ba lta pha ri'i thel du zhog ste/ rtag tu khu ba 'dzag pa dang*/ go cha brtan po yod kun kyang*/ khyi chu brkyal ba bzhin du ci tsug yin cha med par bu smad can du gyur nas khyi khrid nas rngon pa 'ba' zhig byed pa dang*/ srog chags rnams gsod pa yang cir yang mi byed pa mthong na/ 'dod yon mtha' dag dang bud med dpag tu med pa la chags shing bsten pas/ de'i 'bras bu tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas shing 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du mi 'gro nges pas/ nyon mongs pa phra ba'i phra ba nas gsang sngags kyis 'dag par khong du chud par byas nas gzod gsang sngags la 'jug par bya'o// kye snyigs ma lnga yi dus tshod 'dir// shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la// rang nyid byang chub bsgrub pa yi// snying stobs go cha yul na med// lto gos khe grags 'dod pa'i sa// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// spong sems tsam yang mi skye zhing*// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// nyon mongs lam du byed ces pa'i// sgra phyir 'brangs nas nyon mongs rnams// rgyas shing 'phel bar gyur pa yi// 'bras bu dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du// 'gro ba bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'og khang med pa'i steng khang la// re ltos spros pa bcad nas kyang*// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// bslab sdom gang yin thams cad la// rgyud sbyangs 'byong par gyur pa des// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// zhugs nas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas bsgrub// spyir gsang sngags nyams su len pa rnams kyis/

sbyor ba dngos gzhi dang rjes rnam pa gsum du go bar bya ste/ sbyor ba sa bon grung po dang 'dra ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pas rgyud sbyangs pa de dngos gzhi sangs rgyas kyi skur ldang zhing*/ rjes 'od gsal ba phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du 'jug pa gsum las mi 'da' ste/ de dag kyang rim pa dang por so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems brtan por gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa nyams chags med pa des gsang sngags kyi dbang blang bar bya ste/ dbang zhes bya ba'i go ba ni gong gi rgyud shin tu sbyangs pa snam bu shin tu dag par bkrus pa dri ma med pa lta bu de/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas phyi nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tshan gcig bsgrigs nas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su ngo sprod cing bstan pa/ tshos mkhan mkhas pas tshos kyi snam bu de dmar po dang ser po la sogs par tshos des dbang byas nas snang ba ltar/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su thag chod cing nges nas/ sems can du 'dzin pa'i bsam pa dang bral te/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dbang du gyur pa ni dbang thob ces bya ste/ de ltar dbang thob pa'i rten gyi gang zag de ni/ bu chung skyes ma khad mi yin yang lus kyi stobs ma rdzogs pas mi'i bya ba byed mi nus pa dang 'dra bar/ rgyud ma smin pa dbang gis smin par byas nas rang nyid sangs rgyas su nges pa'i shes pa yod kyang*/ smin pa dang grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdams ngag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ de yang dang po kho nar bskyed pa'i rim pa la bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas shin tu goms par byas shing*/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rang gi yi dam gyi lhar byas shing*/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po las mi gzhan pas phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa spros shing mchod pa dang*/ rgyu shin tu chung ba gtor ma mtheb kyu gang yang sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa ma lus shing*/ lus pa med pa thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lhar byas nas/ mchod pa rnam pa gsum po sngon du 'gro bas mchod na/ chu thigs pa gcig dang zan mtheb kyu gcig la yang tshul de ltar byin gyis brlabs shing mchod na/ de bas che ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ mchod pa thams cad kyis zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gcig tu byas nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu sems nyid 'od gsal phyag rgya chen pos sad par byed de/ dper na me tog padma'i tshal lgang bu shin tu rgyas shing*/ shin tu smin pa la nyi ma'i 'od zer phog na kha bye zhing shin tu mdzes pa ltar/ he ru ka 'ba' zhig gis rnam par 'phrul pas/ phan tshun bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu ni gzhan don gzugs skur gyur la/ sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba ni rang don chos kyi sku'o// de yang rim gyis 'brel pa can du dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan par byas nas/ da gzod rdzogs pa'i rim par zhugs nas grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por yang 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang gsang sngags thabs khyad par can zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gsang sngags kyis gcig tu byas nas/ tshogs bsags pa 'dis lam myur ba yin te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ gsang sngags thabs che/ thabs myur du bya ba de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i thabs che bas thabs che ba yin gsungs/

de rim gyis 'byung bar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ bskyed pa'i rim par legs gnas shing*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la// thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ mdor na rang nyid kyi zhing dang bsam pa dngos po rnam pa gsum gyis ji ltar ma ltar bsags pa de ye shes kyi tshogs kyis sad par byas nas/ tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa de mthar thug pas rang don chos kyi sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs kyi sku zung 'jug gnyis su med par shes par bya'o// kye rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma lus thams cad sems yin te// sems de gzod nas ma skyes pa// nam mkha' lta bu yin no zhes// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gsungs// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i khams// rang gi rig pa 'di yin zhes// rje btsun byams pas gsungs pa dang*// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di// mtha' dang bral bas stong pa zhes// de ltar gsungs pa'i don go yang*// rang gi rig pa 'di nyid de// phyi rol rkyen gyi rten 'brel gyis// dge dang mi dge cir yang 'gyur// des na skyob pa gong ma rnams// sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten ces gsungs// bu snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs se kun// theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal// de 'dra'i bla ma rnyed pa na// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig mchog /nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// bde skyid sgrub pa'i rten 'brel 'di// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// mkhyen nas bu la gsungs pa yin// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// bslab gsum nor bu rin po che// dbang gi rgyal po gter mdzod rnams// 'od gsal rtogs pa'i skyes bu yis// thabs dang shes rab 'jor thogs nas// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// mi zad gter mdzod kha phye nas// bral dang rnam smin yon tan gyis// rang gzhan ma lus tshim par byas// bshes gnyen bsten las byung ba yi// gsum ldan skyes bu dam pa yis// 'od gsal rtogs par gyur pa des// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kun// bde skyid mthar thug thob pa 'di// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba ste// ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar zhing*// shin tu rmad du byung ba 'o// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor la// rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyud rnams kun tu gsungs gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa// skal ldan las can rnams la gdams par gyur pa 'di// kun gyis shes par gyur kyang ci ma rung zhes pas// rdo rje ye shes kyis ni bdag la zhus nas bris// dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi// nyes 'khrul sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur te// 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par shog
/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur nas kyang*// bstan pa mchog la zhugs pa nyes 'khrul dag gyur cig/ //

203)༄// rang gi gces pa'i bu la snying gtam tshig gcig springs pa/ oṃ swasti/ bkra shis par gyur cig 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// rang gi gces pa'i bu gcig la// snying gtam tshig gcig spring ba ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// tshogs chen rgya che bsags pa yis// chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs// sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa yis// 'khor ba me 'obs bzhin du gzigs// 'chi ba mi rtag rjes su dran// dbus gtsang rig pa'i gnas su phyin// thi ba 'dag byi'u tshang du 'jug pa ltar// snga bsam phyi mno ma byas par// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad// mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog gis// bla ma dge 'dun mnyes par byas// ji ltar gces pa'i bu gcig ltar// drung nas 'bral bar mi 'dod kyang*// ri khrod dgon par brtul zhugs spyad// rgyu mtshan mang por dgongs pa yis// rang gi mkhan po'i gnas su phyin// chos dang mthun pa'i mdzad spyod kyis// dgra gnyen thams cad mnyam par byas// nga dang dge 'dun thams cad la// bsam las 'das pa'i zhabs tog bgyis// khyod kyi mdzad spyod de rnams la// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun// dga' zhing yid rang smon pa skyes// khyod kyi slob ma 'di 'dra zhes// nga la ngo so gsol zhing ngom// nga yang dga' ba dpag med skyes// khyod la shin tu re ba che// da ni bu la snying gtam zhu// klu mchog rnams kyi mgo bo ni// mang zhing sdug bsngal che ba ltar// bsod nams che bas sdug bsngal snon// chos dang mthun na rang gzhan skyong*// dgra gnyen mnyam na thams cad gnyen// byas pa phal cher don med yin// rang gzhan kun gyi don chen mchog /thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// gong ma rnams kyi bstan pa yi// mi nub rgyal mtshan bzung bar zhu// padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// dben pa'i dgon pa bsten pa 'am// yang na ri khrod dgon par bsten// yang na bla ma'i drung du shog

/chos 'di khyod kyi thugs la zhog/ // 204) ༄// rje dus gsum mkhyen pas rgyun du gzigs su gsol ba'i phag gru'i 'bul yig/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan rin po che phag mo gru pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo lha bla na med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyis/ bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs phun sum tshogs pas gang ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ gang zhing shin tu rgyas par byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba mchog /skyabs chen 'gro mgon rin chen dang*// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// bdag cag spun drung gcig gyur cing*// khams gsum sems can ma lus dang*// dus gsum 'phags pa gcig gyur cing*// dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa yis// mchod do bstod do rin po che// nged spun dang 'gro drug sems can la// re sa rje las yod re skan// rje sngon gyi dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// thugs la thogs shig rin po che// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyan// thogs med rgyun chad mi mnga' bas// rgyun chad med par gzigs nas kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// // 205) ༄// gdan sa thel phag mo gru dar zhing rgyas par dgos pa bskul ba'i gsung phrin// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// gong ma bzhugs pa'i skyes chen la// bdag gi nor 'khrul nyes tshogs kun// so sor bshags so bzod par gsol// bdag kyang khyed kyi zhabs tog tu// ri nas ri dang gangs nas gangs// nags khrod dgon pa thams cad du// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byed par smon// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs mdzad gsol// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge bas byang chub thob par shog

/gdan sa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// rtag tu bde zhing skyid par shog /bdag cag spun drung thams cad kyang*// rin po che yi zhabs drung du// mi 'bral bde zhing skyid pa 'di// bsam pa shes pa'i gdeng chen yin// bde chen 'di dang mi 'bral shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// mgon po chos skyong srung ma rnams// bdag cag spun drung tshogs gyur cing*// bstan pa rgyas pa'i bsam pa can// rin po che yi bu slob rnams// bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad pa dang*// gdan sa dar zhing rgyas mdzad gsol// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid dang bsam mi khyab// bla med mchod pa ma lus kyis// pa pha bla ma rin chen la// nged bu sdug rnams kyis mchod par 'bul// bdag spun la re sa rje las med// pha byin gyis rlobs shig rin po che// pha sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis// 'gro kun bde la 'god pa yi// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir// kun gyis 'bad pa byas pa 'di// nam yang don med ma gyur cig /da lta gdan sa rin po che// btub pa tsam du yod phyir dang*// 'di ltar sa thag ring po'i mis// 'di nas nam thon snyam pa las// bsam pa 'jog pa min phyir dang*// gzhis pa mos gus can gyi tshogs// rgya mtsho lta bu yod bzhin du// byes mi mi 'khyam thag ring gis// bya byed rigs pa min phyir dang*// nga 'bu gcig pus byas gyur na// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// bde skyid bsod nams nus mthu yis// bar chad gegs su 'gyur phyir dang*// bcu gnyis lo yi grangs snyed du// 'bad pa drag pos bsgrubs na yang*// nga yi bu chung gsum po yis// 'di las bsgrub rgyu med phyir dang*// yul mi nye ring dgra zun dang*// gnas dang gnas min bya bzhag rnams// mi shes sgrub pa min phyir dang*// phyogs bcu'i dad pa can gyi rdzas// bla ma dkon mchog dkor rnams dang*// bzang ngan 'bring gsum 'bri gung pas// thams cad dkyus par 'gyur phyir dang*// nged rang rnams kyi dpon che la// zla ba re la dus gsum du// dpon rta re re skyon pa yang*// rgyu med bya bas ma lang bas// gnyer sna lnga yi dge 'dun gyis// gdan sa'i sku gnyer bzhes par zhu// bdag cag spun dang sems can gyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba ma lus thams cad kyis// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog/

// 206) ༄// sems bde ba brgyad kyi dbyangs gnyis med ye shes kyi phreng ba// pha mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen nyid// mkhyen pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pa// gsang sngags bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// bsre 'pho gnad kyi gdul bya gzigs// nyon mongs chos skur bsgyur mdzad pa// 'gyur med bde chen phyag 'tshal lo// pha sangs rgyas mnyam med rin po che// rje bram ze chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// sems nyid gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// bcos ma bya byed 'bad rtsol rnams// gnyis med rang sar rnam dag cing*// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i sku// dgos 'dod kun 'byung phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs rin chen birwa pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyis// snang srid dbang du sgyur mdzad cing*// byang chub mchog la 'god mdzad pa// nus pa mthar thug phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs la shar// chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// chags thogs med pa'i thugs mnga' bas// lam gyi gol sa gcod mdzad pa// mnyam med bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// rje byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas kyang*// sngon gyi smon lam rgyu 'bras kyis// skyob mdzad rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// bla ma bsten pa'i tshul bstan cing*// nyid kyi gdams ngag zab mo yis// nyams rtogs rgyud la bskyed mdzad pa// pha thabs mkhas thugs rje can la 'dud// thugs 'od gsal rgya mtsho chen po la// spros pa'i rba rlabs zhi ba yis// 'gro kun sems kyi dri ma rnams// rang sar dag mdzad byin rlabs can// rje byin rlabs can la phyag 'tshal lo// rje cir snang chos skur sgyur mdzad cing*// 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod pa po// rnam rtog rang sar dag mdzad pa// rje rten 'brel bdag por phyag 'tshal lo// tshe gcig mchog gis sangs rgyas pa// 'khor 'das gnyis med rang sems la// re dogs gol sa gcod mdzad pa// rang gzhan don grub rin po che// chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// pha rdo rje 'chang la skyabs su mchi// 'di chos rje mgon po rin chen gyis// sems kyi bde ba brgyad kyi dbyangs// phyi rabs rnal 'byor don du gsungs// bdag kyang dga' bas bla ma yi// sngon gyi gsung sgros rjes su dran// gus pas yi ger bkod pa 'di// rmongs pa'i thugs dang 'gal na yang*// mi shes pa la bzod par gsol// pha chos kyi rgyal po rin po che dpal ldan phag mo gru pas sems kyi bde ba brgyad kyi dbyangs/

tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag tshig dang yi ge gtso bor byed pa rnams la gsungs pa las/ ku re'i lan du ku re'i bstod pa dang*/ go tshod kyi bstod pa gnyis las/ 'dir go tshod kyi bstod pa gnyis med ye shes kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi gsung dang mthun par bgyis pa las phyi ma rdzogs so// // 207) ༄// nyon mongs skyes pa'i dus su spong ba'i brtul zhugs la 'bad dgos pa// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir khams gzhi mi bde ba'i rigs thams cad dang 'khor ba dang*/ ngan song dang*/ sdug bsngal du gyur tshad thams cad kyi rgyu/ da lta rang gi rgyud la skye bzhin pa'i phyi yul la chags pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang rang gzhan la zhe sdang ba'i zhe sdang dang*/ ngar 'dzin pa dang*/ nga yir 'dzin pa dang*/ gnyid dang rmugs pa dang*/ mi shes pa gti mug pa dang gsum las ma byung ba mi srid pas/ nyon mongs pa gsum po 'di ma spangs na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gang du yang bde ba mi srid pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs shing*/ gsung rab thams cad kyang 'di kho nar ma 'dus pa med pa yin pas/ 'di spong ba gal che/ rgyu mtshan 'dis na bu khyod kyis rang gi rgyud la skye zhing yod pa'i nyon mongs pa 'di gsum ma skyes pa'i dus su spong rgyu med/ skyes pa'i dus su spong ba'i brtul zhugs 'bad par zhu/ nyes pa'i rtsa ba 'di spong bar byed pa la/ btsan mthong dbang med dka' las sdug bsngal mu stegs byed kyi brtul zhugs kyis mi spong bas/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ shes rab zab mo gnyis kyis spong dgos te/ de la yang thabs mkhas pa ni/ mkhan po dang slob dpon dang*/ bla ma dkon mchog gi spyan sngar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i tshul khrims ngo lkog med par srog gam mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba dang*/ nyes pa dang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rgyu/

dbang po rnam pa lnga yul rnam pa lnga la chags sdang rmongs gsum skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po lnga yul la sdom/ rab tu sdom/ kun tu rab tu bsdoms pas/ bsam pa byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi chos thams cad chu bo gzhol phyogs su 'bab pa ltar/ rgyun chad med par shugs kyis 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan yang snga ma'i lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa/ man ngag gi gnad ji ltar du bstan pa chos lnga ldan las ma 'das par nyams su blang ba 'di thabs/ shes rab ni lhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya chen po la nga dang*/ bla ma dang*/ grogs dang*/ gnyen bshes dang*/ bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la ma byed par/ bsam mno med par goms pa las nyes pa'i rtsa ba nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad rang sar grol nas/ skyon dag pa dang*/ yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur bar/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rba rlabs kyi gnyer ma zhi bya'i don// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya// stong nyid bde chen dam pa ni// 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog tu gsungs// grub thob gong mas gsungs pa na// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ de kho na nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o// phan par gyur cig pra dzñā badzra/ rdzogs so// // 208) ༄// bla ma rin po ches yon bdag dgra bla rgyal la springs pa'i snying gtam tshig gcig/ oṃ swasti/ shi tshig snying gtam gyi dbang du byas pas/ rang mi 'chi na 'jig rten 'dir ci byas kyang chog ste/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ gces par byas pa'i lus 'dis kyang mi stongs na/ pha ma dang nye du gnyen 'brel/ rdzas dang yo byad thams cad kyis stongs pa ga la srid pas/ bsdad tshis mi bya 'gro tshis bya/ de yang shi ba'i dus su/ bdag pha rol tu skyes zhes bya ba'i bdag pha rol tu skye rgyu cig yod pa ma yin/

rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam par shes pa bzang ngan ji lta ba de'i rang gzugs su/ pha rol tu 'grub pa yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis zung 'jug tu goms par byed pa gal che/ de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ khyed rang gi bla ma dam pas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du nan tan mdzad par zhu/ ci byed thams cad bsngo ba dang sems bskyed pa'i bar du tshud par mdzad pa gal che// // 209) ༄// dus mchod che bzhi nyams su len pa'i rim pa spyi dang bye brag so sor bstan pa// 'khor 'das kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma mchog gi zhabs btud nas// dus bzhi'i mchod pa bya ba'i lugs// bsdus don cung zad 'bri bar bya// dus dang gnas dang bya ba dang*// byas pa'i yon tan bstan pa'o// dus la rnam pa gnyis yin te// spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'o// spyir na dus kyi khyad par rnams// theg pa che chung thams cad du// rgya cher rnam par bstan pa kun// dge dang mi dge khyad par gyi// bye brag bslu ba med pa'i gnad// lo dang zla ba zhag rnams kyi// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi gnad bstan pa// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa rnams// kun mkhyen bslu ba med pa'i bka'// ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du// mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub byas nas// rten 'brel bslu ba med pas 'dir// bslu ba med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// spyi yi dus gnad bstan pa'o// bye brag dus mchod chen po bzhi// 'dul ba mdo sde gsang sngags su// spyi yi phan gnod 'dug lugs gsungs// sa ga sa ri'i zla ba la// tshes brgyad rgyal dang 'dzom pa'i tshe// ston pa sku bltams dbu skra bregs// de yi nya la rdzogs sangs rgyas// dus der mngon par byang chub pa'i// dus mchod chen po bya ba yin// de nas zhag grangs bzhi bcu dang*// rtsa dgu lon pa'i dus tshod du// wā rā ṇa sīr mgon po yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin// dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po la// tshul du zhugs shing tshul thon nas// zhag bdun lon pa'i nyin par ni// lha las babs pa'i dus mchod yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// 'das mchod dang yang gcig tu 'ong*// cho 'phrul rta yi zla ba la// cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod pa bya// dus mchod chen po rnam bzhi 'dir// ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs// mdzad pa rlabs chen thams cad kun// dus 'dir mdzad pa yin nam snyam// kha cig bco lnga phan chad ces// zla ba'i bgo bsha' byed mod kyang*// rje btsun byams pa'i lung bstan las// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// zhes pa'i bka' bstsal gsungs pa dang*// theg pa che 'bring rnam gsum du// zla ba'i bgo bsha' ma gsungs pas// zla ba gcig pu nyid du nges// bye brag dus bzhi bstan pa'o// gnas la phyi nang gsang ba gsum// gsang sngags mdo sde 'dul bar gsungs// ston pa gang du bzhugs gyur cing*// gdul bya 'dul bar mdzad pa yi// gnas rnams mchod rten yin pa dang*// so so gzhung gi bye brag tu// sa phyogs gnas rnams bstan pa dang*// rje btsun rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las// stobs bcu ldan pas bshad pa'i zhing*// byang phyogs yod pa'i ri dag dang*// kha che dang ni rgya yul dang*// bal po de bzhin mang yul dang*// rgya yul che dang li yul dag

/de dag ma lus 'grub pa'i zhing*// byang phyogs la ni gnas pa dang*// nas dang gro la spyod pa dang*// ri dang chu bo dag la yang*// bsod nams yul du bstan pa yin// ri ni shing ldan me tog yod// 'di dag gi ni phyogs dag tu// sngags 'grub par ni rgyal bas gsungs// de la sogs pa phyi rol gyi// gnas su gsungs pa de dag kun// phyi rol ji bzhin de bzhin nang*// dbyer med gcig tu gsungs pas na// mig med rmongs pa 'ga' zhig gis// mthong thos nyams myong ma skyes pa// smyon pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar// thub pas legs par gsungs pa yi// gnas kyi rten 'brel bsgrub par bya// phyi yi gnas su bstan pa'o// gsang ba'i gnas su bstan pa ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba brda yi gsang skad du// ji bzhin ma yin sgra tshul du// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams dang*// de bzhin sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dang*// btsun mo'i bha gar gang gsungs pa// rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad rnams kun// rdo rje 'chang gis gang gsungs pa// rgyud sde bzhi la mnga' brnyes shing*// bka' babs brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// gnas mchog gang na yod pa kun// khong du chud pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gnas der bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan la// zhus kyin zhus kyin byed pa de// gsang ba'i gnas su bstan pa'o/ /nang gi gnas kyi rim pa 'di// mos pa yul du byed pa ste// ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag gis// mngon dga'i zhing gi bde ba can// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams dang*// khang pa snang mdzad snying po dang*// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// rgyud sde rin chen bzhi rnams su// gzhal yas khang rnams sgom par gsungs// bdag ni sdar zhing sems chung bas// bla ma'i gsung la gus par byas// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon// mchog tu thugs rje che ba'i lha// chos dbyings rnam par snang mdzad ces// gsang sngags rgyud du gsungs pa yi// thugs kar pho brang rtag tu bcas// rgyas sam yang na bsdus pa yi// yi dam gang yin bsgom mo zhes// 'jig rten mgon pos bka' bstsal gsungs// bla ma de yi gdung 'dzin pa// khyod kyis de ltar nyams su longs// nang gi gnas su bstan pa'o// bya ba'i rim pa gang zhe na// khyad par can gyi dus rnams su// dge dang mi dge gang byas pa'i// rlabs can dpag tu med par 'gyur// yongs su grags pa'i bka' bstsal 'di// thub pa'i gsung yin nges pa ste// yar mar gnyis kyi mtshams med du// cis kyang nges par 'gyur phyir ro// des na dge ba spyad la 'bad// sdig pa spang la nan tan bya// dge dang sdig pa gang yin pa'i// mun par 'thoms pa bdag cag gis// yid dpyod log rtog rjes 'brangs pa// legs su re yang nyes par 'gyur// mu stegs byed kyi dka' thub bzhin// tshad mar gyur pa chos kyi rje// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo nyid// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal po yis// bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan pa// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las de mi dge ba// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba zhes// 'gro ba'i mgon pos gsungs pas na// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// dge ba gang des gsum po de// zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis// mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi chos// ji ltar 'grub pa'i bye brag rnams// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// rnal 'byor pa rnams rang gzhung spyad// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod du// rang gi srog la bab gyur na// dkon mchog rten la gnang ba yod// dus mchod chen po bzhi po la// bsngos pa bskyir yang ma gnang ngo*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi// rjes 'brangs jo bo chen po yis// yon tan dpag tu med pa gsungs// rdo rje theg pa'i gsang sngags su// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// nyi zla gza' yis zin pa dang*// cho 'phrul chen po la sogs pa// rgyal la sogs pa'i rgyu skar la// ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul lugs rnams// rang rang gzhung bzhin nyams su blang*// rnam par dkar ba dam pa'i chos// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// mthong chos 'bras bu 'grub pa de// ngo mtshar che ste nges pa yis// nyams len bya ba'i rim pa rnams// so sor ma 'dres byed pa'i tshul// so sor rang gzhung bstan pa 'o// byas pa'i yon tan bstan pa ni// ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po ni// chu rnams kun gyi gnas bzhin du// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba// thabs dang shes rab kun gyi gnas// ji ltar thabs la mkhas pa yis// shin tu zab par 'jug pa dang*// shin tu zab pa'i don rtogs pas// thabs la mkhas par 'gyur ba rnams// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi// brjod bya snying po 'di yin pas// myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba'i thabs// dus dang gnas dang bya ba'i gnad// bdag gi bla ma rin chen gyis// phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa rnams// nyams su blang ba'i tshul lugs kun// rang gi sras la gsungs pa yis// sdig dang sgrib pa dag pa dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu kun// myur du 'grub par bka' bstsal gsungs// khyed kyang de yi rjes su 'brang*// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma la// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po dang*// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga yis// yon tan 'grub par 'gyur ba'i tshul// bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros las// zur tsam bsdus nas bstan pa 'dis// bdag gi pha ma gnyen dang bshes// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can kun// rin po che yi thugs dgongs ltar// thams cad grub pa nyid du shog
/dus mchod chen po bzhi dus dang dus kyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas/ rang rang gi gzhung lugs/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa spyi dang bye brag so sor bstan pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

210) ༄// gnas gcig tu tshogs pa skyong bar gsol ba gsang chen thugs kyi nying khu// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ khyed sku khams shin tu bde ba dang*/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa/ sems can gyi zhing la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon btab pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las mdzad pas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa de/ kho bo la shin tu bka' drin che/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi mdzad tshul/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus bsdus pa'i don/ dus mkhyen pa kho nar gsungs te/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas// dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid// gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la// sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med// ces gsungs pas/ dus de ni gdul bya dad pa'i dus 'ba' zhig yin pas/ gdul bya dad gus can mang po ni yod/ rang la yang gzhan smin par byed pa'i nus pa'i mthu ni yod/ gong ma thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis rlabs pa'i byin rlabs ni yod pa'i dus su/ gnas la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i rten 'brel rang nyid kyis bsgrigs nas 'gro ba'i don byed pa gal che ste/ 'jig rten pa phan pa med par rang gi bu smad kyang skyong ba la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi gcod pa'i brtul zhugs ci'i phyir mi 'dzin te/ 'bad pa drag pos nyams su blang bar bya'o// dus tshod 'dir ni ri bltas dang*/ byas pa dang*/ lag rjes dang*/ gdan sa dang*/ ka ca dang*/ zang zing gis bla ma dang gong ma mchod par byed pa de la ni/ bla ma dam pa mnyes pa ma yin/ sems can dpag tu med pa smin cing grol ba dang*/

bya ba thams cad kyang de'i phyogs su byas pas/ bla ma dam pa mnyes te/ de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid kyang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med// ces pa dang*/ sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu ni// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin 'gyur shog /ces pa dang*/ snying rje padma dkar po las kyang*/ nga'i slob ma dgra bcom pa thob pa la ni mnyes pa ma yin gyi/ nga'i chos gzhan la ston pa la ni nga mnyes pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ slob dpon dang slob ma tshogs pa dang mi ldan pa bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o// zhes rgya cher gsungs pa lags pas/ khyed kyis gnas gcig tu yun ring du bzhugs nas/ tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyang bar zhu 'tshal/ de yang gnas gcig tu yun ring du bsdad pas/ yul mi des mi 'khyag pa dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ rang la phrag dog 'ong dogs pa'i thugs ser gtan mi 'tshal bar gda' ste/ mi chen po bsod nams can mang po la brten pas/ ston pa'i gsung bsgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad dang gzhi mi 'dzin pas bya bzhin rten sa med pa'i phyir dang*/ thams cad la sems snyoms shing bsam pa nye ba'i phyir/ zhing gdung zhing je nyer 'ong ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas dang mi chen dang*/ phyogs ris la zang zing gi sbyin pa tshod zin cing snyoms pas gzhan phrag dog mi skye ba'i phyir dang*/ skad cig ma'i bsam pas sa bon rnam par shes pa ji ltar du skyes pa'i rang gzugs su lus 'grub pas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis skyes shing goms na/ de'i rang gzugs la sangs rgyas zer ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa tshogs su bstan pas nges pa rnyed nas/ rang la bsam rgyu gzhan med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/

kha smras dang mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs pa byung yang bze re mi bskyed cing bzod pa bsgoms pas/ bsam pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ba dang*/ mthu dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ dbang che bar gyur kyang bar dang*/ sdums dang*/ gnya' dang*/ g.yon dang*/ skyel ma dang*/ dbang che ma byas pas/ gong ma rnams kyi zhabs 'dren du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnas gcig tu yun ring du bsdad pas je legs su 'gyur ba thugs su chud par bya ste/ 'di ni bdag gi myong bas grub pa yin no// de de tsam du ched ci che snyam na/ gnas gcig tu yun ring ma bsdad na/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs skyong pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug pa'i phyir te/ mnyan du yod par nyi shu bzhi// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang*/ myong bas shes so// de dag gi dgos pa gang yin zhe na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas// zhes gsungs pas/ so nam snying por ma byas nas// grwa pa nyams nyes spong ba la// gco 'dri khyad du gsod byed cing*// gzhan du chags pa'i sems skye zhing*// so nam snying por mi sgrub pa// byas lo byed lo tsam pa yis// gzhan don 'grub pa mi srid pas// rgyal sras me tog zla mdzes bzhin// skyes chen khyed kyis bsgrub par bya// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// spros mtha' nyes tshogs lta ba yis// 'gro kun srid mtshor 'khyams mkhyen nas// mtha' dang bral ba'i lta ba dang*// de la goms pa'i sgom pa dang*// ston pa'i tshul khrims spyod pa yis// 'gro kun smin par 'gyur nges pa// lta sgom spyod pa ro gcig pa'i// snying po bla na med pa 'di// bla ma rin chen ma gtogs pa// deng sang dus su ma byung bas// 'di ko dar na ci ma rung*// snyam pa'i bsam pa drag po yis// lus dang srog la ma bltas par// 'bad pa drag po byas pa yang*// chud ma zos shing don yod ces// dbugs phyin thob cing dga' bar byung*// bla ma dam pa'i gdung rgyud kyang*// mi 'chad srid dam snyam pa skyes// khyod kyis thugs la shin tu btags// da rung shin tu thugs la thogs// rkang gnyis gtso bo'i rjes 'brangs pa'i// rgyal sras brtul zhugs spyod rnams kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// nyes tshogs skyon dang bral ba 'di// dar zhing rgyas pa nyid du shog

/'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// 'di las skyob pa gzhan med pas// skyob par byed pa'i dam chos 'dis// 'gro kun rnam par grol bar shog /bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i dbang song zhing*// 'jig rten chos kyis yid dkrugs pa'i// lta sgom spyod pa log pa rnams// rgyun chad gyur cig mi 'byung shog /gsang gtam chen po thugs kyi nying khu zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// / 211) ༄// mdo sngags nyams len gyi nying khu phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid snying bsdus// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad dang*/ rlabs po che'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa dang*/ nyams len gnad du bsnun pa'i dus dang bsgoms pa'i thun 'go la/ sems bskyed pa'i dam bca' 'di ltar bya ste/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung nas nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du bsams la/ rang gi lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ med na nga'i yi dam gyi lha/ jo bo thugs rje chen po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang yang rung ba zhig tu bsgom/ bla ma dam pa thugs kar bsgom/ nam 'chi ba'i dus su ni spyi bor bsgom pa yin gsungs/ de nas rang gi rig pa rig rig tur tur po 'di la bltas la/ bltas pa'i dus su gang yang ma mthong ba de kho na nyid mthong ba'o zhes pas/ de'i ngang la ci yang yid la mi byed par bzhag rnam par rtog pa mtho dman gyis sems rnam par g.yengs na/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gam/ spyod lam bsgyur nas bsgoms pas rgyun chad med pa'i dge sbyor/

rnam rtog med pa'i ngo bo/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin du 'ong ba yin pas/ de rgyun chad med par bskyang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa'i rjes sam/ thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes la/ skabs skabs su bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dran par byas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// dus rgyun chad med par tshul de ltar nyams su blang zhing*/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa rin po che bsrung ba dang*/ rtsa ba bzhi las gang thub thub kyi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa srung ba gal che ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ khrims gcig tsam yang mi bsrung na nga'i 'khor du ma gtogs so// zhes gsungs pas ston pa'i 'khor du ma gtogs na byas pa thams cad don med par shes par byas nas/ tshul khrims bsrung ba la 'bad par bya'o// rdzogs so// // 212) ༄// gang du bsgom pa'i sa phyogs su sa gzhi byin gyis rlabs stangs// yang cig zhus pa'i don la/ gnas gang du sdod pa'i sa phyogs dang*// de la gnas pa'i mi rnams dang*// gtso cher mi ma yin pa la// byams dang snying rje'i gdung sems bskyed// yang dang yang du nan tan bya// snying nas rgyud la skyes tsam na// bem po sa rdo shing la sogs// phan pa rgya chen bskyed pa de// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs la zhog /tshad du skyol ba'i dus tshod du// gnas des gtso bo byas pa yi// sa phyogs yul khams thams cad dag /jo bo thugs rje chen por bsgom// de na gnas pa thams cad dang*// sems can ma lus thams cad la// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// nan tan chen pos yang yang bsgom// sa gzhi rdo rje gdan du mos// de na gnas pa'i ma rgan gyi// phan dang bde ba'i don ched du// bsam zhing dge rtsa yang yang bsngo// 'di yis bslu ba med do zhes// bla ma sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs// rang la nyams su myong ba yod// skyes chen khyed kyis nyams su longs// 'phags pa bdag nyid chen po dang*// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams// gang du sdod pa'i sa phyogs su// sa gzhi byin gyis rlob pa dang*// gnas khang tshar ba'i dus kyi tshe// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i phyir// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*// dge 'dun tshogs la bsnyen bkur dang*// 'byung po kun la gtor ma dang*// smon lam rgya chen yang yang gdab// gong ma rnams kyi srol bka' gda'// nyams su blangs na byin rlabs 'byung*// de yang thugs la bzhag par bya//

// 213) ༄// mi mjed zhing gi khyad chos bstan pa rnam par sgra bsgrags zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ rnam par sgra bsgrags srid pa gsum du bsgrags// bsngags pa'i phreng ba 'jig rten kun tu rgyu// bdag gis sems can mchog rnams zhing mthong na// de dag kun kyang khyod kyi yon tan gsung*// 'di na yongs su dag pa'i zhing mchis te// dri ma ma mchis ngan song gsum spangs pa// de 'dra'i zhing rnams de dag kun spangs nas// khyod kyi thugs rjes ngan song yongs su bzung*// 'jig rten mgon khyod ye shes dman ma mchis// ma lus bde bar gshegs dang khyod dang mtshungs// shin tu rnam dag bsam pa sngon mdzad pa// 'di 'dra ba yi zhing 'di khyod kyis bzung*// tshul khrims thams cad rnam dag 'dod spangs nas// gang zhig bskal par gzhan na spyod pa bas// su dag byams pa'i sems kyis shin tu 'dir// skad cig spyod na'ang 'di ni khyad par 'phags// lus dang ngag dang 'on te yid kyis kyang*// gang la nyes bgyis rnam pa gsum mchis te// ngan song gsum du myong ba gang 'gyur ba// de ni tshe 'di nyid la 'byang bar 'gyur// byang chub sems dpa' 'di na gang mchis pa// de dag rtag tu gdung bar mi bgyi ste// de yi las gang log ltung mchi ba yang*// de dag 'dir ni klad pa na bas 'byang*// 'di na byang chub sems dpa' skye med gnas// dam pa'i chos srung chos mchog 'dzin pa rnams// de dag 'di las phyin chad nam du yang*// dran pa mi 'khrugs blo yang nyams mi 'gyur// gang zhig bdud kyis bcings pa gcod pa dang*// de bzhin nyon mongs las bcas sbyang 'tshal ba// de ni zhing 'dir dam pa'i chos nyid srung*// 'di la ye shes ldan pa'i mchog tu 'gyur// gang zhig bskal pa bye bar zhing gzhan du// sems ldan dam chos 'dzin par 'gyur ba bas// su dag snga dro zhig tsam mi mjed du// 'di ni de bas mchog tu mkhas pas dgongs//

// 214) ༄// chos bzhi ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor gyi nang du 'gro ba// chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams 'khor gyi nang du 'gro ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ chos 'dod pa'i phyir te klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pas ma yin pa dang*/ ri mo bcas pa'i phyir te nga rgyal dang khengs pas ma yin pa dang*/ dge ba gang yin tshol ba'i phyir te/ bdag spyoms ngom pa pas ma yin pa dang*/ sems can rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba la gzud pa'i phyir te/ rnyed pa dang bkur bsti dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i phyir ma yin te/ bzhi po 'di dag go/ // 215) ༄// lung ma bstan dge rtsar bsgyur ba ye shes sgron me bgres mo'i zhu chos// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gcig pu// mgon po rin chen zhabs la 'dud// skyes chen de yi zhal snga nas// ji ltar bka' bstsal gsung sgros 'di// ngag tu brjod pa ma nus kyang*// 'gro la phan phyir da bshad do// thub pa rnams kyi dam pa'i chos// 'khor lor gsungs pa gang yin 'dis// 'phar 'bub chen po bskyed pa yin// de la sdang na thar mi 'gyur// byams shing gus par gyur pa yis// nyams su blangs na grol gyur gsungs// rje btsun rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las// thub pa chen po chos kyi rjes// tsan dan me dang bsil ba'i tshal// tsha dang grang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// 'jig rten gsum mgon rin po ches// gsungs par gyur pa'i gdams ngag de// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma yi// byin gyis rlabs kyis dus 'dir dran// dgos dus slebs pa ngo mtshar che// thub pa chen po bla ma dam pa de'i bka' bstsal 'di las/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa dang rnam pa gsum/ lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin du go zhing mthong bas/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad dang*/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i shes pa'am/

ye shes kyi snang ba 'jug ste/ de la lus ngag yid gsum gyi las/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa nas lung du ma bstan par gsungs pas/ sems kyi las bgres mos ji ltar mthong ba de la 'di ni 'dre yin no// bdud yin no snyam nas zhe sdang gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ lus kyis brdung ba dang*/ ngag gis ngan par smra ba rnams kyis/ tshe 'di'am phyi ma'am lan grangs gzhan du mthong chos sam/ skyes nas myong 'gyur ram/ lan grangs gzhan la myong ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa 'byung ba ma lags sam/ gzhan yang tshul de dang 'dra bar 'dod chags dang*/ gti mug las kyang shes par bya'o// yang 'di ni lha dngos yin/ nga grub thob yin snyam nas chags sdang rmongs pa gsum gyi las gsog pa yang las 'dren ma

sna tshogs/ gti mug gis dbang byas pa rnam pa sna tshogs su 'byung bar 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pas bzhed/ chos 'di la ston pa'i bka' dang*/ rang gi nyams myong tshad mar gyur pas mos gus chen po skye bar gda'/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun nag 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las thar bar mdzad pa'i bla ma dam pa de dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar gyur cig mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par byed par gyur cig skad cig kyang mi mnyes pa byed par mi gyur cig rang nyid mi shes pa ma rig pa'i mun pa'i dbang du song ba gzhan gyi lam sna khrid pa byed par 'dod pa kha cig gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi las 'di dang 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la bzang po yin no snyam du bsams pas bzang por 'gyur ba dang*/ ngan pa yin no snyam du bsams pas ngan par 'gyur ba lta bur rtogs te/ lung yang*/ rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges pas// gang ltar brtags pa de ltar snang*// zhes pa dang*/ rig pa yang snang ba rang gi sems yin pa'i gtan tshigs 'god mod kyi/ thams cad mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs la go ba ma rnyed pa'i phyir dang*/ rtag chad gnyis la sogs pa log par lta ba de thams cad la blta mkhan des bzang po dang legs pa 'ba' zhig tu bltas kyang ngan pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ de ltar gyur na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ brda'am don la shed ma bye ba'i byis pa/ nya dang*/ phye leb glang chen mkhas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ glen pa gti mug can gyi tshig tshad mar mi bya zhing*/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung tshad mar bya ste/ yang bla ma dam pa'i gsung yul de nges par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i sems de dang dbyer med par 'gyur ba dang*/

tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ lha bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis/ don legs par rtogs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum gyi las dbyer med par gyur pa de yi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ci 'dra ba'i las byas pa/ de 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung zhes/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas/ dam tshig nyams pa chen po rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro ba las ldog par bya ba'i thabs dbang bskur mang po bya ba dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa btsal ba dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thabs bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de dag thams cad kyang rnam par dkar ba'i chos skyabs su 'gro ba nas/ phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi la blo nges par byas nas sdig pa dag nas dngos grub thob par gsungs pa yang*/ mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang*// srog chags bye ba gsod ldan pas// chos 'di la ni zhugs gyur cing*// bla ma la gus yod gyur na// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// bla ma la gus med gyur na// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ rlabs po che de 'dra ba yang sdig pa 'byang zhing dngos grub thob na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ nges par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba dang*/ skyabs su song ba'i dgos pa sdig pa spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems de las byung ba'i lha bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis bsgoms pas/ lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum de'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba ni/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yin pas/ khyed 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de'i sras nga dang yang 'brel bar gyur pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/

lus ngag gi las dge ba dang mi dge bar lung bstan du ma btub pa mtha' dag kyang dge ba'i lus ngag yid gsum thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'ba' zhig tu bsgrub par bya'o// dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /bgres mos zhus pa'i bstan bcos lung ma bstan dge ba'i rtsa bar bsgyur ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i man ngag gsal byed ye shes kyi sgron me rdzogs so// // 216) ༄// gzhan mgo ma bskor mi bzang po zhes pa'i gsol 'debs rin po che// bla ma dkon mchog dpang por bzhag /mi mang po zhig gis mtshan snyan btags// rang nyid chos par zhal gyis bzhes// gzhan mgo ma bskor mi bzang po// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la// mos gus ma chung mi bzang po// ston pa thugs rje chen po'i sras// rnam bzhi 'khor gyi tshogs rnams kun// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la// nye ring ma mdzad mi bzang po// khams gsum sems can thams cad rnams// gnyen mchog a ma yin pa la// brtse gdung phan 'dogs mi byed par// chags sdang ma mdzad mi bzang po// rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// yang rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// // 217) ༄// gdams zab 'dod 'jo'i bang mdzod ye shes tshul khrims la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ nyi ma sprin bral gza' las thar ba bzhin// nyes tshogs 'khor ba'i skyon las rnam grol zhing*// dpag med yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas phyogs thams cad khyab par gyur cig khyed kyis na ning dang do cig yang dang yang du chos cig bris la bskur gsung ba'i ngos nas/

bu khyed nga la zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog kyang shin tu che/ dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs rgya chen po yang mnga'/ khyed rang spun gyi ji yod nga'i phyogs su song bas bdag tu 'dzin pa yang yod mod kyi/ chung a ma la skyes nas da lta phan chad du gces phrug 'ba' zhig tu gyur bas/ skyid sdug gi ro yang ma myong*/ na so shin tu gzhon zhing lang tsho dar la bab pas/ mtho dman bde sdug gi shed kyang ma bye/ rdzas dang yo byad su la yod kyang phyug por gyur pa 'di kho na gong na med pa yin snyam pa'i lta ba ni yod/ 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad la sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ 'khor ba gting mtha' med par 'khyams pa'i go ba ni stor/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyi mig dang ni bral/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs ni ma zhugs/ phyogs gang nas ltas kyang nga tsam med snyam pa'i mi la chos kyi dgos pa ci yod snyam par byung bas yi ge ma bskur ba yin te/ 'on kyang 'di rnams ma legs par 'dug snyam du dgongs nas 'di ltar nyams su blang bar zhu 'tshal/ dang po kho nar stan bde ba'i steng du dkyil mo krung la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis gnas par byas nas/ gnyid dang rmugs pa'i dbang du ma song bar/ rang nyid kyang 'chi/ 'jig rten 'di dang phun sum tshogs pa yang mi rtag na/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod 'di la dgos pa ci yod par dran zhing goms par bya/ bsam par bya/ lus longs spyod chu'i chu bur dang 'dra bar go zhing*/ mi rtag pa gtad med du nges pa'i bsam pa skyes pa'i dus su/ 'o na tshe phyi ma ci tsug tu 'ong snyam du bsam pa de ltar 'ong na rgyu 'di yod na 'di 'byung*/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung ste/ rgyu zhe sdang yod na 'bras bu dmyal ba 'byung*/ rgyu zhe sdang med na 'bras bu dmyal ba mi 'ong*/ de dang 'dra bar 'dod chags dang*/

gti mug dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ phrag dog dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa rnam pa sna tshogs rgyu tha dad pa las/ 'bras bu 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ltung byed yin// zhes pas mngon no// 'o na rgyu nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa las/ 'bras bu 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal ni 'byung bar nges pas/ rang gi bsam pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa la skrag pa skyes pa'i dus su/ 'khor ba rgyu dang 'bras bu las mngon par 'byung ba'i sems skye/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde 'dod pa'i blo 'byung*/ rang nyid 'khor ba rgyu 'bras las thar na su ci 'dra na yang 'dra snyam pa byung ste/ de theg pa dman pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems yin pas/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas la// gtan du gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos sa ni gtan gyi gegs// zhes gsungs pas mngon no// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de thob pa'i lam phyin ci ma log pa byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems yin pas nan tan chen pos bsgom/ des rang gzhan mnyam pa'am rang gzhan brje bar nus pa'i bsam pa byung ba'i dus su/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba byed pa mtha' dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu 'gro bas nan tan chen pos nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di bsgyur nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba legs brtan bzung*// zhes pas mngon no// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rin po che de skyes nas bdag med rnam pa gnyis kyi don stong pa nyid bsgom par bya/ zhes dam pa'i skye bo kha cig gis zer te/ tshig tsam gyi bdag med dang*/

stong pa nyid kyi bshad pa mang po lta me long gis kyang smra shes te/ 'di rgyud la skyes pa'i bla ma zhig dgos pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas/ dus da lta phan chad tshig dang tha snyad kyis ma bslad/ tshong dus kyi 'o mar ma song*/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa rgyun ma chad pa'i bla ma dam pa zhig la mos gus byas nas/ rang byung gi sgom rang shar du skye zhing rang grol du grol bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ khyod ni mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus gcod par byed// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas mngon no// de ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems gong du bstan pa bzhin skyes pa'i 'jig rten gyi gang zag des/ gsang sngags kyi lugs kyis/ lus yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ spyi bor bla ma dam pa bsgom/ de nas rang gi rig pa rig rig po tur tur po 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan/ sangs rgyas thob mkhan/ mi byed dgu byed/ mi bsam dgu bsam 'di la cer gyis bltas la/ bltas pa tsam de nyid kyi dus su mthong ba spu'i rtse mo yang med pa de nyid kyi ngang la bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la mi byed par goms par bya ste/ de yun ring du goms par byas pas/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad chu la chu bzhag pa dang*/ mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin du nye bar zhi zhing dmigs pa med par 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// zhes pas/

rang byung gi sgom rgyun chad med par 'byung ba ma gtogs pa/ rang byung gi sgom de nga la shod dang byas pas de bshad du mi btub ste/ 'on kyang dam pa rnams kyis/ skye ba med pa dang bdag med pa dang*/ zhi dang ma skyes pa spros dang bral// stong pa mtshan med smon pa med// 'gog pa don dam dben pa dang*// 'od gsal sems nyid phyag rgya che// sna tshogs ming du btags na yang*// smra bsam brjod du med pa'i don// rnal 'byor rnams kyi thugs la gnas// tshig gis brjod par nus re skan// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dbang gis smin par byed pa yin// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis grol ba yin// byin rlabs lam la gnas pa yin// mos gus can gyis go ba yin// rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min// rgyus med smra ba kham po che// kha bshad mkhan gyis ga la shes// rgyu med 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// pha med bu chung ga la skye// brgyud pa med pa'i rdol bon yang*// smra bshad mkhas te phan pa chung*// nga po che yang khrel bar zad// bu tshur bla med gsang sngags ni// don gcig la yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas phyir// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// ston pa sangs rgyas tshun chad dang*// skyon med brgyud pa ma chad pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma gtogs pa// log shes rdzun gyi yang zong can// rang gzhan mgo skor byed pa la// gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma re bar// rdo rje theg pa'i brjod bya mchog /rang sems phyag rgya chen po sgom// mos gus rgyun chad med par mdzod// dad dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu dang*// rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir// ye shes tshul khrims nyid kyis zhus// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog /rgyal ba sgom gzhon gyi nu bos zhus pa rdzogs so//

// 218) ༄// sprin chen po'i char 'bebs kyi cho ga byed lugs dge slong dar ma shes rab kyi zhu chos// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag po klu dbang chos kyi rje// skyes mchog bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha dang ni// bla med dkon mchog rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod// gus ldan slob mas dpag med 'gro ba la// phan par 'dod pa'i yid kyis bskul gyur pas// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// skyes chen gsung bzhin bdag gis cung zad bri// thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rje// ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'// phun sum tshogs pa lngar grub pas// de ltar nyams su blang bar bya// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pas na// bya ba'i rim pa mdor bstan bya// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// tshad med thugs rje mchog mnga' ba// yon tan phrin las rgya mtsho las// chos kyi char pa 'bebs pa'i dpal// thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs pa rnams// dbus su bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// rin chen padma'i rgyal po dang*// seng ge'i khri dang nyi zla la// sangs rgyas rol pas rnam par bzhugs// rgyal ba gzhan dag thams cad kyang*// de ltar bzhugs par gyur pa yi// phyag 'tshal dang bcas mtshan rnams ni// rin chen sogs kyis legs par bri// rab gnas cho ga gzhung bzhin bya// de 'dra'i thang ga gang yin pa// seng ge'i khri dang padma yi// stegs bu'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni// ston pa phun sum tshogs pa 'o// ri dbang klu yi dbang po'i gnas// dga' bo nyer dga'i pho brang ltar// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog tu// cho ga ji ltar gsungs bzhin bya// gnas kyi rnam bzhag bstan pa 'o// ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor// dge slong dge 'dun thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang*// khyad par klu yi rgyal po rnams// sa bcu la sogs dag la gnas// 'gro la phan pa'i thugs rje yis// bsam bzhin srid pa nyer blangs pa// rgyal ba'i 'khor du bzhugs pa 'o// ston pa bdag nyid chen po'i bka'// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// sprin chen mdo sde rin po che// rgyun chad med par bklag par bya// rdzas dang bkod pa phun tshogs pa// mi zad bde ba kun ldan zhing*// mu ge la sogs sdug bsngal spong*// bla med byang chub mchog thob pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas kyis// dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sras dang bcas pa thams cad la// gzhung 'dir gsungs pa'i sprin tshogs kyis// nyin mtshan rgyun chad med par mchod// dad pa'i stobs 'chang brtul zhugs kyis// klog sgom bya zhing mchod pas mchod// rten gyi gang zag mtshan nyid ni// chos smra ba zhes bya ba ste// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yis// dge slong yin pa bla mas gsungs// rnam dag dge slong ma rnyed na// gzhung 'dir ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// bsnyen gnas gso sbyong la gnas shing*// rnam par dag pa'i gang zag tu// bsgrub par bya ba nyid du gsungs// bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba yis// rang nyid bsrung ba bya ba dang*// byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// phan dang bde ba'i srog gcig pu// 'di la gnas na phan bde dang*// ji ltar 'dod par 'byung 'gyur ba// rgyud 'di nyid du bstan pa dang*// bde ba mchog la gnas pa yi// bden pa'i byin rlabs 'grub pa yang*// rgyud 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// rgyu dang bral ba'i 'bras bu kun// phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro zhes// thub pa'i dbang pos ma gsungs pas// rgyu med 'bras bu ma re bar// bdag nyid phun sum tshogs par bya// 'di 'dra rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// gzhung du ji ltar gsungs pa yi// bya ba'i rim pa thams cad dang*// snying nas mchod pa'i rim pa dang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa rnams// nan tan chen po klog sgom bya// thub pa'i bka' la bslu ba med// don gyi bsdus don 'di nyid yin// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gzhung du bstan pa bzhin du bya// chos kyi mkhan po chos smra ba// yi ge klog la mkhas pa rnams// ji ltar yod pa thams cad kun// shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas nas// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang gzhung sgrub thabs ji bzhin du// bsod nams tshogs kun rdzogs byas nas// dag pa gsum sogs sngags brjod pas// chos kun stong pa nyid du bsgom// de nas phun tshogs rnam pa lnga// skad cig nyid du der bsgom ste// klu yi dbang po'i gzhal med khang*// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs las// grub cing phun sum tshogs pa der// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bshad pa yis// mchod pa'i klog sgoms ting 'dzin gyis// rgyun chad med par gsol ba gdab// bha ri sha ya sa ma ya// oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ dgyes par mdzod// bla ma'i gsung gi lde mig gis// ston pa'i gsung rab sgo phye ste// nyams myong bdud rtsi'i ros tshim pa// bris pas byang chub mchog thob shog
/sprin gyi chen po'i char gyi cho ga mos gus dang ldan pa'i slob ma shākya'i sras kyi dge slong dar ma shes rab kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

219) ༄// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin dbang 'gug nas char 'bebs pa// oṃ swasti/ khyed rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// klu dbang 'khor bcas kyi thugs mgu nas// char pa kun chen po 'bab pa de// skyes chen kun khyed kyi dam tshig yin// byams chen gyi ting 'dzin ma shes na// yun ring du 'bad cing sdug bsngal yang*// 'bras bu kun mi 'byung rgyu 'bras yin// byams pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// khyed rnal 'byor pa la yong mi mnga'// sprin 'dus shing 'thor ba'i rten 'brel gyis// byams chen gyi sku shugs ma phyung bas// srog gcig pu 'di la nan tan mdzod// bdag bla mar gyur pa 'di shin tu dga'// // 220) ༄// bdag gi rnam par thar pa mi mkhas pa la bzod mi gsol ba// gong ma'i rnam thar yin phyir dang*// ston pa'i gsung dang mthun phyir dang*// slob ma gces par 'gyur phyir dang*// bar chad spang bar bya phyir dang*// tshogs chen rdzogs par 'gyur phyir dang*// ya rabs babs dang mthun phyir dang*// phyis kyi re ltos spangs phyir dang*// dpag med don chen sgrub phyir dang*// rang nyid ngan rnyogs med pa'i phyir// dgos pa'i gnas su med pa dang*// mi dgos phyogs su yod pa yi// bdag gi rnam par thar pa la// mkhas pa rnams kyis thugs khrel med// mi mkhas pa la bzod mi gsol// // 221) ༄// sku tshe ring bar bzhugs pa'i bdud rtsi'i gdams pa dar ma shes rab kyi zhu chos/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi bla ma rin po che// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// thub pa'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i sras// grags pa'i dbang phyug skyes chen gyi// dge 'dun tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir// bar chad bdud kyis mi tshugs shing*// sku tshe ring du 'tsho ba dang*// bla med byang chub thob pa'i phyir// khyed kyis nga yi rim gro zhig

/bya ba shin tu rigs so gsungs// dge 'dun tshogs rnams thams cad kyis// rin po che la gsol btab nas// bdag cag kun gyi don ched du// sku tshe ring bar bzhugs pa dang*// bar chad thams cad med pa dang*// byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs// gsungs par gsol ba btab pa las// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa po// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud 'dzin pa// rgyal ba skye 'jig bral ba la// ma pham rgyal tshab chos kyi rjes// zhus shing gsol ba btab pa las// legs gsung bdud rtsi brjod pa ni// khyed kyis nyams su longs zhes gsungs// bdud rtsi brjod ces brjod pa ni// don lnga 'di yis bstan pa ste// rgyun mi chad par chos sbyin pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mi zad gter mdzod dam chos kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*// rgyun mi chad par 'gro kun la// mi 'jigs sbyin pa sbyin byed pa// chad par gcod pa'i yul rnams sam// mi rigs byed pa thams cad la// bzod cing mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang*// rgyun mi 'chad par byams pa dang*// snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms bsgom// 'gro kun don du gnyer byed pa// bdud rtsi rnam pa gsum du bstan// rgyun mi 'chad par mchod pa'i rten// rnying pa zhig ral 'chos pa yis// chos rgyal rje blon gong ma rnams// mthon por skyes shing bzhugs pas bsrung*// rgyun mi 'chad par sems can kun// byang chub sems la mos byas pas// dkon mchog gdung rgyun mi gcod cing*// 'khor 'das yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun 'byung ba// shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs pa'i tshe// dpag med don chen rab bsgrubs nas// sras kyi thu bo ma pham pas// chos 'di yon tan rgya mtsho yi// bstod pas mchod cing brjod nas kyang*// mgon po bdag nyid chen po des// chos 'di 'dzin pa'i sa phyogs der// gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// dmag dang chom rkun srin po dang*// mkha' 'gro la sogs gnod pa kun// thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang*// lo tog nor 'bru me tog dang*// 'bras bu la sogs phun sum tshogs// bde ba thams cad 'byung bar ni// ma pham mgon pos zhal gyis bzhes// khyed kyis 'di la nan tan bgyis// gsungs shing phyag bzhes mdzad pa yis// dgongs pa grub par bdag gis mthong*// sga pa dar ma shes rab kyis zhus pa tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so//
