// 222) ༄// ri khrod lo ma gyon pa'i sgrub thabs dge bshes stod lung par gnang ba// mi bzad 'khor ba'i nad las sgrol mdzad cing*// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde chen rgya mtsho yis// 'gro ba byang chub mchog la 'god mdzad pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// rang gzhan 'jigs pa chen pos nyen pa las// sgrol byed dpal ldan rje btsun ri khrod ma// lha mo mchog la skyabs su song gyur na// 'jigs pa kun las skyob phyir cung zad bri// spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pas/ rang gzhan gyi don bya bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs pa/ dbang dang dam tshig la gnas pas/ ji ltar dbang thob pa'i lha la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin du byas nas/ las la sbyor ba'i tshul lugs spyi dang bye brag gnyis su shes par bya ste/ de la spyi ni/ rang gi lha yi dam pho reng ngam mo reng cig la yang skyon dag pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i phrin las mnga' ste/ byang chub kyi thugs kyis skyon dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir ro// bye brag ni skyon mi 'dra ba dag pa dang*/ yon tan mi 'dra ba rdzogs pa'i lha mi 'dra ba tha dad pa gsungs pas/ chom rkun bzlog pa 'od zer can// dgra bo gsod pa nag po che// dug rnams dug sel ma yis 'joms// mi ngas mi nad gcod pa sha wa ri// gsang sngags las rnams gang yin pa// rnam gsum bsnyen pas 'grub par 'gyur// bsnyen pa dbang la rag las te// dbang yang byang chub sems dang ni// skyabs gsum tshul khrims dag pa las// nges par 'byung bar shes par bya// 'phong gi slob dpon mkhas pa yis// mda' yi rig pa ji bzhin du// gsang sngags gnad kyi rig byed rnams// rnal 'byor pa yis mi 'grub med// // 223) ༄// rje btsun ma parṇa sha wa ri'i gzungs chog gi phyag len//

'dir ni bcom ldan 'das ri khrod ma'i cho ga cung zad bshad par bya ste/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi mtha' dag tu rje btsun ri khrod ma gsungs la/ de yang gtso bo gyur pa dgos pa ni/ mi ngas chen po dang*/ yams nad gcod par gsungs pas/ nga'i nyams len dpag tu med pa cig yod kyang*/ gzungs kyi cho ga bum pa la brten pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la brten pa gnyis las/ bum pa'i cho ga ni/ lag len bstan pa las shes par byas la/ ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ pha yi ye shes las bsgrub pa// rig pa ri khrod shing lo can// zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum can// zhal ras bzhad cing khro dang bcas// rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste// na chung gzhon nu phyag drug ma// g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste// gnyis pa na ni dgra st+wa nyid// gsum pas mda' ni rnam par gsor// g.yon pa sdig mdzub zhags pa can// gnyis pa shing lo'i bam po ste// phyag gsum pa na gzhu nyid do// thor tshugs me tog phreng bas bcings// de steng kha dog lnga po dag /rab tu 'dres pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs// padma dkar po'i gdan la gnas// mdog ser 'bar ba chen po ste// dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar dang bcas// khro ba'i sprin 'phro sdud mdzad cing*// gdon gang skye dgu'i nang gnas pa// de dag khro bo'i mes kyang bsreg /phyir yang bsregs la sangs rgyas kyi// kha dog bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs mdzad// de 'dra rnal 'byor gyis bsgom na// mi ngas thams cad zhi bar 'gyur// rigs sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha tsi parṇa sha ba ni/ sarba ma ri pra sha ma ni hūm̐/ de nas rigs sngags che gsungs pas// sangs rgyas zhing rnams rab tu g.yos// gnod byed nad mgo srin po dang*// sdang ba rnams kyis sems kyang zags// yam shing 'o ma can dang til// 'o ma dur bas zhi bar 'gyur// nam mkha' kun nas rigs sngags kyi// rgyal mo legs par bkang nas su// bdud rtsi char 'bebs bsams nas ni// mod la gnod pa zhi bar 'gyur// g.yon pa rdo rje'i khu tshur las// khro bo'i mdzub mo snying khar bzhag la// hūm̐ zhes bya zhing lag pa rdo rje khu tshur rdeg pa'i stangs dang bcas par 'phyar ba ni/

ri khrod kyi lo ma can gyi phyag rgya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dang po kho nar gong ltar rgyud dag par byas pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ba la 'jug par bya ste/ gnas shin tu dben par gnas khang phyag dar dang chag chag legs par btab nas/ me tog bkram pa la sogs pa yid shin tu dga' bar bya ste/ rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i rten shar phyogs su bkram zhing*/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod de/ stan bde ba'i steng du kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis gnas nas/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i rjes la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i don chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par bsgoms pa'i ngang las/ rang gi shes pa paṃ ser po zhig tu byung bar bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa gtso bo byas pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas 'od zer de tshur 'dus nas/ sa bon gyi yi ge de nyid la thim pas/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ skad cig gis rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod ma gong du bstan pa bzhin bsams nas/ de nyid kyi thugs kar padma dkar po dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs te/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga yang dag par mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dgyes par bya ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang rtags bsgom pa la sogs pa mthar thug par byas nas/ grangs dang mtshan ma dang*/ rtags kyi bsnyen pa tshad du bskyal ba'i rjes la/ mi ngas chen po la sogs pa dgos par byung ba'i dus su/ gong du ji ltar bstan pa bzhin bsgoms zhing*/ dbu rgyan gyi rgyal ba rigs rnam pa lnga'i thugs ka nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pas/

rang nyid kyi lus bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bus khengs par bsam zhing*/ des sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag pa sems gtad cing*/ ci nus su bzlas pa ni bdag bsrung ba'o// gzhan srung ba ni/ yul ris dang rgyal khams sam/ rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ rje btsun mas nam mkha' thams cad gang bar bsam la/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ nad pa'am/ yul ris sam/ rgyal khams gang zhing*/ nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi ba la sems gtad nas bzlas pa ci nus su byas pas/ grub pa'i mtshan ma'am rtags bzang po byung ba'i dus su bum pa'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bstan pa bzhin nam/ gong du bstan pa de kho na bzhin du bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa bzhi'am/ brgyad dam/ bcu gnyis sam/ bcu drug la sogs pas tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas/ gnod pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba ni myong bas grub pa yin te/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas gnod byed sreg pa dang*/ mtshon cha dum bur bya ba dang*/ brdung pa dang*/ brdeg pa la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni byar mi rung ba kho na'o// mdor bsdus na blo nges pa dang*/ rgyud dag pa dang byams pa dang*/ snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ ting nge 'dzin shin tu gsal bas grub pa kho na'o// brtse ba'i bdag nyid yum gyur rje btsun ri khrod ma'i// nyams len cung zad 'jigs pas nyen par byas pa las// gnod pa de las thar phyir bka' drin dran pa yis// nyams len yi ger bkod pas byang chub mchog thob shog rje btsun ri khrod ma la gsol ba gdab pa'i thabs yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po stod lung pas zhus pa rdzogs so// // 224) ༄// rje btsun parṇa sha wa ri'i gzungs kyi cho ga'i rim pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa yi// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dam pa yis// bdag dang khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// ri khrod lo ma'i lha mos rgyal gyur cig /rje btsun ma parṇa sha ba ri'i gzungs chog byed par 'dod pas/

dkyil 'khor mda' gang ngam yang na de bas che ba bya/ chag chag bya/ thig legs par gdab/ sgo gcig pa'am/ yang na sgo bzhi par bya/ sgo shar du bstan/ dbus padma 'dab brgyad pa lte bar dkar por bya/ der nas bre gang tsam spungs/ padma'i 'dab ma rnams la nas kyi me tog bkram/ bum pa rin po che'am/ rdza bum yin na dkar po byug bre gang tsam shong ba'i bum pa dbus su bzhugs/ bum pa rdzas lnga tshan lnga la sogs pa gzhan dang mthun/ mgul chings prog lnga la sogs pa bcings/ bum pa gu gul gyis bdugs/ sum bha ni la sogs brjod cing*/ nas sam yungs kar la sngags pas brab cing bgegs bskrad/ sku khrus gsol ba'i chu dri bzang gi bum pa bkang*/ bal bu'am shug pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa'i shing gi kha rgyan zugs/ bum rdzas bum pa'i nang du gzhug rdo rje rab gnas byas pa zhig gzungs thag za 'og kha dog sna lnga yod pas byas na legs/ yang na bal tshon sna lnga'i thi gu sum sgril ring thung rang gi lus tshad gsum dang mnyam pa btags la kha rgyan gyi gseb tu bzhugs/ mchod pa lnga bshams/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ de nas bshang gci la sogs pa dor/ kha shar du blta/ stan bde ba la dkyil krung bcas/ lus drang por bsrang*/ de nas gnod byed kyis gtso bos byas pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ khyad par du yams nad la sogs pas gtso bo byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bzlas pa phreng skor gcig bya/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog parṇa sha ba ri dang bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ gtor ma gong ma bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul/ de'i 'og ma chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la dbul/ 'byung po thams cad pa'am/

rlung me bud sbar gyis phul la/ gzungs chog ma thon gyi bar du rten gtor du bya/ thun la 'jug dus su gsos la dbul/ bar chad mi 'byung bar gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma 'og ma de yul de na gnas pa'i sa bdag gi dge bsnyen chen po'am/ gzhi bdag gam gnod byed la kha 'bar mas dbul la/ bar chad ma byed byas la gsol ba gdab/ bka' bsgo bya/ gtor ma 'di phyir gtang*/ skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa zhig bya/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod pas stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bhrūm̐ las bum pa phyi rin po che/ nang lha'i gzhal med khang du bsam/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i gdan steng du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du paṃ dkar po yang na ser po zhig bsams/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mtshor rde'u bskyur ba'i chu'i gnyer ma cher mched pa bzhin du sngon la rang la nye ba'i yul phyogs kyi sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa yams nad la sogs pas gtso bo byas pa rnams zhi zhing dag par byas/ de nas sems can ma lus thams cad la de ltar byas pas thams cad parṇa sha wa rir gyur/ lhar gyur pa sor bzhugs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas bum pa'i nang gi paṃ la thim pa zhu bas parṇa sha wa ri/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum pa/ dbus ser ba/ g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas sngo ba/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa na dgra st+wa bsnams pa/ gsum pa na mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa/ gnyis pa shing lo'i bam po/ gsum pa gzhu bsnams pa/ padma dkar po'i steng na/ me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa/ ri khrod kyi lo ma gyon pa bsgom/ de'i thugs ka na paṃ las padma dang zla ba'i steng na paṃ dkar po'am ser po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ parṇa sha wa ri 'og min nam rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la phyag dang mchod pa dbul/

de nas dza byas pas ye shes ma mdun gyi de bum pa'i nang gi lha mo dam tshig ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs/ hūm̐ byas pas lus la thim par bsam/ baṃ byas pas gnyis su med par bsam/ ho byas pas dgyes pa bskyed par bsam/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐ bsam/ de sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs ka dang*/ rang lha yin pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas sam 'og min nas rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phyag dang mchod pa bya/ dbang bskur ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas lha mo dpag tu med pa byon nas dbang bskur bas/ las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag nas sku lus thams cad bdud rtsis khengs/ yar 'khyil bas don yod grub pa gtso bo byas pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par bsam/ de dbang bskur zhing dbang rtags bsgom pa'o// de nas mdun du spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mi gshegs par thams cad parṇa sha wa ri'i rnam par bsgom/ phyag dang mchod pa dbul/ de nas rang yi dam du gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bum pa'i nang gi lha mo thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas/ yams nad kyis gtso bo byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par byed pa'i thugs dam bcas pa de bskul bas/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor dkar po nar gyis babs pas bum pa'i nang khengs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yang rang yi dam du gyur pa dang bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros nas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba sngar bzhin bya/ de nas rang gi yi dam gyi nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ pi sha tsi parṇa sha wa ri sarba ma ri pra sha ma ni hūm̐ zhes bzlas so// bzlas pas gzungs thag la 'khril bar yang bdud rtsi babs/

gzungs thag lag pas bzung*/ yang na 'od zer la dmigs nas bzlas pas chog gsung*/ lag pas bzung mi dgos/ 'jog tsam na parṇa sha wa ri dang mdun gyi nam mkha'i sha wa ri bzhugs pa rnams bdud rtsir zhu nas bum pa khengs par bsam/ bum pa'i nang gi lha bdud rtsir zhu nas bum pa khengs par bsams/ de nas gzungs chu'i phud bla ma la dbul/ de nas dkon mchog la/ de nas chos skyong la/ de dag sku khrus gsol bar bsams la dbul/ de nas yul gyi mi ma yin pa cig la 'bul/ de nas yon bdag la sogs pa khrus byed du gzhug yi ge brgya pa brjod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya/ yang rje btsun ma parṇa sha wa ri la yi dam du byed na sems bskyed la/ rang skad cig gis parṇa sha wa rir bsgom/ dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par bsre/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la phyag dang mchod pa dbul/ dbang skur bar gsol ba gdab/ thugs ka nas lha mo rnams byon nas dbang skur/ dbang rtags rigs lnga bsgom/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ bdud rtsi bab nas sems can la phog pas yams nad kyis gtso bo byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi zhing dag par bsams la sngags bzla/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya/ grogs pos bskul bas bla ma'i gsung bzhin du// gzungs chog yi ger bris pa las byung ba'i// dge ba'i rtsa bas 'jig rten ma lus rnams// sgrib pa kun dag go 'phang mchog thob shog /gser/ dngul/ zangs/ byi ru/ mu tig sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ kha ra/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar ro// nas/ 'bras/ so ba/ til/ khe tsu tse'o/ gur gum/ bcu gang*/ dza ti/ sug smel/ ka ko la/ li shi'o// tsan dan/ a ka ru/ du ru ka gla rtsi dang*/ rgya spos/ ga bur la sogs pa rnams kyang gzhug go/ //

225) ༄// rje btsun ri khrod lo gyon ma'i bstod pa tshigs bcad ma// chos sku bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// yams la sogs pa nad kyi 'jigs pa dang*// dus min 'chi las skyob par byed pa yi// don 'grub phrin las yum la phyag 'tshal lo// padma'i gdan la gser mdog ri khrod ma// rtsa ba'i zhal ser g.yas g.yon sngo dang dkar// dbu skra thor tshugs gzi brjid ldan pa yi// dngos grub lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes thugs rje'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// dus mtha'i me dpung lta bu'i klong dkyil na// zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed khro mo'i zhal// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// ri khrod lo ma sku la bsnams pa yi// mda' gzhu dgra st+wa shing lo'i bam po 'dzin// sdig mdzub rdo rje bsnams pa'i sha wa ri// yum chen 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// // 226) ༄// chos kyi rtsa ba snying po'i don bsdus dge sbyong bsod nams dpal la gdams pa// mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// mgon po de yi zhabs rdul la// cung zad reg par gyur pa yi// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa// bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga la// bsdus don cung zad bri bar bya// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yis// grangs dang rtags dang mtshan ma yi// bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba yis// sgrub pa las sbyor bya ba yi// rim pa rgya cher bshad pa kun// rnal 'byor pa yis bya ba las// gzhan gyis bya bar ma gsungs pas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// rang gzhan snang srid 'khor 'das kun// sku gsum dbyer med sangs rgyas su// rtogs shing nges pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gsang sngags phrin las thams cad kun// bya ba yin gyi gzhan min phyir// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga yang*// rgyu gsum rkyen gsum byed pa gsum// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub// phan dang bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bur yang*// skyabs su song dang sdom pas bsdams// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab la gnas// rig 'dzin sngags dang de nyid shes// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// gshis sam babs kyi dge ba'i chos// rten 'brel sgrigs la mkhas gyur na// gtsub shing gtsub stan rtsol ba dang*// pi wang sgra yi dpe bzhin du// thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i sku// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyis bsgrub// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa// skyabs gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// tshul khrims bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// byin rlabs chen po bstan pa dang*// chos nyid rnam par dag pa yi// byin gyis brlabs su bstan pa yi// rigs sngags gsang sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya'i byin rlabs bstan pa rnams// sangs rgyas chos kyi rjes 'brang nas// chos 'di ston pa'i rjes 'brang zhes// chos kyi ston pa mchod pa 'am// ston pas dam chos gang mchod pa// ston pa'i gsung rab rnams su ltos// de ltar gyur na dam pa'i chos// dge ba gshis kyi dge ba dang*// mi dge gshis kyi mi dge ba// de la mkhas pa su zhig skrag

/gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad nyid// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// gshis kyi dge ba yin pa'i phyir// mkhas pa rnams kyis cis mi bsgrub// spyi yi rnam bzhag bstan gyur nas// bye brag tha dad gnad bstan pa// 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyis gsungs// ston pa chos dang 'khor dang yang*// dus kyi bye brag gang bstan pa// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga zhes// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las kyang*// phrin las rnam bzhis bsdus pa ste// 'di dag 'grub pa'i sgrub thabs ni// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// skyes chen phag mo gru pa yis// chos kyi rtsa ba gnad kyi don// bsdus pa'i snying po tshig gcig pa// dad pa gcig pu 'di nyid yin// dad pa dad pa dad pa can// rgyud la skyes pa'i dad pa ni// gnas brtan chen po kun dga' bo// ston pa'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i tshe// lus ni dum bur btang na yang*// bdag gis mi tshor bka' bstsal gsung*// sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis// dad pa skyes par gyur pa na// gong nad dmu skran brdol bar gsung*// ma gcig jo mo lha rje mas// ston pa'i dam chos rin po che// zab mo gnad kyi don mthong bas// brgyal zhing 'bog nas sangs pa'i tshe// skyon dang bral zhing yon tan rdzogs// 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya// thub pa'i dam chos thams cad kyi// don gyi snying po 'di yin te// dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i chos ni mi skye ste// sa bon me yis tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no// 'di don khong du chud byas nas// rang gis rang nyid mi bslu 'tshal// rang mgo rang gis mi bskor 'tshal// rang la rang rdzun mi bya bar// mos gus dad pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bsgrub// ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du 'byung*// bslu ba med de rgyal ba'i bka'// mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung*// mnyam gzhag chen po dam pa'i chos kyi rten 'brel gyis// phyi nang gsang ba mtha' yas rgya mtsho ma lus kun// kye ma kye ho bcu dang sum cu dam pa'i chos kyis nges// 'di ltar 'phong gi slob dpon gyis// mda' yi rig byed shes pa yis// gzhu dang rgyud dang mda' dang ni// 'phen pa'i tshod dang rig byed kyi// gnad kyis 'ben la 'phog pa ltar// gsang sngags gnad kyi 'phrin las bzhi// dus kyi sbyor bas bsgrub pa ste// rab snang yul gyi mi ngas kun// gnas brtan sgra gcan ma yis bzlog

/ji ltar srang mda' mtho dman bzhin// skye dang 'gag pa'i rim pa kun// srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin du gsungs// gsang sngags rten 'brel zab mo rnams// zhi ba shar ste dbang la nub// rgyas pa byang ste drag po lho// zhi ba phal cher tho rangs bya// rgyas pa rgyas pa'i dus nyid yin// dmar thag chad pa dbang gi dus// nyin mtshan phyed dus drag po gsungs// zhi ba dkar po rgyas pa ser// dbang la dmar po drag po gnag /zhi ba zlum po gru bzhi rgyas// dbang la mgon po phyag mtshan te// zla gam nyid du gsungs pa yin// drag po zur gsum nyid du bzhed// bzlas pa bskul tshig mtha' bsgyur gyi// sngags tshig gnad kyi bye brag kun// bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi ni// skom par gyur pas 'thung na ngoms// skye rga na 'chi med ces grags// ji ltar rgya mtsho lta bu yi// gzhung du gsungs pa thams cad las// chad dam yang na lhag gyur na// thub pa'i bka' dang 'gal gyur zhing*// dgra bo gsod pa'i ral gri yis// rang nyid ske ba bcad pa las// tshe ring bde ba 'dod pa bzhin// phyin ci log gi rten 'brel gyis// rang gzhan phung bar the tshom med// de phyir bdag gis gdams ngag gi /yi ge mang po bris pa dang*// zab pa'i gnad 'dir bstan pa kun// rang la yod pa'i rang gi sems// dge dang mi dge bsam pa 'di// che 'bring chung gsum skyes pa las// 'bras bu so sor gang 'byung ba// nyams su myong bas snying rje'i shugs// a mas sdug pa'i bu gcig bzhin// skom pas gdungs pa'i chu bzhin du// bkres pas nyen pa'i kha zas bzhin// snying rjes gdungs pa'i chu rlabs kyis// smon lam rgya mtsho ma gtogs pa// kun la phan pa'i re thag chad// mos gus ldan pa'i slob ma la// kha nas khrag skyug tshig tu brjod// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho dang*// 'phags pa grub thob gong ma yi// 'grel pa nor bu rin chen de// dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa de// ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul// de dag spangs pa'i rig byed cig

/bdag gis gzhan nas rnyed gyur zhes// sus kyang smra ba yod min te// brjod byed tshig gis mtshon pa'i don// brjod bya don du gnas pa kun// rang gi bsam pa 'di yin zhes// 'jig rten mgon pos 'o dod 'bod// khyu mchog rlabs chen gnas mchog tu// dam bca' chen po yang yang mdzad// 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra// dpag tu med pa bsgrags pa rnams// chos kyis phongs pa'i blo gros can// tha snyad tshig gis bslus gyur pas// bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du// da lta'i lus ngag yid gsum 'di// lag pa g.yas g.yon ma spos pa// da lta'i lus ngag yid gsum la// bka' bstsal thams cad go ba blangs// nyams su blangs pas rang rgyud tshim// rang gi bu la snying gtam brjod// dper na ltogs par gyur pa'i mi// zas kyis gdungs par gyur pa la// kha zas bzang po rnyed gyur na// rang nyid 'grangs par gyur pa'i tshe// rang gi bu smad dran pa ltar// bdag kyang rin chen gdams ngag kun// rang gi sems la byas pa yis// nyams su myong ba cung zad skyes// phan gnod 'gro ldog go ba rnams// rang gi bu la rgya cher bsgrags// tha snyad tshig gi rjes 'brangs shing*// sgra don 'brel ba ma shes pa// rang sems sbyangs pa med pa la// go ba med pa'i gsang tshig 'di// dmus long nyi ma mi mthong ltar// go ba med pa de dag la// kye ma bdag gis ji ltar bya// rang rgyud rang gis sbyongs shig ces// rang gi bu la 'o dod 'bod// don gyi snying po bsdus pa 'di// padma la ni chu bzhin du// 'jig rten chos kyis ma gos shing*// tshul khrims bsil ba'i dri ngad kyis// rang gzhan rgyud kun tshim pa dang*// 'khor yug rdo rje ri bo ltar// mtho dman skyon gyis mi g.yo zhing*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// yon tan rin chen len pa yi// bdag gi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu// grags chen shākya seng ge'i sras// dge sbyong bsod nams dpal gyis zhus// 'di bris bsod nams gang thob des// dus gsum rgyal ba dam pa'i chos// rang gi sems su gsungs gyur pa// 'gro bas sems nyid rtogs par shog

/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che'i gsung*/ don gyi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong bsod nams dpal gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 227) ༄// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug 'di rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin pa// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de// rtog pa dgag sgrub bslab pa yin// ngan rtog spong ba dgag bcas te// skyabs gsum nyams len sgrub bcas 'di// ston pas thabs su gsungs pa yin// mi rtog shes rab rang bzhin dang*// gnyis su med pas gnas skabs dang*// mthar thug yon tan bskyed pa yin// rnam rtog ma rig sgra spyi la// 'khrul bar gyur na lhung bar nges// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyi gzhung lam yin// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bag chags slongs pa rten 'brel yin// slongs shing 'dag pa ma shes nas// phyi la btsal na 'dag pa dka'// des na bla ma'i mos gus dang*// sgom la nan tan bskyed par bya// // 228) ༄// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtod chen po'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ 'khor ba nyes tshogs sgrib pa rnam sbyong zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan mchog sbyin pa// mnyam med bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal zhabs la rab btud nas// skyes chen mchog gi bka' bstsal ji bzhin du// zhus pa'i gsung don yi ger bri bar bya// dpag med bsod nams tshogs las legs byung bar// thub pa'i bstan pa gangs can rgyud 'dir 'khrungs// smon lam stobs kyis rigs dang rus rnams dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med ljon shing rgyas// bslab gsum skyon med seng ge'i nga ro yis// chos ltar bcos pa'i wa tshogs zil mnan nas// 'jigs med khyod ni gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyu// dbang gi rgyal po u dum ba ra ltar// rnyed par dka' ba'i bla ma dam pa ni// skyes chen lha dbang gtsug gi rgyan du mdzes// dam pa khyod kyis bdag la dris pa yi// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum gyi tshul// 'di la the tshom za ba ma mchis kyang*// khyod kyi tshig la gces par gzung ba'i phyir// yi ger bris la bskur ces gsungs pa la// ji ltar nyi ma'i dbus su gnas pa yi// 'od zer gzhan du btsal ba rigs pa min// khyed kyi bla ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// blo yi mun pa thams cad bcom nas kyang*// 'od zer gnyis pas mun pa ji bzhin dang*// ji ltar lcags sgrogs dam pos bcings gyur pa// bcad cing grol nas thar bar byas pa la// da rung lcags sgrogs grol bar 'dod pa dang*// ji ltar mig nyid ldongs par gyur pa las// sman pa mkhas pas legs par mthong byas pa// da rung mthong bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu ltar// khyed kyis bdag la bskul bar rigs min kyang*// nyi ma mthong bas nyi ma nyid dang ni// sha btson thar byas sman pa'i rgyal po la// dga' bar gyur bzhin khyed kyi gsung 'di 'os// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum thams cad kyi// mi yi seng ge ma lus pas// gsungs pa'i dam chos thams cad kun// sems can khams rgyud ma lags sam// 'gro ba'i khams rgyud bag la nyal// ji ltar yod pa thams cad kun// rang gi sems 'di gcig pu ste// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// thams cad rang gi sems yin gsungs// 'khor 'das rtsa ba rang gi sems// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa dang*// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu dang*// spros dang spros med stong pa dang*// bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis med du// gang gis mthong bar gyur pa yi// skyes bu tha shal de dag gi

/grub pa'i mtha' dang theg pa'i tshul// bsam gyis mi khyab thams cad kyi// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i 'khor lo yis/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// byis pa mu mtha' med par 'khor// de yang 'jig rten mgon po yis// bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi bka'// lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /de bzhin du ni rang rgyal theg /byis pa rnams ni yongs drang phyir// theg pa sna tshogs ngas bstan te// ji srid sems 'jug yod kyi bar// theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med// des na theg pa gcig tu bstan// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*// rgyu gcig lam gcig 'bras bu gcig /tha dad 'dzin pas 'khor bar 'khrul// 'gro ba'i mgon pos gsungs pas na// gang du 'dzin pas bsam mi khyab// rgyu lam 'bras bu de bzhin te// blo yi yul las 'das pa'i don// rang byung phyag rgya chen po ni// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dang*// rje btsun lha rje rin po ches// byin rlabs kyi lam la gnas pa yin// dad pa can gyi go ba ni// thos pa che bas shes pa min// rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min// de ltar lags so grogs po kun// bdag nyid chen pos gsungs pa dang*// ma pham mgon po'i zhal snga nas// rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pa yis mthong ba med// 'di 'dra'i bka' bstsal gsung gi tshogs// dpag med sprin phung 'khrigs pa rnams// mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam bshad mdzad// de don gang yin mig 'byed pa// de bzhin nyid gcig shes pa yis// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kyi// mdo dang rgyas pa shes pa de// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bla ma las// khyod kyi thugs su chud par nges// de ltar yin pa'i gtan tshigs kyang*// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// mos gus de 'dra skyes pa de// bdag la mngon shes ma mchis kyang*// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams// rgyu yis 'bras bu dpag pa dang*// 'bras bus rgyu nyid dpag par gsungs// de yi phyir na skyes chen gyis// yon tan rgya mtsho skyed bzhed na// de bzhin nyid du dbyer med pa'i// chos 'di thugs su chud pa yi// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la// sngar bzhin mos gus mdzad par zhu// bcom ldan 'das kyi mchog gi zung*// ston pa drung du phyin pa'i tshe// dang por ston pa bcom ldan la// phyag mi 'tshal ba'i bcas pa mdzad// de yang 'di skad bka' bstsal to// rgan pa yang na gzhon yang rung*// gang las chos ni rnams shes pa// de la thog mar phyag bya ste// me la bram ze ji bzhin no// theg pa chung ngur rnam grags pa// 'dul ba lung du gsungs pa las// rdo rje theg pa la sogs pa// theg pa chen po thams cad kyi// brjod bya bla ma yin pas 'dir// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa brtsam pa dang*// mchod pa kun gyi thog mar ni// bla ma'i mchod pa brtsam par gsungs// rje btsun mi la yab sras kyis// bla ma sangs rgyas yin pa la// brgyud pa bgrangs pa mthol lo bshags// bshags pa'i yul du bzhag pas na// nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma la// sngar bzhin mos gus byas gyur pas// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyang*// de dang gnyis su med pa'i phyir// thams cad mchod cing bkur bas na// gong ma'i yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// byin rlabs 'byung bar the tshom med// 'jig rten mgon po gong ma'i bka'// bu la rjes su gdams pa 'o// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// bcom ldan 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs las byung gyur cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa shes rab rnam gsum gyis// rang gzhan blo yi mdud pa grol byed pa// rgyal ba'i sras po dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// shākya'i rgyal po gsung la gus pa dang*// gong ma'i rnam thar dri ma med pa yi// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs cung zad 'dzin byed pa// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pa la zhus// nor cing 'khrul na bzod par mdzad par zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang po red gyur cig /yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/ rtod chen pos zhus pa rdzogs so// //

229) ༄// nyams rtogs gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan gyi zhu chos// mnyam med bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha// rgyal ba rnams dang zhi ba chags bral chos// rgyal ba rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// rang gi bu la legs par gdams pa'i ngag /nyams len byed pa de la cung zad gdams// rgyal ba'i sras khyod yab kyi pha yi phogs// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen bzung bya zhing*// sdig can bdud kyi spyod la 'jug mi bya// bslab gsum bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun btung bya zhing*// nyes gsum gdug pa'i dug rnams bza' mi bya// rang gzhan phan zhing bde bar 'gyur ba'i thabs// thub pa'i bka' bzhin byed pa yin zhe na// dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa'i rgyal sras kyis// ci yi phyir na rang gzhan smin mi mdzad// nyams len gnad du dril ba rdo rje'i gsung*// sde snod rin chen gsum gyi snying po'i bcud// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// drang srong chen po phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi snying po smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems// rang dbang med par chu bos khyer ba'i yid// rgyun chad med cing nyes pas ma g.yos na// theg chen rgya mtsho'i nang du chud gyur pa// mkhas pa chen po khyod kyis thugs su chud// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin mi bskyod pa// gdod nas dag pa lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan bdag nyid dang*// rtag tu 'bral bar mi byed dam tshig can// skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon pos rtag tu skyabs// skyob mdzad bla ma sems nyid ji lta bar// mos gus can khyod rje dang 'bral mi bya// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad kun// nam mkha'i padmo ri bong rwa bzhin du// yod ma myong la 'dod pa'i bsam pa ni// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor pa la 'byung mi 'gyur// byis pa'i rjes blos nyes spyod gar thabs ni// mig ldan mkhas pa rnams kyis byed mi srid// skye med zhes dang stong dang bdag med zhes// dman pa rnams kyis sems dang yul rnams la// rnam par brtags pa'i blo gros ngan pa rnams// phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i mes// skal ldan rnams kyi sgrib pa'i bud shing bsregs// sems nyid rnam dag chu snod me long la// rang gzhan gnyis med sna tshogs gzugs brnyan rnams// nor 'khrul med par so sor gang snang ba// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i mi zad gter// rten cing 'brel 'byung nam mkha'i gnas 'di la// bcom ldan mgon po rnams dang gong ma yi// bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ngo mtshar zhes// ched du brjod pa'i dbyangs kyis legs bstod pa// rnal 'byor ri khrod pa yis longs spyod mdzod// lus dang sems dang snang ba'i ri mo kun// lus med sems med snang ba med pa la// snang ba mkha' bzhin rtogs pas mngon shes ldan// mi bslu phag mo gru pas de skad gsungs// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag rgya mtsho rnams// mthong dang thos dang reg dang dran pa dang*// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i bye brag rnams// bdag nyid thugs la btags dang ma btags kyi// smig rgyu'i chu bos khyer ba'i ri dwags rnams// log shes tshig gis bslus nas ltung bar nges// ji ltar dmus long nyi ma mi mthong la// nyi ma bshad pas de la ci zhig bya// snang med mig gis rgyu 'bras mthong na ko

/mig ldan de la nyi ma bshad mi dgos// rin po che yis bu la 'di skad ces// ri khrod dgon par bsgom zhes yang yang gsungs// snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa'i yi ge 'di// bdag nyid chen pos bskul nas bris pa las// byung ba'i dge ba dri med 'dis mtshon nas// dge ba thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rigs las byung*// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar 'dzin byed pa// rigs la skyon med dge slong shākya yi sras// brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan zhes pas zhus pa 'o// nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pas gsung rab don gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ tha snyad dang tshig gi spros pa gcod pa'i yi ge /nyams su blang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 230) ༄// dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la mchod cing bkur bsu bya ba'i rim pa// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa bdag nyid chen po'i bkas// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// mchod cing gus 'dud yin zhes gsungs// de la mchod cing bkur ba'i thabs// bsu ba bya ba'i rim pa bshad// de la smod cing sdang ba yis// ngan pa brjod pa gang yin pa// thub pa'i gsung la sdang ba bas// shar phyogs snga ma bzhin du 'thad// nub phyogs bsu ba'i rim pa la// dar dang gdugs dang rol cha bas// sngun nas bsu la zhabs tog bya// chos kyi khri yi shar phyogs su// 'ben gang tsam gyi thad so nas// lho yi phyogs su khrid par bya// lam nas lho yi phyogs nyid du// 'dom pa bcu nas nub phyogs su// mnyam gzhag yengs pa med pa yis// thams cad lam la tshud pa'i tshe// dkon mchog gsum la phyag gsum bya// de yi rjes la 'gro ba dang*// sdod pa'i skabs kyis shes par bya// de nas byang gi phyogs nyid du// lam du ma slebs bar du dgug

/lam du phyin nas shar phyogs su// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i gom pa yis// mnyam par bzhag pas phyin nas kyang*// snga ma'i lam gyi srol nyid la// byang du 'dom pa nyi shu dgug /gnas der phyag rten byas nas kyang*// dar gyi brda yi mtshon pa yis// phyag dang 'dud pa gang 'os bya// ku dang bswo yis mi gda' cing*// sred can za 'dod mchu smyong gi /ngan spyod spangs pa'i tshul gyis 'gro// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// // 231) ༄// bag med sha chang spangs nas bza' btung ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor bskor ba// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum mgon rin po che// chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs kyi sras// thos dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus// skal ldan smin cing grol mdzad pa// khyed kyi mdzad spyod thugs dgongs la// bdag kyang rjes su yi rang zhing*// zhe 'dod snying nas gsol ba 'debs// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// mi shes mun par 'khyams pa kun// brtse ba'i ma ma khyed nyid kyis// lam khrid ded dpon mdzad du gsol// skal ldan gus pa'i yid can gyi// slob ma smin par byed pa la// ci gnas lta ba'i 'pho skyas kyis// yi chad sgyid lug gyur pa de// drang srong chen po gong ma yi// rnam thar bsdu dngos rnam bzhi dang*// 'gal ba med pa ma yin pas// dpon slob tshogs pa bral ba yi// bdud dpung ma lus bcom mdzad nas// 'gro ba smin cing grol mdzad gsol// dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad du// sha chang chags sdang 'khor lo yis// ngan song gsum dang khams gsum du// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo mi bskor bar// kun rdzob don dam byang sems kyi// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// bza' btung ye shes bdud rtsi yis// mchod cing mnyes par byas pa yis// tshogs gnyis 'khor lo mi chad pa// bsod nams mthar thug tshogs 'khor lo// bu slob rnams dang khyed rang gis// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad gsol//

// 232) ༄// drang srong chen po'i dmod mo dpal chen rdo rje ye shes la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ nye gnas kyi yang snying*/ dpal chen po rdo rje ye shes la spring pa/ nyid kyi zhabs tog dang*/ phyogs nas byon pa'i 'grul pa la khums pas/ thub pa 'gro ba'i mgon po/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis nyon mongs pa phra rags bcom pas/ 'bras bu bcom ldan 'das su gyur ba yin pa la/ sha chang 'dod yon gyi ro la chags pa'i nyon mongs pa gsum gyis/ rang rgyud sregs nas/ 'od kyis gzhan gyi rgyud/ bskal pa'i mer 'bar bas/ thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang ma lus pa bzhin du/ dkar po'i chos ma lus par byas nas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar byed pa rnams la/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po'i gdung ba'i shugs kyis/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi yon tan rin po che mtha' dag skyed par byed pa'i gzhi rten du gyur pa/ 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i rgyu/ tshul khrims rin po che la 'god cing*/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i bral 'bras/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis/ dpag tu med pa'i 'gro ba smin cing grol bar mdzad ces khums/ de ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i sras su khas len pa rnams kyi 'bab sa yang de yin/ bla ma dkon mchog gong ma thams cad la byas pa shes pa dang*/ byas pa gzo ba dang*/ byas pa chud mi gzon pa de yin/ bdag kyang bla ma dam par bkur nas/ mtho bcu gsum gung gi ya blar bzhag pa yang de lags pas/ shin tu thugs la btags/ cha byad bzang*/ kho bo la sogs gong ma rnams// khyed kyis shin tu thugs la btags// thub pa'i bstan pa bzung ba yis// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten yang*// shin tu thugs la btags pa lags// nyid kyi 'bul yig ji bzhin du// gtan tshigs lnga yis bsdus pa yi// gang phyir de phyir de dag la// byas pa'i dge rtsa 'bul ba rnams// bzhed pa bzhin du phyag tu thengs// bu sdug shin tu thugs la btags// da rung sngar bzhin thugs la thogs// nga yi sgom chen ri khrod pa// nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams// la las bla ma rjes su dran// byin rlabs chos skur rtogs zhes gsungs// la las sangs rgyas rjes su dran// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin rgyun chad med// la las dam chos rjes su dran// sems gnyis 'dres pas rang rgyud grol// la las dge 'dun rjes su dran// mos gus rgya mtsho gting nas g.yo// la las mi chos 'khrugs pa dran// mi chos thal phyag bya sa dka'// la las a ma rjes su dran// a ma skyong ba ngas ma mthong*// la las bu lon khe skyed dran// len pa mang ste khugs pa nyung*// la las mi chos 'khrugs pa dran// babs kyang dgra bo ma chun pa// blo nor rnams la the les

mchil ma thob// bzang dran dbu 'phang dgung du bstod// bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// chos skyong rnams kyis bar chad sol// 'di drang srong chen po'i dmod mo yin// bden pa mi 'grub kha med lags// // 233) ༄// dge 'dun mtshams sgrub mi nus pa'i rigs phyogs gzhan du gshegs par zhu ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i bka' drin gyis/ sngon nga la grags pa chen po byung*/ de la brten nas rnyed pa chen po byung*/ de la ngas bsams pas/ rang la yon tan ni med/ yon tan can du grags pa'i 'bul ba 'di log 'tshor 'gro'am/ khur chen po ngas mi theg mi blang dgos snyam pa la/ 'jig rten mgon po'i bkas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang*/ dri med grags pa dang*/ na gardzu na'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ thog ma dang bar dang*/ tha mar dge ba/ zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum bsgrub pa/ bzang ngan med pa thams cad rab tu 'byin pa/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes la bsams nas/ 'khor ba mtha' yod pa'am/ byang chub thob pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig la bsams pa lags/ deng sang ni sgrub pa byed pa'i bsam pa yod pa 'ga' re yang byung*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bsam pa 'ga' re 'dug pas/ snga ma'i bsam pa phyogs log bsgrub pa byed pa la blo nges/ dge 'dun gyi sku mtshams nga'i rim gror 'gro bar 'dug pas/ dge 'dun rnams mtshams gcaud par zhu/ mtshams bcad la mtshams rgyags cung zad zhabs tog bgyi bas thams cad sku mtshams su bgyi bar zhu/ mtshams mi nus sgrub pa mi byed pa'i rigs can rnams phyogs gzhan du gshegs par zhu/ sngon bzhin rjes la bskyar nas blangs pa ni med/ dad pa can gyi rdzas ni lci/ sa thag ring po nas ni 'ongs/ chos zab mo nas bre gang la yang rag lus pas/ tshong gzab pa dang sri dgos par yang go/ // 134) ༄// ngag gi dbang phyug dri ma med pa'i sgron me rin chen grags kyi zhu chos// bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig dpag med du// las dang skal pa mthun par gyur pa dang*// gcig gis gcig la bstangs

phan 'dogs pa par gyur pa yis// gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// thub pa'i bstan la skal mnyam mtshungs par skyes// sngon gyi thub pa drang srong sras bcas ltar// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel 'dod yon dang*// rang gi lus dang srog la ma bltas shing*// mi blta ltos pa med pa'i bdag nyid can// mi bzad dmyal bar song yang rjes 'brang zhing*// sangs rgyas thob la dga' ba'i blo med pas// ci gsung bka' la nyan pa'i mos gus can// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa dang*// pha mes ma mes brgyud pa'i don rgyud 'dzin// khams gsum sems can kun gyi mgon mdzad pa'i// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad 'khor lo'i bdag /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta thams cad du// lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug mkhas rnams kyis// tshig gi don la sgro skur med par mjal// de 'dra'i slob ma rang bas lhag pa la// ci yi phyir na gdams ngag ster mi byed// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad du// mi chos lha dam gang gis ngos nas kyang*// de 'dra yal bar dor ba srid dam dgongs// bu bu bu gcig gus pas bdag la nyon// dam pa'i gsung la gus pa ma skyes na// nyon mongs 'joms pa'i nyams rtogs mi skye ste// dgon gdung tsha sgo can la padma bzhin// nyon mongs dug lnga 'bar ba'i stobs 'phel nas// bla ma rnams dang dam pa'i chos la smod// sdig pa'i grogs po bdud kyi dbang du 'gro// tshe 'di'i che thabs g.yeng bas rnam par g.yeng*// thos bsam sgom gsum brtul zhugs gang 'dzin kyang*// lto gos chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i yang zong phyir// 'bad pa byas kyang 'khor ba'i gting rdo ang*// ang nge ang nge rang la ltos pa'i bu// bla ma dam pas khyed cag mgo mi skor// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam rgyas pa 'bum// byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar phal po che// rdo rje tshig rkang dpal ldan birwa'i lam// bram ze chen po'i dgongs pa do ha yin// slob dpon 'phags pa'i do ha rtogs pa'i chos// rtsa ba shes rab rim pa lnga yin gsungs// tshad med snying rje chen po phul byung bas// rgyal ba sras bcas grub thob gong ma yis// nyams rtogs thugs las byung ba gsungs pa rnams// nyams len mos gus byed pa'i mi rnams kyis// gong ma'i dgongs pa lon pa mi srid ces// rgyal ba'i gsung dang grub thob gong ma yis// rgyu med 'bras bu rgya cher gang gsungs pa// skal ldan mos gus can gyis go bar zad// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs gang yin pa// me stag chung yang nags tshal chen po bsreg

/gnyis med ye shes me lce rab tu 'bar// mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab tu sel// sred sogs nyon mongs ljan ljin thal bar rlog /nyes spyod bdud kyi dpung gis zil mi bzod// thub pa'i yon tan dpag med rab yangs pa// thob par 'gyur na gzhan lta smos ci dgos// phra ba'i me stag gsos shig rang gi bu// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid chos rnams la// chags dang thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis// bka' dang bstan bcos lung rigs thams cad kyis// legs par gtan la phab pa'i dam chos kyang*// mes ni nags tshal ji ltar sreg pa'i tshul// nor 'khrul med par rgya cher bshad pa yin// bshad pa'i tshig dang don gyi me stag gnyis// sgra dang don du snang gi rnal 'byor pa// me stag legs par skyongs la bshad pa bzhag /me lce 'bar na bshad pa shes nas mchi// me 'dod pa la de bzhin sa dang chu// rnam pa sna tshogs log shes tha dad kyis// phyin ci log tu log ltas bslad pa'i yid// yang dag lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud// tshong dus 'o ma gdams chung man chung rnams// sa dang chu sogs rgya che grangs mang yang*// me min me yi grogs su mi 'gyur bas// don med gdams chung rnams la re thag bcad// rang gi me stag gsos dang rnal 'byor pa// 'di ltar nyams su longs dang 'di ltar 'ong*// gtan tshigs rgyu mtshan dag dang bcas pa yi// man ngag mang po gzhan gyis gang bstan pa// 'thad 'thad 'dra ba'i tshig dang yi ge la// su zhig nges shes skye zhes bden par 'dzin// snga ma'i las 'phro goms pa'i tshul nyid la// sad pa'i rkyen gyis sad par gyur pa la// goms par bya bar gsung rab thams cad dang*// bla ma dam pas bka' bstsal yang yang gsungs// nor bu rin chen 'dod par gyur pa la// de nyid 'ching bu yin zhes ston pa yi// rnam par smin pa ci 'dra go bar zad// gegs sel 'bogs 'don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// mos gus yod med gcig pu ma gtogs pa// gzhan du mi srid bka' bstsal yang yang gsung*// mos gus brtul zhugs bskyed cig rnal 'byor pa// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes pa de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten dang bsod nams gsung*// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyis// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dang yang*// rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus thams cad du// zab dang rgya che dpag med bzhugs gyur kyang*// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na// bshad dang mthong yang nges shes mi skye zhes// nan tan chen pos bka' bstsal yang yang gsungs// rigs pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen par sbyangs pa yi// slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs skyes chen rnams// bshad pas ma go nam mkha'i padmo bzhin// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' dag kyang*// sbas pa med par mngon du gyur pa'i tshul// dpal ldan nā ro 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*// rtag tu ngu dang rgyal sras nor bzang dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas mtha' dag thams cad kyang*// bden mthong don la goms par byas pa yis// yon tan rgya mtsho brnyes zhes yang yang gsungs// rang la ji ltar skyes pa'i nyams rtogs la// mthun rkyen bsten cing 'gal rkyen spong ba'i thabs// thub pas sbyangs pa'i yon tan gang gsungs pa// nyams su blang zhing ri khrod dgon par bsdad// nyon mongs dug rnams spangs par gyur pa las// gegs sel gzhan med snying gi dbus su zhog

/ma chags zhe sdang med dang gti mug med// rnam dag dge ba gsum po ma gtogs pa// bogs 'don gzhan na med de nyams su longs// nga sngon ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di yi phyir// bu dang chung ma mgo dang rkang lag dang*// gtang bar dka' ba'i dngos po dpag med btang*// tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus de bzhin bsrung*// de yis byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// shākya'i rgyal pos zla ba sgron mar gsungs// sems thag ma chod bzhag sa ma rnyed la// la kha'i bya sgro lta bu'i mi rnams kyis// bla ma 'tshol zhing gdams pa 'tshol ba ni// de bas bya thabs med pa shin tu mad// nyams rtogs cung zad yod pa'i sgom chen la// bla ma'i zhabs tog bya ba'i bsam pa yis// blo btsal gros byas pho btags mo 'dur nas// khe grags rnyed bkur mang po btsal nas kyang*// gong ma'i zhabs tog rgya chen byas pa 'dis// dang por mos gus dam chos yin mod kyang*// spyod 'gros chos dang bral bar gyur pa yin// 'jig rten pa dang blo mthun byed pa la// mi chos 'dun ma shin tu mkhas pa dgos// mi chos 'dun ma byas na 'khrug dpon yin// mi chos 'dun ma bzhag na gong ma'i zhabs tog ang*// lha chos pa dang mthun 'jug byed pa ba// kun tu grags dang ma grags gdams ngag dgos// gdams ngag rgya mtsho dpag med bstan na yang*// bla mar 'dzin pa smos kyang ci dgos te// slob dpon tsam du'ang 'dzin pa ngas ma mthong*// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa yis// kho bos 'khor la gdams ngag bshad gyur na// kho bos slob ma gcig kyang mi thon la// nga la mgu ba gcig kyang mi 'ong zhes// kun mkhyen mgon pos gsungs pa 'di re mad// thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa 'di re mad// yig nag mang po slob pa'i slob dpon la// yig nag mang po klog pa'i slob mas kyang*// zhabs tog chen po 'ong bar mi 'dug pas// yig nag klog 'don zhog la rang sems bsgom// bla ma'i zhabs tog med par gyur kyang bla// chos las skyes pa'i bu gcig rnal 'byor pa// sbas ston ye shes seng ge bshes gnyen la// tshad ma la sogs lung rigs gang bslabs pa// byang chub sems sogs gnad kyi man ngag dang*// lhan cig skyes pa de dag 'jug pa'i thabs// zab dang rgya che'i gnad rnams bstan pa las// nam mkha'i padmor dmus long blta ba bzhin// rtog pa'i phreng bas rtog med mi rtogs te// bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu yis gang rtogs pa// slob ma byung na de nyid khrid pas chog

/'thad pa dang bcas smras par gyur pa la// bdag kyang dga' zhing rjes su yi rang skyes// gus ldan slob mas btud nas bla ma yis// log pa'i lam du 'khrid pa rigs pa min// nyams dang rtogs pa nor bu rin chen yang*// phyi ba gsum gyis legs par phyis gyur nas// rgyal mtshan rtser btags mchod pas mchod gyur na// dgos 'dod ma lus thams cad 'byung ba'i dpes// bla ma mchog las rnyed pa'i gnyug ma'i yid// skyon med lhan cig skyes pa de nyid ni// nyon mongs gsum po dri ma gang yin pa// gsum la mngon par zhen pa gdug pa'i yid// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs drag pos spang bar bya// nyes pa'i dri ma de yis dag gyur nas// bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin skyes gyur cing*// zhen pa'i dri mas bsgos par gyur pa yi// ting 'dzin 'di yis khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor// zhen pa'i dri ma spangs la sems nyid bsgom// sems de sgom pa'i yul du byas gyur na// yul can shes par yun ring goms na yang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa nyes pa'i dri ma 'dis// sems nyid rang dga'i gzugs su son mi 'gyur// gnyug ma'i yid la spang blang re dogs dang*// bsgom bya sgom byed spros pa'i mtshan ma kun// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad pa'i spyod pa dang*// bla ma mchog la gus pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i nus mthu yis// dri ma sbyang gi gzhan gyis nam yang min// de 'dra'i dbang gi rgyal po rang sems de// byang chub sems kyi rgyal mtshan rtser btags nas// snying rje chen po'i mchod pas mchod gyur cing*// lhag bsam dag pas gsol ba btab gyur na// 'khor 'das yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun// 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bla ma rin chen gsungs// tshig dang yi ge ston pa'i bla ma nga yang min// tshig dang yi ge mang po khyed la ci bya ste// lta spyod ya bral med pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// ri dang gangs dang dgon pa'i gnas dag tu// ltem rkyang med par nyams len gzhung bsrangs na// sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho mngon du 'gyur ba yang*// dka' ba med na gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos// bu gcig snying gtam yin gyi gdams ngag sems la zhog

/ngag gi dbang phyug dri ma med pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bstan bcos 'di'i ming yin/ zhu ba po'i ming snyan ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rin chen grags zhes bgyi bas zhus/ bris pa 'di las byung ba'i dge ba des// nyams len byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun// thi ba tshang du 'jug pa ji lta bar// ltem rkyang med par rang sems dag byas nas// shin tu rnam dag go 'phang thob par shog /ngag gi dbang phyug dri ma med pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rin chen grags kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

235) ༄// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che dpal ldan sgam po la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas pas// rnyed par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// skad cig tsam gyis sems su rtogs mdzad pa// bla ma mchog gi mtshan de thos par dka'// ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal bas// sems kyi de nyid rab tu snang mdzad pa'i// bla ma dam pa'i mtshan 'di thos par dka'// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i sems can la// thugs rjes ma bzod byang chub sangs rgyas nas// 'khor ba ji snyed 'khor lo mi zad pas// 'gro kun smin mdzad de yi mtshan thos dka'// 'jig rten mgon po shākya'i rgyal po yi// sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa// zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa zhes bya ba// bla ma rin po che yi mtshan thos dka'// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// thub pa'i bstan pa zab zhi spros bral ba// spros pa'i rtog pa log par rtogs pa yi// g.yul las rgyal mtshan de yi mtshan thos dka'// bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa'i snying po mchog /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rin po che// ma go log par rtogs nas phung gyur la// rtogs shing don ston de yi mtshan thos dka'// mdor na chos sku bla ma rin chen de// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad 'khor lo yis// 'gro kun smin mdzad rin chen bla ma de'i// mtshan 'di thos par shin tu dka' bas na// dad cing gus pas sras kyi thu bo la// skyu ra sgom pas gsol ba btab pa las// thugs kyis dgongs nas gnang ba thugs la btags/ chos kyi rgyal po rin po che dpal ldan sgam po pa'i mtshan la bstod pa zur tsam yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// // 236) ༄// yan lag bdun pa tshig lhug ma pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/

dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin/ bde ba dang legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la/ bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad lus gus shing sems dang bas skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams shin tu rnam par dag pa/ nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral zhing legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis gang ba/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ yun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong gi bar du 'byung ba las/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed cing*/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mnyes pa dang dgyes par spyod pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa thams cad kyis rgyun chad med par mchod do// bstod do// bkur ro// bsngags so// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du/ lhun gyis grub par gnas pa las/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs lhun grub tu byung zhing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las mnga' bar ma go zhing*/ phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa'i nyes pa thams cad so sor bshags so// bla na med pa'i 'phags pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis byas shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang zhing yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul ma 'debs so// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa thams cad la/

ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla ma rin po che'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig/ // 237) ༄// rang gzhan gnyis su med par dag par bya ba'i zhal gdams// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang gis byin rlabs pa// tilli nā ro'i brgyud pa la// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yod// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// sha za srin po klu la sogs// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// yul gang gnyis su med pa yi// sems nyid ye shes rdo rje ni// de rnams kun gyi rdo rje 'chang*// phung po la sogs bdud tshogs rnams// 'joms mdzad dpa' bo chen po yis/ khams gsum ma lus thams cad kyi// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad cing*// byang chub mchog la 'god par mdzad// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// bu 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// bu 'di dang ma 'bral rnal 'byor pa// bu 'bral med shugs la goms pa las// gzung 'dzin rang sar dag pa yin// ci tsam gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos// rang gi ngang du dag pa ltar// sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos// phra rags rten 'brel mngon du gyur// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun// rang gi ngang du ro gcig pa// rang gi rang ngo shes pa 'di// ci yang ngo mtshar che rgyu med// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ma lus kun// rang gi gshis las mi gzhan pas// skyob pa rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa med// bu spang bya gnyen po gnyis med pas// gnyis su med las ma g.yos shig

/bu gnyis med gnyis med zhes bya ba// gnyis ka med pa ma gtogs pa// gnyis ka gcig tu byed pa yang*// byed mkhan blo dang gsum du 'gro// des na gnyis med sgra don la// phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa yi// byis pa rnams kyi log rtog gis// mkhas pa'i dgongs pa mi dga' bar// bu gnyis med ye shes rdo rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 'tshal// lar bsgoms pas nyams myong ma skyes na// zab mor ming du btags pa yi// zab pa'i chos dang gdams ngag tshogs// mang po yod pa'i gang zag kyang*// dgos pa'i dus la bab pa dang*// tug gis thug pa'i dus tshod du// phan nam mi phan the tshom za// yin nam ma yin som nyi skyes// rje rnal 'byor chen po'i zhal snga nas// dus 'dir shin tu dka' ba yin// mo dang thu ba 'debs dogs yod// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems la// sems skye ba med par rtogs pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pas na// mi mthun rkyen gyi tshogs rnams la// 'di dang 'di zhes bgrang mi lang*// rang gzhan gnyis su med pas na// gnyis su med pas dag par bya// de yi lag len 'di lta ste// dus 'dir nye bar 'khor bas na// dang po bzod pa mtshon par bya// de yang rnam pa gsum yin te// bdag la gnod pa byed pa yi// mi dang mi min la sogs pa// nyon mongs gsum gyis ldongs pa yis// bdag la gnod par byed pa rnams// sems gsum rdo rje'i lcags kyus gzung*// gnyis med bzod pa'i go bgos nas// gnod cing 'gal ba ci byas kyang*// ma mthong ma tshor ma rig pa'i// thabs la mkhas pa'i zhags pas bcings// shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// zang zing spros pa rab bcad nas// gdul bya rigs can tha dad la// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gdul bya la sogs 'gro ba kun// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas kyang*// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// dam bca' brtan pos 'di ltar bya// kun brtags mig la nges pa bskyed// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du bsgom// rtsa sngags rgyun du bgrang bar bya// bsgrub bya mngon du gyur pa'i tshe// dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma btang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// phrin las gang dang gang byed kyang*// zla ba gcig gis 'grub 'gyur te// 'di la the tshom mi bya 'o// lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo// sha za srin mo mkha' 'gro ma// srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyis// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa la// rang rang srog gi snying po phul//

// 238) ༄// rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mkhan po rgyal ba 'bum la gnang ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// gdod nas zhi zhing rnam par dag pa'i sku// bzang ngan spang thob skyon gyis ma gos pa// kun bzang bde chen rin po che dpal 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po de dang dbyer med cing*// snyan pa'i 'brug sgras phyogs bcu kun bkang zhing*// rang gzhan don grub bla ma dam pa de'i// sku gsung thugs kyi sras nyid dge ba'i bshes// bstan pa'i srog 'dzin mkhan po chen po yis// bdag la brtse bar dgongs pa'i bsam pa yis// bkur bsti chen pos legs par bkur gyur nas// bdag nyid yon tan rgya mtshor longs spyod kyang*// phebs par smra ba'i tshig gis 'brel 'dod pas// yi ge bskur ces bka' bstsal gsungs pa'i don// bdag gis byas lugs cung zad 'dir brjod bya// lus sems rdul du brlags nas bslabs pa yi// gdams ngag nam mkha'i sprin phung mang po rnams// 'bad pas nyams su blangs kyang bslus pa yi// smig rgyu'i chu yis ri dwags ji bzhin du// skyug log nad kyis thebs pa'i ldom bu bdag /nyams rtogs bdud rtsi'i kha zas 'dod pa'i blos// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs kyi padmor btugs// khyod kyi thugs dgongs ltem rkyang ma mchis kyang*// 'jig rten mgon pos bka' bstsal gsungs pa'i don// yi ger bris nas bcangs pa ma mchis te// mos gus stobs kyis nyams su blangs pa yis// nyams rtogs cung zad skyes par gyur pa kun// mkhyen pa'i ye shes yod med man chad dang*// nyon mongs ji ltar skyes pa yan chad kun// dri ba 'thems nan tan par dris shing zhu btug byas// ji ltar me long g.ya' dang bral ba la// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang ba bzhin// dus gsum nor 'khrul med pa'i bla ma des// bzang sar ma bzhag bu yi rtsis su bcug

/zab dang rgya che chos kyi zhu sgo phye// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs dngos su bstan// thabs lam rgya mtsho kun la bka' nan mdzad// lta kham nam mkha'i 'brug sgra ngar yang bcag /sangs rgyas ye shes go ba'i lung bstan mdzad// rgyun chad med par bsgom zhes bka' bstsal gsungs// thabs lam la sogs zab pa'i gdams ngag gi /khrid rnams kho bos bya zhes zhal gyis bzhes// sgom chen tsam la bzang ba 'ong ngo zhes// lan gsum bar du gsung zhing dbugs kyang phyung*// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo 'grel man ngag gi /lung rnams gnang zhing zab pa'i gnad kun bstan// rab tu 'byung ba'i bka' nan chen po mdzad// khams su mi 'gro blo thag spyan sngar bcad// bla ma dam pa lo gnyis bsten gyur kyang*// lus ngag yid gsum gsung dang ci mthun byas// gzhan la phan pa'i re ba ma mchis shing*// gsung bzhin 'ong ba snyam pa med na yang*// ci zhig ltar la de 'dra de 'drar song*// drin can bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// sun 'byin bdag la ma bab snyam pa yis// rnam thar cung zhig bslabs par gyur na yang*// rgya mtshor rabs yangs chu gter chen po la// sbrang bu'i dri chus char yang mi phod cing*// ri dbang rgyal po phra ba'i rdul nyid ltar// rnam thar zur tsam bzung bar ma nus na// cha tsam rtogs pa'i re thag bcad pa lags// sku gsung thugs nyid dus gsum thams cad du// kun tu snang zhing snang ba med pa yi// kun bzang rdo rje rgyal po bcom ldan de// mthong ngam thos sam gang gis dran gyur pa// bskal pa mang por dpag med sbyang bar byas// nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan du skal pa yod snyam mi bgyid do// ji ltar rab tu dwangs pa'i chu nang du// bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan ji ltar snang ba bzhin// 'jig rten mgon po sku gsung thugs nyid la// rang snang rnam pa sna tshogs ci snang ba// rang gi bsam pa de nyid snang ba las// yul la 'gro 'ong byed pa med do zhes// 'jig rten mgon pos de nyid bka' bstsal gsung*// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa de nyid las// rang rang mngon rtogs phyogs re smra ba las// gzhan du mi 'gyur gtan tshigs nges pa'i phyir// 'di skad bdag thos sdud pa po rnams smra// gang zag gcig la mngon rtogs skye ba'i tshul// dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi bye brag gis// rab kyis mtshan tsam thos pas rtogs pa skye// 'bring gis zhal mthong tha mas khrid byas pas// mngon par rtogs pa skye zhes bka' bstsal gsungs// gang ltar yin kyang nyams len khrid kyi thabs// gsang sngags pha rol phyin la brten nas ni// nyams su blang ba gong ma'i bzhed yin pas// skyabs su song zhing so sor thar pas bsdams// byang chub sems mchog rab sbyangs dbang bskur nas// yi ge brgya pa maṇḍal bsnyen pa sogs// bsags sbyangs rtags dang mtshan ma ma byung bar// 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blangs gyur nas// phyag rgya chen po bstan par gyur pa las// nyams myong skyes shing nyams dang bral gyur nas// rang sems skye ba med par rtogs pa'i tshe// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa thugs su chud// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa'i spros pa spangs// yod dang med pa'i sgro skur gnyis dang bral// rang byung lhun grub chen po'i rgyal sa zin// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// dbyer med mnyam pa nyid du skad kyis 'byams// snang zhing srid pa nyon mongs rnam rtog kun// phyi shun dang ni sbur ma spung gis song*// tshig dang yi ge spros pa'i chos rnams kyis// don gyi snying por 'gyur med mtshon du med// dngos po mtshan ma dmigs pa'i chos rnams la// smig rgyu'i chu la mkhas pas mi re ltar// 'dus byas chos la mya ngan 'das pa med// byang chub snying po rang sems nam mkha' ni// dus gsum kun tu rtag pa nyid kyi sku// lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal dang*// nyon mongs rnam rtog rlung bzhin 'tshub pa kun// sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa yang*// rgyu ngan las skyes phung po lus rgyas lan// rgya dang bral na gnyis med mngon sangs rgya// ri dwags rgyal po mngal nas byung ma thag

/ma dang mnyam zhing mthu rtsal rdzogs pa 'am// mkha' lding rgyal po sgo nga'i rgya bcag pa// mthu stobs mnyam par gyur pa ji bzhin du// lus rgyas bcings pa rgya dang bral ba'i tshe// nam mkha' gnyis 'dres gnyis med sangs rgya bar// 'jig rten mgon pos ngo sprod bka' bstsal gsungs// rtogs pa'i chos kyis nges par brtan gyur nas// lus kyi rgya dang rtog rgya snang rgya gsum// dbyer med sems kyi ngo bor ro gcig pa// snang ba sna tshogs gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// spros bral nam mkha'i dbus su ro gcig pa// dus 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po de// zhi ba rin chen gling du zhugs gyur kyang*// dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la zhugs// nyon mongs bsal kyang skye ba ston par byed// rga nad 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston// rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa las// zung du 'jug ces phag mo gru pas gsungs// bshad pa'i rgyud du gnyis su med pa dang*// rin chen gong mas ro gcig rnal 'byor te// 'di la thams cad gnyis med gcig ces gsungs// mkhas pa chen po rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed// rdo rje theg pa'i gsang sngags thams cad du// badzra dhū pe dī pe ghandhe la sogs pa// gsang sngags badzras drangs pa'i sgra gnad 'dis// thams cad stong par bstan pa ma lags sam// don dam kun rdzob gnyis su gnyis kyis btags// gnyis dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// dngos dang dngos med dmigs dang mi dmigs med// bdag med gzhan med bdag gzhan gnyis ka med// thub mchog rdo rje 'chang la bcom ldan gyis// gsang sngags gsang zhes gsungs par gyur pa'i gnad// rang sems phyogs gcig rtogs pa'i theg dman dang*// rgyal sras mnyam nyid ma rtogs sems dpa' la// dngos po dngos med yin zhes gsungs pa dang*// dngos po dngos med yin zhes gsungs pa'i don// badzra badzra rdo rje ma go bas// phyogs gcig stong par rtogs pa'i blo mig gis// theg chen yangs pa'i gnad 'di ma mthong ba// rmongs pa'i by-is pa ga chad ngu bar byed// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi drung du lo gnyis bsdad pa las// lo gcig bar du stong pa'i zhal 'dzin che// sems nyid rtogs pa skye ba mi len zhes// rtsa ba chad pa'i lo 'bras ji bzhin dang*// gres thag bsregs pas 'ching bar mi nus shing*// skyi shod zan sbags snod na med na yang*// dri ma ngan pa bro ba ji bzhin du// gnas ngan len gyis dri mas mi gnod pa// dgra bcom nad bu can dang rang sangs rgyas// spre'u ltar byed pa'i dpe rnams sna tshogs kyis// gnod pa med pa'i bka' bstsal dpag med gsungs// re dga' re skyid nam shi sangs rgyas dang*// thod pa bor bas chog pas nga re dga'// rang gi sems la bltas pas 'di re rmad// rang sems stong pa nyid 'di pha rol tu// dngos po skye ba len par mi 'thad pa'i// nyams myong mngon rtogs lung rigs 'thad pa skyes// dga' bdes gang ba'i dus tshod de nyid la// mya ngan 'da' khar phyin pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'di ni theg pa dman pa nyan thos chos yin pas// nyan thos mdo sde pa yi grub pa'i mtha'// mar me shi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// rang gi sems ni thar par 'dod dang 'dra// chos 'di mthar thug gyur pa ma yin zhes// lo gcig bar du rgyun chad med par gsungs// dbang po rno zhing shes rab che ba dang*// drung du gnas shing bsten yun ring ba rnams// 'gyur ro 'gyur ro grub mtha' 'gyur ro zhes// gsang skad 'o dod chen pos rnam par bsgrags// 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus kun// nye bar zhi zhing 'gro don mi byed pa// kho bos gar yang mthong ba med ces gsungs// phyag rgya chen po rtogs ldan mthar thug pa// rgyal bas lung bstan slob dpon 'phags pa yang*// da ltar bde ba can na bzhugs pa dang*// grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rnal 'byor rnams// mya ngan mi 'da' 'jig rten kun tu bzhugs// dpag med 'gro ba smin par mdzad do zhes// dpag med bka' bstsal mang po mang po gsungs// mtha' mar gnad la bab pa rdo rje'i gsung*// thub pa'i skyes rabs mang po mang po byung*// rdzun dang sgro skur med pa'i dpang por bcas// tshogs dang dpag tu lhur phyung rjen par gsungs// thub pa'i gsung la gus par mi byed cing*// phyogs gcig go bas skye ba mi len zhes// glen pa smra bar byed pa 'ga' zhig la// rigs pa skyes pa'i skyes bu khyu mchog rnams// khyed kyi bla ma skye ba len pa la// khyod lta skye ba mi len ngo mtshar che// stings pa'i tshig gis khyad gsod chen por byed// don gyi snying po tshig gcig zhu lags na// badzra zhes bya gnyis med snying po'i don// phyag na rdo rje'i rdo rje rab 'bar bas// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang*// 'khor ba nyes tshogs spros pa'i mtshan ma kun// thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ba rdo rje'i tshig

/yang dang yang du nan tan bka' bstsal gsungs// gal te lta kham chen por rnal 'byor pa// sems la stong par btags pa'i rnam rtog gis// skye ba mi len sdig pa ma spangs par// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas 'dod pa de// badzra'i gnad 'di go ba med pas lan// kye ho/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan dpa' bo de// pha rol phyin drug mthar thug ma rdzogs shing*// nyon mongs bdud bzhi bcom par ma gyur na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang du 'byung bar 'gyur// sems nyid stong zhes sangs rgyas yin srid na// nyon mongs rnam rtog snang srid 'khor 'das kun// stong pa nyid du ci'i phyir khas mi len// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel stong pa ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba rnams kyis stong pa gzhan mi bzhed// bla ma des kyang de ltar mi bzhed de// shes rab snying po la sogs gsung gis nges// yon tan rdzogs phyir sangs rgyas mi bzhed na// thub pa yon tan kun dang bral bar thal// gzhan snang yin zhes dam bca' mdzad na yang*// 'phags pa na gardzu na'i zhal snga nas// gzugs kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na// bsod nams tshogs las byung ba yin// rgyu dang 'bras bu gtan tshig nges pa rnams// rnal 'byor dbang phyug de yis phye ste gsungs// phyag rgya chen po nam mkha' yangs pa la// dag pa'i tshul khrims srung ba mi shong zhing*// nyes spyod mtha' dag shong bar gyur pa 'di// mthong dang bsgom pas spong bar mi 'gyur zhing*// de la yon tan med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// bla ma dam pas bzhed par ma tshor bas// tshul khrims la sogs rgyu yi 'bras bu rnams// 'byung bar nges pa'i gtan tshigs khong du chud// tshul khrims nyid las gzhan pa'i stong pa nyid// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs re nga 'dir shi// de yang rin chen ske rags las// ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur ba yin// dam pa brgyad kyi bstan bcos las// mkha' gnyis su med pa'i nam mkha' la// 'ja' gnyis su med pa'i gzugs skur shar// yongs su dag pa'i rgyu 'bras de// rang bzhin med kyang mi 'khrul bar// chos rje thub pa rnams kyis gsungs// sku gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i tshig 'di la sogs pa// 'jig rten mgon pos dpag med gsungs// rang gi nyams su blangs pa'i nyams myong gis// yid ches skyes pa'i gang zag mang po yod// rtog pa mi bsgom rtog med mi bsgom ste// dmigs pa mi bsgom dmigs med bsgom mi bya// badzra zhes pa'i sgra don byang chub la// yon tan phrin las 'byung bar 'gyur ba 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de nyid kyi// dgongs pa bla na med par nyid kyis bzhed// bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa rtogs gyur na// yod dang med pa'i spros pa chad nas kyang*// lhun grub chen po'i rang sa zin gyur nas// yod dang med pa'i phyogs ris rnam par spangs// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa 'ong ngam snyam// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs yan chad nas// mthar thug rgyal ba'i ye shes man chad la// yod dang med pa'i blo yis gang rtog pa// tshu rol mthong ba'i rmongs pa kho nar zad// phyogs 'dir 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dgongs pa phra rab rdul gyi cha shas tsam// phyogs gcig go bar gyur pa 'di dag kun// skyes bu dam pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa lags// mthar thug sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor gang*// rgyal ba rin po che yi sku gsung thugs// mthar thug bdag gis dpag mar ma nus so// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag
/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ mkhan po dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba 'bum gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

239) ༄// sems don nyams len tshang la ma nor ba dge slong snying po blo gros kyi zhu chos// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon du gyur pa chos kyi rje// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// chos la shes rab spyan mig bye// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// don gyi snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud// bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rnams// thugs su chud pa'i blo mnga' bas// gsol ba btab pa'i yi ge 'di// dam pa khyed kyi thugs la zhog /rang gi rig pa rig rig 'di// ngos gzung spros pa mtha' dang bral// sems nyid lhan skyes chos sku 'di// rtsol sgrub med par lhug par bzhag /mtha' bral gshis su 'dug pa de// lhun gyis grub pa'i zhi gnas yin// de nyid mthong bas lhag mthong yin// gnyis su med pas zung 'jug yin// res 'jog med pas bsgom pa yin// rang rgyud skye ba'i las la ni// las kyi sgrib par 'dogs pa yin// de nyid rtogs nas sa bdun par// nyon mongs skye ba nyon mongs sgrib// bag chags shes bya'i sgrib pa zhes// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin// 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya// rje btsun byams pas gsungs pas na// de ltar nyams su blang bar bya// tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa yi// thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel ba// dang por byang chub sems bskyed bya// rang lus yi dam lhar bsgoms nas// bla ma dam pa thugs kar bsam// rang sems rtsol sgrub bral bar bzhag /lhun gyis grub par gcer gyis mthong*// rtsol sgrub spros pas ma gos pa// de yang sa gser zla ba me// ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du// rgyun chad med par mngon du gyur// rjes sam skabs skabs thams cad du// dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya// tshul khrims ngo lkog med par bsrung*// pha rol phyin drug rgyun du spyad// de ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul// tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa zhes// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsungs// rtag tu nyams su blang bar zhu// sher gyi dge slong snying po blo gros kyis zhus pa rdzogs so//

// 240) ༄// tha dad 'dzin blo spangs nas rtogs pa'i mtshan ma zhi bar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rjes// skal par ldan pa'i nor bzang sems bskyed de// kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob 'dod pa// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam thar tha dad pa'i// bshes gnyen rnam pa sna tshogs bsten pa las// nyes tshogs skyon ni gcig kyang ma mthong bas// byang chub sems gnyis gcig tu gyur pa'i sku// kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i rang bzhin du// gnyis su med pa'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyis// khrid kyi mdzad pa shin tu ngo mtshar che// mchog gi bla mas yab sras skyes chen dang*// ma lus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// dus gsum bla ma brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// khyed kyi bdag cag sems can ma lus kun// ji snyed rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor 'das rnams// kun tu bzang po lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// gnyis med gcig tu myur du rtogs gyur nas// spang thob bzang ngan 'dzin pa dag mdzad cing*// rang lta mchog tu 'dzin pas dkrugs gyur pas// nyes tshogs sgrib pa 'di las thar mdzad gsol// phung po 'di dag 'jig rten pa nyid de// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med du// rtogs pas 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam nyid du// ston pa bdag nyid chen pos bka' bstsal ba// tha dad 'dzin pa'i blo rnams spangs gyur nas// rtog pa'i mtshan ma tha dad rab zhi ste// rang gzhan tha dad lta ba tha dad kun// nye bar zhi nas nam zhig bde bar gnas// // 241) ༄// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi chos rang rig 'dug lugs kyi springs yig/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// che ba'i bdag nyid rje btsun gyis// yi ge bskur cig ces pa'i don// rang nyid yon tan che na yang*// gus pas zhus par gyur pa 'di// gsung mi bcag phyir bri bar bya// rang gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// brgal zhing sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs// lta spyod rnam pa gnyis sam yang*// thabs dang shes rab rnam gnyis su// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag rnams// 'di las gzhan med rnal 'byor pa// lta ba rtogs pa'i spyod pa yis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub thob pa yang*// tshul khrims bsrungs pas rgyal ba yi// stobs bcu thob par gsungs pa yin// lta ba rtogs pa med pa yi// so so'i skye bos tshul khrims la// ji bzhin nyams su blang gyur pas// gong ma'i yon tan thob pa yang*// thub pa chen po gsungs pa yin// ji ltar mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya// gshog pa gcig gis mi bgrod ltar// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis// byang chub thob pa mi srid pas// tshul khrims gzhir byas thabs rnams kyis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzod// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob don du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan la sogs pa// dkar phyogs byas dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// gnas lugs lta ba bstan pa yi// nyams su len bzhin da lta yi// dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba dang*// 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos// gzugs nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// shes rab pha rol phyin pa de// rang gi rig pa'i 'dug lugs yin// gzugs nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// phyi rol don du yod min te// 'dzin pas bzung ba'i rnam rtog yin// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rtog dang mi rtog dbyer med pa// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dug lugs yin// 'dug lugs go ba lta ba yin// lta ba go ba rtogs pa yin// brjod med gshis las mi g.yo ba// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dug lugs yin// 'gre log spyi tshugs gar gnas kyang*// sems nyid gshis las g.yo ba med// rang sems sgoms shig rnal 'byor pa// rnam rtog sems dang chos rnams kyi// ngang la bzhag pas 'dug lugs kun// mngon du gyur cing gsal nas mchi// 'di las dri sa gar yang med// bde bde po dang gsal gsal po// res yod res med ting 'dzin la// 'ong du re bas bsgoms na yang*// byis pa 'ja' tshon bda' ba bzhin// je ring je ring mkha' la yal// sems kyi 'dug lugs go bas na// sgom pa po med sgom pa'ang med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa de// skye 'jig 'gro 'ong med pa'i don// skyes chen khyed kyi rang bzhin lags// nyid kyis thugs su chud na yang*// yi ge bskur ces gsungs pas na// dam pa'i gsung bcag 'os min phyir// yi ger bris pa gyur pa tsam// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba de// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog tu bsngo// rdzogs so//

// 242) ༄// grub thob brgyud pa'i man ngag byang chub sems nyid gcig pu yin pa// oṃ swasti/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// dus gsum rgyal bas bgrod pa'i shul// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam// 'phags pa rnams kyang 'byin byed pa// grub thob brgyud pa'i man ngag ni// byang chub sems nyid gcig pu yin// de la kun rdzob byang chub sems// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// de la don dam byang chub sems// rang rig skye 'gag med pa'i don// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar bzhag /rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya// lhun grub rgyun chad med par bzhag /rgyun chad med par mngon du 'gyur// // 243) ༄// stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ce yon btsun la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ ce yon btsun la springs pa/ khyod nga la dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu g.yos pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bai ḍūrya'i glegs bam la/ rin po che gser zhun mas bzhengs pa phul nas/ chos skur gsungs pa'i don la/ khyed kyis tshul khrims rin po che// rin chen srog dang bsdos la srungs// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang rgyud shin tu dul bar bya// stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ni// 'chi ba med phyir btung bar bya// rang gzhan dus gsum bsags pa yi// dge ba chud zos med pa'i phyir// rtag tu byang chub mchog tu bsngo// 'di ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// 'di phyi dus rnams thams cad du// phan zhing dge ba nyid du 'gyur// //// 244) ༄// spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba'i lam rim nyams len gyi zhal gdams// spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba yin pas// dbang ma thob par yi ge brgya pa mi gdab// yi ge brgya pa btab pa rnams tshogs chos mnyan pa dang*/ zung 'jug tu tshogs chos mi bcag
