sgom btab nas nan tan du sgom pa gal che/ bogs 'don gyi tshul lugs gang su la nan tan bya/ thabs lam sgom pa la bla ma gnyan/ prag prig cung zad shor ba'i thabs med// so sor bsam pa gang yin pa// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// de ni smin pa rnam smin pas// lta spyod zung du 'brel pa yis// myur du sangs rgyas thob par nges// 'di la rgyud tshod mtho dman zhes// mkhas pa'i skyes bu thams cad gsungs// // 245) ༄// gnyen pos mi chom na rtag lta'i log lta yin pa sgom pa chos skyabs la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa dus di ring nas bzung ste/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'i mos gus dang smon lam gyis 'brel ba/ nged pha spad la tshe snga ma'i las kyi 'brel pa zab mo yod pa yin pa la/ bar skabs su sdig pa'i grogs pos/ blo gzhan du bsgyur kyang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'dres pa yin na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi mthus gnod par bsam pa la/ gnod pa byas kyang bde bar 'brel par gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal te// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba'i// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// zhes dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor yin na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ji ltar gla rtsi ni phan pa'am/ gnod pa'i bsam pas btags kyang*/ dri ma mnyam du 'byung ba dang 'dra bar gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che la/ zhal zas ngan pa drangs nas grongs pa la/ gang zag de ngan song du mi 'gro ba'i gnyer kho bo la yod gsungs pa dang*/ 'di la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs te/ ji ltar bskal pa'i me chen rab tu 'bar ba la// phub ma sbar gang bsreg par gyur pa bzhin// byang chub sems kyi bskal pa'i me chen gyis// khyed dang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg par byed// legs par dgongs dang bu gcig rnal 'byor pa// don dam pa byang chub kyi sems mngon par rtogs pa la yang tshul de dang 'dra ste/

tshul de bzhin nyid rtogs pa gcig la/ ma rtogs pa gcig gis bsam pa zhugs na/ de yang snga ma bzhin du 'gyur te/ de bzhin nyid dbye ba med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung ba'i gnas/ rgyal po sde rab tu mi pham pas/ byang chub sems dpa' drang srong me'i rkang lag bcad pa gzhir gyur pas/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob cing lung bstan pa dang*/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras mtshams med rnam pa bzhi byas kyang*/ sems stong par rtogs pas/ 'brum bu me dbal nag po'i nad zhi/ mtshams med pa'i sdig pa byang*/ sa drug gi rtogs pa thob par gsungs pa yin na/ khyed kyang stong pa nyid la mos gus ni yod/ nga dang dwags po'i brgyud pa 'di stong pa nyid bsgom pa yin pas/ khyed kyi de tshod kyi sdig pa mi 'byang ba ga la srid de/ de ltar yang*/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang po red gyur cig /khyed dang 'gro ba gzhan dag thams cad kyi// yod pa lhun gyis grub pa'i de nyid dang*// tshad med byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// gnyis med tshul gyis byang chub chen por yang*// 'gro kun bdag pos bsngo ba byed na ko /yul dang yul can gnyis su med tshul gyis/ khyed kyi sdig sgrib thams cad cis mi 'dag gzhan yang sdig pa mi dge ba gsog mkhan rang gi sems yin pa la/ mi dge ba'i sems snga ma 'gags nas/ dge ba'i sems 'gyod pa skyes pa de nyid kyis 'dag par gsungs te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis log par lta ba la/ log par lta ba nyid du shes na de nyid du yang dag pa'i lta ba'o zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig ma// mi dge'i sems kyang skad cig ma// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sems gnyis 'grogs shing phrad pa med// ces gsungs te/ snga ma'i mi dge ba ni spang bya/

phyi ma'i 'gyod pa ni gnyen po/ gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa ni gshis nyid/ gnyen pos spang bya mi choms snyam na/ rtag par lta ba log lta chen po yin pas/ khyed kyi sdig pa thams cad dag zin/ nga dang yang yun ring mi thogs par myur du mjal/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom la myur du drung du 'byon par zhu/ khyed kyis 'bul ba skur ba rnams ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bgyis pa lags/ sgom pa chos skyabs la springs pa rdzogs so// // 246) ༄// gdan sa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa gnas lugs rdo rje'i gsang tshig/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i// 'gro ba smin par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes chen de yi sku gsung thugs kyi sras// sngon chad bsod nams tshogs kyi 'bras bu yis// chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs rgyud dam par 'khrungs// theg chen bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la btugs// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab mchog sbyangs pas// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba'i bshes su gyur// sngon gyi rgyal po ind+ra bho dhi ltar// khyod kyi rdo rje theg pas rab tu byung*// phrin las bzhi yis gdul bya 'dul mdzad cing*// bsdu dngos bzhi yis mtho dman kun bsdus nas// zab mo'i chos kyis thams cad smin par mdzad// snyigs ma'i dus su ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// rdo rje 'chang chen chos rje rin po ches// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs nyid byin gyis rlabs// lus ngag yid med rdo rje'i rang bzhin sku// skye 'jig med pa'i don nyid thugs su chud// khyod kyi lus ngag longs spyod bu dang gnyen// thams cad ltos pa med par zhabs tog tu// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma mchog la phul// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las dang*// rab tu mnyam pa gdan sa rin chen mchog

/khyod kyis rang gi srog bzhin bskyangs shing mdzad// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir deng sang snying po'i don// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i bstan pa dar// nub par mi 'gyur rdo rje'i phyag rgyas btab// 'jig par mi 'gyur gdan sa rdo rje gdan// dar zhing rgyas 'gyur mchod sdong 'bar ba bzhin// dbang gi rgyal po kun gyi gtsug na mdzes// skyes chen khyod kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa 'di// da rung shin tu rdzogs par mdzad par rigs// ci phyir zhe na nyid kyang sku na bgres// rjes su lus kyang gzhan la phan pa dka'// phun sum tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bur yangs// khyed kyi sras dang btsun mo gnyen mdun dang*// 'khor dang 'gro ba kun gyi don ched du// snying po bla na med pa blangs nas kyang*// gang du gshegs pa'i gnas su snoms par mdzod// ri khrod dgon par spros pa rab bcad nas// nye bar zhi ba'i brtul zhugs rab spyod pa// rnal 'byaur bdag ni so nam rnam bzhis stongs// snying rje brtas pas bsod snyoms byung ba la// rin po che yi gdul bya rgya mtsho'i tshogs// chu la bya tshogs rub pa ji bzhin du// 'di spang de la btang ba rigs min te// gdan sa'i g.yog po mang po sgrub phyir dang*// thugs dgongs 'gro ba'i don 'di ma byas na// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma bslu phyir ro// nam mkha' 'di la bsam yas dpag mi khyab// nam mkha'i mdzod dang nam mkha'i rgyu 'bras dang*// yon tan phrin las rdzogs pa ngo mtshar che// bdag kyang yid skyo gdung ba skyes pa dang*// khyed kyis yi ge bskur zhes gsungs pa'i don// gnas lugs rdo rje'i gsang tshig man ngag 'di// brtse bas gang gis thos kyang mnyes par zhu// rdzogs so// //

247) ༄// lta sgom gcig gyur snying tshig gnad kyi man ngag gnam tsho do pa'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khaur ba'i rgya mtsho na// mgon med skyabs dang bral ba'i 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje chen pos thar mdzad gnyen gcig pu// mnyam med rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis bsags las byung ba stong pa nyid// rang sems rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu yi// gang la mig yod pa yis chos rnams mthong*// de mthong rnal 'byor pa la 'khrul pa med// thog ma bar dang tha ma thams cad du// mi dge dge bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med cing*// dge ba rnams kyang mi dger mi 'gyur ba// gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa thub pa'i gsung*// dam pa'i chos la myong ba skyes pa rnams// mtho dman tshig gis phrogs par mi 'gyur ro// gang la bsten na phal cher nyes pa'i gzhi// thog med dus nas rang gi ma yi sha// brtse ba can rnams ci'i phyir za bar byed// dbang po 'di lnga yul gyi rjes 'brang nas// chags sdang rmongs par gyur pa'i skye bo rnams// grol bar 'gyur zhes mkhas pas mi gsung na// sha la sred pa'i ro la ci phyir ang*// 'dul ba rgya mtshor spong ba'i thabs bcas nas// theg chen mdo sder dngos su bkag pa dang*// gsang sngags theg par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur bar byed pa'i thabs// don gyis thub pa chen pos bkag pa 'di// brtul zhugs can gyis spang bar shin tu 'thad// de ltar min na gsang sngags lugs kyis snyam// mnyam med bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i mgon po dus gsum mngon gyur pa// thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba ji srid par// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i khur snoms pa// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po ches// nyid kyi srog gi phyir yang ma gsol na// nyes pa'i gzhir 'gyur myos par byed pa'i chang*// rjes 'jug sras su bdag cag khas len pa// shi bar gyur kyang su zhig 'thung bar byed// shākya'i rgyal po ston pa bcom ldan gyis// nga la ston par 'dzin pa gang yin gyis// bdag nyid mi btung gzhan la mi sbyin zhes// phung bar nges pa dus gsum gzigs pa yi// ston pas bcas pa 'di las su zhig 'gal// kha dog dri dang nus pa dug gsum tshogs// spongs par gyur pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud// rdo rje 'chang gis sngags su gnang ba de// 'dul ba'i sde snod rnams su su yis bkag

/rang la snying brtse yod pa'i gces pa'i bu// srog la bab kyang brtul zhugs ma btang zhig /tshad mar gyur pa bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po yis// dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen rdo rje 'chang*// rnam pa gsum gyis rab tu phye ba las// tshogs kyi slob dpon bya bar ma gsungs shing*// gang zhig mchog gi gsang sngags sgor 'jug pa// skyabs gsum so sor thar dang byang chub sems// khyad par dbang gis byas pa ma gtogs pa// gsang sngags mchog tu rung ba ma yin pa// rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud rnams kun tu gsungs// 'gal dang mi 'gal gnad kyi bye brag rnams// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma dam pa'i gsung*// chang gi skabs su ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// gnang bkag thams cad de ltar go bar bya// 'jig rten mgon po de yi rjes su bslab// chos kun skye med nam mkhar rtogs pa yi// lta ba rnam par dag pa yod gyur na// de dang mthun pa'i spyod pa rnam dag pas// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i 'dul ba cis mi spyod// lta spyod gcig tu gyur pa rin chen gsung*// 'di las 'da' bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// thub pa'i gsung rab rnams dang bla ma'i bka'// skyes chen mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa dang*// rang gi bsam pa'i thog tu sus myong ba// mu ge'i snyad kas bor tshong ma byed cig /lta spyod gcig gyur bla ma'i dgongs pa 'di// tshad mar gyur pas nges shes gting nas skyes// bsgrub par ma nus nongs par gang gyur rnams// skyes chen gong ma rnams la bzod par gsol// bdag gi nye gnas dgongs pa rdzogs byed cing*// bu sdug yid du 'ong ba rgyal ba'i sras// rje yi gdung 'dzin gnam mtsho do pa yis// gsol ba btab nas zhus pa'i yi ge lags// snying tshig gnad kyi man ngag rdzogs so// // 248) ༄// nye gnas kyis bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs ri khrod dbang phyug la gnang ba//

oṃ swasti/ chos kun gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba rang gi sems// rnam dag gnyis su med pas 'gro ba rnams// rnam par dag mdzad bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nam mkha' yod med kun las 'das// nam yang blo yi yul du ma gyur bzhin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// rang sems 'khrul bas so sor brtags na yang*// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa kun dang bral// 'gyur med rang sems de la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i sems// 'khor ba kun dang gnyis su med pa 'di// gnyis med bcom ldan byams pa chen po yin// log rtog nam mkha'i mdud pas bcings pa yis// rmi lam skyes bu 'khor bar sdug bsngal ba// sad par gyur ba ji bzhin gnas lugs shes// de nyid snying rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes rab zhi ba// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das dang dbyer med pa// dus gsum rtag pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems// lhun grub bcom ldan 'das 'di rdo rje 'chang*// gang la lus dang ngag dang yid yod pa// de la bsrung bya srung byed chags sdang yod// de dang bral na de nyid yod min te// nam mkha'i padmo ri bong rwa dang mtshungs// thob dang ma thob sku dang ye shes rnams// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor pa yis mthong ba med// mtho dman rtsis gdab mang po ma shes so// stong nyid sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// byams dang snying rje'i byang chub sems kyi sku// med par dogs shing kun rdzob mtshor 'jug pa// nam mkhas bcings pa'i skyes bu log par 'khrul// lus ngag yid du 'dzin pa'i tha shal gyis// padma'i gsung dang dgongs pa bsgrub mi nus// kun bzang nam mkha'i mdzod 'di rnyed pa de// kun tu bzang po dus rnams rtag tu rol// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor smra bcad pa// bla ma'i gsung bzhin dgongs pa bsgrub byed pas// 'gro ba'i don du bya byed sgrub pa'i thabs// zhabs kyi padmor gtugs nas zhus pa 'dis// bdag tu 'dzin pas rnam par dkrugs pa yi// log par ltung ba'i skye bo 'khrul pa rnams// gnyis med nam mkha'i dbus su rnam grol shog

/nye gnas kyis bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed pa bya byed kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa'i thabs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pas zhus pa rdzogs so// // 249) ༄// gdod nas yod ma myong ba'i nges don bdud rtsi'i g.yul bzlog/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid dbyer med pa'i// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// rje btsun de yi zhal snga nas// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i lung*// dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// dang po nyid nas rang gi sems// spros pa bral zhing yod ma myong*// de la bsgom bya sgom byed med// sgom med lhun gyis grub pa la// rmongs pa'i blo yis gang bsgom pa// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i sgrog tu tshud// mtho na skye mched mu bzhir skye// stong pa nyid dang 'brel ba med// ji ltar thugs kyi dgongs pa bzhin// nor dang 'khrul pa ma mchis pas// snga ma bzhin du nyams su blangs// rin po che yi thugs dgongs yin// gzhan la dmigs pa ston pa'i gnad// nyams su myong ba'i rjes 'brangs nas// bcos kyi rim pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyis phan pa ma lags pas// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs la zhog /rdzogs so// // 250) ༄// 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar nyams len rin chen mi zad pa rgya mtsho'i gter// oṃ swasti/ thub pa chen po sku gsung thugs nyid kyi// phrin las 'gro ba'i phan bde chu snod zla ba bzhin// rnam dag yon tan bdag nyid rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi// 'dir 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de ni/

chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bus/ sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/ ji ltar snang ba de thams cad bdag cag gdul bya sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad pa kho na yin pas de'i rjes su bslab par bya'o// de yang 'di skad bdag gis thos shing cung zad mthong ba'i dus gcig na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten khams 'di'i dbus kyi lte bar gyur pa/ gling bzhi pa bar ma'i lho 'dzam bu'i gling du/ thub pa chen po ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di byung ba'i bstan pa/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyas par lung bstan pa yin la/ bstan pa de yang rgyas par byed pa'i byed pa po rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams sam/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad lags mod kyang*/ yul khams kyi rgyal khams/ mi nag la ni 'jings che/ so rno la ni ltag tshan mthug gdong che la ni byas pa gzo/ khas blangs pa'i bya ba ni mthar 'don/ byas pa stobs dang lag rjes ni rlabs che/ dge ba dang mi dge ba ni gang bden cha med pa'i sa phyogs der/ gdul bya de lta bu 'dul ba la dgongs nas/ khams su sku skye ba bzhes so zhes grags pa lags so// de yang spyir cho rigs phun sum tshogs pa lags mod kyang*/ thub pa chen po'i bstan pa ni rigs gtso bor gyur pa ma yin/ rus gtso bor gyur pa ma yin pa la dgongs nas/ rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas/ kho bo'i yab ni mi shin tu gnag pa/ sdig pa la dga' ba/ nyes spyod la 'jug pa ngan pa zhig yin te/ kho bo de 'dra ba'i bur skye ba gsungs pa lags skad/ de yang yab yum shin tu dbul por bzhugs shing 'tsho ba rnam par ma dag pa longs spyod kyang*/ ji ltar padma la chus mi gos pa bzhin du dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su mkhan po chen po 'phags pa'i sprul pa'i sku/

yan thub bu tshul khrims la rab tu gshegs nas/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rang gis 'bad pa dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ brtson 'grus la rag las par bstan pa'i ched du sus kyang slob par bskul ba med kyang*/ yi ge slob pa rnams kyi nang du rang zhugs su bzhugs nas slob pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ 'bri ba thams cad kyi drung du yang tshul de ltar mdzad nas/ 'bri ba dang klog pa thams cad kyang mthar thug par gyur pa dang*/ thos pa dang bsam pa la sogs pa rab tu byung ba rnams kyi las dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs la ma 'gags shing stobs 'phel bar mdzad nas/ dgung lo bco brgyad la yon tan rin po che gzhon pa'i dus su bslab par bya ba dang*/ yon tan rin po che de yang yon tan gyi 'byung khungs/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i gdan sa/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams/ yul dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams na yod par bstan par bya ba'i phyir yul dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams su gshegs pa lags so// de yang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sngon sbyangs pa'i las kyi 'phro can bsags pa rab tu gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs mthu chen po dang ldan pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po byed pa'i stobs yod pa/ pha bzang gi bu/ rno lcags kyi rtse/ che ba'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi nang nas khyu ma 'khyar na/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan rin po che 'grub pa la tshegs med par bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ phyag na dar yug bco brgyad yod pa gcig kyang ma lus khams pa mdo stod smad/ gnas po dang grogs po bla ma dang slob dpon la spong dag tu mdzad pa lags so// de nas skyi shod du gshegs nas thos pa dang bsam pas spyi dang bye brag rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad la sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pa dang*/

skyes bu yang rab thams cad kyi mdzad pa rig pa'i gnas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yin par bstan pa dang*/ phyi dang nang gi sgro 'dogs gcod pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i paṇḍi ta grub pa thob pa rnams kyi dgongs pa/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po chen po rnams kyis bstan bcos la thos pa dang bsam pa gal che bar bstan pa'i phyir/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen stod lung pa chen po la sogs pa yul dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa chen po rnams las lung dang rigs pa thams cad gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por bzhugs pa lags so// don gyi snying po theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa rnams la/ thos pa dang bsam pa mthar thug par mdzad cing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur nas bzhugs pa lags so// de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po lta bu las snying por gyur pa don du gnyer bya 'o ma'i thigs pa gcig po lta bu/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nyams myong dang rtogs pa can rnams la yod par dgongs shing de bsten par bya ba'i ched du/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rje btsun dpal rga lo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*/ jo mo lha rje la sogs pa rnams las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mthar thug pa ma lus par gsan pa la/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po nor bzang ltar/ pha jo dang ma jo dang*/ yon tan can la gdams ngag med pa'i bla ma bzang ngan med par thams cad las gdams ngag zhus pas/ gdams ngag gi be'u bum/ dpal gyi phag mo gru nas dpal chu bo rir sbrengs kyang mi zad pa mnga' bar grags pa lags so// der yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum sangs rgyas kyi rmang rdo yin pa dang*/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa nyams su len pa rnams la/

lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che dang bral ba'i gdams ngag gis yon tan skyed par mi nus te/ phub ma rdung ba dang khyad par med par dgongs shing bstan pa'i phyir/ rje sa skya ba chen pos dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i chang ljags la ma btang cing bu ram la rung chu btab nas gsol ba dang*/ gdams ngag pa rnams kyi rang spyod tha dad pa rnams la/ gang gis kyang g.yo ba med par rdo rje'i ri lta bur bzhugs pa lags so// lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la rang gi srog la bab kyang thub pa chen pos bcas pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi shin tu phra ba yan chad la 'dzem par dgongs shing thugs su chud nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu gshegs nas/ mya ngan 'das pa chen po mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du/ yul dbus gtsang sa ngan yang*/ skyo tshwa'i rdor tshil bu btab pa gcig kyang zhal du gsol ba ma myong zhing*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor la sku 'gag brje ba'i dus ma gtogs par sku rags 'grol ma myong ba dang*/ rus pa'i tsha ba zhig nye gnas kyi drangs pa gsol ba dang dge slong bzhi sde la bshags bsdom mdzad pa dang*/ rta dang phyugs ma la sogs pa dngos po thams cad 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba la sogs pa/ mdor na bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dang*/ rab tu gshegs shing mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du 'gro ba mtho dman med pa thams cad kyi khur 'khur zhing*/ skyes bu dam pa thams cad bkur bas yon tan rin po che bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'ong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'grub par dgongs nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bran lta bur mdzad cing*/ dka' ba'i khur thams cad bsnams pa la/ drin brtsi ba dang*/ lan bgrang ba med pas rab tu gshegs nas/ rab tu byung ba thams cad kyi khur bsnams shing dka' ba dang du bzhes pas/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che lta bur rgyan du gyur pa dang*/

grwa sar bzhugs pa'i dus su nga rgyal dang khengs pa spangs shing brtul bu lta bur mdzad nas/ dman pa dang mchog gi bya ba thams cad dang du bzhes pa dang*/ chab gdan 'dren pa dang*/ thal ba gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bshos lhag mi rung ba legs par mdzad nas gsol ba dang*/ tshan po che'i stobs rab tu brnyes pas/ dman pa dang mchog rnams kyi khres po chen po bsnams shing gshegs pa la ngo lkog dang skyo dub med par mdzad pa dang*/ thub pa'i bstan pa la thos bsam sgom gsum don du gnyer ba rnams kyis/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs nyams su ma blangs par/ jag chom po/ tshong khe skyed/ zhing rmo rko/ 'brog be'u lug skyong bas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan mi 'byung bar dgongs nas/ bsod snyoms pa chen po sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par mdzad pa dang*/ de ltar che ba'i yon tan dpag tu med pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin cing*/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan thams cad la 'gran gyis do zla dang bral bar gyur kyang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma bde blag tu rnyed na ma 'khrul ba'i chos kyi mig gis rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par gzung bar bya ba dang*/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa skyon dag pa dang*/ yon tan rin po che rgyud la skye bar gzigs na/ tshegs la mi lta bar/ dan grogs bya bar bstan pa'i phyir mkhan po rin po che'i zhabs tog tu mdzad nas dwags lha sgam por byon te/ dri ba tshig gsum gyis rang byung gi ye shes thugs la shar nas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad kyi don thag kyang der chod/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad ni phyi shun dang sbun bur song*/ bla ma btsal sems kyi spros pa yang der chad/ gdams ngag btsal sems kyi re 'dod kyang der zhi/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su yang der mthong*/ bya byed kyi spros pa yang der chod pa lags te/

de ltar yang*/ nyams myong la zhen pa ma mchis na// dpe cha la chags pa ga la mchis// ji snyed kyi grong khyer ma zad na// bza' rgyu la zad pa ma mchis pas// ltogs kyi dogs pa ga la mchis// shi sa brla gang 'dra ba la// yul phyogs la dmigs pa ga la mchis// zhes pa dang*/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom na/ bsten yun ring thung med par yon tan bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'byung ba yin no// zhes bstan pa'i phyir dgung lo gnyis sgam por bzhugs pa las/ sgam po pa chen po la mos gus lta a cang ches te/ bzhes pa yan chan la yang mos gus mthar thug pa mdzad cing*/ nye gnas dang grwa dpon thams cad la bla ma dam par bkur ba dang*/ spyir yang dge 'dun thams cad ni ston pa dngos dang 'dra bar mdzad cing*/ nyid pas bslab pa bgres pa thams cad la ni phyag mdzad/ gzhon pa'i dge slong bzhi sde yan chad la ni phyag dge tshul bzhi sde la ni ldang ba dang*/ chos tshig gcig pa yan chad/ gsung rab thams cad la ni phyag dang ldang ba dang bsu ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi sku 'bag la ni skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar mdzad pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya mtha' dag ma bral bar gyis shig par bstan pa dang*/ de yang thub pa chen pos yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen por chu bo thams cad 'bab pa dang*/ padma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba ji bzhin du slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus pa rnams la bskyang bar mdzad pa'i tshul lugs/ gsol rgyu'i ngos nas thab chung dang*/ sge'u chung dang*/ g.yos chung la sogs pa zhim zhim po dang bstar bstar po sna gcig kyang mi mdzad par/ dge 'dun gyi rgyugs ma ji ltar gsol ba de kho na nyid las gzhan du mi mdzad pa dang*/ sku 'gag rnying pa dkrus nas gsol ba la/ snying nye ba'i nye gnas kyis gsol ba btab nas/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po ni 'di tsam yod/ sku 'gag gsar pa re gsol bar zhu dang zhus pas/ khyod kyis ci yod par mthong*/

kho bo dge 'dun gyi tshogs skyong ba yin gsungs nas/ phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar du mnga' ba thams cad kyi yod pa la phyug snon mi 'debs/ med pa ltogs grir mi gsod/ yon bdag gi snam phrag mi 'gengs/ 'bul ba la thebs len mi mdzad/ ma bsngos par chud zos su mi gtong bar/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan gyi chu bos skal pa dang ldan pa'i snod 'gengs par mdzad pa dang*/ thos pa dang bsam pa'i yon tan rin po che mthar thug kyang sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rnam par thar pa nyams su len pa'i tshul lugs bstan pa'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rlangs seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis/ rin po che nyid kyi rnam par thar pa mdzad pa'i tshul lugs zhig 'gro chos su byas pas/ kho bo la yon tan gyi rnam par thar pa bshad rgyu med/ tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa ni skye ma myong*/ thos bsam gyi grwa sar yang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma chag pa yin gsung skad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rmar ston 'jam dang*/ chung po grogs kyi dpon slob yin pa la/ rin po che yon tan che/ sangs rgyas yin byas pa la/ sangs rgyas min nas tha mal pa zhig gis bsgrubs kyang*/ brtson 'grus dang 'bad pa chen po de tshod kyis yon tan gyi tshogs 'di tsam pa 'ong dgos/ thag ṛng por gshegs bzhud mdzad/ 'o brgyal/ thang chad gzhan thams cad ro nyal byed pa'i dus su/ mtshan ring por tsog pur mdzad nas gdan gyi sog ma rnams kyang phye mar brlags gsungs skad/ zhal snga nas kyang*/ kho bo bla ma zhu g.yas lta bur ldom bu ba zhig byed pa yin pa la/ dus deng sang 'di 'dra ba zhig tu song gsungs nas/ thugs ma rangs pa'i bka' bstsal gsung ste/ de yang don gyis na sems can thams cad kyi don du sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa 'ba' zhig gi zhe bcad kyis/ sgrub pa rus su thon pa'i dus su 'dag rgyu nyon mongs pa dug rnam pa lnga ni rang sar dag byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che rang 'khris med pa'i stobs ni thob/

gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba dang gtong ba chen pos 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs la ni mkhas/ bdag dang bdag gi zhes pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i spros pa thams cad ni chad/ rang gzhan ma lus pa thams cad rang nyid dang gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig tu rtogs pas phrag dog pa'i me ni zhi/ ci dang ci byed pa thams cad kyi byed pa po nga dang bdag gi rgyal thabs dang*/ che thabs dang bzang thabs thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rdo rjes choms pas/ chos kyi sku'i phrin las/ byang chub kyi sems kyi ston thog sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu/ rang don dang gzhan don 'byung ba'i dus su bla ma dang yi dam gyi lung bstan ni byung*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ sems can gyi don mi byed pa'i dbang med pa zhig 'ong bar bla ma dam pa dang mdo rgyud thams cad du gsungs pas/ rin po nyid kyang de ltar lags pa'i bka' bstsal mang po gsungs pa lags so// dus phun sum tshogs pa de lta bu yin kyang gnas phun sum tshogs pa shin tu gal che ste/ de skad du yang*/ nags khrod dben pa stes dbang gis// phrad cing rang dbang bsten mdzad gsol// zhes pa kho bos gsol ba thebs pa yin gsungs/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyang*// nags khrod byang chub shing drung du// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shing*// me tog zla mdzes la sogs pa// bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyang*// nags khrod dgon par don chen grub// dpal gyi ri dang 'be ta'i tshal// grub thob gong ma thams cad kyis// nags khrod dgon par dngos grub brnyes// rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rnams// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// nags khrod dgon pa yin no zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// de ltar gnas phun sum tshogs pa nags khrod kyi dgon pa rgyal byed kyi tshal de lta bu rnyed nas/

rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'khor rgya mtsho chen po lta bu bskyang ba'i thabs 'di ltar bya'o zhes bstan par bzhed pas/ slob ma'i rgyud smin pa dang*/ yon tan rin po che'i tshogs zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin 'phel ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang*/ bde ba dang legs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i dus yin pa dang*/ mtshams bcad cing sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams zla ba'i sgron mes gsal bar gyur pa la sogs pa/ nged tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag rnams kyis kyang*/ phan pa mang po 'byung ba nyams su myong bas grub pa dang*/ mar gyi ngo zla phyed la thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i yon tan rin po che nyid kyis ji ltar bzhed cing gsungs pa thams cad nyams su myong bar gyur ba dang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zad par gyur ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyang smra ba la dga' ba'i nyes pa spangs pas/ bsam gtan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa tha dad pa mnyam par bzhag pas sngar slob ma'i rgyud smin par byas pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs ye shes kyi tshogs kyis smin par byas pas/ tshogs gnyis 'phel zhing mi zad pa'i gter chen po thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ rang gi yon tan la bogs dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur ba dang*/ zhag bco lnga po 'di la khrid 'di byas pa'i yon tan ngo so dang bcas pa kho bo'i drung du khyer la shog cig gsung pa'i bka' nan mdzad nas/ mi mthun po re rag 'jigs gsum yod par ni song*/ mnyes pa dang mi mnyes pa mtho dman gyi dbang chen po ni 'dzin/ legs nyes kyi gsung tshig gcig gis gtan gyi so nam yod med du ni 'gro/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' bar rang la bya ra dgos pa rnams la skul ma btab pas/

yon tan rin po che dbang med du 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi dus shes par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa la dgongs nas/ mar ngo la sku mtshams mdzad pa dang*/ de la zla ba yar ngo'i dus su yang*/ snga dro'i dus su sku mtshams shin tu dam par mdzad cing*/ phyi 'bred kyi dus su sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad par de yang rjes su 'jug pa rnams dang*/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa spyi dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad la yang gdams par dgongs shing mdzad pa lags te/ rin po che nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ spyir yon tan rin po che skye ba'i dus nam gyi tho rangs yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang tho rangs byang chub sangs rgyas ba chos nyid yin/ thabs lam gyi yon tan thams cad kyang tho rangs kyi dus su mi skye kha med yin gsung zhing*/ tho rangs shin tu gdams par mdzad nas/ de'i don thugs kyi dgongs pa shin tu zab mo rnams sras kyi dam pa rnams la bshug thabs su mdzad cing tshogs su seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyis mngon sum du mdzad pa dang*/ thub pa chen po bstan pa'i bdag po sku 'khor dang bcas pas kyang*/ gdugs tshod la ma bab phan chad du thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ gdugs tshod la bab pa'i dus su/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol zhing lhung bzed bsnams te/ bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyag bcabs nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gang zag re re la la sogs pa khrid kyi spros pa chod par mdzad cing*/ dgong ja dus yol pa lan gcig mdzad pa'i rjes/ nyi ma ni gung yol la/ sa'i khams dang tshad pa ni dwangs/ ser bu'i ngad bsil ba ni ldang*/ khams dang dbang po ni brtas/ grib chung sil le grib chen 'ub be ba'i dus der/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya tsho chen po 'dus pa la/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i seng ge'i khri la/

dbu mar gnas pa'i rin po che'i gdan bshams nas/ sku dgye dgu med par drang por bzhugs shing*/ skyil krung chen po legs par bcas nas shin tu zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis shod ces pa ltar/ 'phrul gyi spyan gyis dge 'dun gyi tshogs la gzigs te/ dung gi tshems bar nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas/ seng ge'i rgyal po'am/ bya ka la ping ka'am/ 'brug gi sgra'am/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar zab cing snyan pa'i gsung*/ ha cang mang ba ma yin pa dang*/ ha cang nyung ba ma yin zhing*/ lung dang bcas pa dang*/ rigs pa dang bcas pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa/ nyams su myong ba'i gnad zab mo dang bcas pas/ khams dang bag la nyal ba dang*/ bsam pa'i gnad mngon du gyur cing tshim par mdzad pa'i gsung gi sgro 'dogs dang the tshom gyi spros pa chod nas/ 'jig rten yi rangs shing gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes gsungs pa lta bur gyur pa lags so// gzhan yang chos don du gnyer bas gzhan yang don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang*/ mdzad pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mi chos kyi 'dun mas dgos pa med par bstan pa'i phyir/ zhing khams de na 'dus pa'i gtso 'dun med// sa gzhi nyid kyis dbang ba ma bzung zhing*// 'dod pa'i yon tan spangs pas shin tu bde// so nam rnam bzhi spangs pa rgyal ba'i sras// 'tsho ba bya tshol byed pa'i bsod snyoms pa// sa phyogs gcig tu yun ring mi bzhugs na// skyes chen de la 'dun ma ci zhig bya// dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar// bde ba'i 'byung gnas chos kyi rgyal po la// lha klu gnod sbyin chos skyong srung ma rnams// yul dang phyogs su bcas par bsrung bar byed// mi zad gter chen dgos 'dod char pa yis// yul khams thams cad bde skyid dpal ldan na// su yi 'dun mas de la ci zhig bya// 'das dang ma 'ongs dus gsum mkhyen pa yi// mngon par shes pa thob pa'i mthu med kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab dam chos kyi// rjes su 'brang zhing chos dang bstun pa la// nyes pa med na 'dun mas ci zhig bya// thub pa'i gsung dang 'gal ba med pa yis// rgyal ba'i sras rnams sa phyogs gar phyin yang*// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i gnas kyang rung*// gang du phyin yang kun gyis mchod pa dang*// bsu zhing bkur bsti chen pos bkur gyur na// gcig tu zhen pa'i 'dun mas ci zhig bya// zhes pa la sogs pa 'dun ma mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dpag tu med pa slob ma rnams la bstan pa lags so// de yang 'dir nged sems can rnams kyi 'dug lugs ni gzhan dag legs par gnas shing bde ba dang skyid pa'i dus su ngo dga' ba dang phye gtor/

dgos pa med cing mi 'dod kyang shi shi dang chad chad du phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub cing*/ sdug cing phongs nas nyam thag pa'i dus su nyes pa brjod cing spong bar gyur ba chos nyid du 'dug la/ skyes bu chen po de nyid ni/ brtse ba chen pos kun la bu bzhin gzigs// phongs par gyur na shin tu mi gtong zhing*// gnod par gyur kyang thugs rjes bder 'brel ba// nga 'o zad pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag /ces pa lags/ su la yang mi dgos pa'i dus su ngo dga' dang*/ kha bsag dang*/ zhogs slong dang*/ thob kyis 'jal ba la sogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ phongs shing dgos pa'i dus su phan zhing 'doms par mi 'gyur ba ni gcig kyang med de/ bdag nyid kyi bde ba dang skyid pa thams cad dang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad brjes nas khur du bsnams par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ de yang gzhan gyis ma tshor bar dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mos dbang bsgyur zhing*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang*/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du yang*/ skyon dag pa dang yon tan rdzogs par byed pa ni gzhir gyur pa yin la/ tshor ba dang mthong ba ni cung zad tsam yin par rang nyid la nyams su myong ba dpag tu med pa yod pa dang*/ yang dus cig na/ mi bya ba a pho rang yin/ ngas dka' ba dang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa zhig gis zhabs kyi drung 'dir thon snyam pa'i rlom pa chen po skyes pa dang*/ zhal snga nas/ khyod lta rang la re ba che bar 'dug ste/ khyed rnams kyi phyir ngas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byas pa yin gsung ba la/ dus der go ba ma skyes/ mdor na khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang dbang med par byang chub kyi thugs rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings su/ rang dbang med par 'khor lo la skyon nas rang dbang med par 'dren pa ni gzod go ste cung phyis tsam/

de yang mya ngan las 'da' ka'i dus su gzhan gyis mi mthun pa'i phyogs bsgrub par byed pa rnams kyis zhal zas drangs pas sku lus thams cad ni zug gis gang*/ 'o brgyal ba chen pos ni shin tu 'o brgyal ba'i dus su sras kyi dam pa mos gus dang gdung ba'i yid can gyis/ rin po che la 'di ltar byas pa'i mi de mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gro zhus pas/ 'di ngan song tsam du yang ma song ba kho bo'i gnyer ka yin gsungs pa dang*/ spyir yang gdug sems dang gnod sems can mang po dang*/ gdug pa'i kha zas drangs pa'i dus su/ kho bo'i sku'i rim 'gro dge slong rnam par dag pa bzhi sde yan chad la/ kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs kyi cho gas gzhan gyi sdig sgrib byang na/ nyid kyi sku khams bde zhing byang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa brjod kyis mi lang ba dang*/ yang dug gi rigs sngags shin tu zab pa mang po phan zhing nyams su myong bas grub pa yod pa/ sras kyi dam pas bya bar gsol ba btab pa dang*/ khyod kyi de ngo mtshar shin tu che ba zhig gyis dang gsung skad/ de la sngags 'di shin tu nus pa che/ shin tu bsil bas/ chang bzang po'i nying khu med na gdab du mi btub pa lags zhus pas/ srog gi phyir yang*/ chang ni btung du btub pa ma yin te/ las kyi 'bras bu rnam pa smin pa yang shin tu 'jigs su rung ba yin te/ de yang sngon 'das pa'i dus su/ dge slong dge ba'i blo gros chos kyi dpal zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pa drug thob pa/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan pas/ spre'u mang po zhig gis/ ratna tsarya'i mchod rten la mi rigs pa byed pa mthong bas/ 'di rnams gang du skye dgongs pa las/ thams cad mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gro bar gzigs pas/ de thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ gnas der spre'u'i lus su bsams bzhin tu srid par nye bar blangs nas/

ngag tu ni chos ma bshad/ byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ mchod rten la bskor ba byas pas/ spre'u rnams ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par gyur te/ 'pho ba mdzad dgongs pa las/ spre'u gnyis chags pa spyod pa mthong ba las/ dud 'gro rten ngan pas thig le nyams pa zhig byung*/ nyes pa des rgyus mngal gyi skye gnas su skyes nas/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa rnams ni shor/ mngon par shes pa brjed pa la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung bar gsungs te/ dus gzhan gyi tshe yang*/ e ma las kyi rnam par smin pa 'di ni re 'jigs/ mngal gyi dri ma 'di ni nyes pa re che gsung ba lags skad/ bdag nyid chen po des chang 'thung ba'i skyon gzigs shing ma 'thung ba'i yon tan thugs su chud pas/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rang bas gces par gyur pa rnams la ma 'thung zhig ces/ snying por gyur pa'i gdams ngag gi gnad/ phyin ci ma log pa skyes rabs dang bcas pa gsungs pas chang btung bar mi bya'o// dus gsum mngon du gyur pa dpal ldan chos kyi rjes// rgyu dang 'bras bu shin tu phra ba rnams// 'di las 'di byung shin tu thugs su chud pa'i phyir// 'gro ba bur gyur rnams dang bu slob rjes 'jug la// brtse chen des ni rang bas gces par gzigs pa'i phyir// rgyu dang 'bras bu zab pa'i gnad 'di snying por gsungs// chags sdang nyes pa'i rtsa ba sha dang chang rnams kun// rang nyid mi bzhes gzhan la gnang bar mi 'gyur ba// dus gsum mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i gsung rnams dpang mdzad nas// nyid kyis mngon du gyur pa gces pa'i bu la gdams// gnad 'dis so sor thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi// dam tshig ji bzhin bsrungs pas gsang sngags yon tan rnams// bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs la bzhag nas ni// thugs kyi snying por chongs shig rjes 'jug slob ma rnams// chags pa spyod pa'i sbyor thabs sum brgya drug cu dang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad rnams zab pa ma yin te// de rnams 'od gsal dbyings su dag na thub pa'i chos// rgyal bas gsang sngags zab pa'i gnad du gsungs pa yin// gzhan du mu stegs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgrub thabs su// yang dang yang du nan tan chen pos bka' bstsal gsung*// 'o na mad de de na thams cad shin tu legs/

khyod nyid de ltar mi byed ci ste zhe na/ de ni shin tu mad ste/ bdag nyid chen po de'i rnam par thar pa mtha' dag ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis kyang bsgrub par mi nus mod kyi/ phyogs re re tsam gyi rnam par thar pa la ma gnas na ni/ byi bo dbyig pa thogs pas kyang mi tshe phyid par mi 'gyur bas/ bdag kyang phyogs 'ga' zhig la bzhugs pa lags te/ zla stod zla smad dang*/ snga dro phyi 'bred la sogs pa sgrub par nus tshad gyis de sngon yang 'bad cing*/ da ltar yang 'bad pa lags/ ra lnga med pa 'ga' zhig byung ba la ni nyes par ma mthong zhing tshod yod du bgyis pa ma lags te/ rje rin po che sras dang bcas phyogs ris dang bcas pa thams cad la mthol zhing bshags pa lags pas/ rjes su 'jug cing phan pa dang bde bar 'dod pa rnams kyis bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa la bslab par bya'o// ji ltar nyi ma shar nub bzhin// rigs 'di gtso bor smra ba yin// 'jig rten pa rnams rigs gtsor byed// rgyal po bram ze rta dang glang*// de las de nyid ji bzhin na// 'jig rten mgon po thub pa yi// sras rnams de yi rigs las skyes// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar rnams// gang zhig 'dzin par mi byed na// rgyal ba'i sras su ji ltar 'gyur// gzhan gyi brtul zhugs tha dad pa'i// rigs nyid gtso bor mi byed zhing*// thub pa chen po'i rjes 'jug pas// thub pa'i sras su gyur pa yin// thub mgon bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// mi slob rjes su mi 'brang na// de yi sku gsung thugs nyid dang*// dbyer med gcig tu ji ltar 'gyur// skyes chen mnyes par bya ba'i phyir// rnam thar phyogs gcig tsam spyad kyang*// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rnam thar de yi rjes 'brangs nas// chos kyi sku la sa bon btab// chos kyi sku dang mnyam par 'gyur// gzugs kyi sku la sa bon btab// gzugs sku gnyis dang mnyam par 'gyur// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med bla ma rin chen dang*// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa'i phyir// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// nan tan chen pos bslab par bya// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// ngar snabs la yang 'od 'byung ltar// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// yon tan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// ngar snabs 'dra ba bdag kyang 'tsher// ngar snabs bzang po ma yin te// tsha ba'i 'od la blo gtad med// skyob mdzad mgon po rin po che// sangs rgyas 'od la thug pa med// dpag tu gyur pa bsam yas kyang*// bdag cag tshu rol mthong ba'i ngor// mthun par snang ba'i rnam par thar// skye dang rnam par rol ba dang*// yon tan brnyes dang bsgrub pa dang*// nags khrod bsten cing tshogs skyong dang*// stong nyid 'brug gi sgra sgrogs pa// seng ge'i rgyal por sras rnams la// ji snyed mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i chos// rgyu 'bras zhal chems bzhag pa rnams// bdag cag rjes su 'jug pa dang*// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// zab pa'i gnad du bdag gis go// stong nyid rtogs na ci phyir na// rten 'brel nyid las gzhan pa yi// stong nyid ston pas ma gsungs shing*// rin chen nyid kyang mi gsung la// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ston par yang*// 'gyur du btub par ma gos bas// gsung la nan tan bya ba dang*// rnam par thar pa'i rjes su slob// che ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho ltar yangs pa// yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas bshes gnyen gyis// thub pa'i gsung bzhin bla ma mnyes byas nas// bdag gi rnam thar zhus phyir yi ger bris// dri med rin chen rnam thar 'di bris pas// mdzub mos zla ba ston pa ji bzhin du// kun tu bzang po bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med gcig tu shog
/bdag cag dman pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ tshu rol mthong ba'i ngor/ mthun snang gi rnam par thar pa cung zad bris pa/ nyams len rin po che mi zad pa rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

251) ༄// sgrub pa bca' ldad kyi man ngag rin chen shugs kyi gsang chen// spyir gong du snyan du gsol ba'i nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i gnyen por/ mnyam pa nyid rnam pa lnga mngon du gyur pa la/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas bshad pa bzhin du byung ba'i dus su tshogs pa skyong ran pa yin/ rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sgom ro gcig rgyud la skyes nas tshogs skyong ran gsungs/ de yang phan 'dogs pa dang gnod pa skyel ba thams cad gnyug ma byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ sems nyid kyi ngang du bcu chos ltar nyams su blangs pas/ bcu chos ltar 'ong ba yin/ rang la yod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad/ mnga' ris dang phyogs ris/ slob ma snying por gyur pa ni 'di yin/ gzhan ngan pa ni 'di yin snyam pa byung na/ rang la skyong rgyu zhig byung ba'i dus su de la gnod pa zhig cis kyang 'byung ba chags sdang gi rgyu 'bras/ ro gcig gi dam tshig nyams/ bla ma la mos gus mnyam pa nyid kyi don la nan tan/ de mnyam pa nyid du goms pa gal che/ de yang zla stod zla smad dang*/ snga dro phyi dro dang*/ slob ma bogs ma thon pa dang*/ gdug pa dang*/ nyes pa mang po dang*/ nad dang gnod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs byung ba'i dus su kho bo sku khams ma bde gsung*/ zla drug dang gsum dang ci rigs pa mtshams dam par bcad nas/ sku'i rim gro dge sbyor la 'bad du bcug pas/ zhing dag pa bla ma tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu/ gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs thon pa dang yon tan skye ba/ rin po che'i thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang*/ gnad shin tu zab par gda' bas/ phal cher sku mtshams su mdzad pa dang dge sbyor la 'bad pa gal che/ dris lan dang po/ ngag bzlas brjod mang po dang*/ sems bsam mno mang bas/ rlung rang gnas su ma tshud/ srog rtsol yan par 'chor/ kha ton bzlas pas mi 'tshengs/ rdo rje bzlas pa'i gnad dang bral bas/ skad chung zhing 'gag dpral mdo bsdus shing gnyid bro/

byang khog dbugs kyis rgyangs/ kha shugs 'byin/ skad chen po byas pa'i dus su yon tan ye med/ skyon mtha' dag gis rgyas/ tshe thung nad mang ba la sogs pa 'ong ba yin pas/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje/ thugs gnyis su med pa ye shes kyi rdo rje dang*/ me lce dmar po chu 'bab dmigs pa chen pos skyon 'dag cing yon tan rdzogs pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag tu gsungs pas/ nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du/ nan tan chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhu lan gnyis pa/ ma zhus pa'i gdams ngag nyams su myong ba'i snying po/ phyi rol tu rdzas dang yo byad/ nye du gnyen 'brel/ phan 'dogs pa dang gnod pa skyel ba gang yang mi 'dug rin po che'i chos lnga po 'di 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug pas/ lnga po 'di 'ba' zhig las gzhan skad cig kyang nyams su mi blang bar 'di 'ba' zhig tu song ba zhig mdzad par zhu/ zla stod zla smad/ snga dro phyi 'bred/ dgos pa'i dus dang gsum du sku mtshams mdzad nas dge sbyor la 'bad par zhu/ dpon gcig g.yog gcig ri khrod kyis// dgon par spros pa rab bcad de// sgrub pa bya ba'i sems yod kyang*// skad cig skad cig bca' bldad kyi// sgrub pa byed pa'i gnad med na// yang cig yang cig ri khrod kyi// shom ra shom ras mi tshe zad// mkhar lan mkhar lan bya byed kyis// rang gzhan gnyis kyi lus sems dub// mos gus can gyi slob ma rnams// yid chad skyug nag gting nas log /so nam khe skyed mi chos kyi// 'dun ma srid pa gcod byed cing*// dar gyi nang du bre btums kyang*// nye ring kun gyis shes nas 'ong*// thub pa chen po sras bcas kyis// dro zan gcig gi gsog 'jog spong*// nyin zhag phrug gcig nyams myong gis// dgra bcom rang sangs rgyas la sogs// 'phags pa rnams kyis don chen bsgrub// sgrub pa bca' ldad man ngag 'di// rin chen shugs kyi gsang chen yin// tshogs kyi dge 'dun grwa pa yang*// lnga brgya tsam du ma longs tshe// phyi bcud nang bcud mtho dman 'ong*// de yi bar du bzod pa bsgom// bcu chos gsum chos gnad du zab// las can blo gtad yod pa yis// bsod nams bsags pa che ba yi// nye gnas rang la mi 'khu ba// dpal chen chos ye lta bu yi// la la zhig dang lhan cig tu// dge 'dun rgya mtsho ltar 'phel na// thams cad chos kyis dul nas mchi// pha srol bu yis 'dzin pa ltar// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i dam chos ni// spyod pa tshul khrims rnam dag pas// lta ba nang nas 'char bar bzhed// tshad ldan bla ma'i mos gus kyis// rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa dang*// nya mo chu dang mi 'bral ltar// spyod pa tshul khrims rin po ches// gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad byed// lta spyod gnyis kyi nyams len 'di// rin po che yi mdzad pa yin// bdag kyang 'di la slob pa yin// rnam thar 'di la slob pa yi// dam pas dbu snyung bzhes pa yin// dpon gcig g.yog gcig ri khrod dang*// gcig pu gnyis su med pa dang*// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun skyong*// chos ldan mdzad pa sna tshogs kun// gang phan gang legs blta ba las// phyogs gcig kha tshon bcad pa med// ji ltar dgyes shing 'tsham par mdzod//

// 252) ༄// 'khor 'das kyi spang blang nyams len ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig nyes tshogs mun pa rnams// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba ji bzhin du// 'khor ba 'jig rten chos las rnam rgyal ba// thub mgon phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// thub pa chen po de yi sras su 'khrungs// skyon med yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pas// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten re ba skyes// 'gro ba'i mgon du khyod la mnga' gsol ba// gdung zhing brtse ba'i yid can bla ma yis// dbang gi rgyal po nges phyir rgyal mtshan rtser// legs par bzhugs pa skyes bu chen po la// legs spyad rgya mtshos gsol 'debs yi ger bri// 'dir skyes bu dam pa bsod nams dang ye shes tshogs bsags pa'i rgyab can/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang*/ re gnas su gyur pas/ gnad gnyis la brten par bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i chos su gyur tshad spang byar shes pa byas nas spang ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad blang byar shes nas nyams su blang bar bya/ gnyis po 'di kho na thugs kyi dkyil du bcang bar zhu 'tshal/ de la 'jig rten pa'i chos spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/ rang gi pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel/ phyogs ris dang bcas pa thams cad/ rtsa ba gti mug nga dang bdag med pa nam mkha'i me tog lta bu la/ kha dog legs ma legs kyi 'khrul pa gti mug chen po 'byung bas/ chags pa dang sdang ba'i me chen pos rang nyid sreg cing*/ 'od kyis gzhan bsreg pa/ thal ba tsam yang ma lus par byed pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa/ 'dun ma dang gros dang*/ byed lugs mtha' dag spang bar bya ba ni thog ma dang*/ bar dang tha mar mi dge ba rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu ngan pa mtha' dag thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ mgo'am gos la me shor ba ltar thams cad spang bar bya'o// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/

de la rnam pa gnyis te/ snga ma lta bu sems can rnams la yang*/ rgyu khams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa yod pa dang*/ rkyen sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs zhugs pas/ dkar po'i bsam pa skyes te/ phan pa dang bde ba'i tshig ku re dang kyal ka yan chad du ngag tu brjod pa dang*/ bsam pa de dang 'brel bas/ zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur byed tshad bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam par dag pa yin pas/ rang nyid zhing rnam par dag pa bsgrub pa gal che ste/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ de las skyes pa'i yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma/ ji bzhin du babs rtogs pa'i shes rab la gnas par byas nas bdag gir bya ste/ shin tu phra ba nas nan tan dang*/ gces spras byed pa gal che ste/ zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis/ mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/ chos mngon par gsungs pa dang*/ rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ phra ba'i rgyu 'bras la yid ches na/ rags pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon sum du go// zhes pa zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi sa bon phra ba'i rgyu 'bras la so nam dang nan tan byas na/ rags pa'i rgyu 'bras rags pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ dpag tu med pa longs spyod par bzhed pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang slob dpon 'phags pa ni zhing srung ba'i thabs la mkhas pa yin pas nga'i bstan pa gzung bar nus te/ gzan kar bab pa'i zhing rang nyid kyis bsrung mi nus te/ rgyal po dang rgyal po'i blon po dang*/ chen por gyur pa thams cad dga' bar byas shing*/ legs par mchod nas zhing bsrung ba'i rogs bcol na/ rang gi rtsol ba mi dgos par legs par bsrung ba dang 'dra bar thub pa'i bstan pa gdug pa'i skye bos 'jig par byed pa yang*/ de dga' ba dang bsnyen bkur byas nas rang gi grogs su gyur nas/ bstan pa bsrung bar ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa dang*/ phan pa dang grub pa la dga' ba'i mi chos gtso bo mkhas pas kyang*/

bzang po'i tshig zer ba/ lce dmar gte'u du bzung nas phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa ni/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi rgyud la/ 'phags pa'i yon tan yod pa/ mkhas pa'i 'byung khungs nas gser btsag pa lta bu dang*/ 'phags pa bdag nyid chen po gong ma rnams kyi yon tan blang ba ni/ thub pa'i gsung rab sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum yin pas de'i rjes su bslab par bya'o// de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa jo bo chen po rje lha cig yin gsung*/ des thugs su chud pa mngon par rtogs pa'i chos tshig tu nyung ba/ don du 'dril ba/ gnad du phog pa/ gsung rab thams cad kyi don 'dus pa de 'dra ba cig byung na/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i chos yin gsung*/ de la jo bo'i chos/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa las rgyu dang 'bras bu/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa dang*/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis kyi don bsgom pa 'dir/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad ma 'dus pa med gsung nas/ bstan pa'i rim pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di'i khrid dang*/ phyag bzhes dang*/ bka' bstsal yang gsung thog tu yang bab ste/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa shin tu gal che/ de ma bsams na 'jig rten 'di pa rang rkyang*/ 'jig rten pha rol la dran pa med pa sdig po che zhig tu 'gyur ba la tshegs med pas nyams su myong bas grub pas/ 'chi ni nges de ring dang sang nam 'chi yang cha med/ bsam pa'i rgyu 'bras kyang zab pas/ 'di la nan tan chen pos 'bad par bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas khe chen po dang*/ don chen po thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba la 'jug pa'i blo skye ste/ de gang yin snyam du thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du btsal bas/ shin tu rlabs che ba/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'di thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba/

sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin pas/ 'di kho na la bsam pa 'byongs shing lag len du bsgrub par bya'o// de la yang dus deng sang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni sha dang*/ chang dang bud med dang*/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing*/ 'bar ba 'di yin zer/ lung khungs ni sems la dbang thob cing sprul sgyur mdzad pa'i grub thob rnams la byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni mi dge ba rnam pa bdun po mtha' dag gnang ba yin zer/ lung khungs ni dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprul sgyur gyi rnam par thar pa la byed/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba ni/ rtsa ba brnab sems dang gnod sems log par lta ba gsum thug reg med/ nged spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pa 'di kho na spong ba yin zer/ lung khungs ni sus kyang mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ bye brag gi bshad mdzod chen po yin lo/ de la gsum po 'di srol chen por grub pa yin/ lung pa g.yo ba chus mi 'gyur/ bod khams kyi rnam par thar pa khyod kyis bsgyur mi nus/ rang tshod zin pa dga' ba yin snyam pa yod na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po rin po che ston pa'i bstan pa che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyis khyad par du 'phags shing*/ 'gran gyis do zla med la/ bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyi spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher gyur pa de'i rnam par thar pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad ni/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig la rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par mdzad/ sems nyid gdod nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad dang bral ba/ rje sgam po pa chen po'i rjes su 'brang zhing rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par mdzad/ lta spyod rnam pa gnyis gcig tu gyur pas skyon 'dag pa dang yon tan rdzogs pa 'ba' zhig tu thugs nges shing*/

lung rigs pa man ngag myong ba thams cad kyis gtan la phab nas/ bstan pa'i snying po rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rnams la gtad pa/ khyed kyis thugs nyams su bzhes par zhu/ de gang yin zhe na/ da ltar khyed rang nyid kyi phyag bzhes dang*/ nyams len de las gzhan med de/ rtag tu snyan du gsol mod kyi/ gal po che la lan gsum du bgyid na/ jo bo chen po rje dang*/ rin po che nyid kyi thugs dgongs theg pa che chung byang chub kyi sems yod med las gzhan med par gsung te/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod pa dang*/ slob dpon zla grags kyi dbu ma la 'jug pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod de gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'grel pa thams cad nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pas sa bcu rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces pa tshul khrims 'ba' zhig gis sa bcu lam lnga rdzogs par byas nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pa yin pas/ de yang dang po kho nar dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i rjes su 'brang ste/ de la 'dul ba'i sde snod thams cad kyang bkag pa dang*/ gnang ba dang*/ sgrub pa rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa yin te/ bkag pa ci'i phyir bkag gnang ba ci'i phyir gnang*/ sgrub pa ci'i phyir sgrub snyam pa'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa gal che ste/ de la bkag pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rgyu nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ de'i las mi dge ba byas pas 'bras bu 'khor ba ngan song gsum du 'khor bas thub pa chen pos bkag pa dang*/ rgyu nyon mongs par ma song ba dang*/ las de'i rjes su 'brangs pa med pa dang*/ 'bras bu ngan song rnam pa gsum du mi skye ba ni nyes pa med pas bkag pa med pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i bcas pa ni rgyu nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi gnyen por gyur pa dang*/

lam de nyams su len pa dang*/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa zag pa med pa 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa gsum du shes par bya'o// 'di lta bu'i 'byung khungs gang yin zhe na/ gong du snyan du gsol ba'i so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig pa pa mi tra/ sdig pa'i grogs po log pa'i bshes gnyen rnams las 'byung ba ma yin te/ de dang bsten par bya ba'i tshul lugs kyang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/ byang chub snying po rnam mthong nas// de la brnyas par mi bya 'o// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gdams pa de rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas gus 'dud dang*/ bsnyen bkur dang*/ zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog bya yi/ blo gtad dang*/ snying bzhag pa dang*/ blo bzhag pa'i kho thag bcad par byas nas/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che nyid kyi rjes su 'brang zhing*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ 'phags pa rnams kyis zag pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i gter mdzod/ chos kyi rgyal po ston pa mya ngan las ma 'das shing zhal mngon du bzhugs pa/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che 'di la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar bya ste/ de yang rang nyid ston pa'i gsung rab dang mthun par byed pa ni bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ gzhan thams cad de la 'god pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur dang zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog byed pa ni bgyid du bstsal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ gnas dus rgyang ring po nas bskal nas bkur bsti ma grub pa la ni/ phyogs su mchod pa bshams shing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dga' ba bsgom pa ni rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ gsum po re re la gsum du gyur pas ni/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/

rang gi bsam pa gcig gis nges par byas shing byang chub tu bsngo ba ni thabs la mkhas pa/ de nyid kyang rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur rtogs pa ni shes rab/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel ba ni/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa lags pas/ de la nan tan chen por 'bad par bya'o// ji ltar ri dwags rgyal po yi// rtsi dang sgog skya'i dri bzhin du// gang la nye ba'i dri yis gos// sems 'di chu yi chu bur bzhin// rkyen las skye zhing 'jig par snang*// sdig pa can gyi mi rnams dang*// de yi tshig dang 'dun gros rnams// mkhas pas dug bzhin spang bar mdzod// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// rgyu lam 'bras bu bzang ba yi// grogs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten// phal cher mnyam gzhag bsam gtan bya// 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam thar gyis// zla stod zla smad bya ba dang*// snga dro phyi 'bred ting 'dzin gyis// bsam pa sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin 'di// mi chos 'dun ma zab pa yin// sdang ba'i dgra dang byams pa'i gnyen// srid dang 'dun ma gcod lugs kyi// skya log sngo log mang po la// gtan srid 'byung ba mi srid cing*// ma byas pa yi mi med kyang*// legs par byung ba ngas ma mthong*// rgyal ba'i spyan gyis ma gzigs pas// rgya gad tshig ngan mi brjod cing*// 'tshams pa'i bsnyen bkur byas la btang*// rang gi dge sbyor stobs 'phel na// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// chos skyong srung ma mthu bo che// tshangs pa rgya byin rgyal chen bzhi// dam pa'i chos la skyes pa yi// mthu stobs ldan pa'i chen po rnams// tshogs shing 'dun 'gros bcad pa la// gre bo gre mo bse rags kyang*// 'dun 'gros byed sa med par 'ong*// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// snying gros 'dun ma mthil gyi gnad// rang la sdang ba'i dgra bo dang*// 'dun ma gcig tu byed pa 'di// bdag la shin tu zab par byung*// shes pa gcig tu 'dres pa 'di// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin yin// dgra gnyen gnyis su med pa 'di// dam pa rnams kyi mdzad spyod yin// de ltar yang snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can ni gdul dka'/

las ngan pas 'brel ba'i grogs po ni snying ring*/ blo gtad sa'i grogs dang gnyen bshes ni med/ dris kyang gnas skabs mthar thug tu phan pa'i 'dun ma ni sus kyang mi shes/ da ci tsug bya snyam na/ sngar snyan du gsol ba bzhin du/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi 'di kho na blta ba dang*/ mchod gnas dge slong bzang por klog tu bcug nas de la mnyan pa dang*/ der ji ltar du legs par byung ba'i 'dun gros de ltar lag len du btab pas shin tu legs pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug rang rgyud chos dang mi mthun pa'i bya ba ci byas pas/ rang gzhan thams cad phung bar 'dug 'dul ba rin po che 'di zab par yang gsungs te/ zab par tshor bar yang byung bas/ 'di kho na'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// 'di ni snying por gyur pa'i gdams ngag go/ /gzhan yang ston pa bcom ldan gyis/ lnga brgya'i dus kyi sems can rnams// ji ltar 'dul bar bya ba'i thabs// zhib tu ting 'dzin rgyal por gsungs// shar du shes rab pha rol phyin// lhor ni phal chen sdong po bkod// nub tu gsang bsam ting 'dzin rgyal// byang du gser 'od dam pa'i mdo// bklags pas gnod pa thams cad 'jig /yon tan rdzogs par ston pas gsungs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// bsod nams yon tan 'byung 'dod pas// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// mchod pa rgya ches mchod par bya// gsung ba bzhin du dge 'dun gyi// sde la bkur sti bya ba'i thabs// dang po skyes bu dam pa zhig /'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang*// bklag pa kha ton 'khor lo can// de 'dra gcig dang gnyis dang gsum// bzhi sde tsam zhig rnyed pa na// chos kyi srid dang bya ba rnams// ngam ngam shugs kyis 'phel nas kyang*// chos min thams cad 'byer bar 'gyur// mngon mtshan med pa'i bya ba yis// dam pa'i srid dang 'dun gros kyis// skyes bu dam pa 'phel bar bya// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bstan pa khyed kyis bzung nas kyang*// 'gro ba sems can smin pa dang*// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab dang*// bslab pa gsum gyi rgyal mtshan gyis// 'gro ba sems can smin mdzad zhu// ji ltar tshad pas gdungs pa'i skyes bu yis// ngoms pa don du gnyer ba ji bzhin du// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yis// gsol ba btab nas ji bzhin bris pa yin// dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// dge ba kun gyis thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// ma lus sems can khams rnams ji snyed pas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin chen myur thob shog/

253) ༄// bla ma dang mi 'bral ba'i bstan bcos gdung sel snying po ye shes 'od kyi zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po de nyid kyis// byin gyis rlabs pa thugs kyi sras// shākya'i rgyal po'i gdung rgyud 'dzin// bslab gsum rgyan gyis brgyan pas mdzes// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus la// mtho dman ltem rkyang ma mchis shing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu la// byang chub sems kyi nyi dkyil rgyas// gdul bya padmo kha 'byed cing*// mi shes mun pa sel bar mdzad// shākya'i dge slong rnal 'byor pa// ye shes 'od kyis zhus pa yi// zhus lan rdo rje'i gsang tshig 'di// srog dang snying ltar sba zhing bcang*// snying tshig gsang gtam zhu lags na// mnar med dmyal ba yan chad nas// srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyi// lus can 'gro drug thams cad la// rtsa yod rlung yod thig le yod// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le yi// gdams ngag zab gces gang bstan pa// rmongs pa rang mgo rang gis bskor// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// chos kyi phung po dpag med kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul// thabs dang shes rab rnam gnyis dang*// lta ba spyod pa rnam gnyis yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa// byang chub sems su bka' bstsal gsung*// rnam gsum rdo rje'i tshig drug 'di// cung zad phye zhing zhu lags na// 'jig rten mgon po de nyid kyi// sems bskyed nyid kyi rjes 'brang nas// dus gsum byin gyis rlabs nas kyang*// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la// 'khol bar byed pa'i dam bca' yis// mi dge nyes tshogs bar gcod pa// thams cad mkhyen pas bcas pa yi// ltung ba sde lnga thag bsrings te// rang gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum byas dang yod pa yi// dge ba kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin// mthar thug byang chub chen por bsngo// bsngo bya bsngo byed dge ba rnams// ma skyes stong pa'i shes rab dang*// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa de// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med yin// skyes chen khyod kyis thugs la zhog

/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// rang sems lhun grub chos kyi sku// rgyun chad med pa'i ngo bo la// glo bur rkyen gyis byung ba yi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// nyes pa'i dri ma sbyangs pa'i thabs// ston pa thugs rje chen po yis// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod 'di// mtha' dang bral ba'i spyod par bstan// lta spyod zung du 'brel ba 'dis// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dpa' chen dang*// grub thob gong ma thams cad kyis// rang don gzhan don phun sum tshogs// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// bla med thugs kyi yang gter yin// bu snying dang 'dra ba gcais se yis// snying dang 'dra bar nyams su longs// spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar bzhin du ro gcig pa// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid dbyer med pa// dpa' bo bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing*// sku gnyis lhun grub bcom ldan gyis// seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas kyang*// dpa' bo'i dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas kyang*// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun mchog /mi yi seng ges tshogs dbus su// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// las can slob ma mos gus can// sangs rgyas gsung du go ba yis// ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs// ji lta ba bzhin nyams su myong*// thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs pa'i// skyes chen chos kyi mig can rnams// nang du dga' ba yang yang skyes// e ma chos rje bcom ldan 'das// mya ngan ma 'das bzhugs pa 'di// re dga' re skyid ngo mtshar zhes// ched du brjod pa ched du brjod// mgo dang mig dang snying dag dang*// gtong zhing mchod pas spro dga' na// phun tshogs gzhan lta smos ci dgos// 'jig rten mgon po de nyid kyi// rjes su slobs shig rigs kyi bu// gzhan dag thabs lam bye brag rnams// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// mthu chung man chung sgam sgum dang*// khyi sngags rma sngags 'gugs sngags dang*// rig byed ngo mtshar che rnams kyis// phad bu phying khug bkang nas kyang*// grong khyer dbus su su 'dod ces// 'o dod chen pos 'bod na yang*// nges shes mi skye smyon par 'dzin// mthu chen sngags kyi tshul 'chang ba// brgya rtsa bsad pa'i mthu chen yang*// sha skyid mi che sdug pa mthong*// drod po che yi dmyal ba dang*// mkha' la 'phur ba'i byi'u dang*// chu na gnas pa'i nya sram tshogs// mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags rnams// rdzu 'phrul che ste sdug ge 'dug

/bdag gi thabs lam bye brag rnams// sems kyi de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs// gang zag dbang po'i rim pa yis// dpag tu med par 'gyur ba 'di// thug pa med cing mtha' med par// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs la zhog /sku 'bag skur ces bka' bstsal ba// mos gus can gyi slob ma yis// bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du mthong*// sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po 'di// dus gsum bla ma'i sku 'bag yin// sman pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// sman pa'i rgyal po rang sems dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhu// dbu skra phyag zhabs sen mo rnams// ji ltar gsung ba de bzhin bsgrubs// bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yi// rang gi sems dang mi 'bral ba// gdung sel rin chen lta bu yi// gdung ba sel ba'i sman mchog 'di// bu yis zhus nas brtsams pa lags// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// byin gyis rlob cing bzod pa bzhes// dus thams cad du bla ma dam pa dang mi 'bral ba bstan bcos gdung ba sel byed thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 254) ༄// 'gro ba'i bde skyid shes rab phar phyin las byung ba dge bshes lcags ri ba'i zhu chos// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang rgyal sras dang*// 'phags pa rnams dang 'gro ba ma lus kun// bde skyid kun gyi 'byung gnas gcig pu nyid// yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin la skyabs su mchi// rgyal ba rnams dang de sras dang*// mkhas pa rnams dang rnal 'byor pa// chos kyi mig ldan dam pa rnams// rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad cing gus// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po yis// nyid kyi sku bas lhag par dgongs// shin tu gces pa'i gsang tshig 'di// mgon po de yi rjes 'brang zhing*// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mis// rang gi srog pas gces par bsrung*// dpag med 'gro ba smin pa'i thabs// chos 'dir gus las gzhan med pas// dad gus bya thabs cung zhig bstan// 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/

sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod las byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ mchod cing nyams su blang ba'i phan yon de nyid kyis shes pa yin la/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar lung bstan pa yang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi lag thob pa// ring por mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyi byang chub 'thob// ces gsungs pas shes la/ de las ldog pa las ni/ de las ldog pa nyid du 'gyur te/ de yang gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sras dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ bde 'gro'i lha rnams dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bde skyid dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi nang du rang yang yod pas/ de thams cad spangs pa dang*/ 'dren pa thams cad kyi byang chub mi thob pa dang*/ de'i 'gro ba'i gnas kyang gcig pu nyid du gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin la ma dad na// thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de// spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho chen po/ chu thams cad kyi gnas spangs na/ sgo yin pa'i phyir thub pa'i chos rnams ma spangs pa gcig kyang med pas/ rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams kyis spong ba zhes pa/ nyo ba dang*/ 'tshong ba dang*/ gta' mar 'dzud pa dang*/ gong 'debs pa dang*/ khyad par du 'jal len chen po byed pa rnams la/ gsung rab kyi gong btab na/ yul khams gsung rab kyi gong du btab pas/ yul de gsung rab kyi rin du song bas/ yul longs spyad pa gsung rab kyi rin du 'gyur ba dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po gzhan thams cad kyang de dang 'dra bar 'gyur la/ 'di'i rnam par smin pa yang*/ lha'i dbang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rin po che'i phung po blud nas 'bru re rais/ sems can dmyal bar bskal pa chen po rer sdod dgos gsung ste/

thub pa chen po'i gsung 'gyur ba med pas/ dngos po thams cad gsung rab kyi gong du mi gcad/ khal lnga brgya phrag mang po'i grangs sam/ mkhar bshig pa dang*/ thus rta dang*/ yul gru bcad 'dral byas nas ci ma rung bas/ khyed kyi 'di la nan tan bya ba shin tu yang gal che/ paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī'i zhal snga nas/ bdag la thugs mug bka' 'phrin du yang brdzangs pa las/ nyi ma nub phyogs kha che'i rgyab thag ring po nas/ gar log gi dmag byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten thams cad ni bshig rab tu byung ba thams cad ni bsad/ da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya gar yul du zla ba phyed dang brgyad tshun chad na mi gnas pa yin gsung*/ de tsam pa'i rnam par smin pa shin tu che ba/ las rngams po che de la shin tu yang ha las par byung ba las/ yang bsams pa/ ga re yul de na shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa mi mang*/ phung po chen po de tsam gyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spangs pa'i cha tsam yang mi phod pas de kun drag shos su 'dug chos la nor rtsis su bcug nas/ gong btab pa'i dus su chos kyis nam sla chod pa ga la yod/ chos min pa spyod rgyu ni gar rnyed/ za ba dang 'thung ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dkor dang*/ nor dang*/ yul dang*/ zhing gzhi ma thams cad 'di ltar gyur na/ kye hud ji ltar 'gyur ba bsams nas srog la bab kyang shin tu gzab par slob ma rnams kyis thugs la bzhag par zhu/ kye ma kye ma shin tu yid re mug /'khor ba sdug bsngal mun pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// u tum wa ra lta bur res 'ga' zhig /rgyal ba byung yang bstan pa mi gnas pa// thabs tshul mang pos 'jig par byed pa yi// dus 'dir bdag cag skyes par gyur pa la// shin tu yi mug bdag gi 'gro ba la// da lta nyid du shi na ci ma rung*// shi bar 'gyur kyang bde ba mi thob pas// rgyal ba rnams la gus pa'i blo gros kyis// rang gi srog dang bsdos nas 'bad par bya// 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa chen po ma mthong bas/

gzhan la phan pa'i re ba med kyang*/ rang gi bu slob rnams la thugs brtse ba'i yid kyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lcags ri bas zhus pa yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// // 255) ༄// bla ma'i thugs dgongs zab mo lta sgom rtogs pa ro gcig dbyer mi phyed pa// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig kun nas mun pa gtan bcom zhing*// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// ji snyed ji bzhin don rnams ston pa yi// bla ma mchog gi zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// bsags pa rab gyur tshogs chen bsags pa yi// slob ma bzang pos dad cing gus pa yis// gsol ba btab nas zhus pa'i yi ge 'di// mos gus can gyi don phyir 'bri bar bya// spyir bdag cag thams cad kyi 'dug lugs ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa yin/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la gting mtha' med pa yin/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las rang gzhan thams cad brgal bar 'dod pas/ dang por byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas lus yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ bla ma dam pa snying gi dbus su bsam/ de nas rang gi sems/ yod par mi bsgom rtag lta yin// med par mi bsgom chad lta yin// sems su mi bsgom sems tsam yin// dbu mar mi bsgom 'dzin pa yin// sgom pa po med sgom pa'ang med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// gtang yang mi btang dgug kyang mi dgug ste// bsam du med pa sgom du med pa nyid bsgom na// lta sgom rtogs pa ro gcig dbyer mi phyed// bka' bstsal legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// so ma ma bcos lhug pa nyid du zhog /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam thams cad du// rgyun chad med par nyams su blang bar bya// de la rtogs pa skye na rnam grol ba// bla ma'i byin rlabs yin pa rin chen bzhed// de yang rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// don 'dir yang yang bka' bstsal gsungs// ngas sngon ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di yi phyir// rgyal po khab kyi shar phyogs 'di nyid du// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// zla ba sgron ma rgya cher gsungs pa dang*// mi pham mgon po'i zhal snga nas// rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/

mngon par rtogs pa mos gus las skye ba lags pas/ mos gus la nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu/ rin po che yi thugs dgongs mchog /zab mo yi ger bris pa la// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang po reg gyur cig /rdzogs so// // 256) ༄// chos kyi gzhung shing gnad bzhi ma 'khyams par dgos pa rong po ras par gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa yis// chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes mdzad nas// tshogs chen bsags pa'i yon tan gyis// dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas su// nor bu rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs kyis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rgyas par mdzad// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// bdag dang khyed la gnyis su med// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// ji ltar nor bu chu dwangs sam// nyi ma mkha' la shar ba'i tshe// mun pa lhan cig mi gnas ltar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nyes tshogs sgrib pa gang yin pa// thams cad sel ba'i 'phrin las de// sems nyid rtogs la yod par gsungs// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*// rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus pa// 'di las 'byung zhes bla mas gsungs// bu 'jig rten chos brgyad rab bcad nas// ri khrod dgon par gnas bcas te// 'dod yon chang gis ma bzi bar// thub pas bcas pa'i tshul khrims dang*// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas byang chub sems// lus ngag dag pa yi dam lha// rang byung rang sems lhun gyis grub// bu chos kyi rgyal po 'di bzhi yi// gzhung shing gnad 'di ma 'khyam na// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// dpa' bo chos skyong mkha' 'gro dang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dgyes// rang dang rang gi sku 'khor rnams// so nam khe skyed gang che yi// bsam sbyor ngan par btang byas nas// tshogs gnyis chos kyi khe skyed la// nan tan chen pos 'bad par zhu// drung na gnas pa'i slob ma rnams// nyams rtogs bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung nas// spyod pa seng ge'i rgyal po ltar// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod rnams// seng ge phru gus 'gengs par zhu// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar gyis// 'dab gshog ma rdzogs bya sgong rnams// pha mas bskyang nas tshar ba ltar// lo bdun tshun chad skyong bar gda'// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// chos bzhi rkang du byed pa la// rtsa ba'i bla ma pa dam pa la// mos gus tshad du skyol bar gces// mos gus tshad du ma bskyal na// rtogs pa tshad du mi 'khyol gsungs// des na slob ma'i tshogs rnams la// mos gus bya thabs bstan par zhu// rje btsun rong po ras pas zhus pa rdzogs so//

257) ༄// bstan bcos rdo rje ri zhes bya ba rgo na ba dang shākya dbang phyug gnyis la gnang ba// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// lhun gyis grub cing 'gyur ba med pa'i yon tan gyis// bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms thub pa bla ma mchog nyid la// gus pas phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi'o// thub chen nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lhang nge bas// mi shes mun pa sel zhing snang ba sgrub// dpal ldan bla ma mthong bas mi shes sel// dam pa'i gsung 'di cung zad bu la gdams// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po rin po che phag mo gru pa de'i zhal snga nas/ spyir thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan gang yang rung ba rgyud la skyed par byed pa'am/ khyad par du mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyed par byed pa la dpon slob gyi rten 'brel 'dzom dgos gsung*/ de la slob dpon ji lta bu yin zhe na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dpag tu med par bla ma'i mtshan nyid 'di lta bu yin zhes pa'i gsung lung khungs dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa zhig gsung ba ni brjod kyis mi lang zhing*/ 'dir yang mi smos te/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ shes rab chen po'i sgo nas gzhan gyi lam sna khrid nus pa dang*/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sems can gyi khur 'khur ba dang*/ tshe 'di la skad cig tsam yang ltos pa med pa dang gsum yin gsungs pas/ 'di gsum la rang gi rgyud zhu btug byed pa gal che bar go rtogs pa bskyed pa'i bla ma ni gzhan ci yod kyang mi phan te/ rang nyid la phyag rgya chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa yod pa gal che bas/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs padmor 'dud// ces gsungs pas/
