slob ma'i rgyud la sems mngon par rtogs pa bskyed nus pa de la ni/ bla ma rin po che zhes zer ba yin gsungs/ gzhan rgyud la sgom de skyed par byed pa'i nus pa ni sgom ro gcig rtogs nas yong ba yin gsungs/ de ltar yang tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ bla ma byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'dres pa zhig btsal gsungs pa de yang*/ rang nyid byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'dres par gyur pa/ gzhan gang gi yang lus su ma gyur pa/ rang nyid la rang nyid yid ches pa/ bla ma'i gsung dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung dang mthun par gyur pa ni bla ma'o// de la slob ma ni/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang dpag tu med par gsungs shing gsungs mod kyi/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyud la skye ba la ni mos gus kho na yin gsungs/ mos gus kyi chags tshad ci yin snyam na/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pas/ bla ma'i dus kyi mtha' ni 'bul ba che ba dang*/ zhabs tog mang ba dang*/ bsten yun ring ba la zer ba min/ bla ma chos kyi skur mthong zhing nges shes skyes pa de las lhag pa gzhan du mthong ba'i dus med pas dus kyi mtha' de yin gsungs/ de la sku gnyis dang 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba dang*/ skyon mtha' dag 'dag par yang*/ khyod ni mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus gcod par byed// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ mos gus mthar thug 'di 'dra ba zhig rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar du rtogs pa de 'dra ba rgyud la mi skye bar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ de gnyis pa bla ma dam pas gsungs pas slob ma mos gus skyed par byed pa gal che/

mos gus skyed par byed pa de yang rim gyis pa dang cig car ba gnyis yin par go de yang cig car ba ni bdag rang lta bu thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan ni med/ bsam sa bla ma gcig pu las ni med/ de'i sgom zhig rgyud la ma skyes na gzhan gang gi yang bsam pa ni med/ chos kyi sku'i nges shes ni skyer ma btub/ skye ba ni 'dod pa des chos kyi sku yin no ba'i nges shes gting nas bskyed cing*/ bcos ma'i mos gus kyi bsgrub pa drag tu bsgrub cing tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med par bsags pas/ re zhig cig na de la nges shes cung zad skyes nas sgom cung zad skyes pa dang*/ 'bad pa dang rtsol bas chos sku'i nges pa thob nas rtogs pa'i brtan pa thob lugs zhig tu 'dug gnyis pa ni/ nad pa dang ni nad pa la// sman pas rdzas byin ji lta bar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// sems tsam du yang bstan pa yin// zhes pa dang*// rim gyis pa'i lung dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ slob ma khrid pa'i thabs mkhas pa khong du chud par bya'o// thabs de yang gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dang sdom pa dang*// rje btsun thugs rje chen po bsgom// pha rol phyin drug las byung ba'i// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po dang*// bgyis dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang*// rjes su yi rang la sogs pa// gang zag rigs dang sbyar bar las// yon bshad byas pas chos mthong dang*// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa dang*// rang gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba la// rang lus bsrungs pas ci zhig bya// gcer bu bya khyis za ba dang*// me yis bsregs par gyur pa la// gos dang zas kyis ci zhig bya// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /bla na med pa'i dam chos 'di// thams cad kun la bstan par mdzod// rang gi sha khrag btsir ba'i nor// gtan bde gtan skyid 'dod pa yis// rang la phul ba'i zas nor rnams// slong du 'ongs pa'i mi rnams la// rgyal sras mgon med zas sbyin dang*// dge bshes gnyos la bstan pa bzhin// dam pa khyed kyis bsgrub par mdzod// brgya la gal te re shig na// dad gus 'dun pa med pa yis// mthon po'i mthon po'i dam pa'i chos// rang la cis kyang zhu zer na// dang po skyabs 'gro thun mong ba/

khyod la bstan par bya zhes te// ko long byed dam mi byed pa// ngas 'dir chos sgor gzhug ces bya// de dang mthun par gyur pa na// bslab pa gang rung sor chud blang*// de nas sems bskyed rnam gsum sbyin// dbang skur byed du bcug nas kyang*// yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa la// rtags dang mtshan ma ma byung bar// nan tan chen po bskyed du gzhug /mos gus bya ba man ngag yin// de nas phyag rgya chen po gdab// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni// 'jig rten mgon po'i khrid las shes// de yang rin chen zhal snga nas// cig car ba yi sman chen 'di// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di// cig car ba yi dug tu 'gyur// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// do gal chen pos bu la gdams// mos gus can gyis gting nas go /rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa 'di// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po de// rim gyis skye lugs gsungs pa yin// cig car ba dang thod rgal ba// rnam pa gnyis kyang yod ces gsungs// de yi spyod pa rnam pa bzhi// spyod pa dus dang 'brel bar gsungs// a ho kye ma rnal 'byor rnams// mtshan cig gyer ba'i bon yod kyang*// gang la gang 'gro shes lags sam// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// rgyud dang 'grel ba man ngag rnams// rdo rje 'chang dang de sras kyis// gsungs shing mdzad pa 'di dag kun// gang gis gang dag bsgrub pa dang*// de yi dgongs pa shes par shog /rem rem 'on 'on shes par shog /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad dang*// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' yas rnams// gang zag gcig gi lam rim du// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas bstan// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*// 'di la nan tan chen po byas// nyams su myong ba bag tsam byung*// go 'am rtogs sam dgos se kun// 'ud po che dang nga rgyal can// sgyur zhing sgyur zhing bkrab pa kun// 'di ltar khrid pa'i thabs chen 'dis// 'gro ba rjes su gzung bar bya// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yis// skal ldan lam sna khrid pa yi// bya lugs cung zad bstan pa yin// thabs dang rim pa de rnams ni// bla ma'i mos gus rim pa las// rtogs pa'i rim pa skye zhes gsungs// de la rje rin po che la bdag gi mkhan po chen pos/

sgom chen pa'i bstan pa 'di ji tsam na nub ces zhus pa la/ bla ma sgom med pa zhig gis slob ma la sgom nam khrid pa'i dus su sgom gyi bstan pa nub pa yin gsung*/ bla ma la sgom yod kyang rje rin po che'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum dang ma ldan na slob ma thon par shin tu dka'/ dpon slob gyi rten 'brel cung zad 'dzoms pa ltar snang yang tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ rin po che'i rnam par thar pa ma bskyangs na tshe 'di pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yang nub par byed/ rang la blo gtad snying bzhag byas pa'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang*/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyis mnyes pa ma gtogs pa/ sgrub pa byas pas mnyes par yang dka'/ dmag dmu dang 'khrug pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin zer nas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi mar khrid kyi ded dpon byed pa yang rtsa na yod/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i rnam par thar pa tshul khrims rin po che/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi rang bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ngo bo/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen par 'gro ba'i lam stegs/ sa nas sar 'phar ba'i bogs 'don na/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung*/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung bas bu nor bu rin po che rnams kyis 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa gzung bar bya'o// tshogs chen bsags pas 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pa// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// mang po'i dbus su nyi zla ji bzhin du// mi shes mun sel skyes bu dam pas zhus// rgya mtsho'i dbus na lhun po ji bzhin du// rnam par mdzes kyang zhig par dka' ba yi// bstan bcos 'di ni rdo rje'i ri mchog ste// tshur rol mthong ba'i blo yis phigs par dka'// rdo rje ri zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chen po chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa/

shākya'i sras kyi dge slong sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs cung zad 'dzin pa'i bsod snyoms pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rgo na ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shākya dbang phyug gnyis kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 258) ༄// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu bsngo ba ma shes pa gcig pus lan gsungs pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'chi'o// spyir theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa rin po che pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ rdo rje'i theg pa gang yin yang rung ste/ nyams su blang ba'i chos rin po che de ni sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus te/ de yang sbyor dngos kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gang du ji ltar bsngos pa de kho na bzhin du 'grub pas/ bsngo ba shin tu gal che bar theg pa chen po'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du gsungs la/ de yang zab mo ston par byed pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar gsungs/ rgya chen po ston par byed pa'i sangs rgyas phal po che nas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar gsungs so// de ji ltar gsungs zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa dang nyi khri'i yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u'i rjes la/ ko'u shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bzung ba rnams ni thabs mkhas pas/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis thugs dang po bskyed pa nas/

dam pa'i chos gnas pa'i bar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa de dag dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngo bas na bdag gi zhu ba skyes so zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs pa las/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba de sangs rgyas phal po che nas rnyed pas/ de'i gong du dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rjes la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa dang*/ nyi khri na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ tshogs su yi ge bklags shing bshad pa ni byas/ snga ma thams cad du dar ba'i stobs kyis phyi ma yang gcig yang gcig 'bri bar 'tsher bar byung ba yin pa la/ chos la so nam du byed pa'i slob ma mang po zhig gis 'khor 'das thams cad bsngo ba byas nas gda' ba dang*/ dge 'dun spyir zhus nas bsdus pa yi ger btab pa'i bsngo ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces bgyis so// de bzhin nyid dbyer med rtogs shing*// zung 'jug rnal 'byor la gnas pas// 'khor 'das gnyis med gcig pa'i phyir// bsngo ba 'di dang mthun par 'jug /'jig rten mgon po bla ma yis// mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa bzhin// bdag dang bdag gis dus gsum dang*// rang gzhan byas dang yod pa dang*// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyi// dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i tshul// rang blo dman pa'i rim pa las// dus 'dir phyi ma brjod pa yin// rang blo dman pas mang gyur pa// rang blo dman pa'i nyes pa kun// 'khor 'das ma lus kun la bshags// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gyur pa// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// thams cad ma lus sems yin gsungs// bdag cag sems can thams cad kun// 'di ltar 'khor bar lus pa'i rgyu// bsngo ba ma shes gcig pus lan// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// rin chen gsung gi 'grel pa las// 'khor 'das rang sems dge ba kun// byang chub mchog tu bsngo ba dang*// 'brel ba'i gsung dang gtan tshigs la// nges pa'i shes pa cung zad thob// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// zab pa pha rol phyin pa dang*// rgya chen sangs rgyas phal chen las// rang sems shes rab pha rol phyin// dbyer med 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa// dbyer med tshul du bsngo ba 'di// chos kyi dbyings kyi bsngo ba ste// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// bla med sa la gnas phyir dang*// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon btsal phyir dang*// thub pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*// tshegs chung don chen 'grub phyir dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// lha dbang byas pa bzo phyir dang*// bu sdug dge ba'i rtsa bar ngas// smon lam btab par gyur pa 'di// skyes chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// dge 'dun tshogs kyis zhus pa'i ngor// ngag tu bton zhing tshig tu brjod// ji ltar la kha'i bya sgro bzhin// bdag gi dam bca' ma brtan pas// mang po byung ba ma lags te// zab cing rgya che gnad kyi don// bsngo ba 'di 'dra ma thos pas// ngan par smras na nyams dogs pas// ngag tu ma bton gsang na yang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs kyi gsung*// bcag par mi nus bris pa lags// ji ltar bsngo ba de ltar shog/

259) ༄// gnad kyi gdams pa lnga po nan tan chen pos 'bad dgos pa// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// yon tan rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gter// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'dzin// bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang*// khyad par mthu dang nus pa rnams// 'byung ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen rnams kun// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma yis// rgyud dang man ngag thams cad du// legs par bshad pa mnyan par gyis// mnyan nas nyams su blang bar bya// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i gnad dang bcas pa lngar// theg pa chen po thams cad 'dus// 'di la spyi dang bye brag gi /nyams su len lugs tha dad la// snga ma'i dus dang da ltar dang*// ma 'ongs dus su 'byung ba la// bsags pa che 'bring gsum du bshad// dngos grub de las go bar gyis// gnad kyi gdams ngag zab mo'i don// dgra dang 'thab pa ji bzhin du// bsod nams tshogs kyi rgyab rten dang*// rang nyid tshags su gzhug pa dang*// shi sa gnad kyi man ngag dang*// ma yengs 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang*// mi ldog gter du sba ba dang*// gnad kyi gdams ngag 'di lnga la// nan tan chen po ma byas na// thob le bas kyang the le snga// dngos grub thams cad nyams pa dang*// mthu dang nus pa zad pa dang*// nyes phung sna tshogs byung nas kyang*// ngan song gsum du 'gro ba la// dam tshig nyams zhes brjod pa yin// de lta bas na bla ma dang*// bla ma'i gsung dang mdzad pa la// the tshom yid gnyis mi bya zhing*// nan tan chen por nyams su blang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho'i yid bzhin gter// zad med zad pa med pa la// spyod par 'gyur bar the tshom med// snying gtam yin gyis thugs la zhog /zab mo gnad kyi man ngag 'di// rang gi bla ma dam pa la// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byas nas// bdag gi bu sdug sku mched kyis// gces pa'i snying por zhus pa lags// rdzogs so//

// 260) ༄// 'di gsum dbang gi rgyal po yin zhes grags 'byung dang glong thang la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen glong thang pa la zhu ba/ khyed de na yod pa'i bu nga'i bu slob rnams la nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pas slob ma'i rgyud smin par byed pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang mos gus kyis rang gzhan gyi khams gso ba dang*/ che dge dang yig tshangs tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi thog tu lus ngag yid gsum bor bas rgyal ba'i phrin las rlabs po che'i brtul zhugs la longs spyad pa med pa dang*/ man chung dang mdze 'ur ded dang man ngag su la yod kyi 'gran mo byed pa 'dra ba'i yi ge kha na yar la mang pas/ de 'dra ba'i lo rgyus bzlo brjod cag cog zer ba rnams la/ khyed thugs la btags nas 'dug ngo mtshar che/ bla ma ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin na khyi sngags 'gugs sngags/ gtad ser ba/ mkhar sel/ zhing sel/ dug sbyor gyi rigs pa du ma gnang zhes khyad gsod du smos la/ nga la ni/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ tshul khrims rin po che dang 'di gsum las ye med gsungs la/ gsum pos dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu smin par mdzad par zhu/ 'di gsum dbang gi rgyal po yin// gzhan rnams khyi lud ril ril yin// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po 'dis// bu dang tsha bo yang tsha dang*// rang gi gdung rgyud mtha' dag dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus kun// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// mi zad gter dang phrad pa yin/ khyi lud ser ba'i phru gu la// snying por ma lta rigs kyi bu// btsog cing snying po med pa yin// mi chen rgan por song bzhin du// bu chung spyod pa ga la mdzad// snying gtam yin gyis thugs la zhog /dam pa'i chos 'di grags 'byung dang*// bshes gnyen khyed kyi thugs la zhog /rdzogs so//

// 261) ༄// dpal phag mo gru pa'i gdams ngag mtha' dag chos gsum po 'dir rdzogs pa// chos gsum po 'di dang ldan pa'i bu slob sum brgya glo snying 'gel du btub pa/ gdams ngag dang yi ge'i spros pa chad pa nam thon pa'i dus su/ nga la bla ma rin po ches gtad pa'i rten ngo mtshar can zhig dang*/ ji ltar gsung ba'i rang gi chos gos snam sbyar dang*/ snying srog gi thig le zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag zab mo zhig dang gsum gtang rag tu bskur ba lags pas/ de bar du khyed rang nan tan chen pos chos gsum po de la rgyud sbyong zhing bsgom pa ni rgyu/ gzhan de la 'god pa ni rkyen/ gzhan de dang ldan pa ni rgyu/ rang nyid de gsum la nan tan chen pos bsgrub pa ni sems/ sems kyis lus byin gyis rlob pa ni gsang sngags/ lus sems kyis snang ba byin gyis rlob pa ni byin rlabs/ nyams su blangs pas myong ba mang po 'char ba ni gdams ngag de khrid pa ni slob dpon/ yon tan rgyud la bskyed pas ni bla ma lags pas/ bla mas gzhan gdams ngag med pa nyams myong dang rtogs pa can gyi rnal 'byor rnams dpang por nges so// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gdams ngag mtha' dag kyang chos gsum po 'dir ma rdzogs pa med par nga rang la nges shes dang myong ba yod pa lags so// da res kyi yig rten gdung rten chung ngu 'di/ nga'i thugs dam thams cad kyi yang snying*/ rgyud pa gong ma'i rten ngo mtshar can mang po bzhugs pa/ byin rlabs che ba zhig lags pas rtag tu mi 'bral bar zhu/ phyag phreng zhig dang*/ dbu zhu zhig dang sna gsum bskur nas mchis so// // 262) ༄// bla ma'i zhal gdams snying po chos bdun po 'di las med par thag chod pa// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// skyob pa mnyam med rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi pad mor gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs kyi sras// gong ma'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa yi// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yis// thos dang bsam pas rnam dben cing*// bla ma'i gsung rdog gcig pu la// sdug sgur byas pa'i ku sā li// bdag 'dra rmongs pa tha chad la// thams cad mkhyen par dgongs mdzad nas// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dang*// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// thugs la dran tshad dgongs tshad rnams// zhu ba rgya mtsho zhus pa la// thub pa'i dgongs pa zab mo rnams// thub pa nyid kyis dgongs pa las// sa bcu man chad spyod yul min// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yang*// mtha' drug rdo rje gsung dag gis// rgyas btab pa 'di rtogs par dka'// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma la// dad gus prag prig yod na yang*// skyes phyis bu yi pha shi sngas// zab pa gnad kyi rdo rje'i gsung*// lung dang rigs pa man ngag dang*// gting nas nges shes skyes pa yi// byang chub sems dang bsngo ba yi// rdo rje'i gsung 'di ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyi go ba ma mchis pa// skyes chen khyed la cha yod mod// chos lnga bla ma dam pa yi// rdo rje'i gsung 'di ma gtogs pa// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// dus gsum 'phags pa thams cad dang*// dus gsum rdo rje slob dpon la// 'di las med pa'i nges shes skyes// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa ma lus kyang*// rtsa ba 'di las gzhan med par// bdag gi bla ma dam pas gsungs// de la go rtogs skye re pas// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du// shi shi rgas rgas bshad pa byas// phan du re nas bshad pa 'di// sbrul la 'o ma blud pa bzhin// dug 'phel 'gyur ba kho nar zad// phyogs sngar bzhag pa'i gdams chung rnams// deng sang bla med snying po ltar// bcu chos gsum chos zab dgu rnams// rgan sbrang ma yi bal skur gang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam la// nyams len snying por byed pa med// mos gus can gyi slob ma yi// rgyud la nyams rtogs mi skyed par// gdams chung gang mang zer mchu la// 'bri gung rje btsun bu slob rnams// thugs la btags dang ma btags kyi// nyon mongs sdig sog rgya mtsho lud// bu gcig tshe thung nad mang la// rdzun po che yi kha g.yos la// snying po'i don du ma 'khrul bar// rang la gnang ba'i dam chos dang*// rgyud la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs la// nan tan chen por mdzad par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/tshul khrims snying po gces par srungs// gzhan gyi tshig rjes ma dpyod par// rang gi nyams rtogs snying por mdzod/ khyed kyis zhus tshig rgya mtsho 'di// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// gzhung lugs mnyan nas lan gdab bam// yang na rdzun gyi 'khor lo yis// bu gcig bslu bar bya 'am ci// khyed kyi sa phyogs de na yang*// rgyu med 'bras bu 'dod pa yi// gzhi med mkha' lding zhu ba'i tshogs// nam mkha'i sprin phung bzhin du snang*// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang chos brgyad kyi// dbang skur bdag la re ba ni// srid lta mi srid 'di ci lags// lus can kun gyis dman pa'i gnas// ra la ka btags zhabs skyed la// ba bzhag pa yi rtsa gnas la// bla med rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud// phag gdong ma zhes rab bshad pa// 'di na lha de bzhugs sam ci// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa 'dir// bshang lam btsog pa'i khung bu zhes// bshad par gyur pa 'di ci yin// de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /ston pa nyid kyis gang gsungs pa// kha cig dgongs te gsungs pa yin// dgongs min gsungs pa 'ga' yang yod// kha cig drang ba'i don du gsungs// nges pa'i don yang 'ga' zhig yod// kha cig ji bzhin sgra yin te/ kha cig ji bzhin sgra ma yin// 'di tsho bdag gis bshad pa yi// gnyer kha med pa thugs kyis mkhyen// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yis// nye ring dgra gnyen phyogs med pa// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i a ma rnams// byang chub mchog la dgongs mdzad pa'i// brtul zhugs brtan po'i rnal 'byor la// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams// dbang du mi 'du mi srid pas// pha gi zer ba'i rdzun mchu bas// rang gi sems kyi 'gro ldog gzigs// dus gsum rgyal ba gcig pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i yi dam lha// gsal zhing brtan par ma gyur pa// a 'od khu bo smra bcad pas// phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad// byed lta byed de cang mchi 'am// ji ltar chab kyi bum pa la// bskal pa grangs med mang por yang*// 'bad pa drag pos bsrubs gyur kyang*// mar gyi snying por thon gyur ltar// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// bral bar gyur pa'i yi dam lha// gsal zhing brtan pa ma byung bas// gsang sngags phrin las grub gyur na// bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag bslus// legs par dgongs dang rnal 'byor pa// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun dang mang por yang*// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa rnams// nges par skyabs su song ba dang*// tshul khrims rin chen brtan pa dang*// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma'i mos gus phyag rgya che// zad med bsngo bas bsdus pa las// spyi dang bye brag khyad par rnams// gong nas gong du 'gyur ba las// gzhan du 'gyur ba mi srid ces// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bla ma yis// rdo rje'i gsung gi rgya mdud kyis// legs par bsdams shing bka' rgyas btab// gtsigs dang bro thon

mna' phul ba 'dis// gnad bdun rdo rje dam tshig las// 'das par gyur pa'i gsang sngags ni// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mi srid srid par mi 'gyur ba// legs par dgongs dang rnal 'byor pa// ngas chung phud bu lo dgu tshun chad nas// sum cu rtsa lnga phan chad du// snying nas sgrub pa drag por byas// sum cu rtsa lnga tshun chad nas// drug cu rtsa drug phan chad du// slob ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bzang ngan 'bring gsum dpag med dang*// khyad par thos bsam sgom gsum gyis// deng sang dus su sbyangs pa yi// skyes bu mchog gi slob ma rnams// dang por dam bcas brtan pa yi// tshig gcig de las ma 'gyur bar// thams cad kha mthun smra ba lags// yang cig yang cig gdams ngag med// dkar po phyogs kyi sa bon la// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa 'di// bka' drin mi chung shin tu che// kho bo ngo so mthon par yod// snam sbyar chos gos zhig bskur na// shag por 'gyur zhing dgyes srid kyang*// mtho dman 'bring gsum dge 'dun tshogs// mang po mang po yod pa la// bskur gyis ma lang ma bskur ba// dge ba'i bshes kyis bzod par mdzod// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon po yi// sgrub thabs las sbyor dpag med rnams// sngon gyi dus su lung du byas// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma la// lung thob pas na lung du byas// nga la 'di na bskur rgyu med// bka' bkyon zhe bkyon mi mdzad zhu// mdor na 'di dag thams cad kyi// don go ma lus thams cad kun// dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims dang*// chos lnga bstan pa 'di dang bdun// bdag la bla mas gdams pa lags// 'di las med par go ma lags// nyams rtogs skyes sam ma skyes las// 'di las med par thugs thag chod// 'di bris dge bas mtshon nas kyang*// 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa// bla med byang chub thob par shog/

// 263) ༄// yongs kyi dge bshes chen po mkhan po dmyal gyi 'dul ba'i zhus lan// mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// so sor thar pa rgyal ba'i bka' yang dag pa 'di la/ 'dul ba la bstod pa'i sbyor ba'i chos dang*/ ltung ba sde lnga rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong dngos gzhi dang*/ bton pa'am bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu thub dbang go 'phang thob par bsngo ba rjes dang rnam pa gsum du gnas pa las/ sde lnga spyi las bslab pa 'cha' bar snyad ka gleng gzhi rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ dgag bya nyes dmigs ltung ba'i ngo ti yan lag rtsi ba rnam pa bzhis 'chad pa las/ gleng gzhi rnam par bzhag pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gnas 'di na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rten gyi gang zag 'di la dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad nas/ 'di la nyes pa byung ba las/ khyod kyis tshul ma yin pa 'di 'dra ba byas pa bden nam zhes rmed pa dris pa dang*/ byas so zhes zhus pa dang*/ mi bya bar bcas pa dang*/ de rgya cher rnam par bshad pa dang*/ rnam pa lngas rnam par gtan la phab pa ni gleng gzhi rnam par bzhag pa'o// dgag bya nyes dmigs rnam pa gnyis gcig tu brjod pa las/ dgag bya nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum ltung ba sde lngar bzhag pa las/ pham pa la mtshon na 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug rnam pa gsum ste/ nang sems can la chags pa mthar thug pa mi tshangs par spyod pa/ phyi yul la chags pa rlabs po che rku ba/ zhe sdang mthar thug pa mi gsod pa/ gti mug mthar thug pa mi chos bla mar gyur pa'i rdzun te/ ltung ba sde lnga mtha' dag la de ltar shes par bya ba ni/ dgag bya nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las dang bcas pa dgag pa'o// nyon mongs pa de'i las mthar thug pa byas pas ni/ las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*/ ngan song gsum du ltung ba dang*/ gzhan dag ma dad par 'gyur ba'o// zhes 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdus nas gsungs pa la/

gshis sam babs kyi dbang du byas nas/ rgyu nyon mongs pa dang las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni/ thub pa chen pos bden pa rnam pa bzhi gsungs pa las/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig yin pas bkag pa ye bkag pa yin no zhes rnal 'byor pa dag zer ro// ltung ba'i ngo ti ni sde lnga tha dad pa las/ nyon mongs pa che 'bring rnam pa gsum 'di dang 'di'o zhes pham pa nas nyes byas kyi bar dag yin no// de rdzogs par byed pa la yan lag rnam pa bzhi rdzogs par sde snod gsum legs par 'dzin pa mkhas pa thams cad kyis bzhed pa yin te/ de yang gzhi'i yan lag ltung bar bya ba'i gzhi gang yin pa de dang*/ ltung bar byed pa bsam pa 'du shes dang*/ kun slong ngam/ kun slong dang 'du shes su yang rung ste/ gcig tu byas pas bsam pa'i yan lag nyon mongs pa dang*/ bsam pa des kun nas bslang ba'i tshogs sdud pa dang*/ mthar thug gi yan lag byas pa mthar thug pas snying tshim pa'o// 'di yang nyon mongs pa mthar thug pa spyad pa rdzogs pa zhig la shin tu gces pa'i phyir/ shing rta'i yan lag ltar lus 'grub par byed pa yan lag rtsis pa yin te/ ltung ba de las ltung med du 'gyur ba ni mi srid pa kho na'o// de ltar rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa bzlog pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i phyir na/ nyon mongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las che 'bring rnam pa gsum po gang yin yang las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'byung ba bslu ba med pa'i tshul/ dgra bcom pa nag po bya rog zhar ma 'dra zhes smras pas/ bu mo khrid de bcom ldan 'das la 'dis ni zhe sdang gis ni smras pa med/ skye ba lnga brgyar bya rog zhar mar skye zhes mi gsung bar zhu zhes bzod par gsol ba las/ sring mo zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs na lta dmyal bar skye ste/ skye ba lnga brgyar dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye bar dbu bsnyung bzhes pa lta bu ste/

thams cad mkhyen pas babs mkhyen pas na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung por 'byung ba ni/ dge slong rnams sam/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams sam/ sems can thams cad la bkag pa ye bkag shin tu bkag rnam par bkag pa ni ye bkag pa'o// de la bsgrub par bya ba rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa 'gog par byed pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir chos bstan pa la sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba lam 'phags pa'i bden pa las/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa gnyis te/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa 'gags tsam nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi 'gog pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa shin tu phra ba 'gags pa/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig dang rnam pa gnyis te/ 'dir shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral ba'i bral 'bras/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad yin par ni/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg par bzhed pa 'dul ba lung nas kyang*/ stobs bcu ting 'dzin ye shes mche ba can// ston pa glang po de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so// gang zhig spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs pas// dus gsum 'khor 'das shes bya ma lus kun// skad cig nyid la mngon sum mkhyen gyur pa'i// kun mkhyen rgyal po rin po che la 'dud// legs par gsungs pa'i chos la bslab pa'i gzhi// khyad par 'phags shing thun mong ma yin pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba gsungs pa las// the tshom cung zad skyes pa bsal bar zhu// de la rje rin po che yi zhal snga nas/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba'i brjod bya bden pa bzhir nges zhes gsungs pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar la bshad par yang rngo thog mod kyi/ 'on kyang dkyus kyi sa bcad pa ni cung zad dka' bar byung zhes zhus pa dang*/

bden pa bzhir bshad pa'i rngo thog pa shin tu thugs la btags/ dkyus kyi sa bcad pa ni rgyu nyon mongs pa gsum las las 'byung bas/ des sdug bsngal bskyed pa mtha' dag spang bar gsungs pa ltung ba sde lnga dang*/ dgag pa'i bslab pa mtha' dag rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa yin pa dang*/ las de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa thog ma dang*/ bar/ mtha' mar mi dge ba'i sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'dod cing chags pa spangs pas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab skye ba lam gyi bden pa dang*/ lam de nyams su blangs pa las 'gog pa byang chub gsum thob par bstan pa ni/ sa bcad pa shin tu yang sla ba lags gsungs/ yang bslab pa ni dgag pa sgrub pa gnyis su nges zhes gsungs pa yang legs pa la/ ci dgar 'jug pa gnang ba'i bslab pa yang yod srid dam snyam par byung na zhes zhus pa las/ 'di yang nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor la brlam zhing longs spyod pa dang*/ spyod par 'gyur ba bkag pa ni rgan zhugs rang rtags 'dzin pa lta bu ma gnang ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang bral ba'i bslab pa'am bya ba ni thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i snying po yin pas/ shin tu yang yod de/ sems can chen po bzhi dang*/ rang sangs rgyas lta bur dgongs 'tshal gsungs/ dge ba gshis kyis dge la/ mi dge ba gshis kyis mi dge zhing rang bzhin gang na yod pa na bcas pa yod la/ bcas pa gang na yod pa na rang bzhin yod ces gsungs pa yang shin tu legs par gsungs pa lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang zhib tu dpyad na lung gtam gyi gzhi las/ lung ma bstan pa ni kun nas bslang ba dang*/ ngo bo lung du ma bstan pa dang*/ rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ba'i nongs pa yod par gsungs pa ji ltar lags zhes zhus pa dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa ni dge bar lung du ma bstan pa ste/ nyams pa med pa'i dge ba bsgrub bya yin pa'i phyir/

ston pas gsungs pa ngo mtshar te rmad du byung ba'o gsungs/ yang rang gzhan gyi tshul khrims dang*/ srog dang yon tan rin po che'i bar du bar chad kyi rkyen la sogs pa gnang bar gsungs pa yang ji ltar 'gyur snyam na zhes zhus pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi tshul khrims dang*/ yon tan rin po che skye ba'i bar chad kyi rkyen ni/ nyon mongs pa dang las yin pas de dang 'bral ba la ni gnang ba nyid yin pa'o// srog gi bar chad ni dpyad 'tshal ba nyid de/ chu tshags kyi gleng gzhi dang*/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla yi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin par gsungs pas so gsungs/ 'gro ba thams cad la bcas pas khyab na/ dud 'gro phal che ba la dge ba'i sems ni mi srid pa'i tshul gyis/ shin tu yang skye dka' la/ bcas pa'i sdig pa ji bzhin du 'byung na ngan song las thar bar ji ltar 'gyur snyam na zhes zhus pa dang*/ de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas pas/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te ngan song gsum du ltung bar gsungs na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos dgongs 'tshal gsungs/ yang lung las smyon pa dang*/ las dang po pa la ltung ba med de zhes gsungs pas/ khyim pa'am/ 'gro ba gzhan la bcas pa ma mdzad dam snyam pa dang*/ de dag la ldog 'jug byed pa'i dgos pa yang ma mchis sam snyam pa'i the tshom cung zad skyes na zhes zhus pa dang*/ smyon pa la sogs pa gsum ni bsam pa la smyos par byas la nyon mongs pa spyad do snyam pa'i bsam pa med pa dang*/ bsam pa de'i rjes su 'brangs ba'i las mthar ma thug pas gsor rung ba tsam du dgongs pa dang*/ 'di 'dra ba dge 'dun gyis ma bskyangs na gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba la sogs pa dang*/ dge 'dun rang la yang nongs par 'gyur ba'i bsam pa byung na/ nyes pa shin tu che bar 'byung ba'i ched du gsungs te/ mdor na lhung zin pa dang 'dra dge 'dun gyis 'byin pa tsam la dgongs pa'o// las dang po pa la ltung ba med do zhes gsungs pa ni/

ltung ba zhes bya ba ni ngan song gsum du ltung ba'i don gyis na ltung ba med pa lags sam/ nyon mongs pas g.yen spyos pa'i bya ba dang byed pa nyung ba lags sam/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi las bgo skal la dbang ba lags sam/ byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi lam gyi bar chad du mi 'gyur ba lags sam/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad ma dad cing smon par mi 'gyur bas bcas pa mdzad kyi bar du 'di rnams mi 'byung ba lags sam/ 'on te 'byung ba lags sam zhes ston pa nyid la 'dri bar bya ba kho na te/ 'di la ni dgongs pa blang rgyu mi 'dug pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu gsungs pa thams cad dge slong la sogs pa dgag sgrub kyi bslab par bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i dgos pa bsam rigs so/ khyim pa'am 'gro ba gzhan la bcas par mi 'gyur na ni/ yongs su grags pa ltar khyim pa'am 'gro ba gzhan la nyes pa med pa de/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras su khas blangs pa rnams la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod pa chen pos rjes su 'brang ba la khyad par du gnod pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ ston par mi 'os pa'i phyir dang*/ nga'i zhal la ma nyan na khyed la nga gnod pa sgrub pa yin te/ zhes pas zhe 'dod chen po mnga' ba'i phyir dang*/ phywa dang dbang phyug byed pa po yin te zhes pas lta ba las ma 'das pa'i phyir dang*/ shes bya'i babs bden pa rnam bzhir mi gnas/ chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung ma yin par 'gyur ba'i skyon dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ spyod pa spyad pa sangs rgyas pa don med du 'gyur ba dang*/ ston pas gsungs pa'i bslab pa gsum la ma bslabs par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan nyon mongs pa'i las las 'byung ba'i phyir te/ skas kyi them pa ltar bslab pa 'cha' ba ni gnyen po dang sbyor ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos te/

bsgrub par ma nus pa la ming gi ltung med du btags pa yin gyi/ ltung ba gtan med pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stobs bcu dang ldan pa kho na'o// de la rje rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa dngos lags pas/ the tshom gcod pa'i chos zab mo zhig tshogs su gnang bar zhu zhes zhus pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su blta zhing brjod par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes na dus mtha' bsten pas brjod min lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar gsungs pa dang*/ rgol ba shin tu gnad pa tshig 'jam po dang zhe sa dang bcas pas zhu ba skyes bu dam pa ya rabs gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa yin pas spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pas bstod pa'i bstod pa ni legs shing shin tu thugs la btags mod kyi/ bdag la thos pa dang bsam pa'i yon tan rlabs po che yod pa ma lags kyang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod 'di thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su 'gro ba'i gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bur gsungs te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ lung rnam par 'byed pa nas kyang*/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang bral bas sems dang shes rab rnam par grol bar gsungs pa dang*/ sngags dang mtshan nyid rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad du/ gdod mtha' bar gsum thams cad du/ tshul khrims kyis lam bgrod par gsungs pa dang*/ bdag gi bla ma dam pas de ltar bzhed pa lags pa la/ dus deng sang rab tu byung ba kha cig tshangs par spyod pa ni legs par spyod/ tshul khrims rin po che la ni gces spras su mdzad/

srog la bab kyang sdom pa ni mi gtong ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pas/ rang nyid nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i yon tan man chad thob par 'gyur ba la/ rang nyid the tshom dang som nyir gyur cing*/ nyon mongs pa'i dra bar chud pas/ sngags dang theg pa chen po la snyad btags nas/ sha dang chang bud med dang*/ nyes pa thams cad la spyod par 'gyur ba rang nyid kyi rigs las byung na ston pa'i bstan pa bshig cing*/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'phrang bshig nas ngan song rnam pa gsum du 'gro ba/ rang gi slob ma rnams la snying gis ma bzod pa dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rin po che bdag gis zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa de nyid rgyur byas nas/ bla ma dam pa la rnam par 'khus shing rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro ba shes pas ma bzod nas/ rin po che'i gsung sgros cung zad tshogs dang dpag thams cad du snyan du gsol ba lags pas/ rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// skyabs mchog dam pa a ti sha// tshad mar gyur pa'i gong ma rnams// tshul khrims 'di la gces par gsungs// 'di las theg gsum yon tan rnams// ma lus mtha' dag 'byung 'gyur zhing*// med na mi 'byung rgyu 'bras su// rang la nges shes nyams myong yod// rang bas gces pa'i slob ma la// smra bar gyur pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan la phan pa'i re ba med// thams cad mkhyen zhes zhus pa yi// zhus tshig gtan la phab pa'o// gsol ba 'di btab dge ba gang yod des// 'gro ba kun gyi bslab gzhi rnam dag cing*// ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab yongs rdzogs nas// thub dbang go 'phang myur du thob par shog /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sdom brtson rnams kyis kyang*// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i ldog 'jug legs rtogs te// ji bzhin bslabs pas yon tan rab rdzogs nas// tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba'i skur gyur cig
/yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mkhan po dmyal ba pa'i zhus lan rdzogs so// //

264) ༄// rnam rtog gzhom par byed pa rlung 'dul gyi gdams pa u dum ba ra'i ge sar// oṃ swasti/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs padmor 'dud// 'khor ba mtha' med rnam rtog las// skyob par mdzad pa'i skyabs gcig pu// rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin sku// bla ma'i zhabs pad la btud nas// rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa yi// sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba nyid// skyes bu dam pas zhus pa 'di// gces pa'i snying po yi ger bri// 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po nas/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// zhes gsungs pas/ rnam par rtog pa ma rig pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba klong 'khyil ba 'di nyid yin la/ de la phyi rol gyi bgegs dang bdud dang bar du gcod pa thams cad kyang de nyid las med par/ rje btsun chen po mi la'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ rnam rtog bdud du ma langs na// bdud cho 'phrul rnal 'byor gyi rgyan du che// zhes gsungs pas/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i phyi rol gyi bgegs kyang rnam par rtog pa gcig pu yin gyi gzhan med par gsungs/ 'o na rnam par rtog pa de skyed par byed pa gang gis bskyed ce na/ rlung 'ba' zhig gis skyed par byed pa yin te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste// zhes bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang rdo rje phreng ba las// bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rlung rnams phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni// shes dang yang dag 'dres gyur nas// dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni// yul rnams la ni dmigs par byed// ces gsungs pas/

rlung 'dul bar byed pa gal che/ de ltar yang rlung sems dbyer med kyi lung dang*/ rta dang bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ rigs mi gcig pa'i bka' bstsal dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang*/ don gcig las med pas las kun byed ces pa ni bzang po dang ngan pa'i las phyogs ris med pa yin la/ ngan pa ni 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam pa gsum skyed par byed pa'i las rlung gis byas nas/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyi dbang gis gnas skabs su nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ shi nas ngan song rnam pa gsum du skye/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal las mi thar ba nyon mongs gsum gyi lag rjes yin te/ de ltar yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes gsungs pa nges te/ de'i phyir na nyon mongs pa spangs pas/ nyon mongs skyed byed kyi rlung spangs/ rlung spangs pas nyon mongs pa gsum mi skye ba la/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa zer/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su rlung las su rung ba zhes zer dgos pa de med na phung ba'i gzhi yin par theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig tu/ bka' nan chen po gsungs tshul legs par khong du chud par bya'o// yang nyon mongs pa gsum spangs pa'i lag rjes la/ nyon mongs pa med pa rnam pa gsum skye ste/ yang rlung des lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ma chags pa zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa rnam pa gsum bskyed nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi gnas skabs su nad dang gnod pa/ bgegs dang log 'dren/ bar chad dang nyes pa thams cad spangs nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa'i chags pa spangs pa dang*/ shes rab rnam pa gsum ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes nas/ de la sems gnas pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa zhes kyang zer/ nyon mongs pa spangs ba las byung bas lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes kyang zer/

nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i lag rjes las byung ba yin pas dam bcas pa'i shes pa la sdom pa rten can zhes kyang zer/ mdor bsdus na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nyes pa thams cad 'jig pa/ yon tan thams cad skyed par byed pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i gru/ 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs 'di gcig pu las med pas/ 'di la sems rtse gcig tu gnas par bya ba ni lhag pa ting nge 'dzin nam sems kyi bslab pa'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas lhag pa tshul khrims de yang rang gi sems/ ting nge 'dzin de yang rang gi sems/ spang bya dang gnyen po thams cad kyang rang gi sems 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa mi srid par blo thag chod nas/ sems de ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'ga' yang mthong ba med pa ni de kho na nyid mthong ba'o zhes pa dang*/ shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs pa/ zhes pas lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa rtogs pa 'di kho nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad skyed cing skyon thams cad 'jig pa ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes gsungs par nges pa lags so// de yang mdor bsdu na/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas nyon mongs med pa'i sems skye/ nyon mongs med pa'i sems las rnam par dag pa'i shes rab skye ba babs yin mod/ de kun rnam bzhag yin/ zhus pa'i gdams ngag mi 'ong bar/ ma zhus pa'i sde snod gsum dang bslab pa bzhi nga la dgos pa med snyam na/ nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa thol gyis skye ba de nyid la bdag tu mi gzung*/ yan par mi gtong*/ sku yus mi skyed btsir gyis gzung la ma yengs par bzhag pas rtog pa rtog med/

rlung rang dag nyon mongs pa nus med du 'ong bar 'dug pas/ rtog pa de yun ring du bskyangs pa las rtog pa zhi ba'i zhi gnas zer bar 'dug pa/ nye bar zhi ba lhun grub tu gshis yin par go na bdag 'dzin gyi rtog pa bden pa med par go bas yid mi rtog rtog med lhun grub rang chas su song bas 'gro 'ong dang rgyun chad med pa la mkhas pa rnams kyis brten gnas yin zhes zer ba yang yod de/ ste ste su mi rgyugs dgur rgyugs/ rtog pa mi tshol dgu tshol/ bdag 'dzin mi 'dzin dgu 'dzin/ dgu gnyis bco brgyad kyi thog tu yang dgu bsnan pa'i mi la bstan pas ci phan/ gleng bas ci bya/ smras pas kha tshags che ba tsam du zad ces/ dpal 'bri gung pa'i nye gnas rnams la bla ma dam pa'i thun mong min pa'i gdams ngag shi ba skad du bstan pa'i dam chos/ e re 'dod chen mo bya ba lags te/ khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rang gi mtshan nyid la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i shes rab ni mnga'/ bla ma grub pa thob pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs rin po ches ni zin/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa klong yangs pa rgya mtsho chen pos ni thugs la gtams/ dpal chen po 'bri gung pa'i nye gnas ni ma lags pas/ ji ltar zhus pa 'di ltar nyams su blang bar zhu/ ji ltar zhus pa 'di bzhin du// gal te nyams su ma blangs na// sman dpyad bklags pa tsam gyis ni// nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram// zab pa'i gdams ngag rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'di// dpal ldan rin chen zhal snga nas// thugs kyi snying po bcud phyung ba// legs par gdams pa 'di lags pas// gal te phan par ma gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bdag cag thams cad bslus par nges// bslu ba med pa rgyal ba'i bka'// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs la zhog /nan tan chen pos nyams su blangs// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 165) ༄// chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad 'khor lo'i bdag po chos kyi rje// lhun gyis grub cing 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu yin gsung*/ dkyil de nyid ji lta bu yin snyam na/ zhal snga nas/ shes rab sna tshogs las/ phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin zhing*// sems kyi nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa// zhes pa dang*/ dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las kyang*/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa// zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po mi la'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems nyid 'di la dpe ma btub// nam mkha' 'di la dpe byas rung*// nam mkha' rig med stong pa yin// sems nyid rig bcas stong pa yin// stong pa tsam du 'dra lags kyang*// 'dra dang mi 'dra khyad par che// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// zhes pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa las kyang*/ nam mkha' ni kha dog dang dbyibs dang*/ yod pa dang med pa dang*/ ldan pa dang mi ldan pa gang yang ma yin par gsungs te/ mdor na sems kyi gnas lugs smra bsam brjod med/ bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad dang bral bar blo'i yul las 'das pa dang po nas lhun gyis grub cing 'gyur ba med pa de la bzhed par gda' la/ tshul 'di ltar gyur na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni yod mi srid de/ de ltar yang chos thams cad ni gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams mgon po khyed kyis bstan// zhes pas/ de kho na bzhin du thugs su chud par mdzad par zhu/ ji ltar sems kyi gnas lugs 'di// ma go rtogs par ma gyur pas// grub mtha' lta ba'i bye brag tshogs// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam rtog gis// rang sems rnam dag nam mkha' 'di// log rtog sprin gyis bkab na ko /rnam dag gsal bar mi 'gyur bas// sems kyi ngo bo rnam dag 'di// log rtog sprin gyis mi dgab par// lhun grub rang sa zin du chug /'di bris dge ba gang yin des// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs par shog/ // 266) ༄// bla ma'i gdams ngag zhus lan 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud// skyabs gcig drin can bla ma rin chen de// mi 'bral gtsug gi nor bur bkur gyur tam// bla med dkon mchog 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i// skyabs las gzhan pa'i skyob pa mi tshol lam// tshul khrims rnam dag dri med bdud rtsi'i chu// khyad du bsad nas nyon mongs mi g.yem mam// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rgyas pa la// dman mos chos brgyad sta res mi gcod dam// bdag med nam mkha'i ngang la mi 'phyo bar// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'ching bas mi 'ching ngam// tshig dang yi ge grub mtha'i rgya rnyog la// mi shes rmongs pa'i ri dwags mi 'dzin tam// mi zad gter mdzod gnyug ma'i pha phogs de// nyams gsum rgya mtsho'i klong du mi 'phen nam// bsam gyis mi khyab gong ma'i rnam thar la// go ba rnyed dam nges shes skyes lags sam// bla ma'i gdams ngag 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud// blo yi padmor rgyas pa 'thung lags sam// skyabs bral ma rgan sems can thams cad la// snying rje chen pos sdug bsngal khur bzod dam// dris pa'i don de khyod la mnga' lags na// 'gro ba'i don du ci phyir mi 'gyur mod//

// 267) ༄// 'gro ba smin byed khyed la re che zhes bla ma byang chub shes rab la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// brtse ba'i bdag nyid chen po yi// brtse bas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag gi bu gcig dge ba'i bshes// bla ma byang chub shes rab kyis// ji ltar gsungs pa'i 'bul ba rnams// lhag chad med par phyag tu thon// che'o ring ngo 'bul ba rnams// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag tu med// 'on kyang zang zing zhabs tog 'di// bsdu dngos bzhi yi dang po yin// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mtshon pa yin// 'gro ba 'dren par byed pa'i bu// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob yin// 'gro ba kun gyi re gnas yin// gong ma'i dbang skur thob pa yin// mtho dman gzhi byes thams cad du// 'gro ba smin par byed pa la// khyed la shin tu re ba che// snyigs ma lnga yi dus la bab// rtsod pa bdo ba'i dus tshod 'dir// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs dka'// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin dang*// bla ma gong ma'i dam chos gsung*// nyams su len pa'i slob ma la// sdang ba'i dgra rnams gnyen du 'gyur// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyis mchod// sha dang chang gi re ltos bcad// rtsa ba lo ma gyi na tsam// sge'u g.yos thab chung spangs nas kyang*// dpon g.yog mnyam par za na ko /phun sum tshogs par cis mi 'gyur// sngo rngad chol po'i brtul zhugs la// nan tan ma chung rgyal ba'i sras// rtogs pa yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// de nyid 'bral med bla ma yin// nag khung na yang byang chub med// bsngo ba sems bskyed byas na yang*// nyams len bsrung bran byed pa dka'// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor skyong bar zhu// skyong ba'i tshul lugs gong ma ltar// nan tan chen po bya ba dang*// mi zad rin chen rgya mtsho'i gter// rin po che yi rnam thar dang*// bya ba'i rim pa la sogs pa// dpag med bstan pa'i dam chos rnams// khyed kyis nyams su blang bar zhu// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog/

// 168) ༄// mdzad pa bcu gnyis dus mchod rnam bzhir 'du ba klong thang 'dus tshogs la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ rje btsun bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog la// gus pa'i phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi// thub chen skyob pa bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba'i bla ma skyabs gcig pu// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po yis// dang po byang chub thugs bskyed nas// sangs rgyas zhing 'di rnam par sbyangs// sbyor ba'i go ba gang zhe na// bsags pa'i las kyi snang ba de// byas las byung ba ma gtogs pa// rgyu med byung ba ma yin pas// zhing 'di rgyal bas byas pa yin// de yang ston pas bka' bstsal pa// 'jig rten sna tshogs las las byung*// gsungs par gyur pa nyid kyis shes// rgyu mthun las las byung ba yi// snod kyi 'jig rten 'di nyid du// las mthun bcud kyis sems can rnams// ston pas smin par byas pa yi// gdul bya sems can byung ba yin// ston pa'i mdzad pa thams cad kyang*// gdul bya rnams kyi snang ba yin// mdzad pa rnam pa bcu gnyis de// 'gro ba rnams dang thun mong du// ston pas bstan par gyur pa rnams// dus mchod chen po rnam bzhir 'dus// khyad par gang dang gang dag gi /mchod na de de'i 'bras bu 'byung*// cho 'phrul chen po'i dus mchod 'di// rgyal bas chos min pham mdzad nas// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// rgyal ba dgra las rnam rgyal ba// gcig pu nyid du nges par mdzad// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun te// sngon gyi rgyal bas byin rlabs dang*// rigs gsum mgon po'i phyag rjes mchog /klong thang sgron mar bzhugs pa yi// dge 'dun rnams la zhu ba'i don// chos 'khor chen po byung ba dang*// da lta'i dus tshod phan chad du// dge 'dun dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// gzhan phan dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// nye ring grwa sa rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi la// thams cad rten cing gnas pa ltar// thams cad mkhyen la brten pa yin// khyed kyang ston pa bcom ldan gyi// gsung bzhin bsgrub par mdzad pa dang*// dus mchod chen po rnam bzhi dang*// dus dang dus kyi mchod pa rnams// rgyun chad med par mdzad par zhu// de yang ston pa bcom ldan gyis// bsod nams 'dod par gyur pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa mchod ces gsungs// chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan// mgon po tshe dpag med pa nyid// mthong thos dran pas 'gro ba kun// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa 'di// dge 'dun rnams kyi tshogs su zhu// klong thang pa//

269) ༄// gnas gcig ther zug bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzod ces kha rags par gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang bla med dkon mchog dang*// slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras la sogs pa// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa// dpa' bo dpal mchog rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// bstan pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i snying po'i don// lhag pa tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab la// phyogs su gzhol ba tsam yang dkon lags na// 'jig rten 'khri ba bcad pa'i snying po mchog /yon tan gzhir gyur tshul khrims brtul zhugs 'dzin// ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab rnam gsum gyis// 'gro ba smin pa'i mthu stobs mnga' ba khyed// srog dang bsdos nas gzhan phan mdzad par rigs// ston pas mnyan du yod par nyi shu bzhi// dpal ldan nā ros puṣpa ha rir bzhugs// gong ma rnams kyi gnas gcig ther zug ste// byang chub gling du ngas kyang sum cu lhag /mi mthun char ltar bab la bzod par byas// deng sang 'dod pa'i bsam pa lhun gyis grub// skyes chen khyed kyis de ltar mdzad par zhu// bu la thugs rje chen pos ma gzigs par// ci dga' rang dga'i brtul zhugs bzung na ko /ston pa'i bstan pa su yis 'dzin par 'gyur// skyes chen khyed kyis de ltar dgongs mdzod la// gnas gcig ther zug bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzod// bdag dang 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba 'dis// bdag dang sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /kha rags pa la// // 270) ༄// chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs shig zhes pa gug shi ras par gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig chos rnams ma lus pa// nam mkha' lta bur rnam par dag gzigs nas// 'khor ba srid du 'gro ba ma lus rnams// smin mdzad bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa chos kyi rje// dbang bskur thob pa'i skyes bu mtshungs med pa// khyed la cung zad zhu don 'bul ba ni// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa tshul khrims rin po ches// rang gzhan smin par mdzad pa 'gro ba'i dpal/

khyed kyis phyogs der thub pa'i bstan pa la// rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon ltar mdzad pa mdzad// bstan pa gces 'dzin thams cad dgyes shing dga'// chen pos bkur zhing phun sum tshogs gyur na// khengs shing 'gying bag dregs pa'i zhe rlom zhing*// chos la gces 'dzin med par gyur pa yi// sdig can mdun na 'don gyi bram ze spangs// chos kyi rgyal po'i bla ma gyur pa la// khrims la gtogs zhen med par rjes yi rang*// thub pa chen pos rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// nyes ltung che shes rang gi dge ba la// dge bar mi shes gzhan nas dge ba tshol// nyes ltung chen po de la bkyon cing smad// 'gro ba'i mgon por kun tu mnga' gsol zhing*// chos rgyal bla ma dam par gyur pa'i tshe// yul der rang gi shes pa ma bzhag nas// gzeb tu bcug pa'i bya ltar 'bros 'dod na// byams dang snying rje zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis// yul de byin gyis rlob pa'i mthu med pas// rgyal po'i yul khams phyogs rnams nyams pa dang*// rang lus bla ma'i drung du ma thon pas// sha btson chas su bcug ltar sdug bsngal bas// rang gzhan gnyis ka phung bar ci zhig bya// dmyal ba'i gnas su gnas par gyur kyang ni// de na phan cing gdul bya yod pa'i phyir// rnal 'byor pa la 'gro sa gzhan na med// thub pa'i gsung dang 'gal bar ma gyur na// bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral ba// skyes chen khyed kyis thugs la bzhag par zhu// bstan pa'i khur 'dzin chen por mnga' gsol na// rang phyogs 'dzin pa'i phrag dog khe grags kyis// ngan pa mang po'i las kas rgyags gyur na// rgyal po'i srid dang bstan pa gnyis ka 'jig /thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan mchog ldan pa// bka' gdams pa dang dge bshes ston pa rnams// bla lhag gces par 'dzin cing legs bskyang na// rgyal po'i srid dang bstan pa gsal zhing sman// las ka'am bzang por gyur pa ngas byas shing*// ngan pa thams cad khong gis byas 'dod na// rgyal khams yongs dang sa chen 'dis mi khyag

/gzhan la phan yang mi to sems dpa' che// log par bzung ba'i bdag 'dzin rgyal na pham// chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs shig dge ba'i bshes// khyod kyi bla ma nga 'bu gcig pu nyid// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ri khrod pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i dge slong la// rdzas dang yo byad 'bul ba sna tshogs rnams// bde sdug gtam gyis bsdos nas phul gyur kyang*// tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i bsam pa ma gtogs pa// nged rang pha spad gnyis la dgos pa med// mtho dman tshig rnams kun gyis g.yengs pa na// thub pa'i gsung dang rin chen phreng ba dang*// bshes spring skyes rabs la sogs gsung rnams las// skyabs gzhan med pas chos la ri ltar ston// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// thub pas mchod pa'i bla ma rin po che// yon tan phrin las kun dang lhan cig tu// khyed kyi thugs la rtag tu bzhugs gyur na// rten gyi bye brag sna tshogs tha dad pa// bdag gis khyed la ji ltar bskur bar bya// bcu chos sum chos dpag chos mngon chos dang*// nga yi chos rnams ma lus ji snyed pa// sngon gyi dus su thams cad rdzogs par byas// mngon rtogs skyes shing 'bras bu mchog la spyod// khyed la dam chos bskur rgyu bdag la med// thams cad bsnams pas bdag kyang blo re bde// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen gyi// gdul bya nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i dbang bskur zhing*// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun dbus zhugs pas// yig rten bral brul bskur bar ma gyur pa// skyes chen khyod kyis bzod par mdzad par zhu// gug shi ras pa la// // 271) ༄// rgyu 'bras skad cig nyid du shes pa skyangs ston pa la gdams pa// 'chi med rtag pa'i bdag nyid sku// rin po che la btud byas te// rang gi bu yis gsol btab pas// de don cung zad bri bar bya// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin dang*// 'phral gyi rkyen gyis 'chi ba las// las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs zhes// thub pa'i gsung rab kha cig tu// thub pa chen pos gsungs pa bzhugs// tshe dang las la dbang ba yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'ga' zhig la// ji ltar bya bya btub pa yi// thabs kyang ston pa nyid kyis gsungs// ston pa'i dgongs pa bsam yas kyang*// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyis// rgyu 'bras skad cig nyid du bzhed// rgyu 'bras skad cig bden gyur na// ring dang thung dang 'bring po'i tshul// bsam yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// tha mar 'jig pa'i rkyen la sogs// lag mthil skyu ru'i 'bras bzhag bzhin// mig dang ldan pas mthong nas mchi// bu go'am rtogs sam rnal 'byor pa// chos sbom po kha la 'byams lags na// nyams myong phra mo ga la skye// nyams rtogs sgom byung shes rab kyis// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kun// thogs pa med par mngon gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i pha phogs yin// bdag na so rgas shing nad kyis zin// tshan chen grib kyis sku khams log

/nye du gnyen dang bral ba'i tshe// 'chi bar dogs pa'i bsam pa yis// gdung ba'i sems kyis sems gdungs nas// gus pas zhu phul zhus pa'i lan// tshe ring por 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag ni// nyams rtogs yon tan gsang ba dang*// g.yon pa kun spyod la gnas dang*// srog rtsol rlung gi rten 'brel dang*// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// 'chi med rtag pa'i sems dang yang*// rang srog bdud la ma shor na// tshe ring por 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag tu// bla ma ston pa rgyal bas gsungs// bris pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// skye rga na 'chi spangs pa po// mi 'gyur rtag cing lhun gyis grub// rin po che yi sku thob shog /skyang ston la gdams pa rdzogs so// // 272) ༄// mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i rdzas su sha chang zab mo'i tshogs 'khor ang zhes pa// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi gtso// rgyal ba'i gsung rab dar ba'i gnas// bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa// gong ma bzhugs pa'i gdan sa der// mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i dam rdzas su// sha chang zab mo'i tshogs 'khor ang*// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// bka' brgyud gong mas ci gsung na// chos skyong srung ma ra mda' log/ // 273) ༄// sems tsam dbu ma'i gnyer kha med ces pa'i zhal gdams// oṃ swasti/ thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i bka'// theg pa gong ma ston byed pa// yongs grags sangs rgyas phal chen gyi// snying po sa bcu bstan pa'i mdor// bod kyi chen po 'ga' zhig gis// sems tsam ston pa yin zhes gsungs// slob dpon zla ba grags pa yis// dbu ma'i bstan bcos chen por bkral// sems tsam dbu ma'i gnyer med pa// ku sā li yi sgom chen rnams// thub pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar len// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dgongs pa len lugs gcig pu cig /yod lta yod de khar mi thon// don du gnyer ba yod srid na// zla shod sman pa'i da li bzhin// dmar po rin gyis nyo sa tshol// a ya a yāe/

thos bsam sgom pa zla ba nya ba'i bstan rtsa chen po yang*// mi gtsang g.yo sgyu dur khrod ro langs mdza' mos bslu// 'khor ba mi gtsang rlubs 'obs la dga' bar ma byed cig /tsher ma zug pa'i na tshas sdar ma sems sdud byed// dpa' bo dag gis lus srog kun gyis 'phags pa mchod// chags pa spangs pa'i blo gros nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// chags bral brtul zhugs ma chung thub mgon rgyal ba'i sras// // 274) ༄// gdan sa rin po che phag mo grur zhabs tog 'bad dgos gsungs pa// rgod nam 'phang gcod pa'i byams pa de// phyor rang mthong skyong ba'i dam chos yin// babs gshis la gnas pa'i byams pa de// rje dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin// gnad phan pa bsgrub pa'i byams pa de// khong 'khor dang mthun pa'i rtsi sman yin// mi mang pos bkur ba'i tshogs dpon yang*// chos babs la gnas pa bsam par rigs// khong bu sri zhu can rnams pha zhig sems// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa bsgrub cing mnyes// ci mdzad gzhan du byas pa gcig kyang med// bdag ni deng sang khyi rgan dong du lhung*// khyed rnams tshar la re ltos bcas pa yin// gdan sa rin chen dpal gyi phag mo grur// khyed rnams thams cad phul ba yin pas 'dir// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog 'bad pa mdzad par zhu// 'khor 'das yon tan ji snyed yod pa kun// bla ma mnyes par byas las byung bar gsungs// bla ma'i bla ma bla na med pa mchog /khyed rnams bla ma bla na med pa mchog /khyed la rtag tu bde legs bla med shog/ // 275) ༄// thub pa'i bstan pa sha chang spong bar gdams pa'i 'jam yig/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches// nga'i slob mar gyur pa phyogs thams cad na bzhugs pa rnams la zhu ba/ nga'i slob ma yin zer nas/ sha za chang 'thung ba la tshogs 'khor du ming btags nas bstan pa 'jig pa 'dug na/ de dang 'brel ba med pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rma phyung ba yin/

gsang sngags kyi dam tshig bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bco lnga pa yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ mi mthun pas dam nyams su song ba yin/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che phag mo gru pa bslus pa yin/ de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa dang mi mthun pas/ skyes bu gong ma de rnams sun phyung ba yin/ mdor na thub pa'i bstan pa la dgra 'di gcig pu las med pas khyed rnams kyang dung dung mdzad par zhu/ so so'i yul phyogs su mi chags par gzhan du bskrad par zhu/ slob ma thams cad kyi 'jam yig dang da rung gong du yang mang du byas pa yin pas/ da res kyang 'di 'jam yig yin pas/ bu slob rnams kyis rna bar phyin pa thugs gnyer du mdzad par zhu// // 276) ༄// mi min gdug pa gnas sar dgon gnas mi bca' ba ye blar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// mi min gdug pa gnas pa'i sar// gnas dang dgon pa mi bya bar// nan tan chen por gsungs pa dang*// gnas dang dgon pa byas pa na// lha 'dre gtum po khros pa yis// phung bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za// rnal 'byor pa la ma tshugs na// gnas dang dgon pa 'jig pa dang*// nyes pa mang po 'byung ba yin// bya byed spangs la bsgrub par bya// snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa yin// rdzas kyis dbang po mi 'dra ba// blang du btub dang mi btub pa// 'di las 'di byung rgyu 'bras kyi// rten cing 'brel pa zab mo rnams// rang sems nam mkha' dag pa la// nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin tshogs kyis// sgrib pa med na shes nas mchi// ye bla la// // 277) ༄// bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad par gsol ba mkhan po brag thog la gdams pa// pha dang ma dang nye du dang*// gnyen dang 'brel ba ma lus dang*// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// sha dang rus pa khrag 'di la// nga dang bdag ces rnam 'khrul pa// dgongs pa 'di la bdag med cing*// bdag kyang 'di dag rnams la med// ji ltar smig rgyu'i chu bo yis// ri dwags skoms pas shi ba bzhin// zhag gcig zhag gnyis zhag 'ga' dang*// zla gcig zla gnyis zla 'ga' dang*// lo gcig lo gnyis lo 'ga' yi// smig rgyu'i chu bo g.yo ba yis// ri dwags 'chi ba ji bzhin du// gtan sdug brlag par 'gro ba 'di// skyes chen khyed kyis ga la mdzad// chos kyi rgyal po chen po yi// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas mdzad gsol// thub pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad gsol// bla ma thams cad dgyes mdzad gsol// 'gro ba bde la 'god mdzad gsol// ri khrod dbang phyug ldom bu ba// khyed kyi bla mar gyur pa bdag

/snying nas khyed la gsol ba 'debs// mkhan po brag thog pa la// // 278) ༄// gdan sa phag grur snying stobs chen pos dge 'dun skyong bar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ lus dang ngag dang yid rnams la// 'jig rten bsam pas ma gos shing*// mi byed mi smra mi bsam pa'i// sbyor bas phyi yi spros pa gcad// lha dang sngags dang byang sems kyis// nang gi spros pa gcad par bya// mos gus 'od gsal skye med kyis// gsang ba'i spros pa gcad par bya// spros pa 'di gsum ma bcad na// phyi nang gsang gsum bdud kyi tshogs// rgyun chad med par ka ra ra// khab rtse tsam gyi bu gar yang*// bdud kyi dmag dpung 'jug par nges// zhugs nas rang dang rang gi 'khor// gnyen 'dun phyogs ris rlags par byed// a la la dang a dzi dzi// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// byang chub shing drung rdo rje gdan// 'di na bdud kyi dmag tshogs med// de ltar thugs su chud byas nas// 'bad pa chen pos sgo gsum bsdams// snying stobs chen pos dge 'dun bskyang*// dus ring po cig tu gnas 'dir bsdad// mtho dman 'bring gsum nyams myong yod// nga yi tshig la gsan par zhu// zhu rten gser gyi mdog 'dra ba// nang dar ser po yug gsum 'di// rin po che yi mtshan gyis mtshan// gsum ka kha the'u ma nyams pa// phyag tu 'bul lo ci dgyes mdzod// gdan sa ba la// //

279) ༄// rje btsun mi la'i rtogs tshad kyi zhal gdams gsung mgur// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi// mdzod 'dzin dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mi la chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// bla ma mnyes mdzad mos gus can// ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa// gcig pur sdod pa'i snying stobs can// pha la bu skyes rje btsun pa// rtogs pa tshad ldan mi la la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// pha rje btsun de yi zhal snga nas// yod pa dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas// rang rig gzhan rig yod min te// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis// rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*// de la snying rje shugs 'byung ste// stobs dang mi 'jigs gzungs la sogs// sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin pa// nor bu rin chen tshul du 'byung*// de rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs tshad ces// rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas gsungs// // 280) ༄// sdig pa'i 'khor lo bcu 'dis mi bzad dmyal bar ltung ba// oṃ swasti/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas bkra shis par gyur cig ston pa'i gsung gis 'di skad du// sdig pa'i 'khor lo rnam pa bcu// dge slong rdol pa can dag dang*// rgyal blon rdol pa can sogs kyis// dben pa'i dge slong dag mthong na// skur ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// bskur nas brnyas shing smod pa dang*// gang na de dag gnas pa dang*// byams dang snying rje dge ba'i chos// legs par gyur la mi spyod par// mchod rten dge 'dun nor la spyod// mdzangs shing drang la sdang ba dang*// sdig pa'i grogs la bsten pa yis// shin tu glen par gyur pa yis// nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gyis// gang rung de yi grub mthar zhen// gzhan la smod par 'gyur ba dang*// sdig can tshul khrims mi ldan ngor// yon tan can la zhe sdang bas// gcam sgyu gnod pa sna tshogs byed// nor 'phrogs chad pa sna tshogs kyis// mgo gcod bar du byed pa dang*// shin tu glen pa'i rang bzhin can// cung zad shes pa snyems pa yis// g.yo sgyu thabs ngan sna tshogs kyis// srog dang 'bral ba la sogs pa'i// gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa dang*// sdig pa'i grogs po bsten pa dang*// dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ba yis// phyogs bzhi dge 'dun rnams kyi dkor// skyes shing skyes pa bud med sogs// dge 'dun dkor la longs spyod dang*// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// shes rab rno la mang du thos// tshig don rdzogs par smra bar nus// theg pa gsum gyis gzhan don byed// de la 'phya bskur gnod pa dang*// phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun dkor rnams la// rang nyid spyod par byas nas kyang*// gzhan la spyod dang 'phrog byed cing*// gzhan la phrog tu 'jug pa dang*// srog gcod ngan par lta ba yi// 'jig rten bslus pa'i gang zag dag

/bdag ni tshul khrims ldan smra zhing*// rnam pa sna tshogs thabs rnams kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa ma rung byed// bstan la rab tu byung ba la// gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// gsod pa'i bar du byed pa dang*// de ltar gyur pa de dag gis// ston pas legs par bstan pa yi// chos la yid ches mi skye bas// mchod rten gtsug lag khang 'dzin dang*// dge slong khyim par 'bebs pa dang*// rab byung bar chad byas nas kyang*// sna tshogs las la 'khor ba ste// sdig pa'i 'khor lo bcu 'di dang*// spyi dang bye brag re re rnams// gang gis byas pa'i sa phyogs de'i// lha klu chos skyong thams cad kun// mi dga' zhe sdang skyes nas kyang*// 'bros dang gnod pa byed pa dang*// yul der phyi 'khrugs nang 'khrugs dang*// nad dang mu ge lo nyes kyis// shin tu brlags pa nyid du gyur// dkon mchog gsum las byung ba yi// yon tan bsod nams zad pa yis// thog ma bar dang tha mar yang*// mi dge sna tshogs 'byung ba ste// yul der yod pa'i rgyal blon dang*// khyim pa tshong dpon dge sbyong dang*// bram ze la sogs gdol pa rnams// ring por mi thogs yan lag kun// dum bur chad dang lkugs pa dang*// mi bzad nad dang sdug bsngal gyis// shi nas mnar med dmyal bar ltung*// de ltar gyur pa'i dge slong dang*// thub pa'i ngur smrig 'chang ba la// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis// gnod pa byed du ma gnang ste// glang chen dur khrod srin po dang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten mchod rten te// gus pas yon tan dpag med pa// bskal mang 'khor ba bsnyil nas kyang*// myur du byang chub thob par gsungs// // 281) ༄// zhus tshig nyi shu spyi zhus cig zhes bya ba'i gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ chos kun gdod nas rnam dag nam mkha' las// sku gnyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa// 'gro ba'i mi shes mun sel bla ma dang*// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'dud// khyed kyi zhu ba rgya mtsho ltar yangs shing*// dpag med don rnams bgrang gis mi lang ba// bdag dang dbyer med gcig tu khyed gyur pas// bdag gi rnam thar legs par thugs chud mod// zhu ba 'di yi don rnams mdor bsdus na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug mi bzad pa// gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu nyes skyed cing*// dkar po'i phyogs rnams ma lus bcom pas na// gnas skabs mthar thug gang du gnang ba med// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug dang bral ba// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba'i phyir// bkag pa med cing bsgrub pa'i bslab par gsungs// thub pa'i chos rnams mtha' dag 'dir shes bya// chos rje mgon pos nad dang rims dang dug

/bzhi rgya rtsa bzhi nad dang gdon tshogs dang*// 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug nyes tshogs rnams// dug gsum las byung mkhyen nas gnyen pos bcom// spyi dang bye brag rten 'brel bsam yas rnams// de rgyu mkhyen pas rgyu lam 'bras bu kun// dag par mdzad pa 'di las gzhan med par// shes rab spyan gyis gzigs nas phyag len mdzod// bsags pa rab gyur gang zag gis// skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgoms pas na sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'dir shes bya// dbang po 'bring dang tha ma yis// 'khor 'das rtsa ba sems nyid las// gzhan gyi bya ba byed pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod pa rnams// rim gyis rim gyis 'jug pa'i phyir// rgyud nas byang chub thob pa yin// nyan thos skye ba lnga brgya ste// bse ru bskal ba brgya yi bar// sangs rgyas bskal pa grangs med gsum// slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis// mdzod du legs par gsungs mod kyang*// thub pa'i gsung rab mtha' yas su// ji ltar gong du bstan pa bzhin// spang bya nyon mongs spong ba yi// gnyen po brtson 'grus bsam byas pas// theg gsum rnam par grol ba la// dus kyang nges pa ma mchis par// chos rje thub pas bka' bstsal to// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la// lam gyi 'dod lugs rnam mang yang*// don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems// gcig chod gcig tu shes par bya// chags lam grol lam gnyis po yi// bye brag nyon mongs rnam pa gsum// spong ba'i tshul lugs gsungs pa lags// da ltar 'dzam gling thams cad na// tshogs 'khor dbang bskur 'dod chags la// mdzad lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa// dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa la// chos dang chos min rnam dbye yis// chags sdang mang po bskyed gyur na// bdag gzhan gti mug chen po la// chags dang sdang ba'i stobs 'phel nas// dug gsum mthu rgyas khams gsum du// sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i phyir// chos kun gdod nas skye med la// mos gus bya zhing gnyis med bsgom// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gzhung lam tshang zhing skyon med pa// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// dbyer med don dam byang chub sems// sems nyid dri ma rnam dag pa// tshul khrims rin chen lhur len pas// tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa yi// dam chos de las gzhan med par// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsungs// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// khyad par dbang gis byed pa ni// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub tu// rtogs na theg chen dbang yin zhes// rdo rje 'chang chen brgyud pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsungs// nges par rang gzhan ma bslus pa'i// dbang bskur mdzad na de ltar mdzod// bdag gis slob ma smin byed na// yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba bsgrag par mi bya zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa'i phyir// gsang sngags cho ga mkhas pa yi// slob ma skyes bu dam pa yis// rgyas bsdus dbang gis smin par bya// de nas zab mo'i khrid rnams kyis// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa la// dbang gi 'khor lo rin chen gsung*// rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs gyur na// dge dang mi dge'i rgyu 'bras rnams// yongs su dag pa'i me long la// dkar nag bzang ngan snang ba ltar// sems nyid rnam dag me long la// rgyu 'bras dge dang mi dge rnams// mngon du gsal zhing snang ba la// mgon po phag mo gru pa yis// rgyu 'bras mngon du 'gyur zhes gsungs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// 'khor 'das thams cad 'chad pa 'di// thub pa'i gsung rab yin zhes gsungs// thub pa chen po'i gsung rab rnams// nyams len lhag pa tshul khrims dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab las// 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas 'byung*// byung ba'i 'bras bu mthar thug gis// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa'i sku// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus kun// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor los 'gro ba rnams// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug yin// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo rnams// 'di yis 'di 'grub phra dang rags// rang sems dag na mngon du gyur// de la zab pa'i don du bstan// gzhan gyi tshogs dpon byed pa la// rang gzhan mgo skor ma byas shing*// mar khrid ded dpon mi byed pa// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang*// bslab pa'i gzhi dang byang chub sems// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// dus gsum 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// dge ba bsdus nas bsngos pa yi// theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen du// thub pa chen pos bka' bstsal te// rang sems skye med mthar thug gi

/rang dbang thob par gyur na gzod// bsam gyis mi khyab mdzad pa dang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel rnams// da gzod bsgrub pa ma lags sam// ji ltar 'on pa rol mo mkhan// legs so yar ro yin no skad// mi shes rmongs pa'i byis pa rnams// sna tshogs tshig gis bstod na yang*// 'di la blo gtad med pa'i phyir// thub pas bsgom pa'i shes rab la// bstod pa gsungs pa go bar mdzod// des na bar do a cang ches// thabs lam so so a cang ches// yang sgos 'pho ba a cang ches// nyal dang tsog pu'i khyad par yang*// thub mgon chos rje rin po ches// dug dang sman gyi khyad par du// gsungs pa thugs su chud pa bas// bem rig 'bral ba'i dus tshod du// gnad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'ong bar// rin po che yi bsngo ba dang*// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog dang*// yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa// dam tshig dri ma 'khru ba rnams// bya zhes yang yang bka' stsal gsungs// nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// thig le 'byams par gyur pa na// bya lugs bcos thabs rnam mang yang*// ji ltar bde ba skyes pa'i tshe// skyes pa bud med yul gzhan la// phyi rol yul la dmigs pas lan// nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo dang*// a ba dhu tī gnad du zab// nang gi rgyal ba'i zhing khams su// rdo rje sems pa bzhugs su gsol// dug nad drag po'i sbyor ba la// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// khro bcu srung ba'i 'khor lo yis// ma rungs 'dul bar byed pa dang*// de nas gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs dang*// bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor thams cad la// bsgoms pas bde skyid 'byung ba rnams// da rung khyod kyis ma go 'am// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dar gzhon gyis// bdag la ji ltar bgyid pa ltar// srung ba'i 'khor lo bya ba gces// sman dang sngags dang ting 'dzin dang*// sbyor ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs kun// li li shor ba'i skar khung yin// thub pa'i rang sems gso lo yin// rdzun po che yi yang zor yin// de phyir ston pa bcom ldan gyis// slob dpon dang ni slob ma gnyis// mtshungs par dam tshig mnyam gyur pas// 'brel bar gtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*// 'gag dang nya ga 'di nyid yin// slob ma'i mtshan nyid dpag med rnams// gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di nyid yin// rang gi rigs las skyes pa las// blo gtad bya bar gsungs pa yang*// rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'brel ba yin// slob ma yod dam rnal 'byor pa// yod na de la snying gtam mdzod// tshogs kyi gtor chen rlabs po che// sha dang chang gis brgyan gyur cing*// ri rab tsam du spungs pa dang*// til 'bru tsam gyi gtor ma la// byin rlabs che chung ga la yod// dag pa gsum gyi rnam dag dang*// byang chub sems las byung ba 'di// shin tu phra ba'i rdul phran dang*// dus gsum 'khor 'das mnyam pa 'di// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed nyid kyis// thugs su chud cing go bar zad// rgyan gtor da lta'i bsngo lugs 'di// rnam gsum rlung me bud sbar gyis// bla ma yid dam dkon mchog dang*// chos skyong srung ma mchod pa dang*// 'gro ba rigs drug sems can kun// 'byung po gtor mas lhar sbyangs pa'i// don gyi gnad 'di gcig yin phyir// gsum la gcig bsnon phyogs gcig lags// phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre dang*// klu rigs gsum gyi gtor ma 'di// byin gyis brlabs pa mthun pa'i phyir// bzhi po gcig tu sgrub pa lags// snying rje'i mgron gyur yi dwags dang*// bzang ngan skyid sdug lan chags kyis// mgron gnyis zhing dang bsam pa dang*// gtor ma sbyong lugs gcig pa'i phyir// gnyis po gcig tu sgrub pa lags// zhus tshig nyi shu spyi zhus gcig

/khyed kyis bdag la zhus pa 'di// bdag gi rjes 'jug slob ma la// rtse bas gsol ba btab pa 'di// legs so legs so khyod legs so// shin tu legs so rgyal ba'i sras// rang don thugs dam nyams len dang*// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa rnams// zhus par gyur pa'i tshig rnams kyis// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 282) ༄// rgyal ba ma gtogs dpang po gzhan med ces shrī phug pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ srid zhi sems kyi dkyil 'khor
