mnyam nyid ro gcig pas// nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du bzhugs gyur cing*// 'phags pa rnams dang 'gro kun smin mdzad bla ma yi// zhabs kyi padmor 'bral med gus pas rtag tu 'dud// bdag nyid chen po tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// dpag med 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa la// nyid sku bde zhing thugs dgongs rdzogs zhes khums// de la bdag cag thams cad blo bder mchis// deng sang bstan pa'i sgor zhugs skyes bu yi// 'dug lugs gang yin zur tsam brjod pa 'di// skyes chen khyed kyis thugs la dgongs par zhu// bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po 'dis// sngon tshe nged kyi 'dug lugs mi bzad pa// nyes phung rtsa ba nyon mongs dbang gyur cing*// 'khor ba ngan song rnams su gnas gyur pa// bdag cag rnams la thugs rjes ma bzod nas// snyigs ma lnga ldan zhing 'di ched du bzung*// phan btags lan du gnod pas 'tshe byed cing*// gdug sdang gnod 'khrug sems can rnams kyi phyir// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas ston pa dang*// nged rnams smon lam gcig cing rjes su zhugs// de yi bstan pa 'dzin par smon lam btab// thub pa'i sras po bdag nyid chen po rnams// padma'i mtsho la ngang pa ji bzhin du// ya nga 'jigs pa'i gnas su rol par mdzad// gnad 'dis tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par nges// de phyir rgyal sras dpa' bo chen po rnams// gangs ri'i spo la nyi ma shar bzhin mdzes// rgyal ba rnams kyis legs par thugs su chud// rgyal ba ma gtogs dpang po gzhan med lags// chos kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i zhing*// dkon mchog pho brang phan dang bde ba'i mdzod// rtswa mi'i yul de bstan pa'i gzhir gyur lags// lus can bsod nams ma yin tshogs 'phel bas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'jig par gyur la phyogs// mtshon gyi bskal pas lus can dpag med shi// nad kyi bskal pas shin tu bcom par 'gyur// mu ge'i bskal pas ya nga'i las la spyod// 'jigs pa'i gnas der mgon po khyod nyid la// rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs pa dang*// gong ma'i thugs dgongs chos skyong mthu rnams kyis// rang dbang med par yul der byon pa ni// sangs rgyas mthu yin rang la ci byar med// 'di nyid khyed kyi khur yin gang gi yang*// khur ma yin par bdag gis bsam pa lags// ngan khrid bskal par ma pham mgon po ltar// lhar bcas 'jig rten de kun dbugs phyung mod// rgyal ba'i bstan la mdzad pa rlabs che mod// gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rjogs lags mod// lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad re ba 'di// rdzogs par mdzad la bdag cag rjes yi rang*// bsam gyis mi khyab 'jigs pa chen po 'di// 'dzam bu gling 'dir byung bar gyur pa dang*// ya nga'i gnas su khyed nyid bzhugs pa la// thams cad bred cing dngangs par gyur pa yi// rgyu mtshan cung zad brjod par gyur pa 'di// lung rigs man ngag chos las legs byung bas// bdag gi bsam pa'i gsos su gyur pa lags// phyag tu bzhes la thugs kyis dgongs par zhu// shi ri phug pa la//

283) ༄// yig nag zhog la rang sems bsgom zhes pa 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ro// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spyir rnal 'byor pa rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par 'dod pas/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa de tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bur sangs rgyas la/ ji ltar dgongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin re re la mnyam par bzhag pas phun sum tshogs pa lnga lhun gyis grub par 'byung bas/ dpag tu med pa'i sems can smin pa dang grol bar 'gyur ba de dang 'dra bar/ rnal 'byor pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i stobs kyis bla ma dam pa'i drung du phyin nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa ji bzhin du skyes pa'i rten gyi gang zag des/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba re re la mnyam par bzhag pas ting nge 'dzin de'i mthu chen po stobs su gyur pas lus dang dbye ba med par 'gyur te/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sems kyi ting nge 'dzin lus kyis mngon du byas nas sdug bsngal ba dang bral bar gyur to// zhes gsungs la/ de ltar gyur pas phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad kyang phan pa dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur te/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs lta bur gyur nas/ rang gzhan thams cad bde ba dang skyid pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba de ston pa'i gsung rab tu gsungs shing*/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams su myong bar nges te/ de la mdor bsdu na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ lhag pa'i lha dang*/ bla ma dam pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bsngo ba rnam pa lnga las/ ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad bsdus pa don gyi snying po 'gyur ba med par nges pas/ rang gi nyams su myong ba goms pa'i stobs chen pos/ bskal pa'i me chen po rab tu 'bar ba ltar stobs bskyed pa las gzhan med pas/

de ltar thugs la bzhag par bya'o// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa pos// pha med yig nag mang po yis// dam tshig nyams la dngos grub med// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// yig nag zhog la rang sems bsgom// rang nyid nyams myong mngon rtogs dang*// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mthun pas na// ston pa'i gsung rab rtag tu bklag /gzhan rgyud smin pa'i thabs kyi mchog /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don bya// ting 'dzin stobs mchog skye ba'i phyir// dben pa'i gnas su bsdad par bya// bla med theg pa mchog sgrub phyir// ci byed 'gro ba'i don du bsngo// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// nyams len snying po gces par mdzad// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro ba byang chub mchog thob shog/ // 284) ༄// slob mas ji ltar bya ba'i dris lan snying gtam blo bzhag/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur gyi bar du/ bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi mgon gcig pu/ skyabs gcig pu/ rten gcig pu dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// snying gtad blo bzhag pa'i slob mas nga ji ltar bya ba'i gros dris pa la/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas rang nyid 'chi bar 'dug cis kyang 'chi bar 'dug 'chi nges par 'dug gnas dang dus dang rkyen la nges pa mi 'dug ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ni rdzun med nges/ nye du dang gnyen 'brel gyi don du bde sdug zad pa med pa so tshis dang 'bad par byas kyang*/ khong la yang mi phan rang la yang gnod pa rang nyid kyi nyams su myong bas shes mod/ mi phan gyi pha rol tu nyon mongs pa gsum gyis bdag bsreg 'od kyis gzhan bsreg par 'dug pa/ chos shes kyang nyams su ma blangs na shes pa'i don med pa'i pha rol tu chos byed la re che bas rang gis chos ma byas pa'i dus su/

gzhan 'gro ba thams cad kyang chos byed pa'i spyod pa 'di 'dra bas chos la bden pa med snyam nas nyams su len pa mi 'ong*/ nyams len byed pa med pas bstan pa dung phyis pa bzhin du 'gro/ 'gro ba gzhan mar khrid kyi ded dpon byas pas rang la thar ba'i dus med/ nyes dmigs 'di thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ khyi rgan bzhin du rang dang rang gi nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel phyogs dang ris thams cad la bdag tu bzung ba'i nyes dmigs yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan gsungs/ 'dzin pa med pa chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yon tan rin po che mtha' dag gi gzhi rten/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i them skas/ 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i dpa' bo/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi yang snying*/ 'dzin pa med pa gcig pu yin/ de la 'bad par bya/ rang phan dang gzhan phan/ rang bde dang gzhan bde/ rang skyid dang gzhan skyid/ gang 'dod kyang bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog la mos gus kyi shugs drag pos tshogs gsog pa dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la nan tan du byas na/ mi chos kyi 'dun ma thams cad dbang med du rang 'grig tu 'gro/ sngon tshogs bsags pas 'byor ba dang btsan 'jing dang*/ bsod nams che ba byung ba yin/ de ltar yang de kho na bzhin du byas na 'ong bar 'dug pas/ mi chos kyi 'dun ma gtan mi bsam par zhu/ lha chos 'ba' zhig don dang khebs gang che che mdzad par zhu/ don che snyam pa la hab shur gyis rlabs po che bya bar 'dod na/ 'grub par shin tu dka' bas pha rol tu nyes dmigs su 'gro ba la tshegs med de/ dge bshes sum pa'i mdzo mo dang 'dra/ de ltar yang slob dpon arya na gardzu na'i zhal snga nas/ dge ba'i nyams kyis mi lcogs pa// gzhan gyis sbad kyang mnyan mi bya// dga' 'o dga' 'o zhes brjod kyang*// me yi nang du su zhig mchong*// gsungs/

yul la dmigs pa'i zang zing 'dis kyang ji ltar byas kyang phan pa mgu ba don du gyur ba shin tu dka' bar 'dug ste/ byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ gsungs/ shes pa nang du log gis log rang gzhan dang 'khor 'das su btags pa thams cad rang gi bsam pas phar la btags/ rang gi bsam pa de ltar du snang ba las gshis la grub pa ni yod mi srid pas/ bsam pa snga ma phyi ma'i zhags pas bcings pas ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed 'khor ba'i 'khor lo srin bu'i kha chus rang 'ching ba'am/ sbur ba bal du btum pa ltar je sdug je sdug je ngan je ngan du 'gro bar 'dug bsam pa de nyid gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis med/ 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis med/ rang gzhan gnyis med/ gnyis med pas gcig bya ba yang med pas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/ gdod nas ma skyes pa/ spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba la mnyam par bzhag de rang gzhan thams cad kyi babs dang 'dug lugs yin/ de la 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba yon tan yin/ des 'gro ba thams cad gnyis su med pa'i tshul des smin pa dang grol bar byed pa chos kyi sku'i phrin las zhes 'dogs pa yin/ don gyis sgom pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ sems nyid chos kyi sku de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi de 'ba' zhig gis bsgrub cing*/ de brtan pa las gsang sngags gyi dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad byung ba yang*/ char 'bebs pa dang*/ ser ba gcod pa dang*/ nad zhi ba la sogs pa mang po zhig 'byung bar 'dug pas/ gsungs pa thams cad kyang mi 'byung mi srid pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lha yi dam/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis sku gsum du gsungs pas/ gang rtogs pa gang la blo nges pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum/ tha mal pa'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rjes su skad cig kyang ma 'brangs par nyams su blang bar bya ba gal che/

byams pa dang snying rje sems can dang*/ chos dang dmigs pa med pa rnam pa gsum las skye ba'i tshul lugs gsungs kyang*/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa 'di bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis rab tu phye ba yin pas chos dang dmigs med kyi snying rje ma gtogs pa sems can la dmigs pa'i skabs ni sbyor ba'i chos kho na yin/ de ltar nyams su blang pas/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis po rang bzhin du// mnyam rjes yod par gyur pa la// byang chub sems dpa' zer ba yin// mnyam rjes med par gyur pa la// grub thob sangs rgyas zer ba yin// mnyam rjes yod pa'i gnas skabs su// mthun pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga// legs par bstan cing nyams su blang*// rjes med mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig la// goms su bcug par gyur pa la// mnyam par bzhag par dka' ba min// mthun pa'i rkyen dang mi ldan zhing*// 'gal ba'i rkyen rnams bsgrubs pa yis// ji ltar me dang chu dag ni// so sor nus pa yod pa la// gcig tu bsres par gyur pa yis// gnyis ka'i nus pa shi ba ltar// nyams len mtha' dag 'di lta bur// 'gyur bar thugs su chud pas na// ston pas bar du gcod pa zhes// nan tan chen pos bka' bstsal gsungs// gnyen po'i dam tshig 'di yin pas// mthun rkyen bsten cing 'gal rkyen spang*// ting nge 'dzin la dbang bsgyur bas// stong gsum stong chen 'jig rten 'di// rin chen bdun du bsgyur ba dang*// dgos 'dod char pa 'bebs pa dang*// byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// 'gro ba bde bar bsgyur ba dang*// ngan song gsum gyi me rlabs rnams// zhi bar byas nas 'gro ba kun// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med pa// bde ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub thob par gyur ba la// rang gi nye du gnyen 'brel gyi// kha tshis so tshis smos ci dgos// nan tan chen pos bsgrub par bya// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba yi// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog 'di las med// 'di las gzhan pa mi srid na// a khu bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs tog yin pa smos ci dgos// 'di la 'bad pa chen po yis// nan tan chen por nyams su blang*// rdzogs so//

// 285) ༄// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs zhes pa// pha skyabs su mchi'o rin po che// bdag cag 'gro drug sems can la// skyabs gzhan na med do 'gro ba'i mgon// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// sdar ma g.yang khar phyin pa ltar// rang la rang nyid ya nga za// pha byin gyis rlobs dang rin po che// pha dam pa de yi snyan pa yis// mi mang po 'dus pa'i tshul lugs 'di// ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// ngar snabs 'tsher bar gyur pa la// rmongs pa'i byis pa glen pa rnams// ngar snabs nyi ma yin par sems// bdag kyang de ltar 'khrul 'khrul 'dra// nyes 'khrul bdud kyi grogs po yi// phye gtor 'di las bskyab tu gsol// rje rin po che yi bka' drin gyis// dad pa can gyis zas nor tshogs// zhing sa gshin po yin nam snyam// thams cad nam mkha'i sprin ltar phungs// bdag nyon mongs gdug pa'i me nang du// dad rdzas sa bon tshig tshig 'dra// gzhan phan zhen med chu rgyun gyis// 'khor gsum dag pa'i sa gzhi la// sangs rgyas 'bras bur smin mdzad gsol// ngo sha mi la byin sha khyi// lus dang srog la ma bltas par// tshe gcig tu bskyangs pa'i slob ma rnams// gong ma'i rnam thar ri khrod du// bsgrub pa byed du btang ba dga'// nyon mongs bag chags sa bon rnams// phyi rol bdud kyi sad par bya// log par 'khrul pa'i nga rgyal gyis// dam pa gong ma khyad du gsod// nag po'i bdud kyi dmag dpon du// bstan pa'i phung 'dre'i ru mtshon 'phyar// rgyal ba'i bstan pa snub par byed// dmyal bar 'gro ba'i gting rdo btags// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// rang la je 'jigs je 'jigs thal// kun mkhyen ye shes ma thob tshe// slob ma skyong ba'i go cha shor// pha byin gyis rlobs dang byin rlabs can// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad mthu bo che// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan gyis// bdag cag skyob par mdzad du gsol// tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i so tshis la// 'di la tig tig yod snyam nas// phongs pa snying nas 'dri ba la// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gsung*// lung dang rigs pa nyams myong dang*// 'brel med mu cor smra ba'i tshig

/ngag 'khyal rnam pa sna tshogs las// da rung thar par ma gyur pa// rang gzhan bslu bar gyur pa 'di// 'khor ba ngan song rgyu yin zhing*// thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa las// bar du gcod par 'gyur ba'i phyir// nyes tshogs sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho las// bcom ldan gsung gi dbang phyug gtso// mgon po 'od dpag med pa yis// ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang mdzad gsol// // 286) ༄// ri khrod du nye bar zhi ba'i brtul zhugs mdzod ces skya mo la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ phyin ci log gi shes pas bdag tu bzung ba'i lus keng rus sha ra ri dang khrag ra ri chags pa/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis gang ba/ blo gtad med cing yid brtan du mi rung ba 'di myur du 'jigs par thugs su chud pas/ rang gi rigs stong pa/ rus stong pa ming stong pa la nga dang bdag tu ma grub par go bas 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa la ma chags pa dang*/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu bslu ba med par/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dang dus gzhan dang gzhan dag tu 'bras bu bslu ba med par 'byung bar thugs su chud pas sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad thag ring du spangs shing*/ dge ba'i phyogs rlabs po che thams cad la dang du len par mdzad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad rang gi a ma yin pa'i nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i go cha chen po bgos nas brtul zhugs chen po la spyod par mdzad pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba las/ 'gro ba'i nyes skyon gyi phung po/ 'khor ba ngan song du log par ltung bar zhugs pa/ 'jug pa/ 'jug par 'gyur ba rnams dang rang nyid lta spyod bstun na rang bde ba tsam yang 'byung mi srid na/

gzhan smin pa dang grol bar byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos par thugs su chud pas/ sems med lus med snang ba med na khyad par gyi chos bdag ces bya ba'am/ sems can zhes bya ba'am/ srog dang*/ gso ba dang*/ skyes bu dang*/ gang zag ces log par brtags pa khyad par gyi chos smos kyang ci dgos par thugs su chud nas 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dkon mchog thams cad kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i zhabs 'bring zhabs tog rgya chen po mdzad pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang*/ bdag la bka' drin shin tu che/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ nga yang de kho na bzhin du thugs la gdags par zhu/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// tshangs pa rgya byin dbang phyug dang*// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bde rgyas rnams// spangs nas ri khrod nags khrod du// nye bar zhi ba'i brtul zhugs kyis// rang don gzhan don mdzad pa dang*// rang skyid gzhan skyid byung ba dang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa de// bu gcig khyed kyi thugs la zhog /shin tu zab bo// skya bo ma la// //

287) ༄// 'dun gros snying dang 'dra bar thugs la zhogs zhes skyo khyam par gdams pa// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang dang 'dra ba'i bu slob rnams// skyid sdug mtho dman bzang ngan gyi// 'dun gros snying nas 'dra ba kun// snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa 'di// snying dang 'dra bar thugs la zhog /kye ho kye kye gces pa'i bu// bde dang skyid par 'dod pa'i blo// rigs drug sems can kun la yod// bde thabs skyid thabs mi shes pas// je sdug je bsngal gtan du sdug /thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i sras// ston pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas// je dga' je skyid skyid mthar phyin// kye ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// rang la re ba ma che bar// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// che 'am yang na chung yang rung*// bla med rnam dag mchod pa yis// snying nas mchod par gyur pa yis// 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i phyir// bsod nams bsags la nan tan bya// de las legs pa'i blo gros skye// nam mkhar dbyig pa 'phangs pa bzhin// rang dbang med par 'gyur nas 'gro// rang 'dod zhe 'dod bsam pa de// nyon mongs drag po'i dug yin pas// de la shin tu 'jigs shing bros// babs la gnas pa'i bsam pa la// drang po babs kyi 'dun ma 'char// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// rang 'khris skyon dang bral ba'i tshe// rang gzhan don kun 'grub nas mchi// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la// las kyi sgrib pas bsgrib pa yi// mi 'di shin tu glen par tshor// lha klu gnod sbyin mi ma yin// yid kyi gzugs can phal cher gyis// rang gi bsam pa shes nas mchi// man chung dag tshangs bya mi 'tshal// skad cig nyid du nges par 'gyur// phan gnod skad cig nyid du 'byung*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa de// byang chub sems kyi 'dug gnas yin// byang chub sems dang ma 'bral dang*// 'dun 'gros thams cad legs par mchi/

skyo khyam pa// // 288) ༄// mi g.yo rdo rje dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'i rten 'brel zab mo'i gdams pa// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa'i snying stobs chung ba dang*// nyon mongs yul la zhen pa dang*// nyams myong yod pa rgud pa dang*// 'khrul ba'i bag chags brtas pa'i 'khor// 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel ci// sna tshogs gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// zab mo'i chos la bar gcod pa// mi mthun rkyen gyis gang ba'i sar// rang dbang med par sdod dgos pa'i// mi mthun rkyen gyi rten 'brel ci// 'grogs shing ngo srung dka' ba yi// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po'i tshogs// nyon mongs drag las byung ba dang*// gtan du 'grogs pa'i rten 'brel ci// nam zhig 'gro ba'i dus kyi tshe// char sgang lhags sgang la sogs pa'i// shin tu sdug pa'i dus tshod du// rang dbang med par 'gro dgos pa'i// 'di yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// 'gro mgon dpal ldan chos kyi rje// mnyam med bla ma dam pa yi// brgyud pa gong mas gnang ba'i rdzas// bya rog 'gums par 'gyur ba dang*// de na skyes pa'i padma la// 'bras bu med pa'i rten 'brel ci// bdag nyid chen pos gsung bar zhu// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel zab mo 'di// rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung nges pas// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i smon lam la// sngon gyi dam bca' ma brjed par// khyed kyis nan tan chen po gyis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// rtsa ni gang yin rlung gang yin// yi ge gang yin dang po yi// rlung sems tshogs pa'i nyams myong gang*// de rnams gang gis sbyong bar byed// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i ma// sbyong byed mi pham mgon pos gsungs// bag chags dag pa'i 'bras bu 'di// gnyis ldan dri med chos sku yin// las mthun par snang ba'i skyid sdug rnams// rgyu gang las 'byung bar shes lags sam// rgyu gang las byung ba ma shes na// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad// gtso bos 'khor rnams byin gyis rlob// 'khor gyis gtso bo byin gyis rlobs// ga pur gla rtsi gar log spos// tshad dang ldan pa'i dri bzhin du// nnaha dharmā ra tsa ni// shin tu zab pa'i rten 'brel nyid// des na mi g.yo rdo rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// bag chags sa bon sbyor bar nges// mthar thug 'bras bu thob par nges// gtan gyi so nam tshar bar nges//

// 289) ༄// kye pa bcu yi gdams ngag rnal 'byor rnams la gnang ba/ kye kye/ yang dang yang du rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams// dam bca' brtan pos thams cad 'grub par gsungs// kye kye/ sdom pa zhes ni gang gis bcas pa yi// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' rnams// dang po kho nar dam bca' byed pa ni// srog la bab kyang ma gtong gang yin des// bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu myur du grub par gsungs// kye kye/ thub pa'i dbang po shākya'i rgyal po des// shing dbang drung du dang po dam bcas pa'i// 'od gsal ba de thob par ma gyur tshe// dkyil mo krung 'di bshig par mi bya zhes// dam bca' zhag bdun gnas pas thob pa yin// kye kye/ ka ta ya na kun dga' bos// shing gi drung du dam bcas grub// kye kye/ ma khol la sogs mu stegs pa// yengs pa med pa'i dran pas grub// kye kye/ 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// gcig gi dran rgyun bsten pas 'grub// kye kye/ dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid ni/ chos kyi rtsa bar thub pas gsungs// kye kye/ ma yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// gnyis pos lam dang dam tshig rdzogs// kye kye/ glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du// dran pa la ni mi gnas pa// des ni nam yang 'grub mi srid// kye kye/ dge dang mi dge'i dran pa ni// sa bon dang po gang byung de// dran pa rgyun du bsrings pas 'grub// kye pa bcu yi gdams ngag la// rnal 'byor rnams kyis gnas pa der// tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sam// yang na zhag bdun kho nas 'grub// // 290) ༄// chags sdang spong bar gdams pa zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med ces pa// pha chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// dag dang ma dag gdul bya rnams// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa la// rang 'dod phyogs re'i bsam pa yis// bzang ngan gyi phyogs ris ma byed cing*// zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med// spyir gang yang yag par 'ong du 'dra// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// bka' rgyud kyi bla ma gong ma rnams// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa mchog

/rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho de// thugs rje chen po'i thabs kyis 'dzin// zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med// spyir gang yang yag par 'ong du 'dra// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// pha skyes chen bla ma gong ma rnams// skye 'gag med par sems kyi gshis// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnas lugs mchog /lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyal sa de// 'du 'bral med pa'i shugs kyis 'dzin// zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med// thams cad legs par 'ong du 'dra// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// pha rtag pa'i rgyal po chos kyi sku// dus gsum 'gyur med kyi gdan sa de// gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas ga la zin// yang pha bdag nyid chen po'i ku re la// bdag 'khrul pa'i byis pa a thang chad// bu nam mkha'i padmo ma 'dzin par// mnyam nyid kyi thang la ngal sos dang*// bde chen gyi dbyings su gnyid nas mchi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// // 291) ༄// 'gro ba'i don du yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba dpal shrī phug pa la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ thub pa'i dbang po dus gsum rgyal ba rnams// 'gro ba smin par thugs kyi dgongs pa gcig /skyon dang bral zhing yon tan rdzogs par mnyam// gdul bya smin par byed pa'i thabs tshul la// nga 'o nga rgyal zad cing bdag med pas// slob dpon slob ma rje bran khyo shugs sogs// cir yang ston pa'i bya ba rus su 'don// bdag pas khyed nyid yon tan che mod kyang*// bla ma yin pa'i dam tshig mdzad phyir dang*// 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// khyed kyis bdag la mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// phun sum tshogs pas 'brel ba med mod kyi// phying rul dug po 'chang bar 'gyur ba ltar// bdag gi lag nas byung ba'i dngos po la// phra bar gyur la rtsi tshad mdzad pa de// kho bo shin tu thugs la btags mod kyi// bra bo phul phyed rin med ma nu med// kha che gur gum rdzun du ma song tsam// shing rtsa rdog ma gsum po rtsis can lags// bco lnga spos la bre lnga kho na mchis// gsung snyan dril bu phyag mtshan phrugs gcig 'di// phog ro ma bas bzang bar bzod par mdzod// rag dung khams gsum gzil gnon 'bul zhing mchis// dbu zhu zhwa phrugs snam yug bco lnga 'bul// 'gro ba'i don phyir yun ring bzhugs par zhu/

dpal shrī phug pa// // 292) ༄// chos rje rin po che la dpal shrī phug pas bstod pa gser gyi phreng ba// oṃ swasti/ dpal dang 'byor ba phun tshogs bsam yas rgya yangs sa gzhir brtse chen yan lag brgyad ldan chus brlan la gnas mchog gi rtsa ba rab tu brtan// sku gnyis dpag bsam chen po mtshan dpe'i ljon pa rab rgyas zag med stobs sogs yid 'ong me tog sdug cing ye shes mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu mtha' yas bskrun// byams dang bde ba'i bsil ldan bsdu ba'i grib ngogs dge legs dri zhim ngad ldan dpag med phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab cing rgyun chad med par rab ldang bas// mchog gi dbang po nges par tshim zhing nyon mongs nyi zer rab tu tsha bas gdungs pa las skyob theg mchog snying pos skyong mdzad chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud// spros med lhun grub mi g.yo nam mkha' las// dmigs med thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul sprin bsdus te// lhan cig skyes pa 'brug gi sgra sgrogs shing*// gnyis med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun rab babs pas// gdul bya blo ldan padmo'i bskyed mos tshal// shes rab sdong bu'i byams pa'i 'dab ma bskyed// nyams myong ze'u 'bru rtogs pa'i snying po dag /gnyis med sbrang rtsis khyab mdzad rje la 'dud// mi 'gyur rdo rje gangs kyi spo la gnas// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i nga ro sgrogs pa yis// mtha' la zhen pa'i ri dwags rnams skrag cing*// grub mtha' dman pa'i wa tshogs myur du 'byer// bsdu ba'i rtsal ldan thabs mkhas mche sder gyis// zhen pa'i mtha' 'dzin glang chen klad 'gems shing*// rang gi rigs la mthu rtsal rgyas mdzad pa'i// mnyam med mi yi seng ger phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems gnyis rnam par grol ba'i spor// dam chos mtha' yas rtsi bcud me tog rgyas// zhi bde dge legs chu rgyun dal gyis 'bab// sdug bsngal skom pas gdung ba rab sel zhing*// so sor 'dod pas don gnyer skyes bu rnams// dad dang shes rab lag pa legs brkyang pas// ji ltar 'dod pa'i bde legs rtsi bcud stsol// mi 'gyur rnam dag spo la gus phyag 'tshal// gnas med khyab pa chos nyid gser gyi gzhi// yon tan mtha' yas rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus// lhan cig skyes pa ri bo mchog rab brjid// bslab gsum gser ri rnam dag rol pa'i mtsho// gsung rab dri med snying po gzigs pa'i gling*// 'gog pa med pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal// tshad med zla rgyas rdzu 'phrul skar mas bkod// 'gro rnams bde ba'i rten mdzad de la 'dud// nyon mongs ma lus tshangs pa'i bdag nyid can// dbang bcu 'byor ldan de ni dbang phyug gtso// sems can khams la thugs rjes khyab par 'jug

/dpal dang grags pas sbyin pas lha yi dbang*// lha mi'i ston pa chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur// dgos 'dod 'byung ba rin chen rnam bdun 'dzin// mtha' bzhi dgra las rgyal thabs legs mdzad pa// bcud ldan rje dpon chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// bde gshegs bla mar bcas pa'i chab srid skyong*// nges pa'i don ston ya lad sku la bgos// theg pa sna tshogs bkra ba'i ba dan bsnams// 'bad rtsol las 'das brtson pa'i glang chen bcibs// spros pa'i rang bzhin spros med gzigs pas dpa'// theg pa chen po rgya mtsho'i dmag dpung gis// phas rgol ma rungs nyon mongs sde bcom nas// mnyam pa med pa'i rgyal thabs mdzad la 'dud// sde snod 'dzin zhes dregs pa'i glang chen snam// zab mo'i lcags kyus brgyab ste nyid ji ltar// dgyes pa bzhin du rjes sgrub tshul du 'dul// bka' skyong chen pos bsgyur te las la sbyar// gzigs pas don sgrub 'gyur ba rnam par spangs// rjes 'brangs dang bcas bstan pa'i snying por rig /mdzad pa dpung bcas tshogs kyis yongs su bskor// 'dul ba'i sde dpon chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// chos rje nyid kyis byin rlabs dpag med pa'i// gzi brjid chen po lha mi'i 'jig rten 'dir// tshangs dang dbang po khyab 'jug drag po dang*// dri za lha min klu dbang la sogs pa'i// sde dpon chen po rnams kyis rtag par mchod// lha yi bu rnams nyid kyi dgyes pa sgrub// 'jig rten khams gang grangs snyed ji snyed na'ang*// 'gran zla med pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// lha dang mi yi gnas rnams gang lags dang*// klu gzhan gnas na ma mchis khyod lta bu// gangs chen mtsho dang brgya byin gnas 'khod ltar// da lta 'di na dgos 'dod 'byung ba ni// 'khod par gyur ba gcig pu dbang phyug nyid// rtog pa mi mnga' 'gro la rtag gzigs pa// skal ldan rgyal mtshan rtse la mchod pa'i tshe// yid bzhin re skong rin po che la 'dud// 'das dang ma 'ongs rab tu bkod pa ni// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rje// u dum wā ra'i me tog ji lta 'dir// khyod 'dra sngon chad ma byung phyis mi 'byung*// da lta gdul bya rnam dag bsod nams kyi// snang bas rnam 'phrul mdzad pa mtha' yas pas// smin grol mthar phyin mu mtha' brjod mi lang*// rab tu 'byon dka' byon pa de la 'dud// ye shes sgrol ma rab tu gsal ba yis// rgyu 'bras la rmongs 'gro tshogs ma lus pa'i// ma rig mun pa'i smag rum rab bsal nas// rgyu 'bras phra ba'i dngos po gsal mdzad pas// rnam smin phra ba'i phra la rab skrag cing*// dge ba'i me tog phra mo bskyed la sbyar// rgyu 'bras rnams la ma rmongs ze'u 'brur gsal// ldongs par 'byed mdzad de la gus phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags la sogs nad kyis gdungs rnams la// bzlog pa'i sman dang gnyen por 'gyur ba'i tshul// tha dad du mar phye ste rab sbyar nas// gnyis med lam gyi rta la bskyon nas su// brtse ba'i phyag gis dal gyi rab bstsal bas// mgo mnan rang bzhin shes pa'i stobs kyis bcom// nad rnams ma lus skad gcig de la bsal// sman pa'i rgyal po de la gus phyag 'tshal// chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel snying por gzigs// mnyam par ma bzhag gnas skabs yongs mi mnga'// sku gsung thugs kyi spyod lam ma lus kun// ye shes las gzhan phra ba'i go skabs med// mdzad pa mtha' dag don dang ldan gyur pa// snying po'i snying po nyid du nye bar ston// 'bad rtsol ma dmigs ngang gis lhun gyis grub// dpal ldan bde gshegs bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'jig rten khams 'dir rigs kyi snod 'dzin rnams// mtshan tsam thos pas dad pa'i bdud rtsis 'gengs// lhun po gser gyi mdog 'dra'i sku mthong na// skad cig de la sems yang gzhan don gyi// spobs pa mtha' yas dpal dang ldan par mdzad// tshangs dbyangs rgyal po'i gsung ni rab bsgrags pas// rnam grol cha 'dzin mi ldog rgyal ba'i sras// bskrun pa'i yum gyur de la gus pas 'dud// sum cu bdun rdzogs pho brang bkod pa can// mi g.yo rab tu rgyas pa'i sa phyogs su// chos kyi phung po yang dag don gyi rdzing*// ma 'dres mkhyen pa'i utpal tshal rab rgyas// legs par rtag gsung phu chu'i rgyun sgra snyan// sna tshogs blo la bye brag bkod ma'i chu// rab tshim me tog du ma'i kha dog can// ma 'dres rdzogs mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spro dang sdud pa po// sems dpa' rgya mtshos bskor ba'i dbus su rol// dgra bcom rgya mtsho chen po stobs mnga' ba// chos skyong rgya mtsho chen po'i ru dar 'phyar// theg mchog rgya mtsho chen po'i bang mdzod 'dzin// gdul bya rgya mtsho chen po grol bar mdzad// ting 'dzin rgya mtsho chen po sgo 'byed pa// yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// tshangs pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi bsnyen bkur gnas// lha yi dbang po rnams kyi dpung dang dpal// lha min rgyal po rnams kyi skyabs kyi mchog

/klu yi rgyal po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor// gnod sbyin rgyal po rnams kyi cod pan mdzes// dri za'i rgyal po rnams kyi dgos 'dod gter// mi yi rgyal po rnams kyi bde legs tshal// 'jig rten dbang rnams smin mdzad rje la 'dud// chos dbyings rnam dag yangs pa'i ri rgyal brtan// sems nyid rnam rol zab pa ri rgyal brjid// dbyer med zung 'jug ri rgyal lhang nger gsal// 'khor 'das mnyam pa'i ri rgyal 'gyur ba bral// gzod nas lhun grub ri rgyal skye ba med// spang gnyen ma dmigs ri rgyal lhun po spa// re dogs med pa'i ri rgyal dus gsum stong*// gnyis bral chos sku'i ngang du bdag phyag 'tshal// 'di ltar snang ba'i bkod pa 'di dag rnams// bkod med ngang du rnam par grol bar spyod// ye shes lhan skyes gnyug ma mtha' las 'das// gcig dang tha dad phra ba'i phra bas stong*// zhen pa'i brtag pa'i dri mas ma gos pa// brtags pas mi rtogs ma brtag pas ma yin// gnyis su 'dzin pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs mod// yongs su gzigs med gzigs la dmigs med 'dud// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag /sku gsum bdag nyid ye shes stobs dang bcas// mtshan dpes rnam spras sprul pa du ma 'gyed// rigs lnga 'dus pa'i tshul gcig rdo rje 'chang*// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal mgon thugs rje can// 'jig rten ston pa shākya'i rgyal po nyid// mkhyen pa gnyis med yon tan bsam mi khyab// 'dren pa dpe zla med pa de la 'dud// khyod kyi yon tan mtha' yas gyur pa ni// bskal par brjod kyang rdzogs par mi 'gyur la// tshangs sogs 'jig rten bcas pas bgrang mi lang*// rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// rgyal sras dpa' bo chen po rnams kyis kyang*// gzhal bar mi nus de yang bsam las 'das// de phyir rgya mtsho che las chu thigs dag

/skras blangs gyur pa tsam zhig 'dir bstod lags// slad ma nyid sku lhun po lta bu ni// 'gro ba rnams slad rtag tu bzhugs zhes dang*// zhi bde'i char gyis brlan par mdzad ces pa// g.yar 'bangs bdag gis phyogs kyi 'grul la khums// rab tu dga' ba'i mdangs ldan gyur pa ni// ye shes gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhin// de ltar bzhugs pa bdag sogs thams cad la// bka' drin chen po'i skyabs kyis skyong mdzad lags// 'bad pa med pa brtson pa'i 'khor lo yis// skad cig 'grib med gzhan don mdzad pa la// yang dag nyid du mnyel sogs mi mnga' yang*// kun rdzob snang bas kha cig drang ba'i phyir// thugs kyi mdzad pa dgyes par spyod pa dang*// sku mchog nyams dang ldan par bzhugs pa dang*// zab mo'i don ldan rtag par gsung ba la// cung zad mnyel ba'i rnam pa mi mnga' ba// nyid kyi bstod brjod gser gyi phreng ba ni// yon tan 'dod chags dga' dgu rab snyoms pa// 'phags dbyangs srad bu la brgyus mdo 'dzin rgyun// khyad par 'phags 'di gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes// de slad chos rje'i spyan sngar gsol bgyi ba// zhu ba'i don cig ring nas drung du mchis// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis rab gzigs la// cung zad gnas pa'i skabs gcig dbye bar zhu// sngon chad bsod nams bsags par gyur pa yis// nyid dang 'brel ba'i rtsa ba rab brtan zab// yod par gyur pa'i rkyen des gnas skabs der// chos rje chen po'i spyan sngar lhags par gyur// de tshe bka' bstsal rten 'brel zab mo'i gsungs// bsam pa g.yos pas lha la gus pas btud// lam gyi rim pa'i sngon 'gro dag dang sbyar// brtson pas nan tan nyams su blang bar bgyis// skabs der mtshan ldan dpal 'dzin dgon pa de// mdun na gser gyi maṇḍal lta bu'i thang*// bsreg bya btsal phyir de ru phyin pa na// skad cig de la don gcig rab tu rnyed// chos kyi rje la zhus pas legs gsung la// ro gcig nyid du nges par bskyed de gsal// yun du bsten pa'i stobs kyi go cha mchis// smin byed mdor bsdus snod rung gyis zhes gnang*// gsung ltar bsgrubs te mang po yod pa dag

/ma 'khyams legs par gyur pas dgyes byed lags// de slad bde legs yon tan thams cad ni// rtsa bar gyur pa 'di las byung ba lags// gzhan du rnyed pa'ang ma lags btsal ma lags// rtag tu gsung bzhin bgyis pa nyid du rtogs// dus phyis bdag gi sems ni g.yos pa las// nyid kyi drung du lhags nas rab zhus pas// gnang ba rnyed pas yul gzhan bgrod pa'i phyir// dal gyi dal gyis nye bar 'ongs pa las// gnod sbyin sde dpon sprin gyi phreng ba can// bzhugs gnas rma chen spom ra'i zhol du ni// lo grangs kha cig bsod snyoms bgyis pa la// ngo srung sla ba'i yul der dge sbyor 'phel// dgon pa bsten pa'i dge sbyong kha cig byung*// zang zing cung zad rnyed sogs nyid kyi mthu// bdag ni mos gus grogs dang rang 'grogs te// dpal ldan nyid dang 'bral ba'i skabs ma mchis// dran pa rgyun chags ngang du gnas pa las// ting 'dzin khyad par gzhan na ci yang med// bskyed rdzogs la sogs lam gyi rnam pa ni// de las gzhan pa'i bgrod bya ma mchis lags// nyon mongs sna tshogs yul dang bcas pa yi// spros pa rnams kyi rang bzhin spros med rtogs// 'khor 'das dus gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu ni// lhan cig skyes pa'i tha mal shes pa nyid// dbyings rig dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang nyid la// bzang por brtags pa'i sangs rgyas thob du med// spang blang re dogs gang du gnas ma mchis// brjod pa dang bral brjod pas yongs mi rtogs// 'dzin pa dang bral 'dzin pas kun tu dben// dngos po dang bral dngos po'i ngo bo nyid// dgag sgrub bral ba 'di nyid chos kyi sku// bde dang gsal ba'i rang bzhin sku nyid lags// yin snyam 'ching bas ma dkris rtsa ba chad// e ma ngo mtshar rmad byung mtha' las grol// sgom zhes 'dzin pas bral ba'i rang bzhin du// 'bad rtsol ma dmigs bdag ni bde bar gnas// de slad phyogs nas nye bar 'ongs pa'i mi// ngal zhing dub pa'i rngul gyis lus khebs shing*// gtso bo zas nor don gnyer bcos ma'i wa// khas 'che rgyal ba kha cig lhags pa las// chos rje'i rjes 'dzin lhag par 'gyur grang ba// rnam pa mang po rtag par mchis par khums// de la rab dga' gus pas zer gyis su// rgyun chad med par rgyas par rab tu bstod// don gzhan nyid kyi legs brdzangs bka' yig dag

/snyan par gyur pa phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin las// mi mthun ston pa rgyan gyi tshig gis su// nyid pas bdag la yon tan che zhes gda'// 'di ltar brtags pas de yi dgongs pa ni// drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don la sogs// gang zhig lags pa shes par ma gyur pas// nyin mtshan dpyod pa'i stobs kyis bdag rab dub// sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad la// rgyu mtshan med pa cung zad mi mnga' na// nyid pas yon tan mang zhes gsung ba de// gang las 'ongs pa'i 'brel pa ji ltar lags// bdag la bsam pa tshul min de lta bu// rlom pa'i stobs dag cung zad mchis gyur na// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas legs gsungs chos// de skyong rnams ni dgyes par yongs mi 'gyur// bdag gi dpang po bdag nyid chen po lags// spyan sngar 'gum zhing yon tan skye mi 'gyur// dus rnams kun tu skyabs gzhan gnas med na// ci la dgongs te de skad gsungs par 'gyur// bdag cag dpung bcas rtag tu ngal bcas shing*// bran g.yog bgyis pa ji ltar gang du lags// da lta nye bar mi gnas bdag yin pas// lus kyi stobs kyis der las mi bgyis mod// da ni spros pa'i g.yeng ba rab bskyungs nas// nags khrod gcig tu dben par gnas bgyis snyam// 'on kyang bdag gi sems ni dri ma bral// zla ba rgyas pa bzhin du gsal bar mchis// de yi yon tan mi bslu gyur ba des// ches gsal nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ba lags// nyid kyi bka' brgyud dri ma med pa ni// rgyan dang bcas pa skyong bar byed pa yang*// bdag gis bgyis la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dpal ldan chos rje nyid rab dgyes par 'os// ji ltar brgyud 'dzin mi 'dzin gang lags pa// gnyis med snying por byas te rab bskyangs pas// mi phyed dad pa rgyud la skyes pa dang*// rtogs ldan rnam mang yon tan legs rig 'tshal// rtogs ldan yon tan med par gyur pa ni// nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod mi 'byung ngam// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la shar ba la// 'od zer med pa srid par mi 'gyur ltar// yon tan mtha' yas nyid la mnga' bas ni// grangs med 'gro rnams smin par mdzad la mod// 'dam skyes padma 'dam gyis mi gos ltar// 'gro rnams smin mdzad skyes rnams dri ma bral// ji ltar sprin chen glog dang bcas pa las// char pa bab pas lo tog smin byed ltar// rtogs ldan yon tan bcas pa'i sprin chen las// dge ba'i lo thog smin byed chos char 'bebs// de bas sngon chad brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// rtogs dang yon tan zung du 'brel ba yis// 'gro ba mang po smin dang grol byas shing*// slar yang nyid kyis rgyas par mdzad lags mod// de ltar mdzad pa mtha' yas bzhugs bzhin du// bdag la de skad gsung ba rigs sam ci// yon tan cung zad snang bar gyur na yang*// nyid las byung bar gyur pa ma lags sam// de ltar yin yang bdag la de skad ces// gsung ba'i gnas ni ci yang ma mchis so// mi bdog bzhin du gsungs par gyur pa la// bdag gi sems ni 'di ltar dpyod pas gzer// ci phyir mi dgyes yod pa su yis byas// gang gis dgyes byed de ni gang lags snyam// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yi// bu gcig gces par 'dod pas don gsol ltar// bla med chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar yang*// bdag gis gsol bgyis de yang de 'drar 'dod// slad mar chab yig 'di rten bde gshegs kyis// byin gyis brlabs pa rgya chen las byung ba'i// zi pol mchog gyur dri ro reg bya dang*// bsnams myangs reg pas brtson zhing ting 'dzin gsal// dpal sder mthong bas nyes pa rnams 'joms shing*// bde legs rnams grangs ming gzhan nag rug ces// rgya gar yul sogs gzhan na dkon pa yi// sman gyi khyad par rgya ma bzhi bcu 'bul// bdag gis dge ba gang bgyis dpag med dang*// bgyid gyur da lta'i bye brag ma lus pas// sems can khams rnams grol ba'i sar bzhugs nas// chos rje nyid kyi go 'phang thob par shog
/bdag kyang rgyun chad med par 'gro rnams kyi// 'dren pa'i sde dpon nyid du 'gyur ba dang*// chos rje bla ma rtag tu mnyes byed cing*// stobs sogs rgyal srid myur du 'dzin gyur cig/ //

293) ༄// dpal phag mo gru pa'i mthong chos bzhi tha dad med pa'i tshul bstan pa// na mo gu ru/ rje sa bdag rgyal po'i bka' bstsal dang*// snang ba sems kyi grub mtha' dang*// rkyen nyid 'di pa'i rten 'brel dang*// dpal phag mo gru pa'i mthong chos bzhi// tha dad med cing bye brag spangs// gcig tu gyur pa 'di re dga'// jo bo ba la zhu ba lags// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i srid spangs nas// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// zab mo thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'di las med par zhal gyis bzhes// legs par dgongs sam jo bo rje// skyabs su mchi 'o bcom ldan 'das// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// brtul zhugs dpag tu med pa yis// grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i// 'bras bu rten 'brel thugs su chud// skyob pa de yi rjes 'jug pa// rten 'brel gang gis mthong ba des// bla med dkon mchog gsum mthong bar// thub pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes// kye legs par dgongs sam jo bo pa// yang legs par dgongs sam jo bo pa// 'di legs par dgongs sam jo bo pa// nged kyi pa phas de skad gsungs// mthar thug zab pa'i rten 'brel 'di// dus gsum rgyal bas thugs su chud// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// shākya'i rgyal pos thugs su chud// ngam shod dpal gyi phag mo grur// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsungs// 'di sla mo ma lags dka' mo lags// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gang du yang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs ma gtogs pa// gzhan du rnyed par 'gyur mi srid// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// mi kho bo'i bla mas de skad gsungs// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid dang*// yon tan mthar phyin bla ma rje// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces// ston pa shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs// rtag cing 'gyur med dam pa'i chos// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog

/dbyer med byang chub sems su bstan// thub mgon bla ma gong ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dis// 'gro ba smin par bya'o zhes// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas// mdze bo'i grong khyer nyugs na yang*// mdze zhal mthong ba dka' bar byung*// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// bag yangs dben pa'i ri khrod du// gdul bya skal ldan dpag med pa// 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa yi// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra rgya mtsho la// 'dus pa'i skal ldan sprin phung bzhin// mkhas dang btsun dang bsgrub pa la// brtag dpyad ci yang mi dgos pa// dpag tu med pa'i tshogs 'dus 'dir// dam chos ston pa dga' mor gda'// res 'ga' skyid pa'i tho le rgyal// res 'ga' sdug pa'i nga re sdug /res 'ga' btang snyoms ci dgar gnas// dge 'dun tshogs pa'i so nam du// kha smras zang zing 'dod yon sgrub// bdag la brtse ba'i slob ma yis// khyod kyi dam chos 'di kun yang*// zhang lcam rjes bzhin thal lo zer// legs par brtags na 'di re bden// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// dpal ldan stag lung thang pa grongs// mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen med// legs par ngo so gsol sa med// nyes na zhe bas khrel dgos bral// 'phongs shing thug pa'i dge 'dun la// za ma cig gi skru sa med// ston pa'i bstan pa'i gzhi rten mchog /skyes chen rin chen sgang pa dang*// bdag nyid chen po gong ma rnams// 'og min dga' ldan gnas su gshegs// dpal chen shrī ri phug pa dang*// skyes chen rje btsun ras pa dang*// kha rag rje btsun rin chen rnams// rgas shing thug pa'i bla ma rnams// rgyal ba rje btsun gong ma la// gces ka mdzad pa ga la srid// sems can zhing la sangs rgyas skyes// dge ba'i bshes la rag las pas// 'di las lhag pa'i bya rgyu med// de la ku re mdzad mi srid// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'ching bas bcings// so nam chags sdang gnyis la byed// 'dod yon don du gnyer ba yis// so bsod

dben pa e skyid lta mi srid// mtha' drug ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig /dpag na yod pa ma lags sam// dge 'dun mi skyong ngo zhes grags// nus pa yod pa'i skyes chen gyi// zab pa'i dgongs par ngas ma shes// da ni ban rgan ske rags 'chings// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu des// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa sgrub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin 'gyur shog/ // 294) ༄// cig car dang rim gyis gnyis su med pa shākya ye shes dang grags 'byung la gsungs pa// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal chos rje rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// mgon po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// bdag blo mun pa dwangs mdzad pas// ngar snabs lta bu bdag 'dra yang*// nyi ma'i 'od kyis rnam par 'tsher// 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' drin gyis// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la// nges shes cung zad skyes pa 'di// gus pas zhus pa'i bu la gdams// 'dir rten gyi gang zag kha cig dang po kho nar 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa las rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rim pas ji bzhin du rgyud la skyes nas/ gzod bdag med rnam pa gnyis bsgom par bya ba 'di kho na yin cing*/ gzhan gang yang ma yin zhes gsung ba dang*/ yang kha cig na re stong pa nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom par bya ste/ de la yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad yar ldan gyis ma tshang ba med la/ de ltar yang*/ stong nyid bsgoms pas grol 'gyur gyi// bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin// lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa kun// theg pa dman la bstan pa yin// zhes pa la sogs pa stong pa nyid gcig pus chog par bzhed pa dang rnam pa gnyis yin no// de la rnam pa gnyis po 'di gang ltar byas kyang thub pa'i gsung rab tu mi bzhugs pa'am/

rang dga'am rang bzo'am gzu lum du gyur pa ni ma mchis te/ gong ma ltar na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du bskal pa dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rab gcig tu nges pa ni lung yin/ rigs pa'am 'thad pa'i dbang du byas kyang*/ gzhi med pa la khyad par gyi chos 'grub tu mi btub cing gzhi la brten nas skas kyi rim pa ltar gong nas gong du bgrod pa ni 'thad cing rigs pa/ nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag ni jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi rjes su 'brang zhing tshul lugs 'di ltar nyams su len pa 'di la 'gal ba med cing ngo mtshar du gyur pa'o// phyi ma ltar byas na/ rten gyi gang zag dang po nas stong pa nyid la dga' ba'i rigs can zhig bla ma rtogs pa dang ldan pa cig dang phrad nas stong pa nyid kyi don rgyud la skye ba yang mi 'gal te/ 'di yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ cig car ba bya ba ni mi srid/ tshe snga ma phan chad la bsod nams kyi tshogs gong du bsags pa las 'dir dge sbyor cig car du skye ba de yang snga ma la ltos pa'i rim gyis pa yin gsungs/ de ltar gyur na cig car ba dang rim gyis pa yang gnyis su mi 'dug snga phyi nyams su len pa'i tshul la yang mi mthun pa med/ thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du yang sems bskyed ma thag tu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa dang*/ sems bskyed nas bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i 'og rol du gzod mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa gnyis la 'gal ba med par khong du chud par bya'o// gong du mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas/ yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa de gzod skye ba 'di yang ston pa'i gsung rab tu gsungs te/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa dang*/

sa bcu'i rim pa rgyud la skyes nas yon tan skye bar gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin la/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ de ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// stong nyid 'di ni bsgom byas nas// blo ni gzhan don la dga' bar// 'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med// ces pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems rgyun rtogs pa dwangs pa'i 'od gsal ma mchis par// byams dang snying rje'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar 'dod pa yi// skyes bu rnams ni g.ya' ma las byas me long blta// zhes pa la sogs pa ston pa'i bka' dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs pa gong ma'i gsung dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ 'thad cing yongs su grags pa'i dbang du byas kyang stong pa nyid mngon par rtogs pa'i sa gzhi la yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pa'i 'bras bu 'char ba la yang mthun/ rgyu tshogs gnyis las 'bras bu sku gnyis 'byung bar yang mthun/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa la yon tan ji snyed pa mkhyen pa stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar mthun na/ nged tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag 'jig rten gyi pha rol gyi g.yang sa chen po ni ma mthong*/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pas ni bcings/ phyogs 'dzin gyi blo mi shes pa'i drwa bar chud pa rnams/ shes rab kyi go ma phyes pas nyams su len pa'i tshul la rmongs nas/ 'khor ba'i pha mthar phyin par mi nus pa la dgos pa ni ci yod/ snying po ni ci len/ then chags zhen lo'i snyan grags khe grags kyis ni ci la phan/ snyam du legs par bsams nas blo phyogs lhung med par gnas par bya'o// 'di'i dgongs pa gang zhig yin snyam na/ rim gyis pa dang cig car ba mi mthun pa dang*/ thabs gtso bor smra ba dang*/ shes rab gtso bor smra ba mi mthun pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa gtso bor so sor smra ba mi mthun pa rnams ni so sor rang gi nyams su myong bas rtogs pa phyogs gcig pa dang*/

slob dpon gyi 'dod lugs phyogs char then pa dang*/ sngon gyi goms pas mos pa tha dad pa skye ba shin tu rigs pa yin mod kyi/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi tshad mar gyur pa/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab la 'gran gyis do zla med par gyur cing*/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thub pa chen po de nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa mtha' dag thams cad gru bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dbal dang dgur nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa las dang po ba'i rten gyi gang zag jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi bstan pa'i rim pa ji bzhin du nyams su blang ba'i khrid kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs nas/ tshad med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po ches 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i byang chub kyi sems lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa g.yo med pas 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul lugs/ thub pa chen po 'dis snyigs ma rnam pa lnga'i zhing bzung nas gdul bar dka' ba'i gdul bya 'dul bar byed pa la/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin rgya mtsho 'khrugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis theg pa gsum las yang dag par 'da' bar/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum mam dpag tu med par bya dka' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzad nas/ byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i thub pa chen po/ 'og min gnas mchog dam pa der// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po ni 'dir sangs rgyas// zhes pas/ 'og min du rnam par snang mdzad chen po'am/ rdo rje 'chang chen por sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de'i dam pa'i chos theg pa chen po gsang sngags rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las/

rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa gsum ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud nyams su blang ba'i mthun rkyen nam cha lag tsam du gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ rgyud sde rin chen bzhi po ni// bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med rgyud// dang pos lus spyod gtso bor ston// gnyis pas ngag spyod gtso bor ston// gsum pas sems spyod gtso bor ston// bzhi pas lhan skyes 'ba' zhig go /zhes pa dang gsum po 'di cha lag tu ston pas 'di ltar gsungs pa yin zhes bka' bstsal dpag tu med pa gsungs te/ mdor bsdu na sku gsung thugs rdo rje gdod ma nas lhan cig skyes pa/ dang po nas byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rnam par grags// zhes pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus par gsungs pa dang*/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang ltar snang*// zhes pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom par gsungs shing*/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad las kyang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pas/ bla na med pa'i rgyud mtha' dag tu sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'gyur ba med pa lhun gyis grub pa de/ mi shes ma rig pas bsgribs pas/ mi shes ma rig pa'i ling tog de/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas las brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa phyin ci ma log pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i mthu mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa la/ las dang skal par ldan pa'i mos gus kyi shugs rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs g.yo ba lta bus bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas pa las/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu zhes// bla ma rin po ches gsungs pas// mtshan yang rin po cher 'dogs shing mos gus can gyi slob ma gser dngul lta bu'i snod lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes seng ge'i 'o ma lta bus gang bar byed pa ni/

tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing*/ rin po che nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pa de'i don glo bur gyi dri ma mos gus dang byin rlabs kyi rkyen gyis skad cig gis mi gnas par mdzad pa la dbang zhes gsungs pa ste/ sgyur ba dang*/ smin pa dang*/ rtogs par mdzad pa dbang gi go bar byed pa ni de kho na yin te/ de nyams su blang ba'i rim pa lung dang 'thad pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung dang*/ rang gi nyams su myong bas de ltar shes par byas shing nyams su blang bar bya'o// de yang dang po kho nar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmor gtugs nas/ mos gus rgya chen po dang ldan pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi ded dpon du gyur pas/ thub pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug gi nor bu rin po che thabs mkhas pa dang bya dka' ba dpag tu med pas 'bad pa las sku gsung thugs rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gdod ma nas rang chas su yod pa/ rang gi nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa khong du chud pa'i rten gyi gang zag des/ thub pa chen pos dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i brjod bya sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi gtso bo/ dang por smos pa'i dgon pa nags khrod dben pa'i gnas su tshul khrims rin po ches spang bya dang gnyen po ngo shes par byas nas/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis ma gos pa la pang du sbrul 'ongs pa'am mgo la me shor ba ltar/ dang por ma byung bar bya ba dang*/ byung na myur du spong ba tsam ma gtogs pa nyams su blang rgyu mang po yod pa ma lags te/ de nyid 'ba' zhig nyams su blangs nas de nyid kyis g.yen spyos na/ bcud med pa'i snod stong pa byi dor byed pa dang 'dra bas 'di la yang snying por mi blta ste/

bla ma dam pa las thob pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po rang la yod pa phyi ba dang 'dra bar/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la gnas shing*/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje nyams su blang ba'i rim pa nyin mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i chos drug ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po phyi ba rnam pa gsum gyis legs par phyis pa dgos 'dod kyi re ba thams cad phun sum tshogs par byung ma thag pa sngar bstan pa'i khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de/ dben pa'i gnas su glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byas pa dang*/ dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi skus dam bcas pa'i shes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par byed pa de dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi sku 'di nyid kyis byed pa 'ba' zhig tu shes par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa la zhen pa'i nga rgyal gyis yang dang yang du rang gis rang la phye gtor zhing*/ bdag gir bya zhes pa de bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba/ ma rig pa'i mun pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po'i rba klong 'di nyid kyis byed par ga la nus te/ de ltar yang*/ lus dang ngag yid yod na khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rnams dang mnyam par mi 'gyur na// rnam gsum rnam par dag pas bde chen ngo bo nyid// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa khyod ni 'dus ma byas// zhes pa dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi sku de la yon tan dang phrin las dbyer med par gyur nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pa dang*/

rang nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rjer gyur pa dang gnyis/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag pa dang mar la mar bzhag pa ltar gnyis su med par gcig tu gyur nas lhun gyis grub cing rtsol sgrub med pa 'di nyid kyis sngon dam bcas pa'i shes pa byang chub kyi sems de rdzogs pa ma yin nam snyam du bsam par bya'o// 'di ni lung dang 'thad pa dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung*/ rang gi nyams su myong ba yang sngon a pha 'di'i bu dang a ma 'di'i bu mo yin pas/ dus da lta'i dus su rang gzhan gyi don 'byung ba ma yin/ bla ma dam pa'i chos rin po che nyams su blangs pa las byung ba yin/ chos kyang po ti dang yang a cang ches te rang gi sems chos su song ba la zer ba yin/ de las 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad 'byung ba yin pas da rung rang gi dge sbyor de kho na la nan tan che bar nyams su blang ste/ de ltar yang rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ dben pa'i gnas su rab bsdad nas// rgyun chad med par bsgom lags na// 'dod pa med kyang dbang med du// dpal gyi ri la dar chen phyar// dgos dgu mi 'dod bzhin du 'ong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bsgoms pa las thams cad 'ong ba yin/ de la rang gzhan thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'ong na/ 'di 'dra lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du bsams la bsgrub pa la nan tan shin tu che bar bya'o// rtsa ba snying por gyur pa'i rang gi dge sbyor ni bzhag dge ba'am mi dge ba'am/ bar chad dam/ dngos grub bam/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs sam bdud kyi bar chad dngos brgyud dang*/ rang gzhan la phan pa dang bde ba dang*/ gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bsgrub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin cha med la/ phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub ma shes/ nyes pa dang phung ba gnod pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur cing*/ bdag 'dzin gyi khe grags sgrub pa la snying por gyur na bdud kyi bar chad/ ngan song gi rgyu bsags/ 'bras bu rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro/

phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang chad du 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ rgya la re shig skyes bu yis// sems la lta ba 'di rnams spangs// mya ngan 'das la rgyab kyis phyogs// byang chub kyi sems zhig gzhan nas btsal// tshig tshogs kyi spros pa nyer gzigs te// tha snyad kyi spros pa rnams bsams pas// bsgrub pa'i dam tshig rtsa nas nyams// mi 'dod kyi 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba// dbang med kyi rgyu 'bras ma lags sam// zhes gsungs pas/ thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis gcig tu gyur pa 'di la nan tan dang gces spras shin tu che bar bya zhing*/ de las gzhan pa ni skad cig tsam yang bsam par mi bya na/ nyon mongs pa skyes pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ las bya ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te spang bar bya ba gal che gsungs/ btsan thong dbang med du bsam pa'i nyams su myong ba 'di tsam la brten nas ma 'khrul bar 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang ba dang*/ dus da lta'i dus na phrad phrad dang shi la khad dang*/ 'bad pa zad pa med pa cig byas kyang gcig tsam la phan pa yang dka'/ sprang phrug tshe ma phyid/ nam ma langs/ phas ma sos/ mas ma khyogs pa/ mi mang po 'dus pa'i phyogs su bor ba la rtsi tshad gnam tsam byas/ bzang skad 'brug tsam bsgrags/ gces tshod bu gcig tsam/ mchod bkur bla ma ltar byas/ ngo mtshar che lo che lo byas kyang gser gyi bu chung sol bar 'gyur ba la tshegs med par 'dug sna thung shal gyis 'gro ba la tshegs med par 'dug khyod kyi drin med/ ngas khyod dang khyod kyi grwa pa ma bsad pa khyod rang kha rje che ba yin khyod rang tshod bzung*/ khyod nga'i lag tu ltung nges zer bar 'dug pa/ btsun lugs gsum dang brtul zhugs gsum gyi grwa sa dkrugs/

khyim sun 'byin/ bstan pa snub/ dam pa thams cad yid skyo bar byed par 'dug pa/ 'di 'dra ba'i grwa pa la gdung ba'i blo bzhag smig rgyu'i rgya mtsho ma bsnyags nas bsgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas/ phyi ba rnam pa gsum gyis nor bu rin po phyis/ 'bad pa chen po byas nas/ khyod ni mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus gcod par byed// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas/ phyogs su mos gus dang gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis gong du smos pa ltar mthong ba tsam dang*/ dran pa tsam dang*/ dad pa tsam dang*/ bsgoms pa tsam gyis rang nyid rdo rje rnam gsum dang*/ gzhan dag rdo rje rnam gsum la// dbye ba med par gcig gyur pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// 'di'i dgongs pa gang yin na bsgom rgyu rang la yod pa ngo shes par byas nas/ dben pa'i gnas su glo bur gyi dri ma phyis pas/ sku gsum lhun grub tu 'char bas da 'gro ba'i don la snga phyi chen po mi 'dug rin po'i che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa bsgrub la nan tan shin tu che bar bya'o zhes gdams pa 'di ni shākya ye shes dang*/ shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa la smras pa'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa'o// de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ thub mgon ston pa bcom ldan gyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung ba'i tshul// mthong chos skyes nas myong 'gyur dang*// lan grangs gzhan la myong zhes gsungs// sbyor ba'i chos dang dngos gzhi dang*// 'bras bu smin par gyur pa las// rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dgongs ni// rim gyis pa las gzhan pa yi// cig car mi srid nges pa'i phyir// zhe 'dod phyogs ris spangs pa yis// thub pa'i gsung bzhin nyams su blang*// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa dang*// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// nyams len cung zad 'dir smos pa// ston pas legs par gsungs pa yi// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa la// nan tan chen por bslab pa ste// sbyangs pa'i yon tan gzhir gnas nas// lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang tshul du// yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// phun sum tshogs 'gyur yon tan ni// bla ma mnyes par byas pa las// legs par byung ba'i sku gsung thugs// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje ni// dbang gi rgyal po rin chen zhes// bla ma sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs// gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pa// de nyid dben pa'i gnas dag tu// glo bur dri ma dag par bya// dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku las// yon tan phrin las thams cad kun// gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis 'byung*// sems can khams dang rang gi khams// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yis// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa'i// 'khor lo chen por 'gyur ba 'di// dam pa rnams kyis nyams su blang*// dus ngan tha ma'i srog chags kun// rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na// bdag 'dra dman pas smos ci dgos// de bas 'jig rten bsam pa gtang*// sgrub pa snying por byas gyur na// mthong dang thos dang dran pas kyang*// 'khor ba srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// thar mdzad ded dpon chos kyi rjer// 'gyur bar the tshom ma mchis pas// bu sdug sgrub pa snying por mdzod// mchog gi nye gnas bsgrub pa yi// chos bzhi snying por byed pa yis// bla ma mnyes par 'dod pa yi// nye gnas gnyis kyis zhus pa lags// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// thos bsam sgom pa gang byas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes pa dang*// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// 'dis mtshon dge ba thams cad kyis// bcom ldan dus gsum mgon po rnams// thugs rje chen pos dgongs pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnams// dar zhing rgyas par gyur ba yis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog
/cig car dang rim gyis pa gnyis su med par lam nyams su blang ba'i rim pa gnyis med rdo rje rin po che rdzogs so// //

295) ༄// bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dge bshes kha rags par gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// rang sems bla ma'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// rang sems gzhan la phan pa'i blo// byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /lus ngag yid gsum he ru kaḥ /gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// 'gyur ba med cing rtag pa nyid// yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// dus rnams kun tu mi 'bral ba// skyes bu chen po khyed nyid la// bkra shis rgyun chad med par gnas// bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa// dus rnams kun tu bkra shis par// rtag tu bkra shis rgyun chad med// bkra shis mchog gis bkra shis shog /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// khyed la 'khrul pa yong mi mnga'// ji ltar mdzad pa thams cad la// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gi /thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad pa las// gzhan du 'gyur ba spu tsam med// de la nyes 'khrul ga la yod// sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa la// de sngon 'khrul pa mi mnga' na// da 'dir 'khrul pa ga la srid// khyed kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa kun// bar chad med par rdzogs gyur cig /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ḍoṃ bhi pa// tsarya rin chen rgyal po la// ji ltar gsungs pa'i bka' bstsal gyis// blo thag chod cing shes pa bde// bsam gyis mi khyab 'gro ba kun// smin par mdzad pa ma gtogs pa// bsod snyoms dro gcig slong na yang*// dpag tu med pas bsgrub dgos na// de las gzhan pa smos ci dgos// bdag gi ske rag 'ching lugs kyang*// de dang 'dra ba kho nar zad// nga yi drung nas 'ongs pa dang*// nga yi tshig dang yi ge la// khyed kyis mdzad dang brtul zhugs kyis// log par bsgrubs pa ga la srid// khyed kyis dgongs pa gang yin pas// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa la// the tshom nem nur mi srid pas// thams cad kun la dbang mdzad zhu// kha rag pa//

// 296) ༄// gong ma'i zhabs tog sdig pas mi zhu zhes 'dan ma ye shes grags la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rgyal po rin po ches/ nga yi bu dam pa slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'dan ma ye shes grags pa la gdams pa/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad chos zab mo zhig nyams su blangs pa'i dus su sdig sgrib 'dag ces pa de da lta'i khyed rang gis nyams su myong ba de kho na yin/ de la bar du gcod par 'gyur ba dang*/ yon tan du 'gyur ba dang*/ rang so thub pa dang gsum yin/ yon tan du 'gyur pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis/ skyid sdug nyes tshogs bar chad thams cad byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis dang por btsir gyis bzung nas/ de nyid chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po yin pas/ de nyid la ma yengs par bsgoms pas de rang sar yal nas 'gro ste/ de ltar yang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nas// nang sems su shes pa'i ting 'dzin la// ngas rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa bsten// zhes pa de kho na yin pas de kho na rgyun chad med par nyams su blang*/ gtso bor bde sdug byung ba'i dus su yin/ bde sdug med pa'i dus tshod du ha cang shes pa gzir drags na zhan du 'gro ba srid pas blta la tshod gzung*/ nad dang gnod pa dang bde sdug gang ci yang rung ba la nyams su myong ba cig skyes pa'i dus su mtha' dag thams cad la tshegs med pa thams cad kyi gshis sam babs su gnas pa yin pas de ltar nyams su blang*/ dmigs pa snga ma de ma nor ba yin/ 'on kyang mda' rgyang gang tsam du mar la bsring*/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag des yon tan du 'gyur ba yin/ nyams len spangs/ mo bon sman dpyad 'dre brdungs la sogs pa'i tshan pas bar du bcod nas/ lan cig phan pa ltar byung yang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad du 'gyur bas bar chad du gyur ba yin/

khe grags ni che lo byed/ bla ma ni ngan/ nyams len ni ma shes pa'i dus su sems tha mal/ nang brgyad rgyug bsgom yang btub pa tsam du 'dug pa de la rang so thub pa tsam po yin pas bu rang gong ma ltar nyams su blangs pas de 'dra cig la ci tshegs/ bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig nged kyi pa pha rin po che/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// chos rje phag mo gru pa des// bla ma bla med dkon mchog la// zhe sa ltag 'og mi nor na// mi dge sdig pas ga la chod// bu yin no zer na gong ma la// zhabs tog sdig pas mi mchod zhu// sangs rgyas bstan pa de nyid yin// ci bya gzhan du dam chos spyod// thog med dus kyi pha dang ma// byang chub bsgrub pa'i ngan grogs su// tshe gcig 'bad pa'i yon bdag la// dmag dang mthu ser rigs pa min// bde zhing yangs pa'i gnas su song*// 'dzam gling gang ba'i zas nor gyis// 'chi ba'i dus su phan pa med// bsod snyoms lto 'grang gar yang rnyed// nor gyis ma 'ching bsod snyoms spyod// chos dang mi mthun sdig spyod 'khor// bye ba tsam gyis bskor na yang*// gshin rje'i skyes bu dngos yin pas// sdig grogs spongs la gang dgar song*// 'jig rten 'brel par gyur ba'i mi// nged kyi spyod dang khong mi bstun// khong gi spyod dang ji ltar bstun// chags sdang med pa'i gnas su song*// grogs pos chos tshul mi byed na// khro zhing rngam pa'i kha na med// bags rim bzhin kyis dal bus gzhan du 'gro// byang chub sems dpa' shing rtas gsung*// mi gtsang 'dam las bzur ba yi// seng ge'i rgyal po ga la bsdar// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// rjes 'jug bu la gdams pa yin// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa 'di// gang gis spangs par gyur ba de// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// rab tu byung ba yin zhes gsungs// btsun po rab byung mdzad par zhu// bla ma rin chen/

bla ma rin chen/ bla ma rin chen/ smel tir 'gron po bcom dus gsungs pa// mi mkhas ro tshod ngan pa'i dbyangs 'di la// gre ba brgyangs nas len pa'i skyon chen yod// lhod pa rab lhod rtsol sgrub bral ba de// mkhas pa khul du chud pa'i man ngag yin// // 297) ༄// glen pa sprang po hang ngang la legs par gdams pa'i gdams ngag/ ston pa rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// des gsungs chos la gus pas 'dud// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kun// sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid dang mthun par 'jug /byang chub sems kyi 'bras bur gcig /bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub thob par byed pa 'o// ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sras// 'jig rten mgon po'i bu gcig pu// mkhas shing shin tu mkhas pa rnams// gzhan gyi sems dang mthun par 'jug /dpa' bo dgra las rnam rgyal bas// gzhan sems srung bar mi byed na// byams snying rje bsgom pa sgyu ma yin// gzhan gyis bsam pa mi shes pas// gzhan la phan par dka' bas na// gzhan gyi sems dang mthun par 'jug /rgya chen sangs rgyas thob pa bas// chab tsha sun cig thon pa dam// chab tsha sun cig byin pa yis// mthar thug sangs rgyas sar khrid nus// sangs rgyas che ba bstan pa yis// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'brel bar 'gyur// 'gro ba'i khams dang bag la nyal// bsam pa shes par gyur pa yis// 'gro ba smin par bya 'o zhes// rgyal sras lag na mar mes gsungs// thub pa chen po chos kyi rjes// stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir// ston pa nyid dang nges pa yis// 'gro ba ji ltar 'dul ba ltar// gdul bar bya zhes thub pas gsungs// de ltar ston pa nyid dag dang*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par bya// dam chos 'di yi gleng langs ni// glen pa sprang po hang ngang la// legs par gdams pa'i gdams ngag go/ // 298) ༄// bla ma dam pa'i gsung kho nar yid ches dgos pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gsung lan//

oṃ swasti/ yod med spros pa'i mtha' las rnam 'das pa// chos kyi sku las yon tan phrin las kyi// tshig tshogs mkha' la rnam par 'khrigs pa yis// dgos 'dod char 'bebs bla ma rnams la 'dud// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i zhal snga nas kyis rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa grub pa'i mtha'i tshul lugs ji ltar gsungs pa de kho na ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i bka' bstsal yang de kho na bzhin du 'dug par go de las 'khor ba mtha' yod pa dang*/ mtha' med pa'i bzhed lugs bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu yang dpag tu med pa zhig 'dug mkhas pa chen po che ba'i bdag nyid can mang po zhig gi yang dgongs pa tha dad pa zhig gsung bar gda' bas/ 'di ltar yin zhes bgyi ba bzhag par shin tu dka' mod kyi/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag gi gnad thub pa chen po'i dgongs pa 'di ltar yin zhes bya ba gsung tshig gcig yod pa de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis kyang yid ches par mi 'gyur bas/ yi ge la bri bar yang mi nus pas/ mdor na so so rang gi bla ma dam pa'i gsung kho na la yid ches par bya zhing nyams su blang ba kho na'o// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos bka' stsal gsungs ba'i lan yi ger sbyar ba/ rdzogs so// // 299) ༄// gtor ma cha bcu 'bul ba'i phyag len ji ltar mdzad tshul bstan pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i gtor ma yang*/ gtor ma cha bcu 'ba' zhig tu sdud pa ma gtogs pa med de so so rang rang gi zhe 'dod kyi dbang du byas te phul bas chog pa'o// phyag len gyi mdzad pa ni/ dang por bla ma rnams la gcig yi dam gyi lha la bzhi/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum la gcig ste drug chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po ma mgon lcam dral gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi ngor byas te chos skyong ma lus pa thams cad la gcig

chos skyong thams cad ngor byas te chos skyong ma lus pa thams cad la gcig dur khrod pa ngor byas la chos skyong gong ma gnyis la 'bul ba'i tshul dang 'dra bar gcig ste/ chos skyong ma lus pa thams cad la mnyam du phul ba gsum ste sman btab pa dgu 'bul ba'o// de nas 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor mas 'khor 'das lhag pa'i lhar byas pa la drug dbul bar bya'o// de nas dbang du bya ba'i gtor ma dang*/ klu'i ngor byas kyi gtor ma gsum dang bzhi 'bul bar bya'o// de nas yi dwags thams cad la gcig de nas lan chags thams cad la gcig 'bul ba ni phyag len gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'o// gtor ma cha bcu po 'di la gtor ma mang yang rung nyung yang rung ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'bul bar bya'o// nad pa'i don du brgya gtor zhu ba byung na/ gtor ma cha bcu brgya rtsa brgyad dam brgya la ma gtogs par bcu 'bul/ de nas brgya'am brgya rtsa brgyad po de nad 'dre la nad pa de'i srog blu bar bya ba'i ched du kha 'bar ma'i gtor mas dbul bar bya'o// rin po che'i phyag bzhes ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal ba'i rjes la sngags gcig se gol gcig byas nas nad 'dre la 'bul bar gda' ste/ de 'dra ba brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lo grangs sam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul ba ni gtor ma tog cig zhes kyang zer bar gda'o// gtor ma de dag 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad la phul ba ni sbyin pa'o// de nas 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa so so'i bstod pa bya ba ni tshig snyan pa'o// de nas rang gzhan thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni don spyod pa'o// de nas 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba ni don mthun pa'o// thams cad 'brel pa can du bzhugs so// // 300) ༄// rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dgongs don bcud len sman gyi sbyor thabs//

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u bcu bdun pa nas/ de nas yang dag bshad par bya// snying po thams cad bsdus pa ste// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// sgrub po bdud rtsi sbyor ba'i mchog /ces bcud thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa de len pa bza' ba'i thabs bstan pa ste/ bcud de yang dngul chu ste/ de ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po yin par bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ 'das pa'i dus su sngon byung ba// bskal pa dang po bde ba che// der ni rdo rje sems dpa' che// lhag pa yi ni lha cig bzhugs// lha min grub pa sogs mthong ste// lha yi tshogs ni skrag gyur nas// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa ni// myur du nga la skul bar byed// thig ler zhu las lha mo che// bdud kyis kun tu gtor ba ni// thams cad rmongs par byed pa yi// dngul chu zhes ni bya bar grags// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// sman dang sngags rnams mi bde bar// 'dzin pa log par lta ba zhes// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// mdor na phan bde ji snyed pa// thams cad dkon mchog gsum las byung*// kun kyang tshogs gnyis las byung phyir// tshogs gnyis bsags la 'bad par bya// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu las// bcud kyis len dang rin chen byug pa spos// de dag skye bo che la yod mod kyi// 'phongs par gyur pa de dag rnams la med// ces pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i snang ba ye shes kyi tshogs la 'jug pa bcud kyis len legs par bstan pa dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs par legs par gsungs pa 'di ni/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi rgyu las byung ba yin pas/ ri khrod du sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/

de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dben pa'i gnas/ ri bo'i khrod/ nags tshal gyi mthongs su bsgrub par bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ der yang sman dang rdzas dang bcud kyis len gyi rim pa mdor na khams byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu bskyed par byed pa'i dngos po sman dang*/ rdzas dang rin po che la sogs pa yul dang gnas 'di na 'di dang 'di dag yin ces/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams su gsungs pa de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ de yang ra mo shag dang*/ nye'u shing pa dang*/ dbang po lag pa dang*/ dngul chu dang*/ rtsa ba dang*/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ sha rnam pa lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga dang*/ bcud kyi snying po bsdus pa spyi dang bye brag dpag tu med pa bya ba'i rim pas khams 'phel bar gyur nas/ 'chi ba med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi de la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes ming 'dogs pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i las mtha' dag 'dis khong du chud par byas la bsgrub par bya ste/ mdor na 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bza' ba'i dam tshig ces gsung la/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba la bsrung ba'i dam tshig tu 'gyur pas/ de kho na go bar byas la ri khrod du sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bya ba ni spyir bstan pa dgos pa dang bcas pa'o// de la dngul chu nyid bstan par bya ba'i dbang du byas na/ sbyang ba dug 'don pa dang*/ bcing ba lus la gnas pa dang*/ nus pa bskyed pa btso ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ phan par byed pa mdza' bo dang sbyor ba dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs skyon spong ba dang lnga las/ dug 'don par byed pa ni/ mdog dmar zhes pa dang*/ nyes zad nas gzhan du min zhes pa yan chad kyis dug 'don pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa dang*/ de nas ma he rkang nang du/ zhes pa nas/ bcings par 'gyur ba yin zhes pa'i bar dang*/

lhang tser dngul chu rnon po yis// zhes pa'i bar gyis bcing ba lus la gnas pa bstan pa dang*/ glang chen mgo'i bcud blugs te seng ger btso zhes pa dang*/ de dag zla ba las byung ba zhes pa nas/ yang dang yang du bya zhes pa yan chad kyis nus pa skyed par byed pa dang*/ ni ru ku dang thi ba zhes pa nas 'di dag mdza' bo'i sde zhes pa dang*/ sman skyon med par bstan pa dang*/ bcud thams cad mdza' bo'i sder bstan pa dang*/ dngul chu lha tser gyi skyon gsum gsum dang*/ stobs ldan bcud bral gyi skyon bstan pa dang*/ skyes pa bud med kyi rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gsum gyi gnad ma shes pa'i skyon/ ches na dug tu 'gyur ba'i skyon dang*/ dus drug gnad ma shes pa'i skyon gyis mi mthun pa'i phyogs bstan pa'o// lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ dngul chu rigs bzang po skam sa dang rdo las byung ba dug 'don pa'i sbyor ba gang yang rung bas dug med par byas nas nus pa chen po bskyed pa'i phyir/ glang chen mgor btso ba dang*/ khams tha dad pa la phan pas sman tha dad par btso ba dang*/ btsos nas lhang tsor dang rnon po la sogs pas lus la mi 'bros par bcing ba'i sman dang sbyar ba dang*/ khams tha dad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sman tha dad pa rnams dang sbyar nas skyon mi 'byung bar bya ba'i ched du stobs ldan dang sbyar ba dang*/ bcud mtha' dag bsten par bya'o// 'bras bu ni gong du bstan pa gcig pu'o// dug legs par bton nas ma he la sogs pa'i rkang gi nang du sman gyi nus pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ grogs zangs ma dang*/ mkhar phye dang*/ mig sman dang char pa'i chu la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu btso ba dang*/ de nas de phyung nas rdo gzhong nang du thal sman la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu mnyes te/ sbrang rtsi dang bu ram gyis bshig nas da gzod sman tha dad pa dang sbyar bar bya/ de'i ril lu bla ma mkhas pa'i nyams myong dang*// nyams su myong ba'i gnad rnams dang*// sbyar nas zos par gyur pa yis// ston pa'i dgongs pa de gzod 'grub//
