301) ༄// snying po bsdus pa'i gdams ngag dge bshes dbu sgom la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ brtag pa gsum gyi grong khyer du// 'dzin pa gsum gyi skyes bu de// 'khrul pa gsum gyi ngang la gnas// yengs med mtha' bral gyi dbu ma la// zhen 'dzin chags pas dkri byas na// sman yang dug du 'gyur ba yin// dogs pa gsum gyi gzhal yas nas// yin pa gsum gyi tshangs pa de// mo sham bu yi 'gying bag yin// brtan pa gsum gyi theg pa la// zla phyed lon pa'i byis pas bzhon// kha pho dang sna pho sgrogs shing 'gro// de smyon pa'i lag rjes gsum pa yin// lar cis kyang mi phan 'chi 'gyur bas// skyes bu dam pa sngar bzhin zhu// bcom ldan mgon po chos kyi rje// mthar phyin ye shes rgyal po la// sras kyi thu bos zhu ba zhus// 'jig rten mgon po'i bu slob kyis// bka' bkyon zhe bkyon sna tshogs kyis// sems la shin tu gnad par byung*// ji ltar byas kyang ma phan na// de la ji ltar bgyi ba zhus// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// de la 'dug lugs bka' bstsal pa// bdag dang gzhan dang bdag gzhan du// brtag pa gsum gyi grong khyer na// bdag dang gzhan dang bdag gzhan du// 'khrul pa gsum gyi ngang la gnas// yengs med mtha' bral gyi dbu ma la// gong gi zhe 'dzin dkri byas na// sman yang dug du 'gyur ba yin// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gzhal yas na// bdag dang bdag gi bsgom pa de// mo sham bu yi 'gying bag yin// bdag dang bdag gi phyag rgya che// 'khor gsum rtog pa'i 'dzin pa la// zla dgu ngo bcu tshang ba la// byis pa shin tu rigs pa la// zla phyed lon pa'i byis pas bzhon// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// kha pho sna pho sgrogs shing 'gro// shes bya gshis la mi srid pas// bdag dang gzhan dang bdag gzhan rnams// smyon pa'i lag rjes gsum pa yin// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// lar cis kyang mi phan 'chi 'gyur bas// skyes bu dam pa sngar bzhin bsgoms/

/snying po bsdus pa'i gdams ngag go /dbu sgom la springs pa// // 302) ༄// gdul bya smin cing grol ba mdzad par zhu ba shrī phug pa la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ na mo ratna gu ru/ 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje rin po che// lus can khur snom btang snyoms mi mnga' bas// tshogs gnyis mthar byon 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// mgon po de yi zhabs rdul reg pa yi// shākya'i sras kyi dge slong bsod snyoms pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pas// skyes chen rang gi bu la don 'di gdams// mi mthun ston pa'i bstings tshig la// ston pa'i mtha' drug ga la rnyed// de nyid babs su dgongs la gsan// mtha' drug nges don gcig pur 'gyur// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// yon tan rgya mtsho rab yangs pa// deng 'dir khyod la brjod mi lang*// de yang dus 'dir brjod pa min// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yi// yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa// lhag par gyur pa thams cad kyang*// dus 'dir brjod pa ma yin te// rgyal po chen po nga la nus// sran rdog bzhi las gling bzhi dang*// sran rdog gcig pu lhung zed kyi// kha la phog nas lhung ba yis// dbang po brgya byin stan nyid las// lhung bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// phra rags rgyu dang 'bras bu 'di// mi bslu nges par 'byung ba'i phyir// bdag pas yon tan cis mi che// bla ma bdag nyid gcig pu la// ji ltar mdzad pa thams cad kyis// bdag las lhag par cis mi 'gyur// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan rnams// bla ma mchog las nges 'byung zhes// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs// mchog gi bla ma mnyes byas nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan rnams// shugs las 'byung bar mkhyen grang mod// dpag med yon tan rab rgyas shing*// yon tan thugs la ri rgyal ltar// brtan zhing 'gyur ba med pa khyed// ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du// bdag dang mjal bar gyur pa las// ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// mun pa bsal bar gyur pa bzhin// nga rgyal che thabs thams cad kyis// nam mkha' lta bur rnam par dag

/gdong du blta yang mi phod pa'i// mos gus rgya mtsho gting nas g.yos// drung du bzhugs pa'i dam bca' mdzad// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te// mos gus mthu yis 'byung ngo zhes// thub pas gsungs pa 'di re mad// dpon slob rten 'brel 'dzom pa la// yon tan skye ba ngo mtshar che// khrid dang gdams ngag spros pa rnams// thams cad mkha' la 'ja' bzhin yal// bdag gi bu slob thams cad la// mos gus mthar thug khyed yin zhes// rtsod pa med pa de nyid lags// 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan rnams// bla ma dam pa bkur ba las// 'byung bar khyed kyis nges shes yod// bcom ldan mar pa lo tsā bas// rje btsun mi la rnal 'byor pa// bran dang g.yog tu bkol ba yis// sangs rgyas yon tan 'khrungs pa ste// yon tan che zhes bgyi ba lags// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs drung du// bran dang g.yog lta ci smos te// nyin las gcig kyang byed ma myong*// khyed kyang bdag dang 'dra lags sam// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i blo yod kyang*// lo ngo gnyis las ma bsten cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yang*// spu rtse tsam yang ma mthong zhing*// tshig don brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la// lung thob tsam las ma mchis pas// bdag dang khyed du mnyam lags sam// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa de// zhabs kyi padmo rab btud nas// dus 'di da lta phan chad du// bran dang g.yog tu zhal gyis bzhes// bde gshegs gong ma'i zhabs tog tu// 'gro la phan pa sgrub snyam yang*// rgyu yod rkyen dang bral bas kyang*// bsam pa 'grub par mi gyur te// bzang ngan 'bring gsum gdul bya rnams// khyed kyis legs par smin mdzad nas// thams cad bdag la phul ba de// bdag dang khyed kyi bya ba de// mnyam par 'dug gam ji ltar dgongs// thub mgon chos rgyal rin chen gyi// rnam thar tshul khrims rin chen la// 'gro ba 'god pa'i bsam pa byung*// khyed kyis bdag gi bsam pa de// dgongs shing rdzogs pa'i don ched du// rab tu ma gshegs gong du yang*// sha dang chang gi spros pa bcad// gzhan gyi rab tu byung ba bas// bdag gi dge bsnyen btsun par grags// da lta bdag gi dge 'dun rnams// tshangs par spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bdag la shin tu bka' drin che// su dang su zhig mnyam pas snyoms// phra ba'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la// bsgrigs sam rang 'grig ngas ma shes// shar nub spyil po'i rten 'brel dang*// zab chen kha gang rten 'brel gyis// phyogs mtshams gang du gshegs na yang*// bla ma dam pa'i gdan sa 'dzin// dpag med 'gro ba smin par mdzad// su dang mnyam pas su dang snyoms// yul 'dir bsdad par gyur nas kyang*// 'gro la phan bde sgrub pa la// mang drug gnyis kyis legs par bskyangs// tshur la nye ba dpon jo dang*// drung na 'dug pa'i bu slob rnams// kun kyang nye gnas yang snying lags// bdag gi rten sa re gnas dang*// dge 'dun kun gyi rten gnas kyang*// khyed kyi bu slob ma lags sam// bdag gi bsam pas khrel ba med// ngo dga' kha bsag bzlo ba min// 'di 'dra 'di 'drar 'dug pa de// thugs kyis ma dgongs lags sam ci// su dang mnyam pas su dang snyoms// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// gdul bya smin par mdzad pa la// bsdu dngos bzhi yis mdzad par gsungs// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa der// 'bad pas dge 'dun skyong na yang*// nged rang pha spad 'dzom dus su// sus kyang 'grangs shig zos pa med// nged rang gnyis pos go bar zad// dpag med gdul bya smin slad du// shar gyi phyogs su gshegs pa dang*// nyi ma di ring phan chad du// kun tu bzang po'i sprin phung 'char// nam mkha' mdzod la longs spyod pa// su yi drin yin gang nas byung*// legs par dgongs dang shes rab can// su dang mnyam pas su dang snyoms// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bu// cha rkyen rin chen bdun ldan pas// rgyal po'i srid la longs spyod ltar// brgyud pa gong ma'i gdul bya mchog

/khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// smin par byed pa'i mthu med na// gdung rgyud gum pa ma lags sam// mi rabs chad pa ma lags sam// glang sna bol ba ma lags sam// ston pa sangs rgyas man chad dang*// 'jig rten mgon po yan chad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// rdzogs par mdzad pa a cang ste// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang*// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa yis// yab dang sras kyang ngo ma shes// gnyis su med pas gnyis med pa'i// gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs mdzad pa// gong ma rnams kyi zhabs tog 'di// su dang mnyam pas su dang snyoms// 'di la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /dpag tu med pa ma smos shing*// zur tsam smras par gyur pa la// bka' bkyon chen po mdzad pa de// nyid kyi 'dug lugs ma dgongs sam// gong ma'i zhabs tog ma dran nam// gdod mtha' bar gsum thams cad du// bu slob mtho dman thams cad dang*// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// rgyal ba dpang por bzhag nas 'dir// 'gro ba kun gyi khur 'khur bas// ngo dga' phye gtor byed na ko /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// 'gro ba thams cad bslus par 'gyur// de phyir 'di 'dra med pa de// de ru khyed kyis ma shes sam// 'di la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /'gran gyis do dang bral ba yang*// thams cad brjod kyis rdzogs pa min// brjod pa'i tshig 'di thams cad kun// skyug mi bro ba gang yin pa// khyed kyis mdzub gus slongs par zad// 'on kyang skyes chen gong ma rnams// byas pa khyad du mi gsod cing*// bde dang legs pa thams cad kun// bla ma dkon mchog bka' drin du// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa de// chos mig mnga' ba'i mdzad pa yin// dus gsum rgyal ba man chad dang*// khams gsum sems can yan chad kyi// phan bde yon tan ji yod pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa las// ma lus thams cad byung ba dang*// brjod du med pa'i lhan cig skyes// bla ma'i mos gus las byung bar// sangs rgyas rdo rje can gyis gsungs// deng sang skye bo phal cher dang*// rig byed sde snod 'dzin pa dang*// dpon slob grogs po thams cad kun// bla ma gong ma'i yon tan bas// rang nyid yon tan che'o zhes// zhe bas rlom zhing tshig tu smra// bla ma gong ma thams cad dang*// 'brel ba yod kyi dogs pa 'dra// yi chad skyes pa'i dus tshod 'dir// khyed kyis bka' bstsal gsung byon pas// dga' ba rgya mtsho ltar yangs shing*// nam mkha' lta bur mtha' med pas// bdag gi sems rgyud tshim par gyur// shin tu thugs la btags so bu// yon tan bdag bas khyed che zhes// babs su 'dug pas zur smras pas// 'di la khyed nyid thugs chad pa// kun tu rgyu dang rkang gnyis pa// mtho dman gang dang gang dag gi

/yab sras phye bar thugs dgongs na// mtho dman 'bring gsum thams cad kyis// khyed kyis yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// brjod par phyag rten ma gtogs pa// phra mas bdag gi bsam pa la// skad cig thang cig yud tsam yang*// 'gyur bar smras pa yod re skan// rgyal ba sras bcas dpang por bzhugs// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu de// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa 'grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin par shog /'bras bu mdor bsdus gsungs pa 'di// deng sang khyed kyi dus la bab// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// bla ma brgyud pa gong ma yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// sgrub par mdzad pa'i dus tshod 'dir// gcig pu nyid du dpag phug tu// sgrub pa byas par gyur ba las// 'bras bu ci 'grub thugs kyis dgongs// na so rgas pa los gdungs shing*// nad dang gcong gis lus po gdungs// bsam pa zhum pas gnyen la skyo// sngar 'dris 'brel pa thams cad la// ltogs pa zas kyis gdungs pa ltar// khyed dang mjal bar shin tu skyo// lan cig mthong bas gdungs na yang*// thams cad sgrol gyi bu bzhin du// khyed kyis 'gro ba smin pa la// 'dod pa'i brtul zhugs drag pos byung*// nga yang khyed kyis gdul bya rnams// smin cing grol bar mdzad par zhu// khyed kyi bkur sti chen po dang*// dad pa can gyi zas nor dang*// mdzo brtag thabs blo shes gsum gyis// zas dang gos la brid byas nas// sems bskyed pa dang bsngo ba gnyis// rna bar thos su re lags na// khyed kyi gdul bya dpag med rnams// 'dul bar mdzad pa smos ci dgos// bdag gi bsam pa 'di las med// khyed kyis mdzad pa rdzogs mdzad gsol// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig

/shrī phug pa la// // 303) ༄// nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos bdun gyi bslab bya me tog phreng ba// oṃ swasti/ mgon po yab sras 'khor bcas dang*// des gsung chos de dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ston pa thugs rje chen po'i gsung*// nyams par mi 'gyur dam pa'i chos// gus pas spyi bo gtsug gis blangs// bcom ldan 'das la bram ze dbyar byed kyis/ dgra spong byed pa pham par nus sam mi nus zhes zhus pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ ci kun dga' bo yul spong byed pa rnams yang dang yang du 'du zhing*/ yang dang yang du 'du ba las/ ring du gnas par thos sam/ de bzhin du mthun par 'dug cing mthun par 'gro ba dang*/ dgos pa dang bya ba mthun par byed pa thos sam/ smon pa ma yin pa la ni smon par mi byed/ smon pa ni kun tu 'dor bar mi byed kyi/ ji ltar nang khrims bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs nas spyod pa thos sam/ yang spong byed kyi bud med rnams gzhon nu ma dag 'di lta ste/ phas bsrungs pa dang*/ mas bsrungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du ming po dang*/ phu nu mo dang*/ sgyug mo dang*/ nye du dang*/ rus dang*/ chad pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan gyi chung ma gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba bsrungs pa dag chung ngu na me tog gi phreng ba bor ba lta bu dag la yang 'phral du khyad du gsad nas mthus 'dod pa mi spyod pa thos sam/ yang spong byed kyi rgan rigs dang ya rabs rnams dang pha ma'i rgyud gang dag la/ bkur stir byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed cing de dag gi tshig la dad pas mnyan par byed/ sems par byed pa thos sam/ yang spong byed kyi phyogs bzhi po gang dag na mchod rten yod pa de dag la bkur stir byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed cing*/ de dag gi sngon gyi mtshan mar bzung ba mi 'dor bar thos sam/

yang spong byed pa rnams dgra bcom pa rnams la dad pa drag pos kun tu bsrungs pa dran pa nye bar gnas te/ dgra bcom pa ma byon pa rnams ni spyan 'dren par byed/ byon pa rnams la ni mngon par dga' bar byed cing*/ de dag la chos gos dang*/ bsod snyoms dang*/ mal cha dang*/ nad kyi rkyen sman dang*/ yo byad rnams kyis mi brel bar byed pa thos sam/ thos lags/ de ltar bgyid ces zhus/ dbyar byed de ltar gyur pa la// nyams par mi 'gyur bka' bstsal te// dris dang dris pa'i lan dag las// lan gsum bar du gsungs pa yis// dbyer med dga' mgu yi rangs te// 'di la gcig dang ldan na yang*// ma ga dha yi rgyal pos kyang*// thub par mi 'gyur gzhan ci 'tshol// de ltar zhu ba zhus nas song*// song nas ring por ma lon par// ston pa bdag nyid chen po yis// kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa// bya rgod phung po'i ri 'di la// 'dug pa'i dge 'dun bsdus shig gsungs// drung du 'tshogs nas zhus pa las// dge slong dag ces yang dang yang*// bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di ltar ste// 'du dang dge 'dun mthun pa dang*// smon pa'i gnas la mi smon cing*// srid pa'i 'dod chags dbang mi 'gro// gnas brtan rgyal po lta bur bkur// dgon dang nags khrod bas mtha' bsten// tshangs par spyod pa'i dge slong dag /ma 'ongs pa dag 'bod byed cing*// chos kyi longs spyod yo byad kyis// de ltar 'brel bar mi byed pa// nyams par mi 'gyur chos bdun zhes// ston pa chen pos bka' bstsal cing*// gzhan yang*/ ston pa nyid dang ston pa'i chos// rnam par 'byed dang ting 'dzin dang*// bkur sti bla ma'i rim gro dang*// ting nge 'dzin du byed cing byas// des kyang nyams par mi 'gyur gsungs// gzhan yang*/ las dang smra dang gnyid dang ni// 'du dang 'du 'dzi rnyed bkur dang*// 'du shes spangs shing sbyor ba brtson// cung zad ngan ngon tsam gyis chog

/gong nas gong du bsgrub la 'bad// des kyang nyams par mi 'gyur gsungs// dad dang ngo tsha khrel yod dang*// brtson 'grus dran pa nye bar 'jog /mnyam rjes shes rab dran pas kyang*// dge ba'i chos rnams mi nyams gsungs// gzhan yang dge slong ji srid du// chos shes pa dang don shes dang*// dus shes pa dang tshod shes dang*// bdag nyid shes dang 'khor shes dang*// gang zag mchog dang mchog min shes// dge ba'i chos las mi nyams gsungs// dge slong dag ji srid du dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas rnam par bsgyur ba bsgom pa dang*/ chos rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ dga' ba dang shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun po la gnas pas kyang nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dga' bar 'gyur bar gsungs so// gzhan yang dga' bar 'gyur ba'i chos drug gsungs te/ byams pa'i lus kyis las dang*/ ngag gi las dang*/ yid kyi las kyis chos ston cing bsgom pa dang*/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas pa rnams la zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog dga' bar gyur pa thams cad kyis byed pa dang*/ des sdud pa dang*/ chos kyis thob pa'i lhung bzed kyi nang du 'ongs pa/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dang lhan cig tu za zhing dga' ba dang bsgom pa dang sdud pa 'thab rtsod med pa dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa lhan cig tu mthun par spyod pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i lta ba rnam par grol bas nges par 'byin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal zad par byed cing mthar 'byin pa 'di yang dga' bar 'gyur pa'i chos su gsungs so// ston pa dang ni 'du ba dang*// las dang dad dang chos nyid dang*// byang chub yan lag kun tu dga'// dbyar byed pa dang yang dag bshad// mgon pos dran pa nyer bzhag las// khams dang yid byed reg pa dang*// dga' ba'i zas dang rnam pa bzhi// 'dod pa'i khams su gsungs pa la// ngan song gsum dang lha ma yin// kun la yod par gsungs de dag

/nyon mongs zhe sdang gzhir gyur pas// mi rtag mi brtan 'gyur zhing g.yo// lha yi byams pa gzhir gyur pas// yun ring bar du gnas par 'gyur// 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sras// rnam par grol ba'i mnyam gzhag can// rjes rnams thabs dang bcas pa yis// rnam par grol ba nyid du gyur// log par lta ba rnam gnyis te// yod pa 'jig dang log par shes// sbyin pa sbyin sreg mchog sbyin dang*// legs nyes 'bras bu rnam smin med// ces pa'i log par shes pa ni// bde dang sdug bsngal gang yin pa// las kyi 'bras bu ma yin te// lhas byas zhes pa log shes so// bcom ldan ston pa sangs rgyas kyi// rjes su zhugs pa'i slob ma rnams// ston pa'i gsung bzhin nyams len pa// thog ma bar dang mthar dge bar// ston pa nyid kyis gsungs pa ste// gus pas phyag 'tshal spyi bos blangs// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus kyis// dus gsum ston pa rgyal ba yi// bstan pa ma lus rgyas byed pa// dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos bdun// rdzogs so// //

304) ༄// thub bstan 'dzin skyong srung gsum gyis bsgrub pa rag shi mkhan por gdams pa// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge ba'i thabs yin te/ de ltar yang*/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ gang zhes pa'i sgras dris pas/ 'di zhes pas lan/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ srung ba dang*/ skyong ba rnam pa gsum lags te/ de yang 'dzin pa ni yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin la/ de ltar yang*/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs// zhes pa lags la/ de yang sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/ 'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnam pa gsum yin pas/ de la thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bsgom pa'am bsgrub pa rnam pa gsum gyis yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' dag tu gyur ba lags/ de lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa de la chos kyi rgyal po chen po'am/ dus deng sang dge 'dun gyi sde rgya mtsho chen po lta bu rnams kyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de'i bdag ma byas/ mchod pa dang bkur sti med na dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ram/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la med na mun pa'i smag rum du gyur pa ltar/ dge ba dang mi dge ba ngo mi shes shing*/ thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge ba rgyun chad pas/ khams gsum du 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por ltung ba yin pas/ bsod nams dang dbang chen pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkur ba gal che ste/

de la yang rnam pa gsum/ bsod nams kyi gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan nam/ rgyal po dang phan pa dang tshul khrims la gnas pa'i blon po'am bza' mi dang*/ de legs par skyong zhing sgrub pa'i yon bdag dang rnam pa gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che skyong ba lags/ bstan pa rin po che bsrung ba'i dbang du byas na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog phrin las rnam bzhi'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dkon mchog gi zhabs nas 'degs pa/ sangs rgyas sam chos sam dge 'dun gang nyams dma' ba de mthon por byed pa dkon mchog gi zhabs nas 'degs pa/ phu mis mda' skyong ba rgyal po rnams kyi dbang du byas nas/ yul khams mi gcig pa'i rgyal po mthu chen po dang ldan pa rnams phu mi'i zla 'brel zhing mthun pa dang*/ de'i dbang du mi 'gro ba'i thabs/ rang gi yul ris dang rgyal khams der/ so nam gyi rigs lo tog bsgrub pa dang*/ tshong bya ba dang 'brog skyong ba dang sman dang sngags rig byed kyis phyi nang gi gnod pa sel ba dang*/ mar ngan slong gi rad pa gnon pa dang*/ so khams kyi dgra gdug pa can zil gyis gnon pa la/ yul gyi dpa' bo go cha dang*/ mtshon dang dgra thabs kyi rigs la mkhas pas phas kyi rgol ba zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags mthu dang rig pa rmad du byung bas/ gdug pa can phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'dul bar byed pa ni ngan slong gi rad pa gnon par bstan pa rin po che bsrung ba yin pas/ mdor na thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge ba/ 'dzin skyong srung ba dang rnam pa gsum gyis dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur bas de kho na bzhin du bsgrub par bya'o// // 305) ༄// ma rig mun sel nyi ma'i gzi brjid ces pa rgyal ba 'od sogs kyi zhu chos//

dpal ldan dus gsum bdag nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa 'gyur ba med pa nyid// mgon po phag mo gru pa bcom ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// skyes chen de la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bu bu yab dang sras kyi 'brel ba ni// chos las skyes pa'i sras gcig pu// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal po dang*// bram ze las skyes shā ri'i bu// yab dang sras su rnam par gsungs// rje btsun brgyud pa gong ma rnams// yab dang sras kyi tshul lugs ni// khyed kyi thugs su chud pa bas// pha dang bu yi 'brel don gyis// pha dang bu yod bu nyid dbang*// bu yang pha yi rjes su 'jug /gla mi'i bu mo bran dang khol// pha dang bu ltar mi 'gyur zhing*// dbang tshod phyogs ris 'tsho bar byed// mgon po bla ma thugs rje can// 'gro kun skad du chos ston pa// rang gis ji ltar rtogs pa de// nyams su blangs pas yon tan skye// bu ram mi yis bka' bstsal gsungs// gang la yon tan gang skyes kyang*// byang chub sems dang ma ldan na// 'di yang lha cig jo lcam ma// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// gang zag so so'i blo tshod las// gzhan na med pa go lags sam// srid dang byus dang zas dang nor// phyogs ris kun gyi gang dang gang*// bdag gi bla ma'i phyogs ris rnams// bdag dang bdag gir gang 'dzin pa// 'di la thub pa chen po yis// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song zhing*// thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po yis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin par gsungs// dad dang gus pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// kun gyi bdag por 'gyur nges na// gzhan gyi bde skyid yon tan la// phrag dog byed pa ci snyam ang*// bdag gi nyams su myong bas ni// bla ma'i rdzas dang yo byad dang*// bar chad brgyad po gang rung yang*// sems la shin tu brtse bar 'dug

/gus 'dud phra mo de 'dras kyang*// lo gnyis bstan pa'i ku sā li// yon tan med pa bdag 'dra yang*// pha yi bu zhes brjod par gnang*// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa// de la sras su dgongs pa mdzad// de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// bu sdug 'dra bar dgongs par 'gyur// gong ma rnams kyis bka' bstsal pa// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// tshad ldan bla ma gong ma yi// sras kyi dam par gyur pa ni// byang chub sems las gzhan mi srid// byang chub sems dang ma bral dang*// gong ma rnams kyis sras mchog yin// de yang rin chen zhal snga nas// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can rnams// bde ba dag dang ldan pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su// bdag gis bsgrub par bya ba yi// go cha chen po bgos nas kyang*// nyams su len par mi byed pa'i// bzang po byas pa'i bzang lan tsam// byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag la// snying rje can zhes mi brjod de// de tsam zhig gi snying rje ni// dbyug thog byi po la yang yod// byang chub sems kyi brtul zhugs kyis// rang gzhan smin par bya 'o zhes// yang dang yang tu bka' stsal gsungs// bu go 'am rtogs sam rnal 'byor pa// de ltar gyur na dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba dkon mchog gsum rnams kyis// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kun// rang nyid dbang bar nges pa'i phyir// dus gsum 'phags pa thams cad kyi// dge ba bsngo bar btub pa yin// bu go 'am rtogs sam dgos se kun// shes rab zhib mos dgongs dang kye// don 'di go zhing rtogs gyur na// chu bo gzhol phyogs 'bab pa 'am// nyi ma shar nas 'char ba bzhin// rtsol sgrub med par dge ba'i chos// dpag tu med pa 'thob 'gyur snyam// gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa yi// thabs su gyur pa thams cad kun// byang chub sems 'dis bsdus pas na// nan tan ma chung rgyal ba'i sras// 'o na don dam byang chub sems// spros pa kun dang bral gyur cing*// dus gsum rgyal bas ma gzigs pa// sems nyid skye ba med pa de// gang yin gang nas btsal bar bya// snyam pa'i rnam rtog skyes lags na// gong gi thabs las gzhan pa yis// sems nyid gzhan na mi rnyed de// gong gi de nyid skye ba med// rnam par dag cing spros bral bar// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs// 'di yang bcom ldan 'das kyi yum// shes rab snying por gsungs pa bzhin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gdod nas ma skyes stong pa la// dngos dang dngos med gang du yang*// lta na log shes nying 'khrul yin// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa rnams// tha dad 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// nyams myong can zhes su zhig smra// gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i don// yang dag don gyi snying po mchog

/'khor 'das kun gyi gshis gcig pu// 'di las ma g.yo rnal 'byor pa// g.yo bya g.yo byed g.yo ba yang*// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// 'bad pas btsal yang rnyed re skan// gnyis su smra ba thams cad kyang*// rnal 'byor pa yis ma mthong bas// gnyis med gnyis su med pa yang*// yod pa ma yin gnyis med nyid// skye chen nyid kyis thugs la zhog /thub mgon bcom ldan 'das kyi sras// rgyal ba'i 'od dang byang chub dpal// 'byung gnas rin chen g.yu ris pas// mnyes par mdzad nas zhus pa lags// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i sras kyi rnal 'byor ri bo'i khrod na bder gnas pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang phyug gter mdzod thob pa la// legs par bstan pa'i dam chos nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'dis// shin tu gsal bar gyur cing bla na med pa'i gnas thob pas// 'gro ba ma lus kun gyis thabs dang shes rab stobs thob nas// rtsol sgrub med par rin chen byang chub sems kyi gter rnyed de// thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shog /ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba nyi ma'i gzi brjid ces bya ba// rdzogs so// // 306) ༄// gong ma'i rnam thar brtul zhugs cung zad bzung zhes pa dpal sdings la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// dbyer med byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid// mgon po phag mo gru pa bdag nyid gtso// sras dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi 'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mgon po de yi sras kyi thu bo pa// bdag cag kun gyi mgon dang skyabs gyur cing*// mchog gi bla ma de yi sras kyi gtso// skyes chen khyed kyi zhabs kyi padmo la// spyi bo gtsug gis 'dud cing skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten mgon po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la// 'dul zhing mdzes pa rgyal sras 'od zer gyis// ngar snabs 'dra ba'i dman pa bdag nyid kyang*// nyi ma'i 'od ltar cung zad 'tsher bar mchis// rgya mtsho lta bur rab yangs sras rnams kyis// gdan sa khyod kyis skyongs zhes bdag la gtad// brtse ba'i bdag nyid grong 'das ma mchis des// gdan sa gtod la logs su sgoms shig gsungs// ti se'i gangs la sgrub pa byed du phyin// byin gyis rlabs kyis 'bri gung dgon par bab// gong ma'i rnam thar brtul zhugs cung zad bzung*// gsung sgros cung zad cung zad gzhan la bstan// bla ma'i thugs dgongs cung zad rdzogs sam snyam// bsten yun thung zhing zhabs 'bring zhabs tog la// kho thag ma chad gdung ba chen pos gdungs// srog la ma bltas gdan sa rin chen la// snying la dran tshad zhabs tog mtha' dag byas// sa bdag rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' rnams// dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun sde rnams dang*// ngam shod la sogs phyogs ris thams cad kyis// sprang po bu gcig lta bur shin tu bskyangs// lus pa med par rtag tu bkur gyur kyang*// dge 'dun rnams kyang bla ma'i mos gus kyis// lus dang srog la blta ba med pa dang*// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun nyung ba dang*// bdud kyi sprul pa mi ngan kha cig gis// phra ba'i gnod pa mi 'ong mi srid gda'// de ltar gyur na bskal pa'i me chen ltar// legs par spyod pa'i go skabs ma mchis par// yab sras kun gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis go

/gang nas bltas pa'i rgyu mtshan zab mo yang*// gting nas nges pa'i shes pa skyes gyur bas// rin chen yab sras rtsa ba brgyud pa dang*// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog tu// 'jig rten chos brgyad lus srog ma bsam nas// gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas// dam pa rnams kyang bdag la dga' ba skyes// lhar bcas 'jig rten mang po dbugs kyang phyung*// rang gzhan mang po tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing grub// je dga' je dga' je skyid je skyid thal// deng sang dbus gtsang khyim par gyur pa yis// thams cad legs par dgongs par gyur mod kyang*// gus pa'i shugs kyis cung zad yus bdo lags// legs par dgongs pa'i skyes chen khyed nyid kyis// 'jig rten mgon po'i na bza' rin chen dang*// bka' lung mnyan pas dbugs dbyung thugs la btags// slad kyi zhu ba dgos don snying po zhig /snyan du gsol gyi thugs la legs par dgongs// rin chen dgongs pa nyid kyi phyag rjes mchog /sdings kyi yang dgon gdan sa chen po der// spyi dang bye brag bu slob thams cad kyis// thugs kyi dgongs pa gzhol zhing 'bab par 'gyur// bdag gi bsam pa dme 'dor sa phyogs der// mdo khams la sogs spyi dang bye brag gi /phyogs ris med pa'i gdan sa chen po lags// mchod cing bkur bar bdag kyang shin tu spro// bdag la dad gus byed pa yod srid na// sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang 'bul ba'i tshogs// sdings su phul ces bu slob rnams la gdams// nga yi bu slob mos gus can rnams kyis// sdings su mchod cing bsnyen bkur bgyid pa lags// sa thag ring zhing na so rgas pa dang*// drung du tshogs pa rgya mtsho ltar yangs shing*// pre ta pu ri'i grong 'dir phongs pa yis// zhabs tog bya rgyu 'dzom par ma gyur kyang*// khyed kyi nye gnas dbon por gyur pa lags// nga yi bu dang slob mar gyur pa la// chibs dang mdzo dang bu ram ltang tshe gcig

/bskur nas mchis pas spyan gzigs cung zad 'di// bdag gi tshogs chen rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir// cis kyang mas kyang zhal du gsol bar zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa kun// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /sdings pa la// // 307) ༄// yod pa'i dge rtsa bsngo tshul bstan pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod pa de stong nyid snying rje nyid pa'i dus su bdag 'dzin med pa dang*/ khra dang spyang ki yang bu la snying rje yod pa la zer ba yin gsung*/ rmongs pa/ glen pa/ chos ma mthong ba/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa la rang bzhin gyis rgyud bzang ba/ rang bzhin gyis yon tan dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ sems can gyi rigs mi gcig pa rnams la yod pa de/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yin par ma shes pas/ de bsngo ba'i bsam pa ma byung ba lags pa la/ mgon po de nyid kyi gsung gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yod pa'i tshul/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i go ba sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba/ rin po che nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa 'di ni ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba ste/ bla ma rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa de la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi chos// mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di yin zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// de ltar gyur na ye shes des// ma rig mun pa sel ba 'di// nyi mas mun pa sel ba bzhin// 'gro 'ong bsal bzhag med pa nyid// nan tan chen pos gsung pa dang*// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las ma gtogs pa// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob med// rje ngo mtshar che 'o rin po che// skyabs su mchi 'o rin po che// byin gyis rlobs dang rin po che// rje sngon yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

308) ༄// nyes tshogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje shākya rgyal po'i zhu chos// 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa'i sman// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// mgon po chos rje'i zhal snga nas// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i// bla med dam chos rin po che// 'gro rnams smin par mdzad ces gsungs// de yi bsdus don cung zad bri// spyir nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal gyi tshogs nyes pa ji snyed cig byung ba de thams cad ni/ mi dge ba 'ba' zhig las 'byung bar zad kyi/ de ltar yang*/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*/ zhes pas mngon no// 'di la dbye na don rnam pa lngas ston te/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad/ 'chi ba'i ltas/ las kyi rnam par smin pa dang rnam pa lnga 'ba' zhig tu zad de/ de yang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad ni/ sman pa rnams kyis bcos par bya ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad ni/ gdams ngag gi gnad gegs sel gyi rim pas bcos pa yin/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad ni/ che 'bring gi bye brag gis sngags dang gnyen po'i sbyor bas bcos pa yin/ 'chi ba'i ltas la ni 'chi ba bslu ba 'ba' zhig gis bcos pa yin/ las kyi rnam par smin pa'i nad la ni bcos med pa yin te/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so zhes lung 'dren pa yod kyang*/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di thams cad 'phrang dog pa dang khal yo ba dus mnyam du 'ong bas/ 'di thams cad la bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*/ tshul khrims rin po che nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po la nan tan dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rang gi dge sbyor la nan tan byed pa 'ba' zhig gis sel bar gsungs te/ 'di thams cad la nges par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas ni/

srid tshan po che yod pa la dgras mi tshugs pa dang 'dra ste/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi skyabs dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas/ nges par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing srog gi phyir yang bslab bya mi gtong bas/ nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims dug rnam pa lnga'am gsum gyi rtog pa skad cig kyang mi rgyu ba'i tshul khrims ni/ sa 'gag btsan po la mkhar btsan po'i nang du go btsan po gon pa dang 'dra ba/ rgyu nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ las de dang las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa mi ldog pa ni gnas med pa lags pas/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri mas ma gos pa la gnas pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ byams pa dang snying rje chen po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bus ni/ nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal gyi tshogs 'dag pa a cang ches te/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba ni/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad kyi yon tan yang nor bu rin po che las 'byung bar/ a mo gha pā sha'i rgyud du gsungs la/ byang chub kyi sems rin po ches ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas man chad/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag 'byung bar gsungs te/ de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dam pa de'i zhal snga nas/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dam bca' sems bskyed par bya zhes gsungs pa/ srog dang snying dang rkang du song bas rang gi lus lhag pa'i lha/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa'i dbang gis shes shing rtogs pa/ tha mal pa'i lus yul gsum phyogs na med par/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad pa med pa/ yi dam gyi lha dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid gcig pur gyur pa nyid du dang por shes par bya/

bar du goms par bya/ mtha' mar goms pa'i dbang gis de nyid du 'gro ba ni/ dang po nyid nas lhun gyis grub par bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid yin te/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'am/ khams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa zhes ming du 'dogs kyang*/ gshis de las mi 'da' bas de'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la/ sgom pa mthar phyin zhes bya ba'am/ grub pa thob ces bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas zhes ming 'dogs te/ rang gi rang bzhin du gyur pa la nges par byas pa'i yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pas ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyang bde ba dang ldan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid du 'gyur na/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa las byung ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa las grub pa'i tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi rkyal pa/ phung ba'i gnod pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum du 'dzin pa'i shes pa/ de'i khyad par gyi chos nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal 'dag par 'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar na mun pa rang shugs kyis mi gnas pa dang 'dra bar/ lhag pa'i lha bsgom pa la nan tan shin tu che bar 'bad pa ni/ sprin med pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mun pa thams cad rnam par sel ba lta bu'o// 'di thams cad kyang 'brel ba can du blta bar bya ste/ 'brel ba med pa don gyis 'grub pa ste/ skyabs su song nas tshul khrims las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems de'i rang bzhin lhag pa'i lha lags la/ 'di thams cad kyang bla ma dam pa 'ba' zhig las gzhan mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes pas/ bla ma dam pa 'ba' zhig las med pas/

bla ma dam pa ni kun gyi byed po ste/ dper na mig dang snying dang lus spyi dang bye brag tha dad pa dang 'dra bar/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas dang chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ bye brag phan pa dang bde ba thams cad bla ma 'ba' zhig yin pas/ bla ma dam pa ma gtogs gzhan bsam du med par mos gus kyi shugs rlabs po ches bsgom par bya ba'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgom nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag blang bar bya ste/ rtag tu snyan du gsol ba thugs la nges pa kho na'o// gzhan yang 'di ltar lhan cig skyes// lhan cig skyes pa lhan skyes de// su zhig gang dang lhan cig skyes// gang gis gang la 'dris byed pa// chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid// dbyer med mya ngan 'das pa po// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// dus gsum dus med rtag pa'i sku// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan skyes de// bla ma'i mos gus ma gtogs pa// yig nag rgya mtsho 'bri ba dang*// dpag med 'gro ba smin pa'i thabs// rdzas dang yo byad ka ca rnams// chos rje mgon po bla ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa mi 'grub par// phyi dang nang gi rta rgyug dang*// gsang ba'i rta rgyug 'dre res 'dis// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// yon tan bskyed pa ga la srid// bla ma dam pa bzhugs bzhin du// lus ngag yid gsum srog gis kyang*// bla ma dam pa mnyes byas nas// longs spyod g.yo ba'i dngos po la// snying po len par mi byed cing*// yig nag rta rgyug byed pa rnams// wa la za mi nga re na// bsam gyin tshig pa mi za re// mgo log po la cho re re// dam tshig snying nas byed pa'i mi// shākya'i sras po rnal 'byor pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma gnyen gcig pu// khyed kyis rang gzhan thams cad kyi// don du bdag la shin tu bsams// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas// chos ldan rdo rje ri bo yis// sgrib gsum nyes pa'i tshogs bcom pas// thub pas byang chub shing drung du// tho rangs byang chub 'tshang rgya tshe// srod la bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung*// gong ma'i gnad 'di thams cad la// yul dang yul can gnyis med cing*// nyes tshogs sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*// gnyen po ye shes gnyis med par// nyams su blangs pas rnam par dag

/snying gtam tshig gcig smras pa 'dis// mtho dman zer mchu'i gdams chung tshogs// brdzun tshig mun nag 'thibs pa yang*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar bas sel// bla ma dam pa'i bka' bstsal dang*// rang gi nyams su myong ba dang*// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi// bsdus pa'i snying po bla med 'di// thugs la bzhag la nyams su blang*// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// thub dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// ma lus thams cad rdzogs par shog /zab mo yi ger bris pa la// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na/ /thugs rje chen po dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlabs cing bzod par bzhes// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// tshe 'di dang bar do dang phyi mar rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i gdams ngag nyes tshogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen shākya rgyal pos zhus pa rdzogs so// // 309) ༄// byang chub kyi sems dang ldan na lha klu sogs kyis mthun 'gyur byed par bstan pa// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// nges par skyabs su song ba rnams// chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// byang chub sems dang ma bral na// 'dzam gling bdag po klu yi rje// byang chub sems dpa' ma dros pas// rgyal sras ltogs drir ga la gsod// dga' bo nyer dga' 'jog po dang*// mtha' yas dung skyong rgya mtsho che// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// rgyal ba'i sras rnams skyong bar nges// yul 'khor skyong dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs// sangs rgyas sras po 'gro ba'i mgon// skyes chen bdag nyid chen po rnams// ston pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs pas na// rgyal sras ltogs drir ga la gsod// sum cu rtsa gsum chos kyi rje// lha dbang rgyal po kau'u shi ka

/rgyal sras bden mthong lung bstan thob// 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gcig pu nyid// rgyal sras thugs kyis 'dzin par nges// mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa che// khyab 'jug dbang phyug chen po dang*// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i skyabs gnas mchog /rgyal sras bsod nams gzi brjid can// chos skyong srung ma mthu bo che// ci 'dod 'grub pa'i bdag nyid rnams// rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad la// spyan ras mi gzigs ga la srid// 'grangs par zo la ngoms par 'thung*// nyin mtshan med par dge sbyor mdzod// kha zas rnal 'byor gtsigs su che// khong lha yi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i tshe// khong gnod pa med pa tsam re mdzod// prang prang gzhan gyi kha na med// nor sgrub bsod nams 'di na gda'o// // 310) ༄// sangs rgyas kyi 'das lo dang bstan pa'i gnas tshad paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gsung du nges pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bla ma yi dam dang*// ma lus bla med dkon mchog gsum// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dge ba'i bshes// kun kyi zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur dge ba'i bshes// lnga rig mkhas pa shākya shrī// rdo rje gdan sogs yul dbus kyi// bstan pa'i mnga' dag gnas brtan mchog /rgyal po sing ga la rigs kyis// gces par 'dzin pas bstan pa 'di// ji tsam gnas pa rtsis pa yi// lugs su mkhas pa chen pos gsungs// smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi// tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la// zla ba ri bo la nub tshe// thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das// de rjes lo ni stong phrag cig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang*// zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed// de bzhin nyin mo lnga rab 'das// lo ni stong phrag gsum dag dang*// nyis brgya dang ni bzhi bcu dgu// zla dgu dang ni nyin mo bcu// ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lhag mar gnas// zhes pa me mo yos kyi lo/ (1207) /dpyid zla 'bring po'i gral tshes lnga'i nyin mo/

yar lung sol nag thang thang po che zhes kyang zer gi gtsug lag khang chen por/ chos kyi rje paṇḍi ta chen po kha che shākya shrīs rtsis pa lags so// bdag gi rnam par rtog pa la// ston pa mya ngan 'das 'og tu// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa byung*// dgung lo drug brgya'i bar du bzhugs// 'phags pa'i slob ma zla ba grags// de sras rig pa'i khu byug gis// a ti sha la dbu ma bshad// ston pa mya ngan 'das 'og tu// lo ni dgu brgya lhag tsam na// slob dpon chen po thogs med byung*// lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho// thogs med slob ma dbyig gi gnyen// de sras 'phags pa rnam grol sde// de bzhin so skye rnam grol sde// rab mchog sde dang dul ba'i sde// bai ro tsa na'i sde yis ni// seng ge bzang po nyid la bshad// de yis ratna pha la la// des kyang ghu na mai tri la// de yis gser gling pa la bshad// des kyang a ti sha la gsungs// brgyud pa mang dang nyung na yang*// don gyis legs par dpyad pa las// chos rje paṇa chen gsung du nges// 'di la dga' ba chen po skyes// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bdag cag bsgrub pa byed pa rnams// 'bras bu rgya chen thob pa la// mkhas pa dga' ba cis mi skye// slob dpon chen po 'bum ṭig mkhan pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ lo lnga stong gi bar du dam pa'i chos gnas par 'gyur te/ de la lo lnga brgya phrag bcu yod de/ lnga brgya phrag dang po la dam pa'i chos spyod pa rnams phal cher dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur la/ gnyis pa la phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur la/ gsum pa la lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur ba mang ba ste/ lnga brgya phrag gsum po de dag gi tshe ni chos rtogs shing 'bras bu thob pa mang ba'i tshigs zhes bya'o// lnga brgya bzhi pa la ni lhag mthong gi shas che zhing shes rab rno ba mang ngo*// lnga pa la ni zhi gnas shas che ste/

ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa mang ngo*// drug pa la ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa mang ste/ lnga brgya phrag gsum po de dag gi tshe ni/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgom zhing tshul khrims dang ldan pa mang bas bsgrub pa dang ldan pa'i tshigs zhes bya'o// lnga brgya phrag bdun pa la mngon par dar bar 'gyur/ brgyad pa la mdo sde dar bar 'gyur/ dgu pa la 'dul ba dar bar 'gyur te/ lnga brgya phrag gsum po de dag la bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i sde snod gsum pa la brten cing lung la spyod pa mang bas lung gi tshigs zhes bya'o// lnga brgya phrag bcu pa la sde snod gsum la yang brtson par mi byed/ chos bshad pa rnams kyang gzhung las bshad pa bzhin du legs par nyams 'og tu mi chud/ mtshan ma tsam zhig spyod pa mang bas mtshan ma tsam gyi tshigs zhes bya ste/ de ltar lnga brgya phrag bcu'i mtha' ma 'di la phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya mtha' ma zhes bya'o// de'i dus su yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba mang nyung tsam du gsungs pa las/ 'bras bu mi thob pa ni ma gsungs te/ zla ba snying po'i mdo las/ bstan pa nub pa'i dus su yang dgra bcom pa des pa 'byung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yong mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par yong mi 'gyur// gsungs pa lags na/ gdul bya smin pa dang grol ba rgyun chad par ga la 'gyur te/ tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su yang rgyal po rdo rta can dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon pos tshe lo brgyad khri'i bar du 'khrid ces grags pa dang*/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'phags pa rgyun mi 'chad pa las shes par bya'o// //

311) ༄// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas gshin po yar 'dren tshogs rdzogs bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rtag lta shid kyi nyes sbyang phyir// bdag gis yi ge 'di brtsam bya// shid pha ma mchod pa bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gro ba dang*/ pha ma pha rol tu pha ma rang du yod par lta ba log lta yin pa dang*/ thabs 'khor gsum gyi byed pas yan man du 'gro ba bstan pa'o// de la dang po'i tshogs su 'gro ba ni/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang*// zhes pa'i don/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis byas pa shes shing byas pa drin du bzo ba las/ byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems skye bas sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bstan pa dang*/ chos dkon mchog de nyid thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge ba/ thub pa'i chos de las gzhan med par bstan pas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bstan pa'o// pha ma'am shi ba de pha rol tu ma shi ba bzhin du yod par lta ba ni rtag lta ste/ gang zag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang*// de yi rnam par smin pa mi bzad ldan// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ log par lta ba gti mug gi rjes su 'brangs pa 'khor ba dang ngan song 'ba' zhig yin te/ pha ma dge ba dang mi dge ba'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs su pha rol tu skye la/ dge ba byas na snga ma'i bsam pa dge ba'i stobs 'phel nas rgyu rkyen gnyis 'dzoms pas/ thar pa gong nas gong du 'phar zhing thob pa dang*/ yang shi khar dge ba'i bsam pa phra yang nye du gnyen 'brel gyis kho'i ched du dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pas/ lha'i dbang po nor bu dri ma med pas dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pas/ mnar med pa dga' ldan du skyes nas/ sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar gyur par gsungs pa dang*/ rtag par lta ba ni/ pha ma bsam pa'i rang gzugs su gyur nas/ rigs drug mtho dman du skyes zin pa la/ ma shes pa gti mug gi dbang du song bas rta bsad pas pha ma'i bzhon par re ba dang*/

zas nor btang bas za rgyu dang nor du 'ong du re nas chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi bsam pas mi dge ba rnam pa gsum gyi stobs 'phel ba/ gshin po'i mi dge ba'i bsam pas rgyu/ rkyen 'dir mi dge ba chen po byas pas rgyu rkyen gnyis 'dzoms nas mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen por skye ba dang*/ shi ba de la dge ba'i bsam pa cung zad yod kyang*/ rkyen kho'i ched du mi dge ba'i las byas pas dge ba'i bsam pa phra mo bcom na yang dmyal bar skye ba/ sngags pa dam nyams pas mnar med du skyes pa lta bu yin pas/ log par lta ba spang bar bstan pa'o// de la zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yo ga'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la 'bad par bya'o// de yang ji ltar bya zhe na/ dang po kho nar zhing rnam par dag pa dkon mchog gi spyan sngar gtad yar gyi phud la shid byed pa'i snga nub bam/ zhag gsum mam bdun la sogs kyang rung ste/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ 'byung po'i gtor ma/ long sprang gi yon/ bdun tshigs rgyas bsdus rnam pa gsum gang yang rung ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ phyi de nyin par rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po mdun du bsags pa/ bsang po dang*/ 'brang rgyas dang*/ gtad yar gyi dngos po 'di don gtor ma yin pas/ ji ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med/ yul de'i lugs gang yin pa bshams nas/ rnal 'byor pas 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa de dag gis gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa gnas skabs dang mthar thug sdug bsngal dang bral ba gnas skabs dang mthar thug byang chub gnas skabs dang mthar thug rnam pa gsum go ba'i shes rab kyi rjes su 'brangs nas 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor mas/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa gtad yar bya ba'i yul de la sogs pa/

khams gsum gyi sems can ma lus pa rang gi lhag pa'i lhar byas pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum lhar byas pa la mchod pa rnam pa lnga sngon du 'gro bas gtad yar thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan phyi nang gsang gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pas spyir mchod nas/ 'di'i phad phud mar gyi mtshan ma ji ltar 'os pa dkon mchog la mar me 'bul/ sum cha la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa gtor ma dgu'i cha rkyen du bzhag g.yang khu ye bdag po la ci 'os sbyin/ sum cha la der 'dus pa rnams la tshogs sog tswa ru'i ston mo bya/ sha'i rigs dang zan la sogs pa'i cha nyung zad cig bar do'i shes pa dri za bar bshad pas gsur bya bar gal che/ shin tu gal che ba cho ga thon pa'i rjes la bsreg gtor ma dgu'i brgyad po 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor mas snga ma bzhin du 'bul/ gcig kha 'bar mas gshin po dang yon bdag gi lan chags la 'bul/ de ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni dge 'dun rnams kyis zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang las mdo tshar re klag de dang dus mnyam du rgyun bshags gsum pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i bkra shis brjod nas bkra shis pa'i mthun 'gyur bya/ de'i rjes la yon phul nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i mthus/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i yon tan 'byung tshul de kho na ltar khong du chud par bya'o// gtor ma'i sbyor ba/ shid kyi bya lugs yul mtha' la sogs par bya ba'i rim pa/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i man ngag 'di sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyis/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig

de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig/ // 312) ༄// dpal chen shrī phug par ring 'tsho snyun rmed kyi bstod phrin a khu dge bshes bya ba// skyes chen gang zhig dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs byang chub bla na med pa brnyes// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad med par rtag pa'i sku// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /mnyam med bla ma de yi sras gyur pa// rin chen de dang gnyis med gyur pa yi// dpal chen shrī ri phug par rnam grags pa// ring du 'tshor gyur snyun rmed cung zad bri// 'dir sras kyi dam pa phyogs nas 'grul pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ thugs kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin du rdzogs par mdzad pa nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu/ a khu dge bshes pa la smras pa/ sku khams shin tu bde zhes bgyi bar khums/ de bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad la bka' drin che/ de yang bde bar gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dpag med bskal par tshogs gnyis bsags pa yis// dpag med phun sum tshogs pa'i rigs su 'khrungs// dang por bltams nas mtha' ma'i dus kyi bar// chos kyi rgyal po'i byang chub mtha' dag mdzad// ston pa'i bstan la bslab gsum rin chen gyis// rang gzhan smin mdzad yon tan rgya mtsho brnyes// thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud smin gyur pas// skyes chen khyed ni rtag tu bde bar bzhugs// gang gi rigs su 'khrungs pa'i bstan pa'i gtso// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan de nyid kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par gyur// thugs rje phul byung gdung rgyud 'dzin mdzad pas// skyes chen khyod ni shin tu bde bar bzhugs// bla med theg par rang dbang man ngag rgyud// rgyal bas lung bstan 'brel bar bcas pa rnams// thugs su chud cing mun pa mi mnga' bas// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal bde bar bzhugs// thog ma bar dang mthar dge bsil ldan pas// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la rgyas 'dra ba'i// dam chos rnam dag dri ma med pa yis// gzhan rgyud tshim mdzad khyod ni bde bar bzhugs// nyid ni bla mar gyur pa gang la yang*// bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du rab gzigs nas// sgrub pa'i mchod pa yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// chu snod gcig nas gcig tu ji bzhin par// lus pa med par thugs kyi padmor bkang*// de don snying por gyur pa'i bdud rtsi yis// dpag med smin mdzad khyod ni bde bar bzhugs// mnyes pa gsum du rnam grags zhabs tog las// rtag tu ngu 'am nor bzang ji bzhin du// g.yog dang bran du nyid kyis zhal bzhes nas// gong ma khur chen bsam gyis mi khyab pas// khur du bzhes nas rgya mtsho lta bu yi// dge 'dun rnams dang ma lus sems can gyi// don chen bsgrub pa khyed ni bde bar bzhugs// nam mkha' mdzod dang kun bzang rnam 'phrul ltar// phun sum tshogs pa'i dgos 'dod bsam yas pa// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad med pa yis// bdag gi bsam pa rtag tu rdzogs mdzad cing*// gong ma mchod cing 'og ma skyong ba dang*// mnyam pa mgu bar gnas pa khyod kyi drin// skyes chen khyod kyi thugs la mi bde med// bde bar bzhugs pa khyed ni rtag tu bde// sa steng 'dzam bu gling 'dir 'jigs chen byung*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs// ngan song gnyis dang dmyal ba ji bzhin pa'i// rab 'bar gnas su bzhugs kyang padmo bzhin// mgon po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen dang rdo rje bsnams// spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon ltar khyod ni mgon// mgon po mgon gyur 'gro ba'i mgon po khyod// bstod pa rgya mtshos bstod pa khyod nyid ni// bde bar gyur cing thugs bde bde bar bzhugs// skyes chen khyed nyid 'di ltar bder bzhugs shing*// bdag gi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu rnams// phal cher chos dang mthun zhing bder bzhugs pa// padma'i tshal ltar tshul khrims rgyan gyis mdzes// lhun po'i ri bzhin ting 'dzin g.yo ba med// rgyal ba'i 'od ltar shes rab rnam dag cing*// sems nyid rin chen drug gis phyug gyur pas// bdag kyang deng sang shin tu bde bar mchis// bar skabs lo rgyus cung zad snyan gsol ba// bya byed spros pa'i mtshan mas g.yengs gyur cing*// gti mug me yis rang nyid bsregs pa dang*// 'od kyis gzhan rgyud bsregs pa rigs min kyang*// snying dang 'dra ba gong ma'i rten mchog rnams// re ba chen pos bdag la phul ba rnams// 'thor bar gyur pa snying gis ma bzod nas// gdung rten mchog cig deng 'dir bgyis pa 'dis// rang dbang med pa rgya mtsho'i gru bzhin du// spros pa'i g.yeng bas rnam par g.yeng yang dogs// rgya mtsho chen por klu dbang char pa bzhin// spros pa nyer zhir 'ong du re 'ang mchis// gang ltar bgyis kyang mi bya dbang med pa'i// gdung rten legs par bgyis pa 'di nyid kyis// rten mchog bla na med pa'i gzhal yas khang*// shel dang bai ḍūrya dang gser dang ni// shel gdar me shel tsan dan gor shi ṣa// gyi dhan dngul khri la sogs rin chen rnams// snying po yang snying rten gyi snod du bgyis// bla ma gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par thugs dgongs pa// legs par grub pa 'bras bus rgyu dpag pas// thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa rdzogs pa lags// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed ba dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 313) ༄// phyi nang bar gsum gyi bar chad zhi ba bcu chos gsum chos las med par thag chod pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan ri khrod pas/ bla ma yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dpal chen po'i spyan sngar gdams pa/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad dang rnam pa gsum du gsungs pa yin la/ de gsum la gang yin pa brtag pa dang*/ brtags nas bzlog pa dang*/ bzlog pas yon tan skyes pa'i rim pa dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs shing*/ khyad par du yi dam gyi lha zhal mthong ba la sogs pa'i rim pa la/ brda dang brda'i lan dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ de thams cad kyi don/ bslu ba med pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa'i gdams ngag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa/ phyi nang gnad kyi rten brel/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang tshig bcu chos dang sum chos ma gtogs pa gzhan ma mchis par thugs thag rbad kyis chod/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga'i chos ni rigs pa'i spobs pa dang*/ 'brel ba'i spobs pa dang*/ don dang ldan pa'i spobs pa dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad las 'phags shing khyad zhugs pa'i spobs pa mtha' dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung du shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ don gyi gnad kyang sangs rgyas bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi gsung dang*/ chos dang byin gyis brlabs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du shes par bya ba ni don gyi gnad 'brel ba zab mo/ rigs pa dang bcas pa yin par shes par bya ba dang*/ bdag nyid kyis nyams su myong zhing khong du chud pa'i don ni bslu ba med pa/

ston pas gsungs pa bla ma dam pa'i bka' snang ba rang gi sems/ yul gang byang chub sems su shes// byang chub sems su mthong gyur na// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis// rang nyid byin gyis rlob pa dang*// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po la// phrag dog drag po'i bsam pa yis// log par ltas pa'i lhas byin ni// rnyed dang bkur sti rgyun chad nas// mnar med dmyal bar 'tshed 'gyur pa// thams cad 'di dang 'di 'dra zhes// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub// gang phyir bdag cag thams cad kyi// skyob mdzad skyob pa'i mgon gcig pu// slob dpon 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang*// mgon po de yis byin brlabs shing*// skyob pas skyabs pa 'di nyid ni// skyob mdzad mgon po 'di nyid la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// gus pas mchod cing rtag tu mchod// gzigs pa de nyid de yin par// nges pa'i shes pa skye ba'i tshul// mgon po de yi byin rlabs kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang yang*// bye brag nyid kyi dam chos kyis// nged kyi sems rgyud smin pa dang*// rnam par grol bar gyur pa 'di// bla ma de yi bka' drin yin// phongs shing nyam ngar gyur pa'i tshe// skyob par mdzad pa dam tshig yin// ngo mtshar che 'o rgyal ba'i sras// rmad du byung ngo rigs kyi bu// nges shes skyes so e ma ho// bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba bla na med pa yis// slob dpon 'phags pa'i thugs dgongs mchog /thams cad byang chub mchog thob shog /rdzogs so// // 314) ༄// kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems gnyis kyi tshul ber ston la gdams pa//

slad mar zhal nas gsungs pa'i don// gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa zhu zhes pa// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kun// byang chub sems las byung ba yin// de la rnam pa gnyis yod de// dang po kun rdzob byang chub sems// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams// bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob par// bdag gis bya zhes dam bcas nas// g.yo sgyu med pa'i lhag bsam gyis// lus ngag yid gsum ma lus pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di// 'dzin dang srung dang skyong ba des// dus gsum rgyal ba mchod pa dang*// sems can ma lus smin pa dang*// bla med byang chub thob pa lags// zab dang rgya che dpag dka' ba// bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas pas// bsngo ba bla na med pa 'di// ston pa thugs rje chen po yis// zab pa shes rab pha rol phyin// rgya che sangs rgyas phal chen las// bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba ma lus thams cad kyis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob gyur cig /'di don nges par bsam byas nas// yang yang bsngo ba gang yin pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob ces// ston pa thugs rje can gyis gsungs// kye ho don dam byang chub sems// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// slob dpon chen po tilli la// don dam gang zhes zhus pa las// kye ho 'di ni rang rig ste// ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul min// tilli nga yis bstan du med// rang rig nyid las shes te byos// bla ma dam pas gsungs pa'i don// dpal ldan tilli'i chos drug la// blo dang bral bar nyams su blang*// spros dang bral bar rang gi sems// nyams su myong bar the tshom med// kye ho nyams su blang pa'i tshul// khyed kyi bla ma gong ma rnams// rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// tshong 'dus 'o mar ma song zhing*// snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang*// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa dang*// thugs rgyud phyin ci ma log pas// thugs kyi padmor rab bkang ba// rgyun chad med par bsgom par zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ber ston la/// / 315) ༄// 'chi ba blu ba'i gdams ngag chos lngar 'dus pa ska ldam pa la gnang ba// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis// 'chi bdag gzhom pa'i gdams ngag gsungs// de la dang por 'chi ba'i rtags// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi 'chi ltas bzhi// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// mgon po de yi bka' bstsal gyis// 'chi ba bslu ba'i gdams ngag kyang*// mang po zhig tu bka' bstsal yang*// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// chos lnga dag tu ma 'dus med// de yang dang por lam du btang*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// de rjes 'di la zab pa'i gnad// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog la// yang dang yang du nan tan bya// de nas rang nyid yi dam lhar// rgyun chad med par nan tan bsgom// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// bla ma mchog la mos gus bya// stong nyid bde chen dam pa ni// 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog tu gsungs// grub thob gong mas gsungs pas na// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// lar gyis lar gyis lar gyis na// bslu thabs gnyen po dpag med kyang*// gnad kyi ting 'dzin 'ba' zhig la// skad cig tsam yang ma yengs par// nan tan chen pos ma bsgom na// gzhan gyis phan pa'i nyams myong med// phan pa yin no yin no zer// nyams myong med pa'i dam chos la// glo gtad snying gzhag byed ma nus// nyams su myong ba'i man ngag la// nan tan chen pos yang yang bsgom// bdag kyang 'chi bdag khar chud cing*// 'chi bar nges pa mang po zhig /dge 'dun mthun pa'i thugs dam gyis// sos par gyur pa myong bas grub// des na khyed kyi bu slob rnams// brtson 'grus chen pos bsgom du chug /'dir yang dge 'dun rgya mtsho tshogs// thugs dam rtse gcig zhu ba 'bul// byed min mi byed ma yin zhing*// the ma rkyang gi lo chos kyis// mi tshe 'das par byas na yang*// shi min gson min yun ring zhig

/nad kyis mnar nas 'chi bar 'dug /brtson 'grus 'bad pa drag po yis// nan tan chen pos bsgom gyur na// skag dang dbang thang rtsod pa yis// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gong nas gong du khyad par 'gyur// tha mal 'khor ba'i srog bcad nas// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob// ska ldam pa// // 316) ༄// mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa// lha na mo/ 'gro ba'i bla ma bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba rjes bzung ba'i// smon lam mthar phyin byang chub mchog brnyes pa// skyob mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// glang po padma nyi ma'i gdan steng na// bai ḍūrya yi mdog 'dra mtshan dpes brgyan// dkyil krung mnyam gzhag sa gnon phyag rgya can// rnam dag sku mnga' de la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi thugs las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus rnam sbyangs nas// bla med sa la 'god pa'i gnyen gcig pu// yon tan rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang sems can rnams// dbyer med gcig pas mtshan tsam thos pa yang*// nyes tshogs spangs nas 'tshang rgyar gdon mi za// phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o bskyab tu gsol// // 317) ༄// snying po don gyi zhus lan gsang chen yi ge zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ 'khor 'das bdag po mnyam med rin po che// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dam pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// bdag nyid chen po'i gsung lan bri bar bya// snying po'i don ni snying po nyid yin de// snying po'i don thob gzhan la re ba med// 'bras bu snying po lo tog legs gyur na// 'dod pa med kyang ji ltar phub sogs bzhin// rang dbang med par shugs las byung ba yin// rang gi rig pa ji ltar yod pa 'di// bcos sgyur med pa gang gis go gyur na// nyi mas mun pa sel ba ji bzhin du// skyon rnams bsal bzhag med par dag nas 'gro// yon tan 'dod pa med kyang ngang gis 'byung*// sems kyi yul du byas pa'i dam chos 'dis// nyid kyis ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du// ri dwags smig rgyu'i chu bor snyog dang mtshungs// rang sems rgya mtshor sgoms shig rnal 'byor pa// 'di las gzhan pa thams cad don med ces// sems kyi de nyid de nyid rang gi gsung*// sems kyi de nyid snying po 'di go na// tshig dang yi ge bzlo brjod thams cad kun// phyi shun sbun pa nyid du nges nas mchi// sbun pa dag la snying po ga la re// don 'di bla ma rin chen gyis// ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// bcom ldan dgyes pa'i rdo rje nas// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bstan pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// ston pas gsungs pa de yi don// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// dus mtha' chos sku'i 'du shes bskyed// nges shes skye ba dka' gyur na// bsod nams tshogs la nan tan bya// lus dang longs spyod yod tshad dang*// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// ltos pa med par rje la 'bul// lus dang longs spyod dge ba la'ang*// 'dzin pa med par gyur pa na// 'dzin pa med pa de nyid las// de las gzhan med 'od gsal don// brjod med lhan cig skyes pa de// e ma mngon du gyur pa 'di// e ma e ma ngo mtshar che// don 'di rtogs par gyur pa'i tshe// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// yod med spros dang spros med rnams// sems nyid ngang du ro gcig pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub de la bya// ma lus rdzogs pas rdzogs pa yin// don gyi gsang chen yi ge 'di// skyes bu dam pas nyams su longs// tshig gi sdeb sbyor ma byas shing*// don gyi snying po rin po che// phug tu ma bzhag rgyab tu ston// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// 'gro la phan pa'i don bsams pas// thugs dgongs rdzogs shing bzod par bzhes// 'gro bas byang chub mchog thob shog

/rdzogs so// // 318) ༄// gtor ma dang lha bshos bza' mi rung ba rung bar bsgyur thabs// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo dge ba'i bshes// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal// gdan sa rin chen mnga' bdag gis// bdag gi mtho dman spyod pa la// bka' bkyon zhe bkyon ma mdzad nas// dgyes par dgongs pa thugs la btags/ /gtor ma dang lha bshos za ba 'dis bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud du/ ngag gi nus pa thams cad 'jig pa dang*/ nyes pa dpag tu med pa 'byung bar gsungs/ bdag gi 'khor ltogs la/ ngan la/ mang thal bas gtor ma dang lha bshos za dgos su thal/ 'di la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ der dbang thob pa lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang ma bral bar byas nas/ gtor ma dang lha bshos rlung me bud sbar gyi sbyor pa gang yang rung ba'am/ rje sgam po pa'i rje btsun ma khams gsum ma'i gtor ma ltar legs par sbyangs nas/ rang dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi thog tu/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams la zhal zas kyi phud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog chos skyong la dang po 'bul/ de nas rang gi lus la bcug nas/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mchod par bsams nas/ legs par gsol ba'i rjes la/ lhag ma la/ oṃ u tsi ta hā ri de bhya swā hā// zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la mchod nas/ mdo'i dod la yi dam lha'i snying po dang bsngo ba bya'o// mdor na kha zas rnal 'byor nang gi gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsum gcig pa yin pas za tshad dang 'thung tshad de ltar bsgrub par bya'o// // 319) ༄// rnam par 'phrul ba'i 'bras bu la tha dad ma mchis pa sher 'byung la gdams pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// slob dpon rgyal po dgyes pas grol// 'phags pa thogs med snying rjes grol// gnas brtan grags pa skyugs pas grol// ta pa zhang sgom rtsib thur bsrung*// rgya stong ri pa mdze mgo za// dam chos gang yin ma shes zer// yongs grags 'di yang bden nam snyam// rmongs pa'i byis pas ma shes pas// bdag gi the tshom bsal bar zhu// de skad zhus pas 'di skad gsung*// bla ma rnam gnyis ngas mi shes// gong ma gsum gyi grol tshul ni// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// grol ba'i grol rgyu ma lags sam// 'chi ba bdag tu 'dzin pa las// grol bas grol ba ma lags sam// rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu la// gnyis med tha dad ma mchis pas// rnal 'byor rnams kyis go bar mdzod// de ltar min na dam pa gsum// rtag tu de ltar mdzad par thal// 'di la thub chen rgyal ba'i sras// ston pa'i byin rlabs zhugs gyur cing*// thos bsam bsgom pas rgyud sbyangs nas// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// gsung gis grol bas shes pa yin// log pa'i rjes 'brangs mu stegs pa// tshu rol mthong bas go ba min// bu go 'am shes sam dgos se kun// sher 'byung la//

// 320) ༄// bla ma lha pas sgrub pa'i mchod par nan tan mdzad par bsngags pa// oṃ swasti/ yul dbus gtsang gi sa'i cha/ mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' rigs gsum mgon po'i gdan sa/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i gzhi/ brtul zhugs kyi khur blangs shing grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi gnas/ slob dpon chen po padmas phrin las rnam pa bzhis gdug pa can thams cad btul ba'i yul/ gzhu stod ti sgro brag dkar/ 'bri gung se ba byang chub kyi gling nas/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs nyams su len pa/ shākya'i dge slong rin chen dpal gyis/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ snying por gyur pa'i bu gcig pu/ bla ma lha la springs pa/ khyed bla ma gong ma'i rnam par thar pas/ 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po bskyed par mdzad cing*/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag chos dang mthun pa yang dag par skyong zhing smin par mdzad ces khums/ de bdag dang bdag gi bla ma brgyud pa gong ma rnams la shin tu bka' drin che/ zhabs tog che/ phyogs gang nas kyang bkur sti dang zhabs tog de las che ba ma mchis/ de yang snga ma bzhin du thugs la btags nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu smin pa dang grol bar mdzad par zhu/ 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po yi// bla med bstan pa rin po che// thos dang bsam dang bsgom pa yis// thams cad dar zhing rgyas lags kyang*// nyams len snying por gyur pa yis// rang gzhan smin par gyur pa 'di// skyes chen 'ga' yi rnam thar tsam// yongs su grags pa'i kha skad la// khyed rang yab sras 'khor bcas rnams// sgrub pa snying por mdzad ces khums// de la kho bo dga' ba skyes// rgya la bden na dga' ba la// snyam pa'i bsam pa yang yang byung*// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur paṇḍi ta// lnga rig mkhas pa shākya shrīs// mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams na// mkhas so shes so zer ba de// shin tu mang bar gyur na yang*// nyams len byed pa mi gda' zhes// thugs mug thugs chad bka' bstsal zhes// yongs su grags pa bdag gis khums// khyed rang yab sras 'khor bcas kyis// sgrub la nan tan gces mdzad zhu// bdag gi zhabs 'bring zhabs tog kyang*// de las che ba med par dgongs// rdzas dang yo byad zhabs tog ni// 'dzam gling dngos po kun gyi bdag

/rgyal po chen po a cang ste// gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal srid ma lus thams cad kyis// bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pa bas// rab byung gcig la mnyes pa dang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs tog che ba de// rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad du// khyed kyis thugs su chud cing dgongs// rdzas dang yo byad bkur sti'i tshogs// nga la 'di ko bskur ba yis// bdag la 'dis ko ci zhig bya// dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// gnang zhing 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// gnang zhing 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// bla ma lha la gdams pa// // 321) ༄// bkra shis smon lam bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dad ldan rna ba'i dpyid 'jo// rang byung byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu nyams dga' ba// lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i ro la rol mdzad cing*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa thams cad bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod kyis rtag tu bde legs shog /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing dang nye ba'i zhing rnams na// dpa' bo rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang gyur pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus tshogs ni skems mdzad pa// dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs kyis rtag tu bde legs shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams// sras dang bcas pas yon tan rgya mtsho rab brjod cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med kyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma lus smin dang grol byed shog /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin mi rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi dpal dang bde skyid ma lus thams cad kyang*// khyod la brten nas shin tu rgyas shing bkra shis 'byung*// bde ba'i 'byung gnas khyed kyis rtag tu bde legs shog /rdo rje 'chang chen dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku// dbyer med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med// mgon po gdod nas byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/sems kyi lha tshogs lus kyi dkyil 'khor nas// gdod nas ma skyes 'gag pa med pa rnams// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i gnas mchog tu// rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma'i bkra shis shog /rang byung dkyil 'khor phag mo'i padma la// dpal ldan rdo rje gnyis med bzhugs pa yi// rin chen rgyal po bde chen 'khor lo nas// mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /lhan cig skyes pa nam mkha'i gzhal yas nas// yul dang yul can dbyer med rol pa yi// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma sogs kyis// bla med thugs kyi dbang phyug bkra shis shog /gsung gi 'khor los sa steng khyab gyur cing*// myu gu can dang sa srung mkha' 'gro mas// ma chags padma'i dngos grub bkra shis shog /ngan 'gro'i srid pa rnam sbyong bde ba'i mchog /stobs po che dang shugs can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// gti mug dag pa ye shes lha tshogs kyis// dngos grub chen po'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// dam tshig 'khor lor gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// sna tshogs phrin las thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams// tha mal kun rtog 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// grub mchog khyed kyis sgrol ba'i bkra shis shog /'khor 'das ma lus khyab bdag mkha' 'gro ma// sum cu rtsa bdun thabs dang dbyer med pas// dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su// ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang bde legs su gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ maṅgalaṃ/ bhawantu/ shu bhaṃ/// /
